abstract: Rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) support affordable disease diagnosis. Machine learning (ML) can improve RDT interpretation but often relies on large, proprietary, and costly real-world image libraries. We present SynSight – a ML-enabled RDT segmentation and classification pipeline trained on synthetic data. Validated on HIV (98% sensitivity, 99% specificity) and COVID-19 RDTs (up to 99% accuracy), SynSight enables rapid ML training without real-world training images, keeping pace with new RDT development.

title: Weakly supervised deep learning predicts perineural invasion from H&E whole-slide images in tongue squamous cell carcinoma: development and external validation.
source: PubMed · International journal of medical informatics
zh_title: 弱监督深度学习从H&E全切片预测舌鳞癌神经侵犯
summary: 两中心回顾性研究开发弱监督全切片模型预测舌鳞癌神经侵犯，并在独立外部队列验证。

abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Perineural invasion (PNI) in tongue squamous cell carcinoma (TSCC) is associated with aggressive behavior and poor outcomes, yet it can be under-recognized on H&E sections because it is often focal and interpretation varies. Manual assessment of PNI suffers from significant interobserver variability, motivating AI-based decision support. We developed and externally validated a weakly supervised WSI model to predict PNI in TSCC. We retrospectively analyzed 1,511 digitized H&E whole-slide images from 629 patients at two centers. Patient-level partitioning yielded an internal training cohort of 305 patients and 787 WSIs, an internal validation cohort of 132 patients and 340 WSIs, and an external test cohort of 192 patients and 384 WSIs. Non-overlapping tiling generated 41,552,500 candidate patches before tissue-background exclusion, of which 7,813,555 unique tissue patches were retained for analysis. A two-stage pipeline was used: patch-level modeling and MIL-based slide aggregation. ResNet50 was selected over Inception_v3 and SimpleViT as the feature extractor. Patch-level prediction probabilities and image features were aggregated into a 101-dimensional patch likelihood histogram (PLH) and a 101-dimensional visual bag-of-words (BoW) representation, respectively. For conventional classifiers, the two representations were concatenated into a 202-dimensional vector, followed by z-score normalization and LASSO feature selection. For the Transformer, the two representations were processed separately using PCA, independently projected into 128-dimensional embedding spaces, and integrated using four-head cross-attention. Performance was assessed by ROC, decision curve analysis (DCA), and calibration. The internal training, internal validation, and external test cohorts included 305, 132, and 192 patients, respectively. PNI prevalence was 82.3%, 79.5%, and 72.9% in these cohorts, respectively. The Transformer fusion model achieved AUCs of 0.990 in the training cohort, 0.968 in the internal validation cohort, and 0.940 in the external test cohort. Calibration and decision curve analysis were used to characterize the model's predicted probabilities and modeled net benefit in the retrospective study cohorts. Patch-level Grad-CAM was used to generate qualitative saliency visualisations associated with ResNet50 patch-level PNI scores. This externally validated computational pathology application demonstrated retrospective technical feasibility for WSI-level PNI predicti
zh_abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] 舌鳞状细胞癌（TSCC）中的神经周围侵犯（PNI）与侵袭性行为和不良结局相关，但由于其常为局灶性且判读存在差异，在 H&E 切片上可能被低估。PNI 的人工评估存在显著的观察者间变异，促使采用基于 AI 的决策支持。我们开发并外部验证了一种弱监督 WSI 模型，用于预测 TSCC 中的 PNI。我们回顾性分析了来自两个中心 629 名患者的 1,511 张数字化 H&E 全切片图像（WSI）。患者水平划分得到内部训练队列 305 名患者和 787 张 WSI、内部验证队列 132 名患者和 340 张 WSI，以及外部测试队列 192 名患者和 384 张 WSI。非重叠切块在排除组织-背景前生成 41,552,500 个候选图像块，其中保留 7,813,555 个唯一组织图像块用于分析。采用两阶段流程：图像块级建模和基于 MIL 的切片聚合。选择 ResNet50 而非 Inception_v3 和 SimpleViT 作为特征提取器。图像块级预测概率和图像特征分别聚合为 101 维图像块似然直方图（PLH）和 101 维视觉词袋（BoW）表示。对于传统分类器，两种表示拼接为 202 维向量，随后进行 z-score 归一化和 LASSO 特征选择。对于 Transformer，两种表示分别使用 PCA 处理，独立投影到 128 维嵌入空间，并使用四头交叉注意力进行整合。通过 ROC、决策曲线分析（DCA）和校准评估性能。内部训练、内部验证和外部测试队列分别包括 305、132 和 192 名患者。这些队列中 PNI 患病率分别为 82.3%、79.5% 和 72.9%。Transformer 融合模型在训练队列、内部验证队列和外部测试队列中分别达到 AUC 0.990、0.968 和 0.940。使用校准和决策曲线分析来表征模型在回顾性研究队列中的预测概率和建模净获益。使用图像块级 Grad-CAM 生成与 ResNet50 图像块级 PNI 评分相关的定性显著性可视化。这项经外部验证的计算病理学应用在回顾性研究中证明了 WSI 水平 PNI 预测的技术可行性

abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping cardiovascular medicine by transforming routinely collected clinical data into tools for earlier disease detection and more precise phenotyping. Heart failure (HF) represents a particularly compelling opportunity for AI-driven innovation, as many patients with structural heart disease remain unrecognized and traditional diagnostic frameworks often fail to capture disease heterogeneity. AI-enabled electrocardiogram (ECG) models, including EchoNext and PRESENT-SHD, highlight the potential for scalable opportunistic screening strategies for structural heart disease. Multimodal approaches, using ECGs and echocardiograms, are enabling earlier recognition of specific HF phenotypes, such as transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis. Successful implementation of these technologies will require prospective evaluation, thoughtful workflow integration, and responsible deployment. Early-career cardiologists are uniquely positioned to lead this transformation of AI in clinical medicine, ensuring that AI serves as a tool to augment clinical reasoning and ultimately advances more personalized, patient-centered cardiovascular care.
zh_abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] 人工智能（AI）正在重塑心血管医学，将常规收集的临床数据转化为更早发现疾病和更精准表型分型的工具。心力衰竭（HF）为AI驱动的创新提供了尤其有吸引力的机会，因为许多结构性心脏病患者仍未被识别，而传统诊断框架往往无法捕捉疾病异质性。AI赋能的心电图（ECG）模型，包括 EchoNext 和 PRESENT-SHD，凸显了针对结构性心脏病开展可扩展机会性筛查策略的潜力。使用ECG和超声心动图的多模态方法正在使特定HF表型（如转甲状腺素蛋白心脏淀粉样变性）的更早识别成为可能。这些技术的成功实施将需要前瞻性评估、审慎的工作流程整合和负责任的部署。处于职业生涯早期的心脏病科医生具有独特优势，可引领AI在临床医学中的这一转变，确保AI作为增强临床推理的工具，并最终推动更加个性化、以患者为中心的心血管诊疗。

title: Artificial intelligence for cerebrovascular digital subtraction angiography: methods, evidence, and challenges.
source: PubMed · Physics in medicine and biology
zh_title: 脑血管数字减影血管造影AI方法、证据与挑战综述
summary: 该结构式主题综述汇总AI在2D、三维旋转及4D DSA脑血管图像分析中的方法、证据与验证差异。
key_points: 覆盖2D DSA、3D旋转造影与4D DSA
指出证据分散于不同任务、数据集与验证策略
为结构化主题综述，非原始研究
reason: 综述类文章上限6分，覆盖面广但无新证据，属值得一看档
abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] Cerebrovascular diseases remain a major cause of mortality and long-term disability worldwide. Digital subtraction angiography (DSA) provides high-spatiotemporal-resolution visualization of cerebrovascular anatomy and contrast-agent dynamics and plays an important role in diagnosis, interventional treatment planning, and treatment assessment. Artificial intelligence (AI) has increasingly been applied to cerebrovascular DSA, yet the available evidence is distributed across diverse imaging settings, technical tasks, datasets, and validation strategies. This structured topical review provides a DSA-centered overview of AI-assisted cerebrovascular image analysis across 2D DSA, three-dimensional rotational angiography, and four-dimensional DSA. Literature from Web of Science Core Collection and major engineering databases was screened at title, abstract, and full-text levels using predefined eligibility criteria. The literature is organized around six interconnected tasks: image preprocessing, vessel and lesion segmentation, image registration, reconstruction and generation, disease diagnosis and detection, and hemodynamic analysis. Representative conventional and learning-based methods are reviewed together with their datasets, evaluation metrics, validation designs, and available data or code resources, with particular attention to the strength and limitations of the supporting evidence. Recent studies demonstrate increasing use of spatiotemporal modeling, deep learning, and image-generation techniques, but clinical translation remains constrained by small or single-center datasets, heterogeneous acquisition protocols and evaluation practices, limited external and prospective validation, model interpretability, and deployment requirements. Future work should emphasize acquisition-aware and physics-informed modeling, multicenter and privacy-preserving collaboration, clinically meaningful validation, and closer integration with neurointerventional workflows. By linking methodological developments with their supporting evidence and translational challenges, this review aims to support the development of more robust and clinically applicable AI methods for cerebrovascular DSA.
zh_abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] 脑血管疾病仍然是全球死亡和长期残疾的主要原因。数字减影血管造影（DSA）可提供脑血管解剖结构和对比剂动力学的高时空分辨率可视化，并在诊断、介入治疗计划和治疗评估中发挥重要作用。人工智能（AI）已越来越多地应用于脑血管 DSA，但现有证据分散于不同的成像环境、技术任务、数据集和验证策略中。这篇结构化专题综述以 DSA 为中心，概述了二维 DSA、三维旋转血管造影和四维 DSA 中 AI 辅助的脑血管图像分析。来自 Web of Science Core Collection 和主要工程数据库的文献使用预定义的合格标准在标题、摘要和全文层面进行筛选。文献围绕六项相互关联的任务进行组织：图像预处理、血管和病灶分割、图像配准、重建与生成、疾病诊断与检测以及血流动力学分析。综述了代表性的传统方法和基于学习的方法及其数据集、评价指标、验证设计以及可获取的数据或代码资源，特别关注支持证据的优势与局限性。近期研究表明，时空建模、深度学习和图像生成技术的使用日益增多，但临床转化仍受限于小型或单中心数据集、异质性采集方案与评价实践、有限的外部验证和前瞻性验证、模型可解释性以及部署要求。未来工作应强调采集感知和物理知情建模、多中心和隐私保护协作、具有临床意义的验证，以及与神经介入工作流程更紧密的结合。通过将方法学进展与其支持证据和转化挑战相联系，本综述旨在支持开发更稳健、更具临床适用性的脑血管 DSA AI 方法。

title: PhysioWave-T: Token-Efficient Wavelet Foundation Models for Biosignals
zh_title: PhysioWave-T：面向生理信号的高效小波基础模型
summary: 提出面向EEG、ECG、sEMG的令牌高效小波基础模型，压缩序列长度并在多项EEG基准与癫痫检测上超过对照。
key_points: 小波尺度折叠压缩令牌序列
EEG模型30M参数、预训练超15M窗口
9项EEG指标中8项领先，并优于LUNA-L
reason: 预印本新方法，大规模预训练与多基线对比，但缺外部临床验证
abstract: We present PhysioWave-T, a token-efficient wavelet foundation model family for EEG, ECG, and sEMG. Dynamic scale folding recombines J+1 wavelet subbands prior to tokenization, compressing sequence length from (J+1)CS to CS tokens for J levels, C channels, and S temporal patches. Route-specific front ends and learned channel-name embeddings allow one Transformer per modality to handle diverse montages and sampling rates, while unseen setups reuse the backbone via lightweight adapters. We pre-train a 30M-parameter EEG model on over 15M windows (19--128 channels), alongside ECG (30M) and sEMG (12M) encoders. Across four EEG routes, scale folding cuts Transformer latency by 4.0--7.2x and peak memory by 6.8--12.7x over scale expansion without accuracy loss. Our EEG encoder leads 8 of 9 metrics against BENDR, BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGPT, and surpasses LUNA-L on wearable seizure detection with fewer parameters. Reliability-aware latent fusion (RALF) further integrates summary tokens from independently pre-trained encoders via sample-adaptive weights. On SeizeIT2, RALF raises event sensitivity at 11 false alarms/h from 61.4% to 74.4% and window AUPRC from 0.321 to 0.399 over the best unimodal baseline, outperforming weighted-logit and concatenation fusion across all variants. PhysioWave-T also achieves state-of-the-art sEMG accuracies and top macro-F1 on PTB-XL Super and Chapman-Shaoxing. Code and models: https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PhysioWave.
zh_abstract: 我们提出PhysioWave-T，这是一个面向EEG、ECG和sEMG的令牌高效小波基础模型系列。动态尺度折叠在令牌化之前重组J+1个小波子带，在J个层级、C个通道和S个时间块下，将序列长度从(J+1)CS个令牌压缩至CS个令牌。路由特定的前端和学习到的通道名称嵌入使每种模态的一个Transformer能够处理不同的导联组合和采样率，而未见过的设置可通过轻量级适配器复用主干网络。我们在超过1500万个窗口（19–128个通道）上预训练了一个3000万参数的EEG模型，并同时预训练了ECG（3000万参数）和sEMG（1200万参数）编码器。在四条EEG路径上，与尺度扩展相比，尺度折叠将Transformer延迟降低4.0–7.2倍，峰值内存降低6.8–12.7倍，且不损失准确率。我们的EEG编码器在9项指标中的8项上领先于BENDR、BIOT、LaBraM和EEGPT，并在可穿戴癫痫发作检测中以更少参数超过LUNA-L。可靠性感知潜在融合（RALF）进一步通过样本自适应权重整合来自独立预训练编码器的汇总令牌。在SeizeIT2上，相对于最佳单模态基线，RALF将每小时11次误报下的事件灵敏度从61.4%提高到74.4%，并将窗口AUPRC从0.321提高到0.399，在所有变体中均优于加权logit融合和拼接融合。PhysioWave-T还取得了最先进的sEMG准确率，并在PTB-XL Super和Chapman-Shaoxing上取得最高macro-F1。代码和模型：https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PhysioWave。

title: Ninety-Six Ways to Measure a Scribe: Fragmented Evaluation of Ambient Scribes in Healthcare
zh_title: 环境AI scribe评估指标碎片化：96种测量方式
summary: 分析54项环境AI scribe评估研究，识别10个维度、40项指标和96种操作化方式，评估高度碎片化。
key_points: 54项研究归纳10个评估维度
40项指标被96种方式操作化
文书效率/时间最常测，安全与结局最少
reason: 预印本综述54项研究，揭示评估碎片化，有信息量但非系统综述
abstract: Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes have moved rapidly from experimental pilots to enterprise-wide deployment across health systems, promising reduced documentation burden and improved clinician experience. While research evaluating these tools has expanded quickly, there are no agreed-upon protocols or standardized metrics for assessing their performance, making it difficult to compare findings or cumulatively synthesize evidence across studies. Across 54 recent evaluation studies, we identify ten evaluation dimensions and 40 distinct metrics, operationalized in 96 different ways-35 of them (36%) used by only a single study. Assessment is dominated by documentation efficiency and time, measured in 44 of 54 studies. The other dimensions appear at broadly similar rates (16-24 studies each), and safety and clinical outcome least consistently of all. Ripple effects on the broader care system, such as impact on patients' care outcomes, redistribution of work, changes in billing and coding intensity, and downstream use of notes by other clinicians are rarely assessed. Moreover, the metrics used rely heavily on self-report and are fragmented and inconsistently operationalized, which limits comparability and hinders synthesis across studies. As an effort to support more rigorous and cumulative evaluation, in this paper we review the study designs, data sources, and metrics commonly used to evaluate ambient AI scribes in healthcare settings, discuss the limitations of current evaluation practice, and argue for a more holistic approach grounded in a standardized, multi-dimensional set of metrics.
zh_abstract: 环境人工智能（AI）记录助手已迅速从实验性试点走向卫生系统中的企业级部署，有望减轻文书负担并改善临床医生体验。尽管评估这些工具的研究迅速扩展，但目前尚无公认的方案或标准化指标来评估其性能，这使得比较研究结果或跨研究累积综合证据变得困难。在54项近期评估研究中，我们识别出十个评估维度和40项不同指标，这些指标以96种不同方式操作化——其中35项（36%）仅被一项研究使用。评估以文书效率和时间为主，在54项研究中有44项测量了这些方面。其他维度的出现率大致相似（各16–24项研究），而安全性和临床结局在所有维度中最不一致。对更广泛照护系统的连锁影响，例如对患者照护结局的影响、工作重新分配、计费和编码强度的变化，以及其他临床医生对记录的下游使用，很少被评估。此外，所用指标严重依赖自我报告，且碎片化、操作化不一致，这限制了可比性并阻碍了跨研究的综合。为支持更严谨和累积性的评估，本文综述了医疗环境中评估环境AI记录助手常用的研究设计、数据来源和指标，讨论了当前评估实践的局限性，并主张采用以标准化、多维度指标集为基础的更整体化方法。

title: Weight-Space Programming for Medical Imaging: Do We Still Need Training Data?
zh_title: 医学影像的权重空间编程：不再需要训练数据？
summary: 预印本让大模型直接写出医学图像分类器权重，在7个任务4种模态上与零样本MedSigLIP及常规训练模型比较。
key_points: LLM一次回复直接生成LeNet式网络参数
对照零样本MedSigLIP与Adam训练基线
覆盖胸片、乳腺超声、腹部CT与盆腔MRI
reason: 预印本方法新颖且有明确基线对比，但仅在公开基准上评估，给6分
abstract: Can a large language model (LLM) write the parameters of a medical image classifier from medical knowledge alone, without any training data? Such classifiers normally require labelled images, which are costly and often unavailable. We investigate this question through weight-space programming (WSP), in which an LLM writes or adapts the weights and biases of a neural network directly, without optimisation on training data. Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra each generate the parameters of a small LeNet-style CNN in a single reply, without tool use and without access to any image. We compare these networks against zero-shot MedSigLIP and against the same architecture trained on labels using the Adam optimiser, across 7 classification tasks in four modalities: chest X-ray, breast ultrasound and abdominal CT (all from MedMNIST), and pelvic MRI (SynthUterus). The LLM-written networks perform above chance on all six MedMNIST tasks, with a mean test AUC of 0.719 for Opus and 0.711 for Astra. Both models outperform MedSigLIP on 5 of 6 tasks while using more than 10,000 times fewer parameters. However, the same network trained with Adam on only 256 labelled images achieves a higher AUC on every MedMNIST task (mean AUC 0.828). On SynthUterus, Opus attains an AUC of 0.764, whereas Astra falls below chance (AUC 0.136) owing to a systematic error. These results show that LLMs can write functional medical classifiers, but that they do not yet replace training data. We release the protocol, logs and all generated weights at https://github.com/MaximilianLindholz/weight-space-programming-medical.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能否仅凭医学知识、在没有任何训练数据的情况下写出医学图像分类器的参数？此类分类器通常需要标注图像，而标注图像成本高昂且常常不可获得。我们通过权重空间编程（WSP）研究这一问题：在该方法中，LLM 直接写出或调整神经网络的权重与偏置，而不在训练数据上进行优化。Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Astra 各自在单次回复中生成一个小型 LeNet 风格 CNN 的参数，不使用工具，也无法访问任何图像。我们在四种模态的 7 个分类任务上，将这些网络与零样本 MedSigLIP 以及使用 Adam 优化器在标签上训练的相同架构进行比较：胸部 X 线、乳腺超声和腹部 CT（均来自 MedMNIST），以及盆腔 MRI（SynthUterus）。LLM 写出的网络在全部六个 MedMNIST 任务上均高于随机水平，Opus 和 Astra 的平均测试 AUC 分别为 0.719 和 0.711。两个模型在 6 个任务中的 5 个上优于 MedSigLIP，同时使用的参数少超过 10,000 倍。然而，相同网络仅使用 256 张标注图像通过 Adam 训练，就在每个 MedMNIST 任务上取得更高的 AUC（平均 AUC 0.828）。在 SynthUterus 上，Opus 达到 AUC 0.764，而 Astra 由于系统性错误而低于随机水平（AUC 0.136）。这些结果表明，LLM 能够写出功能性的医学分类器，但尚不能取代训练数据。我们在 https://github.com/MaximilianLindholz/weight-space-programming-medical 发布协议、日志和所有生成的权重。

title: LLM-Supported Pain Neuroscience Education for Physiotherapy Students
zh_title: 大模型反馈用于物理治疗学生疼痛教育试验
summary: 一项随机对照试验注册：在四周疼痛神经科学教育中加入LLM结构化反馈，比较学生疼痛解释能力。
key_points: 120名物理治疗本科生，随机对照设计
对照为专家制定的非AI标准化反馈
主要结局为疼痛解释能力，尚无结果
reason: RCT设计但仅注册无结果、样本120人且为教育结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: İsmail Palalı; conditions: Pain, Chronic Pain, Health Professions Education; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 120; status: COMPLETED] Physiotherapists need to explain pain to patients in a way that is scientifically accurate, understandable, and non-threatening. Pain neuroscience education (PNE) improves students' pain knowledge, but it is unclear whether this translates into retained ability to explain pain to patients. This randomized controlled trial tested whether adding structured feedback from a large language model (LLM; GPT-5.2 Instant, OpenAI, via the ChatGPT interface) to a standardized four-week PNE programme improves undergraduate physiotherapy students' pain-explanation competence compared with the same programme using standardized expert-developed (non-AI) feedback. The primary outcome was Pain Explanation Competence (PEC) on a previously unseen clinical transfer scenario, assessed without AI access 12 weeks after the intervention by three assessors blinded to group allocation.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：İsmail Palalı；疾病/状况：疼痛、慢性疼痛、卫生专业教育；类型：INTERVENTIONAL（干预性）；阶段：NA（不适用）；入组人数：120；状态：COMPLETED（已完成）] 物理治疗师需要以科学准确、易于理解且不具威胁性的方式向患者解释疼痛。疼痛神经科学教育（PNE）可提高学生的疼痛知识，但尚不清楚这是否转化为向患者解释疼痛能力的保持。本随机对照试验测试：在标准化为期四周的PNE项目基础上，加入来自大型语言模型（LLM；GPT-5.2 Instant，OpenAI，通过ChatGPT界面）的结构化反馈，与使用标准化专家制定（非AI）反馈的同一项目相比，是否能改善本科物理治疗学生的疼痛解释能力。主要结局为在先前未见的临床迁移场景中的疼痛解释能力（Pain Explanation Competence，PEC），于干预后12周在无法使用AI的情况下由三名对分组分配设盲的评估者进行评估。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Sun Yat-sen University; conditions: Focal Liver Lesions; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 10000; status: RECRUITING] This study aims to evaluate the clinical value of artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted medical imaging in the diagnosis and management of focal liver lesions. Accurate diagnosis of focal liver lesions is important for selecting appropriate treatment strategies. However, distinguishing between different types of liver lesions can be challenging because of overlapping imaging features. AI-based imaging systems may help improve diagnostic accuracy and support clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：中山大学；疾病：局灶性肝脏病变；类型：干预性；分期：不适用；入组：10000；状态：招募中] 本研究旨在评估人工智能（AI）辅助医学影像在局灶性肝脏病变诊断和管理中的临床价值。局灶性肝脏病变的准确诊断对于选择适当治疗策略很重要。然而，由于影像特征重叠，区分不同类型的肝脏病变可能具有挑战性。基于AI的影像系统可能有助于提高诊断准确性并支持临床决策。

title: SkinMind: Equipping Agentic RAG with Human-Inspired Graph Probing for Reliable Dermatology AI
zh_title: SkinMind：面向皮肤科的多模态智能体检索增强框架
summary: 预印本提出SkinMind多模态智能体RAG框架，借图探查工具迭代检索文本与视觉证据以支撑皮肤科判读。
key_points: 编排器与图环境迭代交互完成检索
八类分层图探查工具支持多跳取证
针对皮肤科异质文本与图像证据
reason: 预印本方法有新意，但仅见方法描述、缺乏验证细节，给5分
abstract: Reliable dermatology AI requires access to verifiable evidence distributed across heterogeneous textual and visual sources. However, conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically relies on one-shot retrieval from flat corpora, limiting its ability to adapt retrieval granularity, explore multi-hop relations, and integrate multimodal clinical evidence. We introduce SkinMind, a multimodal agentic RAG framework that equips policy models with human-inspired graph probing for autonomous evidence seeking. SkinMind organizes retrieval as an iterative interaction between an orchestrator and a graph environment. Through eight hierarchical graph-probing tools, the orchestrator progressively identifies relevant entities, inspects node-level information, traverses relations and paths, and retrieves source-text and visual evidence. This progressive-disclosure design allows the model to adaptively determine the retrieval modality, exploration direction, and evidence granularity while constructing a query-specific evidence subgraph. To support autonomous graph probing, we construct SkinMind-KG from a 62M-token corpus of dermatology guidelines and textbooks and 423K images, guided by a dermatologist-informed schema and a conflict-resolution mechanism. The resulting graph contains over 1.0M nodes and 2.0M edges, unifying textual, relational, and visual evidence for retrieval. Across six dermatology VQA benchmarks and two policy-model settings, SkinMind improves the average score over direct answering by 8.70 and 8.89 points with GPT-5.4-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash, respectively, while consistently outperforming competing RAG methods. Together, SkinMind and SkinMind-KG provide an effective foundation for evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning in dermatology.
zh_abstract: 可靠皮肤病学 AI 需要获取分布于异质文本与视觉来源中的可验证证据。然而，传统检索增强生成（RAG）通常依赖对扁平语料库的一次性检索，限制了其调整检索粒度、探索多跳关系以及整合多模态临床证据的能力。我们提出 SkinMind，一种多模态智能体式 RAG 框架，为策略模型配备受人类启发的图探查能力，以实现自主证据寻求。SkinMind 将检索组织为编排器与图环境之间的迭代交互。通过八种分层图探查工具，编排器逐步识别相关实体、检查节点级信息、遍历关系与路径，并检索源文本与视觉证据。这种渐进披露设计使模型能够在构建查询特定证据子图的同时，自适应地确定检索模态、探索方向与证据粒度。为支持自主图探查，我们基于一个包含 62M token 的皮肤病学指南与教科书语料库以及 423K 张图像构建 SkinMind-KG，并以皮肤病学家知情模式（schema）和冲突解决机制为指导。所得图包含超过 1.0M 个节点和 2.0M 条边，统一文本、关系与视觉证据以供检索。在六个皮肤病学 VQA 基准和两种策略模型设置下，SkinMind 相较于直接回答，在使用 GPT-5.4-mini 和 Gemini-2.5-Flash 时平均分数分别提高 8.70 分和 8.89 分，同时持续优于竞争性 RAG 方法。总之，SkinMind 与 SkinMind-KG 为皮肤病学中基于证据的多模态推理提供了有效基础。

title: Natural-language cohort queries on a hospital data platform: accuracy and provenance in a real-world evaluation
zh_title: 医院数据平台自然语言队列查询真实世界评估
summary: 在多家三级医院评估商业自然语言查询平台，用25条提示检验脑肿瘤队列识别准确性与查询溯源。
key_points: AIRE平台接入机构健康数据平台
25条自然语言提示对比人工SQL
评估队列识别准确性与查询级溯源
reason: 真实世界预印本评估，25条提示单队列，外部验证有限
abstract: Background: Accessing routinely collected clinical data for research remains technically demanding across heterogeneous hospital systems. This proof-of-concept study aimed to evaluate the accuracy and query-level traceability of a commercial natural-language (NL) data-query platform implemented at a university hospital. Methods: An on-premises data integration platform with an NL query interface (AIRE; Briya, Tel Aviv, Israel) was connected to the institutional health data platform across three tertiary-care hospitals under an approved pseudonymization and governance framework. Implementation comprised regulatory and governance approval, and IT deployment. Twenty-five NL prompts addressing cohort identification and characterization in an adult ICD-10 C71-coded brain-tumor cohort (n = 1,594) were evaluated against manually written reference SQL and checked for a corresponding executed query in the exported log. Responses were classified into five categories. Prompts with unanswered or incorrect responses were re-posed in a new thread. Results: The platform was implemented over two years. Fifteen of 25 responses were exact (n = 11), concordant after definition alignment (n = 1), or incorrect but traceable from the logged SQL (n = 3); six were plausible but incorrect without a logged query, and four remained unanswered. No incorrect unlogged result recurred in a new thread. Across the initial and repeat evaluations, 22 of 23 logged responses were correct or traceable, whereas all eight unlogged responses were incorrect. Conclusions: Implementation was feasible but required substantial local institutional preparation. The NL interface reproduced SQL-derived results when definitions were explicit, while query-level provenance and verification of the displayed result were critical for identifying unreliable outputs.
zh_abstract: 【背景】在异质性医院系统中，获取常规收集的临床数据用于研究在技术上仍然困难。本概念验证研究旨在评估在大学医院实施的商业化自然语言（NL）数据查询平台的准确性及查询级可追溯性。【方法】在获批的假名化和治理框架下，将一个具有自然语言查询界面的本地部署数据集成平台（AIRE；Briya，以色列特拉维夫）连接到跨三家三级医院的机构健康数据平台。实施包括监管和治理审批以及IT部署。针对成人 ICD-10 C71 编码的脑肿瘤队列（n = 1,594）中队列识别和特征描述的25条自然语言提示，与人工编写的参考SQL进行对照评估，并在导出的日志中检查是否存在相应的已执行查询。回答被分为五类。未回答或回答错误的提示在一个新线程中重新提出。【结果】该平台部署耗时两年。25条回答中，15条为完全一致（n = 11）、定义对齐后一致（n = 1），或错误但可从记录SQL追溯（n = 3）；6条看似合理但错误且无记录查询，4条仍未回答。在新线程中未再出现错误的未记录结果。在初始和重复评估中，23条有记录回答中有22条正确或可追溯，而所有8条无记录回答均错误。【结论】实施可行，但需要大量本地机构准备工作。当定义明确时，自然语言界面可重现SQL得出的结果，而查询级来源和所显示结果的验证对于识别不可靠输出至关重要。

title: Risk prediction models for macrovascular complications in type 2 diabetes mellitus: from traditional risk scores to multimodal intelligent prediction.
zh_title: 2型糖尿病大血管并发症风险预测模型综述
summary: 综述从传统评分到机器学习、深度学习及多模态AI的T2DM大血管并发症风险预测模型及其局限。
key_points: 梳理传统评分至多模态AI模型演进
指出人群异质、结局定义不一等问题
强调外部验证、可解释性与落地不足
reason: 同行评审综述，覆盖多模态AI但非系统综述，证据级别有限
abstract: [Frontiers in endocrinology] Macrovascular complications are the leading cause of morbidity and mortality in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Early risk identification and accurate risk stratification are essential for both primary and secondary cardiovascular prevention. With the rapid development of electronic health records, medical imaging, multi-omics technologies, and artificial intelligence (AI), risk prediction models for diabetic macrovascular complications have evolved from traditional statistical approaches to machine learning-, deep learning-, and multimodal AI-driven models. However, despite substantial improvements in predictive performance, current models remain limited by heterogeneous target populations, inconsistent outcome definitions, insufficient external validation, limited clinical interpretability, and inadequate real-world implementation, thereby restricting their clinical translation. This review summarizes the evolution, data sources, modeling methodologies, clinical applications, and future perspectives of risk prediction models for macrovascular complications in T2DM. We first describe the transition from conventional cardiovascular risk scores, including the Framingham Risk Score, to diabetes-specific models such as the UKPDS Risk Engine, ADVANCE, RECODe, and SCORE2-Diabetes, followed by the emergence of AI-based prediction models. We then review the major data sources used in contemporary prediction models, including clinical characteristics, laboratory biomarkers, vascular function and imaging, multi-omics profiles, and wearable device-derived data. Furthermore, we compare the strengths and limitations of traditional statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, and multitask learning with respect to predictive performance, interpretability, and clinical applicability, and discuss the major challenges related to study design, external validation, data quality, algorithmic bias, and real-world implementation. Finally, we propose that future risk prediction models for diabetic macrovascular complications will evolve from single-source data to multimodal data integration, from static risk estimation to dynamic risk trajectories, from single outcomes to multiple interconnected cardiovascular outcomes, from prognosis prediction to individualized treatment benefit prediction, and from standalone algorithms to continuously learning clinical decision support systems. Emerging technologies, including foundation models, large language models
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in endocrinology] 大血管并发症是2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者发病和死亡的主要原因。早期风险识别和准确的风险分层对于心血管疾病的一级和二级预防都至关重要。随着电子健康记录、医学影像、多组学技术和人工智能（AI）的快速发展，糖尿病大血管并发症的风险预测模型已从传统统计方法发展为机器学习、深度学习和多模态AI驱动的模型。然而，尽管预测性能有了实质性提升，当前模型仍受限于目标人群异质性、结局定义不一致、外部验证不足、临床可解释性有限以及真实世界实施不充分，从而限制了其临床转化。本综述总结了T2DM大血管并发症风险预测模型的演变、数据来源、建模方法、临床应用和未来展望。我们首先描述从传统心血管风险评分（包括Framingham风险评分）向糖尿病特异性模型（如UKPDS Risk Engine、ADVANCE、RECODe和SCORE2-Diabetes）的转变，随后介绍基于AI的预测模型的出现。然后，我们综述当代预测模型使用的主要数据来源，包括临床特征、实验室生物标志物、血管功能和影像、多组学特征以及可穿戴设备衍生数据。此外，我们比较传统统计方法、机器学习、深度学习和多任务学习在预测性能、可解释性和临床适用性方面的优势与局限，并讨论与研究设计、外部验证、数据质量、算法偏倚和真实世界实施相关的主要挑战。最后，我们提出糖尿病大血管并发症的未来风险预测模型将从单一来源数据走向多模态数据整合，从静态风险估计走向动态风险轨迹，从单一结局走向多个相互关联的心血管结局，从预后预测走向个体化治疗获益预测，从独立算法走向持续学习的临床决策支持系统。包括基础模型、大语言模型在内的新兴技术

abstract: In clinical datasets, data augmentation is often avoided because it can remove important unusual values, known as outliers, which are important for understanding diseases accurately. However, clinical EEG datasets often suffer from two key limitations: small sample sizes and class imbalance, which significantly reduce classification performance. To overcome these challenges, this study applies generative AI-based data augmentation techniques with a carefully designed hybrid pipeline that effectively enhances performance even on limited EEG data. Using EEG signals from 50 brain stroke patients, we investigate both traditional oversampling methods (SMOTE and ADASYN) and advanced generative models, including WGAN and WGAN-GP. Our proposed pipeline involves preprocessing EEG recordings, extracting comprehensive statistical and frequency-domain features, applying feature reduction, and evaluating multiple machine learning classifiers. Experimental results show that the combination of SelectKBest feature selection, SVM classifier, and WGAN-GP augmentation achieves the highest classification accuracy of 72%, outperforming other methods. This work introduces a novel hybrid approach for EEG-based stroke severity classification, demonstrating that generative augmentation, when integrated properly, can significantly improve performance on small clinical datasets. To the best of our knowledge, this combination of techniques has not been explored before on any dataset, providing a solid foundation for future research in automated EEG-based stroke diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 在临床数据集中，数据增强常被避免，因为它可能去除重要的不寻常值，即异常值，而这些值对于准确理解疾病很重要。然而，临床 EEG 数据集常受两个关键限制：样本量小和类别不平衡，这会显著降低分类性能。为克服这些挑战，本研究应用基于生成式 AI 的数据增强技术，并采用精心设计的混合流程，即使在有限 EEG 数据上也能有效提升性能。我们使用 50 名脑卒中患者的 EEG 信号，研究传统过采样方法（SMOTE 和 ADASYN）以及先进生成模型，包括 WGAN 和 WGAN-GP。我们提出的流程包括预处理 EEG 记录、提取全面的统计与频域特征、应用特征降维，并评估多种机器学习分类器。实验结果表明，SelectKBest 特征选择、SVM 分类器和 WGAN-GP 增强的组合达到最高分类准确率 72%，优于其他方法。这项工作提出了一种用于基于 EEG 的卒中严重程度分类的新颖混合方法，证明生成式增强在适当整合后可显著改善小型临床数据集上的性能。据我们所知，这种技术组合此前尚未在任何数据集上探索过，为未来基于 EEG 的自动化卒中诊断研究提供了坚实基础。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital; conditions: Healthy Adult Participants; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 260; status: COMPLETED] The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted training works better than usual training. abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Hospital Universitari Vall d'Hebron Research Institute; conditions: Stroke, Ischemic Stroke, Intracerebral Hemorrhage, Transient Ischemic Attack, Atrial Fibrillation; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 10000; status: RECRUITING] Stroke is a leading cause of death and adult disability. Stroke care is still limited by fragmented care pathways, non-standardised diagnostic work-up and follow-up, and local, non-interoperable data systems across the pre-hospital, in-hospital and post-hospital settings. UMBRELLA-P is a multicentre, prospective, observational study in 7 university hospitals in 6 European countries (Spain, Italy, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and Switzerland). Adults with clinically suspected acute stroke or transient ischemic attack (TIA) are managed according to standard of care. Routine clinical, imaging, laboratory, ECG and patient-reported data are collected, pseudonymised, stored on a dedicated server at each hospital and harmonised to the OMOP Common Data Model. The harmonised data form a federated real-world data platform (U-Platform). On this platform, artificial intelligence (AI) models are trained and validated through federated learning, so that no patient data leave the participating sites. The models aim to predict short- and long-term outcomes, reduce time to treatment, and support diagnosis, triage, discharge, follow-up and secondary prevention. Five clinical sub-studies address pre-hospital triage, fast track to reperfusion, emergent intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) management, TIA/minor stroke, and cardiac evaluation with blood biomarkers. The study is observational. The outputs of the AI models are used for research only and will not influence clinical decisions. Participants are followed for up to 12 months.

abstract: Current medical benchmarks typically break down clinical competence into isolated factual questions, single-image tasks, or static case vignettes. These tests score individual answers, but reveal less about whether a model can integrate subspecialty knowledge with multimodal evidence and track a patient's condition throughout a course of care. To close this gap, we introduce NPCBench, a clinical apprenticeship benchmark for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). NPCBench mirrors specialist training, from guideline and foundational knowledge to case planning, longitudinal review, CarePath integration, and open-ended consultation. It contains 4,777 component and consultation items and a 100-patient CarePath cohort with 417 scored diagnostic and care tasks. The episode-level evaluation tests whether diagnostic and care answers are jointly correct within a care pathway. By linking stepwise tasks to patient-level care trajectories, NPCBench evaluates whether models ground decisions in visual evidence, interpret changes in patient state, and meet clinical requirements in consultation. Across 30 evaluated models, we observe a composition gap: strong performance on individual tasks does not ensure jointly correct diagnostic and care answers for the same patient. Among 21 multimodal models, strict CarePath success reaches at most 23%. Paired controls and physician calibration further examine evidence grounding, longitudinal revision, and consultation judging. Overall, NPCBench broadens the evaluation of medical artificial intelligence beyond static question-answering paradigms to an apprenticeship-oriented assessment of clinical workflows, thereby offering a testbed for evidence-based and temporally coherent reasoning in oncology care.
zh_abstract: 当前的医学基准通常将临床能力拆解为孤立的事实性问题、单图像任务或静态病例短述。这些测试对单个答案评分，但较少揭示模型能否将亚专科知识与多模态证据整合，并在整个照护过程中追踪患者病情。为弥合这一差距，我们提出NPCBench，这是一个针对鼻咽癌（nasopharyngeal carcinoma, NPC）的临床学徒制基准。NPCBench模拟专科培训，从指南和基础知识到病例规划、纵向回顾、CarePath整合和开放式咨询。它包含4,777个组成项和咨询条目，以及一个100例患者的CarePath队列，其中包含417项计分的诊断和照护任务。事件层面的评估检验诊断和照护答案在一条照护路径内是否联合正确。通过将分步任务与患者层面的照护轨迹相关联，NPCBench评估模型是否将决策建立在视觉证据上、解释患者状态变化，并在咨询中满足临床要求。在30个被评估模型中，我们观察到一种组合差距：在单项任务上的强劲表现并不能确保对同一患者作出联合正确的诊断和照护答案。在21个多模态模型中，严格的CarePath成功率最高仅为23%。配对对照和医生校准进一步考察证据依据、纵向修订和咨询评判。总体而言，NPCBench将医学人工智能的评估从静态问答范式扩展到以学徒制为导向的临床工作流程评估，从而为肿瘤照护中基于证据和时间连贯的推理提供了一个测试平台。

abstract: Abstract Background: Ambient AI documentation reduces documentation burden and electronic health record (EHR) time for ambulatory clinicians. Newer features also queue orders and offer some level of coding support for clinician review. This study compares two commercial products deployed at UCLA Health. Objective: To compare Nabla and Epic Systems, Inc. ambient AI solution among ambulatory clinicians at UCLA Health on usability, documentation burden, perceived note quality, adoption, EHR time and productivity, clinician-reported experience with order queueing and coding support, coding and billing patterns and integrity, work productivity, and patient-reported communication experience. Methods: Two-arm parallel-group randomized trial, 1:1, among 374 ambulatory clinicians at a single academic health system who hold an active license for a standalone ambient application (Nabla). Randomization is covariate-constrained where cohort size permits, balancing age, sex, half-day clinic sessions, specialty group, and baseline System Usability Scale (SUS) score. Intervention runs 11/9/2026 to 1/17/2027, with the first four weeks as lead-in. The primary outcome is SUS score at follow-up, compared between arms. Analysis is by intention-to-treat using mixed-effects models. Ethics and dissemination: Determined exempt by the UCLA Institutional Review Board (IRB-26-2147). Survey completion indicates consent. No patient-level data are collected. Findings will directly inform operational decision making and will be published regardless of direction.
zh_abstract:
【背景】环境AI文档记录减轻了门诊临床医生的文档负担和电子健康记录（EHR）时间。较新的功能还可将医嘱排入队列，并提供一定程度的编码支持供临床医生审核。本研究比较在UCLA Health部署的两种商业产品。
【目的】在UCLA Health门诊临床医生中比较Nabla与Epic Systems, Inc.环境AI解决方案在可用性、文档负担、感知记录质量、采用情况、EHR时间和生产率、临床医生报告的医嘱排队和编码支持体验、编码和计费模式与完整性、工作效率以及患者报告的沟通体验方面的差异。
【方法】两臂平行组随机试验，1:1，在单一学术健康系统的374名门诊临床医生中开展，这些医生持有独立环境应用程序（Nabla）的有效许可证。在队列规模允许时采用协变量约束随机化，平衡年龄、性别、半日门诊时段、专科组和基线系统可用性量表（SUS）评分。干预时间为2026年11月9日至2027年1月17日，前四周为导入期。主要结局是随访时的SUS评分，在两臂之间进行比较。分析采用意向性治疗，使用混合效应模型。
【伦理与传播】经UCLA机构审查委员会判定为豁免（IRB-26-2147）。完成调查即表示同意。不收集患者层面数据。研究结果将直接指导运营决策，并将无论方向如何均予以发表。

title: AI in the Clinical Documentation Loop: Effects of LLM-Induced Note Bloat and Diagnostic Overcall on Downstream LLMs
zh_title: LLM生成病历内容对下游模型的影响
summary: 预印本研究考察LLM撰写的病历内容造成的“膨胀”与诊断过度记录，如何影响后续读取同一病历的LLM。
key_points: 区分病历膨胀与临床发现失真两类伪影
以诊断过度记录作为失真案例
提示读写双向闭环带来的部署风险
reason: 预印本方法学分析有新意，但证据规模与验证有限
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to process medical records for healthcare tasks such as clinical documentation. Because these tools also generate documentation, the relationship is now bidirectional: models both read from and write to the record. Understanding how LLMs behave when reading records that already contain LLM-authored content is therefore critical for their safe deployment. In this study, we examine how LLM-authored content in the medical record affects downstream LLMs that read the same record. We consider two types of LLM-induced artifacts: bloat, in which LLM-generated summaries accumulate in the record and change the length and provenance of its content over time; and distortion, in which LLMs subtly alter clinical findings rather than fabricating facts outright. As a case of distortion, we study diagnostic overcall (documenting an unconfirmed differential diagnosis in the record) and test whether it propagates to the reader LLM's output. Across seven reader models from four families, we find evidence of both effects. First, LLM-generated summary notes modestly but consistently degraded downstream hospital-course generation compared with copy-forward and templated text of matched length. Second, injected overcalls reappeared in downstream outputs at rates that varied by reader model, without detectable changes in standard quality metrics. These findings show the need to monitor AI-generated content in medical records and to account for it when those records are later processed by AI.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（large language models, LLMs）越来越多地被用于处理医疗记录，以完成临床文档等医疗任务。由于这些工具也会生成文档，这种关系现在是双向的：模型既读取记录，也写入记录。因此，理解LLMs在读取已包含LLM撰写内容的记录时如何表现，对其安全部署至关重要。在本研究中，我们考察医疗记录中由LLM撰写的内容如何影响读取同一记录的下游LLMs。我们考虑两类由LLM引起的伪影：膨胀（bloat），即LLM生成的摘要累积在记录中，并随时间改变其内容的长度和来源；以及失真（distortion），即LLMs微妙地改变临床发现，而不是直接捏造事实。作为失真的一种情况，我们研究诊断过度判定（在记录中记录未经确认的鉴别诊断），并检验其是否会传播到读取该记录的LLM的输出中。在来自四个模型家族的七个读取器模型中，我们发现了两种效应的证据。首先，与匹配长度的复制前移文本和模板化文本相比，LLM生成的摘要记录会适度但持续地降低下游住院病程生成的质量。其次，注入的过度判定以因读取器模型而异的发生率重新出现在下游输出中，而标准质量指标未检测到变化。这些发现表明，需要监测医疗记录中AI生成的内容，并在这些记录随后由AI处理时将其纳入考虑。

title: Can General-Purpose Generative AI Supply Training Data for Medical Vision Models? A Multimodal Retrospective Study
zh_title: 通用生成式 AI 能否为医学视觉模型提供训练数据
summary: 预印本回顾性评估通用图像生成模型合成医学影像用于训练与审计，并在真实数据上外部验证。
key_points: 覆盖胸片、眼底、CT 与颈动脉超声四模态
合成数据模型在真实数据上外部验证
肺炎任务 AUROC 0.877（n=14863）
reason: 大样本外部验证加分，但为预印本回顾性研究
abstract: Background: Well-annotated, diverse medical imaging datasets remain a major constraint for vision-based medical AI. We evaluated Nano Banana, a general-purpose image generation and editing model, as a source of synthetic medical images for model training, subgroup augmentation, and model auditing. Methods: In this retrospective study across four imaging modalities, chest radiography, fundus photography, and CT models were trained only on synthetic images and externally validated on real-world data against real-data-trained models. Carotid ultrasound models were trained on a private Human Phenotype Project cohort (aged 40-75 years) with and without synthetic augmentation. Clinicians rated image plausibility. Evaluation used AUROC, AUPR, calibration, and decision curve analysis. Findings: Synthetic-only models achieved AUROCs of 0.877 (95% CI 0.843-0.910) for pneumonia (n=14863), 0.963 (0.948-0.975) for retinal detachment (n=1149), and 0.711 (0.600-0.823) for renal calculus (n=4122), comparable to real-data-trained models, but their calibration and net benefit were not consistently more favorable. With mixed synthetic-real training, a carotid ultrasound model produced an ordinal vascular age index that stratified 633 external subjects into subgroups differing in BMI and glucose (both p<0.01), linking vascular aging to cardiometabolic health. To stress-test shortcut learning, editing a moderate tessellated pattern into fundus photographs reduced the true-class probability for central serous chorioretinopathy from 0.996 to 0.822. Clinician-guided editing raised low-quality CT plausibility from 3.10/5 to 4.30/5. Interpretation: Synthetic data can complement real data in model training, subgroup representation, and model testing via controlled editing, but its clinical value should be assessed with calibration, decision curve analysis, and clinician review, not discrimination alone.
zh_abstract: 【背景】标注良好且多样化的医学影像数据集仍是基于视觉的医学人工智能的主要制约因素。我们评估了 Nano Banana——一种通用图像生成与编辑模型——作为合成医学图像来源，用于模型训练、亚组增强和模型审计。【方法】在这项回顾性研究中，涵盖四种成像模态；胸部X线摄影、眼底摄影和CT模型仅使用合成图像训练，并在真实世界数据上进行外部验证，与使用真实数据训练的模型进行比较。颈动脉超声模型在一个私有的 Human Phenotype Project 队列（年龄40-75岁）上训练，分别在有和无合成数据增强的条件下进行。临床医生对图像合理性进行评分。评估采用 AUROC、AUPR、校准和决策曲线分析。【结果】仅使用合成数据的模型在肺炎（n=14863）上达到 AUROC 0.877（95% CI 0.843-0.910），在视网膜脱离（n=1149）上为 0.963（0.948-0.975），在肾结石（n=4122）上为 0.711（0.600-0.823），与使用真实数据训练的模型相当，但其校准和净获益并非始终更优。采用合成-真实混合训练时，一个颈动脉超声模型产生了序数血管年龄指数，将633名外部受试者分层为BMI和血糖存在差异的亚组（两者 p<0.01），从而将血管老化与心脏代谢健康联系起来。为对捷径学习进行压力测试，将中等程度的镶嵌状（tessellated）图案编辑进眼底照片，使中心性浆液性脉络膜视网膜病变的真实类别概率从0.996降至0.822。临床医生引导的编辑将低质量CT的合理性从3.10/5提高至4.30/5。【解读】合成数据可在模型训练、亚组代表性和通过受控编辑进行模型测试方面补充真实数据，但其临床价值应通过校准、决策曲线分析和临床医生审查来评估，而不仅仅是判别能力。

title: Multi-Agent Generative Artificial Intelligence for Transfusion Reaction Feature Extraction
zh_title: 多智能体生成式 AI 提取输血反应特征
summary: 预印本开发开源多智能体流程，从自由文本病历提取 NHSN 输血反应特征，并用双医师盲评。
key_points: 从 NHSN 方案整理 181 个特征
三种开放权重模型评测 50 份文本
两名医师独立盲评模型输出
reason: 方法有新意的预印本，但样本仅 50 份文本
abstract: BACKGROUND: Many transfusion reactions are not reported to hemovigilance systems, and the features needed to recognize them are often documented only in free-text clinical notes. We sought to develop and evaluate an open-source, multi-agent artificial intelligence (AI) pipeline to extract transfusion reaction features defined by the National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN) Hemovigilance Module from clinical notes. METHODS: We curated 181 features from the NHSN protocol and developed a multi-stage pipeline that extracted features, their timing, and clinical details from free-text notes. Three open-weight large language models (Qwen 3.6-27B, GPT-OSS-120B, and Kimi K3) were applied to 50 notes from expert-written scenarios, published case reports, and MIMIC-IV discharge summaries. Two physicians independently evaluated every model output in a blinded interface. The primary analysis was restricted to feature occurrences with concordant physician assessments. RESULTS: Physicians agreed on 1,201 of 1,343 co-rated feature occurrences (89.4%; Krippendorff's alpha 0.73). Precision was above 0.98 for all models. Sensitivity was 0.774 (95% CI 0.745-0.800) for Kimi K3, 0.636 (0.604-0.667) for GPT-OSS-120B, and 0.624 (0.593-0.655) for Qwen 3.6-27B, and specificity ranged from 0.952 to 0.991. Omissions accounted for more than 94% of false negatives. Timing and clinical details were judged supported or reasonable in more than 92% and 97% of assessments, respectively. Results were consistent across note sources and in analyses including discordant assessments. CONCLUSION: Multi-agent AI pipelines provide a feasible method for extracting transfusion reaction signals from clinical notes with high precision. Our work may have applications in active hemovigilance, reaction classification, and big data research.
zh_abstract: 【背景】许多输血反应未上报至血液警戒系统，而识别这些反应所需的特征往往仅记录在自由文本临床笔记中。我们试图开发并评估一种开源、多智能体人工智能（AI）流水线，用于从临床笔记中提取由 National Healthcare Safety Network（NHSN）血液警戒模块定义的输血反应特征。【方法】我们从 NHSN 方案中整理了 181 个特征，并开发了一个多阶段流水线，从自由文本笔记中提取特征、其特征时间及临床细节。将三个开放权重的大语言模型（Qwen 3.6-27B、GPT-OSS-120B 和 Kimi K3）应用于 50 份笔记，这些笔记来自专家编写的场景、已发表的病例报告和 MIMIC-IV 出院小结。两名医生在盲态界面中独立评估每个模型的输出。主要分析仅限于医生评估一致的特征出现项。【结果】医生对 1,343 个共同评分的特征出现项中的 1,201 个达成一致（89.4%；Krippendorff's alpha 0.73）。所有模型的精确率均高于 0.98。Kimi K3 的灵敏度为 0.774（95% CI 0.745-0.800），GPT-OSS-120B 为 0.636（0.604-0.667），Qwen 3.6-27B 为 0.624（0.593-0.655），特异度范围为 0.952 至 0.991。遗漏占假阴性的 94% 以上。特征时间和临床细节分别在超过 92% 和超过 97% 的评估中被判定为有支持或合理。结果在不同笔记来源中以及在包含不一致评估的分析中均一致。【结论】多智能体 AI 流水线提供了一种可行的方法，可从临床笔记中以高精确率提取输血反应信号。我们的工作可能应用于主动血液警戒、反应分类和大数据研究。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Pediatric Hospital Medicine: Foundations, Clinical Applications, and Emerging Case Uses.
zh_title: 儿科医院医学中的AI：基础、应用与案例

数据源含电子病历、影像、可穿戴与基因组

abstract: [Pediatric annals] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming health care and has important implications for pediatric hospital medicine. Advances in machine learning and large language models have enabled applications that support patient care in the areas of clinical documentation, decision making, and prognostic modeling. Pediatric AI systems leverage diverse data sources, including electronic health records, medical imaging, physiologic monitoring, wearable devices, and genomic data. Current applications include AI-powered scribes, chart summarization, clinical decision support, prediction of sepsis and clinical deterioration, precision pharmacotherapy, rare disease diagnosis, and mental health interventions. These technologies have demonstrated potential to reduce clinician workload, enhance diagnostic accuracy, and facilitate earlier therapeutic interventions. However, significant challenges remain, including limited and heterogeneous pediatric datasets by virtue of age and developmental characteristics in children, bias, privacy concerns, lack of representativeness, and the need for rigorous validation and oversight. As AI adoption expands, pediatric hospitalists require foundational knowledge of AI principles and limitations to ensure safe, equitable, and effective implementation. With appropriate governance and multidisciplinary collaboration, AI has the potential to improve pediatric inpatient outcomes and health care delivery.
zh_abstract: [Pediatric annals] 人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）正在迅速改变医疗保健，并对儿科医院医学具有重要影响。机器学习和大型语言模型（large language models）的进展已使相关应用能够支持临床文档、决策和预后建模领域的患者照护。儿科AI系统利用多样化的数据来源，包括电子健康记录、医学影像、生理监测、可穿戴设备和基因组数据。当前应用包括AI驱动的记录员、病历摘要、临床决策支持、脓毒症和临床恶化的预测、精准药物治疗、罕见病诊断和心理健康干预。这些技术已显示出减少临床医生工作负荷、提高诊断准确性和促进更早治疗干预的潜力。然而，仍然存在重大挑战，包括由于儿童年龄和发育特征导致的儿科数据集有限且异质性高、偏倚、隐私问题、缺乏代表性，以及需要严格验证和监督。随着AI应用的扩大，儿科医院医学专科医生需要具备AI原理和局限性的基础知识，以确保安全、公平和有效的实施。通过适当的治理和多学科合作，AI有潜力改善儿科住院患者的结局和医疗保健服务。

abstract: [Pediatric annals] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly influencing pediatric inpatient care, extending beyond clinical applications to many areas of health care delivery, medical education, and research. Studies suggest that families are receptive to AI-assisted care if transparency, human oversight, and shared decision making are maintained. Effective governance is necessary to address concerns related to accountability, privacy, regulatory gaps, postdeployment monitoring, and equitable implementation. Algorithmic bias, data representativeness, informed consent, and the potential for AI to exacerbate health care disparities pose new ethical concerns. Explainable AI may improve transparency, trust, and acceptance by clinicians through making AI-generated recommendations more understandable. AI can also transform medical education through personalized learning, simulation, and clinical decision support, while requiring new competencies in AI literacy. AI offers opportunities to expedite clinical trials and data analysis but requires pediatric-specific frameworks to address age-related bias and emphasize ethical use of pediatric data in research. Responsible implementation, strong oversight, multidisciplinary collaboration, and continued clinician leadership will be essential to realizing AI's potential while safeguarding the welfare of pediatric patients and their families.
zh_abstract: [Pediatric Annals] 人工智能（AI）正日益影响儿科住院护理，其影响已超越临床应用，扩展到医疗保健服务、医学教育和研究的许多领域。研究表明，如果保持透明度、人工监督和共享决策，家庭对 AI 辅助护理持接受态度。有效的治理对于应对问责、隐私、监管空白、部署后监测和公平实施相关的问题十分必要。算法偏倚、数据代表性、知情同意，以及 AI 可能加剧医疗保健差异，带来了新的伦理关切。可解释 AI 可能通过使 AI 生成的建议更易理解，从而提高透明度、信任度和临床医生的接受度。AI 还可以通过个性化学习、模拟和临床决策支持改变医学教育，同时要求具备 AI 素养方面的新能力。AI 为加速临床试验和数据分析提供了机会，但需要儿科专用框架来应对年龄相关偏倚，并强调研究中儿科数据的伦理使用。负责任地实施、强有力的监督、多学科合作以及持续的临床医生领导，对于在保障儿科患者及其家庭福祉的同时实现 AI 的潜力至关重要。

title: Multimodal AI in Oral Cancer: A PRISMA-Guided Systematic Review.
zh_title: 口腔癌多模态AI：PRISMA系统综述

abstract: [Healthcare technology letters] Oral cancer presents significant diagnostic and prognostic challenges, often due to late-stage detection and tumour heterogeneity. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML), offer promising solutions by integrating multimodal biomedical data. This PRISMA-guided systematic review evaluates over 82 studies from 2015 to 2025 that apply convolutional neural networks, transformers and graph neural networks to oral cancer, using combinations of histopathology, radiology, genomics and clinical data. Results indicate that multimodal AI models consistently outperform unimodal approaches in diagnostic accuracy, AUC and survival prediction. Architectures employing attention mechanisms, graph embedding and fusion transformers demonstrate superior performance in tasks such as early lesion detection and treatment outcome modelling. Despite these advances, challenges persist in generalisability, data standardisation and clinical validation. Multimodal AI thus represents a paradigm shift toward precision oncology in oral cancer, warranting further research focused on interpretability, prospective validation and ethical clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare technology letters] 口腔癌常因晚期发现和肿瘤异质性而带来显著的诊断和预后挑战。人工智能（AI）的最新进展，尤其是深度学习（DL）和机器学习（ML），通过整合多模态生物医学数据提供了有前景的解决方案。本项遵循PRISMA指南的系统综述评估了2015年至2025年间超过82项研究，这些研究将卷积神经网络、Transformer和图神经网络应用于口腔癌，并使用组织病理学、影像学、基因组学和临床数据的组合。结果表明，多模态AI模型在诊断准确性、AUC和生存预测方面始终优于单模态方法。采用注意力机制、图嵌入和融合Transformer的架构在早期病变检测和治疗结局建模等任务中表现出更优性能。尽管有这些进展，在泛化性、数据标准化和临床验证方面仍存在挑战。因此，多模态AI代表了口腔癌向精准肿瘤学的范式转变，值得进一步开展聚焦于可解释性、前瞻性验证和伦理临床部署的研究。

title: MambaSleepCVD for prediction of long term cardiovascular outcomes from polysomnography
zh_title: MambaSleepCVD：多导睡眠图预测长期心血管结局
summary: 基于耦合Mamba的多模态融合框架，用整夜多导睡眠图预测长期心血管风险，并在SHHS队列上验证。
key_points: 耦合Mamba做跨模态与时间融合
对比单模态专用编码与多模态自监督预训练
SHHS数据集验证，性能与基线相当或更优
reason: 方法有新意、队列规模较大，但仅单一公开队列验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Long-term cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk prediction remains a major global clinical priority. This study investigates how much prognostic information full-night polysomnography (PSG) carries after explicitly controlling demographic confounding, and whether combining specialized unimodal representations with continuous fusion mechanisms can effectively leverage it. We adopt a modular framework based on Coupled Mamba for simultaneous cross-modal and temporal fusion, capturing long-range dependencies and dynamic interactions between physiological modalities throughout sleep. With this capability, we assess whether specialized supervised representations from task-specific unimodal encoders offer prognostic value comparable to task-agnostic multimodal self-supervised pre-training. Validated on the Sleep Heart Health Study (SHHS) dataset, our approach achieves performance comparable to or better than current state-of-the-art architectures in the fully supervised, data-abundant regime, although the cardiac channel alone accounts for most of the discriminative signal. More importantly, we show that in the reference dataset chronological age strongly drives survival ranking; when provided as an explicit input, it can create a shortcut that obscures the contribution of PSG-derived physiology. Ultimately, our findings suggest that supervised unimodal experts integrated through a fusion engine provide a flexible pathway for prognostic risk ranking from sleep recordings, while reliable CVD screening will require independent external cohorts and explicit confounder control.
zh_abstract: 长期心血管疾病（CVD）风险预测仍然是全球主要的临床优先事项。本研究探讨在明确控制人口学混杂后，整夜多导睡眠图（PSG）携带多少预后信息，以及将专门化的单模态表征与连续融合机制相结合能否有效利用这些信息。我们采用基于 Coupled Mamba 的模块化框架，同时进行跨模态融合和时间融合，捕捉整个睡眠过程中生理模态之间的长程依赖和动态交互。借助这一能力，我们评估来自任务特定单模态编码器的专门化监督表征是否能提供与任务无关的多模态自监督预训练相当的预后价值。在 Sleep Heart Health Study（SHHS）数据集上验证时，我们的方法在完全监督、数据充足的情形下达到与当前最先进架构相当或更好的性能，尽管仅心脏通道就承载了大部分判别信号。更重要的是，我们表明在参考数据集中，实际年龄强烈驱动生存排序；当作为显式输入提供时，它可能形成捷径，掩盖源自 PSG 的生理信息的贡献。最终，我们的研究结果表明，通过融合引擎整合的监督单模态专家为从睡眠记录中进行预后风险排序提供了灵活路径，而可靠的 CVD 筛查将需要独立的外部队列和明确的混杂因素控制。

title: Learning to fuse and reconstruct multi-view graphs for diabetic retinopathy grading
zh_title: 多视图图融合与重建用于糖网分级
summary: 《医学图像分析》将刊出一项研究，提出多视图图融合与重建方法用于糖尿病视网膜病变分级；条目仅给出标题与作者，未见摘要。
reason: 仅有标题与作者、无摘要，方法细节与验证情况未知，最多给中等偏下档
abstract: Publication date: February 2027 Source: Medical Image Analysis, Volume 116 Author(s): Haoran Li, Yuxin Lin, Huan Wang, Xiaoling Luo, Qi Zhu, Jiahua Shi, Huaming Chen, Bo Du, Johan Barthelemy, Zongyan Xue, Jun Shen, Yong Xu
zh_abstract: 出版日期：2027年2月；来源：《Medical Image Analysis》第116卷；作者：Haoran Li、Yuxin Lin、Huan Wang、Xiaoling Luo、Qi Zhu、Jiahua Shi、Huaming Chen、Bo Du、Johan Barthelemy、Zongyan Xue、Jun Shen、Yong Xu

title: Health-System-Wide Mapping of Demographic Information in Routine Clinical Histopathology
zh_title: 常规病理切片中人口学信息的全院级映射
summary: 预印本分析 130 万张 H&E 切片，用病理基础模型评估性别、年龄组与自报种族的可识别性。
key_points: 130 万张全切片、25 个器官、25.7 万患者
诊断分层后信号减弱但仍存在
reason: 样本规模大、方法清晰，但为预印本且无外部验证或临床结局
abstract: The extent to which demographic-associated information is detectable across organs and disease states in routine clinical histopathology remains unclear. Here, we analyzed 1.3 million hematoxylin and eosin whole-slide images from 257,322 patients across 25 organs, using pathology foundation-model representations and multiple-instance learning to systematically map information associated with sex, age group, and self-reported race. Across 69 organ-demographic combinations, demographic attributes were broadly recoverable, with pan-organ mean AUROCs of 0.828 for sex, 0.733 for age group, and 0.662 for self-reported race, and substantial variation across organs. Demographic-class balancing produced relatively small changes in performance, while evaluation within diagnosis-text clusters showed modest attenuation. Under training with diagnosis-based grouping, demographic-associated signals remained detectable across multiple organs, including sex in gastric tissue (AUROC 0.865), age group in breast (0.816), and self-reported race in skin (0.728). Literature-guided analysis of these settings generated candidate histomorphological and contextual explanations for further investigation. Together, these findings provide a systematic map of demographic-associated information in routine histopathology, informing investigations of its sources, assessments of potential shortcut learning, and the development of more interpretable computational pathology models.
zh_abstract: 在常规临床组织病理学中，与人口学相关的信息在不同器官和疾病状态下的可检测程度仍不清楚。在此，我们分析了来自25个器官、257,322名患者的130万张苏木精-伊红（hematoxylin and eosin）全切片图像，使用病理基础模型表征和多实例学习，系统映射与性别、年龄组和自我报告种族相关的信息。在69个器官-人口学组合中，人口学属性广泛可恢复，性别、年龄组和自我报告种族的跨器官平均AUROC分别为0.828、0.733和0.662，且不同器官间差异很大。人口学类别平衡对性能产生的变化相对较小，而在诊断文本聚类内评估时显示出轻度衰减。在基于诊断分组进行训练时，人口学相关信号在多个器官中仍可检测到，包括胃组织中的性别（AUROC 0.865）、乳腺中的年龄组（0.816）和皮肤中的自我报告种族（0.728）。对这些情况的文献引导分析产生了候选的组织形态学和情境解释，以供进一步研究。总之，这些发现提供了常规组织病理学中人口学相关信息的系统图谱，为其来源研究、潜在捷径学习的评估以及更具可解释性的计算病理学模型的开发提供了信息。

title: Deep learning screening of otoscopic images for ENT referral: development, validation and deployment of NHREF OtoScan
zh_title: NHREF OtoScan：耳镜图像深度学习转诊筛查
summary: 预印本报告以转诊决策为目标的耳镜图像深度学习筛查工具，合并三个公开数据集4763张图像进行开发、验证与部署。
key_points: 合并三数据集、划分12个临床类别
统一视野归一化预处理
聚焦非专科医生的转诊决策
reason: 多来源图像、面向转诊并已部署，但为预印本且缺前瞻结局，属值得一看档上限
abstract: Background. Middle and external ear disease is common and largely treatable, but accurate otoscopic interpretation requires training that is scarce outside specialist ENT services. Published deep learning models for otoscopy report high accuracy, yet most are optimised for closed set classification rather than the referral decision a non specialist actually makes, report uncalibrated probabilities, and do not report the near duplicate controls that video derived otoscopic datasets demand. We developed, validated and deployed a screening aid framed around referral rather than diagnosis. Methods. We merged 4,763 otoscopic images from 16 folders across three public datasets into 12 clinically meaningful classes. Every image was passed through a single field of view normalisation function (crop to the illuminated field, square, resize to 224 px, mask to one fixed circle) shared identically by training and inference, to remove the framing cue that otherwise identifies the source dataset. Because one source is video derived, images were grouped by cosine similarity of generic ImageNet features (threshold 0.93, joined transitively) and whole groups assigned to a single split, giving 3,326 training, 719 validation and 718 test images. A MobileNetV2 backbone initialised from ImageNet was fine tuned from block9expand. Probabilities were averaged over the eight dihedral transforms of each image and temperature scaled. The referral score was one minus the probability of a normal ear, and its threshold was set on the validation abnormal ears as the highest value still meeting a target sensitivity of 97%, applied with an inclusive comparison. Model selection, calibration and threshold were frozen before the test split was scored once. Results. On the 718 held out test images, referral sensitivity was 97.0% (95% CI 95.1 to 98.2) and specificity 75.6% (95% CI 69.4 to 80.8), with AUROC 0.974 for abnormal versus normal; a cluster bootstrap over the 363 similarity groups in the test split widens those intervals to 93.8 99.6% and 66.0 83.4% respectively. Of 501 abnormal ears, 15 were not referred; 11 of these were myringosclerosis and none was cholesteatoma. Twelve class macro F1 was 0.686, balanced accuracy 68.3%, and accuracy 85.0% (86.2% with chronic subtypes merged). Temperature scaling (T = 1.2) reduced expected calibration error from 0.0498 to 0.0430. A low confidence flag fired on 4.0% of test images, separating 87.2% accuracy on unflagged from 31.0% on flagged cases.
zh_abstract: 【背景】中耳和外耳疾病常见且大多可治疗，但准确的耳镜判读需要培训，而这类培训在专科耳鼻喉（ENT）服务之外很匮乏。已发表的耳镜深度学习模型报告了高准确率，但大多数针对闭集分类而非非专科医生实际做出的转诊决策进行优化，报告的是未校准概率，并且未报告视频衍生耳镜数据集所要求的近重复对照。我们开发、验证并部署了一种以转诊而非诊断为核心的筛查辅助工具。【方法】我们将来自三个公共数据集、16 个文件夹的 4,763 张耳镜图像合并为 12 个具有临床意义的类别。每张图像均经过同一个视野归一化函数（裁剪至照明区域、方形化、缩放至 224 px、掩膜为一个固定圆形），该函数在训练和推理中完全相同地共享，以去除否则会识别来源数据集的取景线索。由于一个来源是视频衍生的，图像按通用 ImageNet 特征的余弦相似度分组（阈值 0.93，传递式合并），整个组被分配到单一划分，得到 3,326 张训练图像、719 张验证图像和 718 张测试图像。以 ImageNet 初始化的 MobileNetV2 骨干从 block9expand 开始微调。概率对每张图像的八种二面体变换取平均并进行温度缩放。转诊评分为 1 减去正常耳的概率，其阈值在验证集异常耳上设定为仍满足 97% 目标灵敏度的最高值，并采用包含性比较应用。模型选择、校准和阈值在测试划分被一次性评分之前已冻结。【结果】在 718 张留出测试图像上，转诊灵敏度为 97.0%（95% CI 95.1 至 98.2），特异度为 75.6%（95% CI 69.4 至 80.8），异常 versus 正常的 AUROC 为 0.974；对测试划分中 363 个相似性组进行聚类 bootstrap 后，这些区间分别扩大至 93.8 至 99.6% 和 66.0 至 83.4%。在 501 只异常耳中，15 只未被转诊；其中 11 只为鼓膜硬化，无一例为胆脂瘤。十二类宏平均 F1 为 0.686，平衡准确率为 68.3%，准确率为 85.0%（合并慢性亚型后为 86.2%）。温度缩放（T = 1.2）将期望校准误差从 0.0498 降至 0.0430。低置信度标志在 4.0% 的测试图像上触发，将未标志病例的 87.2% 准确率与标志病例的 31.0% 准确率区分开。

title: Artificial intelligence for vascular minimally invasive surgery: techniques, clinical integration, and challenges.
zh_title: 血管微创手术中的人工智能：技术、临床整合与挑战
summary: 综述30项研究，梳理AI在血管微创手术中的预测分析、决策支持、图像分析与机器人自动化的应用与挑战。
key_points: 纳入30项原始研究，含机器学习与深度学习
覆盖预测分析、决策支持、图像分析与机器人
讨论临床转化、部署、监管与伦理问题
reason: 同行评审综述，系统检索但纳入研究仅30项、无原始外部验证，属综述上限档
abstract: [Frontiers in cardiovascular medicine] Minimally invasive surgery (MIS), including endovascular and robot-assisted procedures, is widely used for vascular pathologies but remains limited by technical complexity, cognitive workload, and postoperative complications. Artificial Intelligence (AI) may help address these challenges through predictive analysis, decision support, image analysis, and automation. A structured Google Scholar search was conducted from February 21, 2025, to January 1, 2026, and updated through September 2026. Peer-reviewed studies applying AI to vascular MIS were included, with additional targeted searches addressing clinical translation, deployment, regulation, and ethical considerations. Thirty primary studies were analyzed, including eight on machine learning, nine on deep learning, four on natural language processing, and nine on robotics or reinforcement learning. Machine learning supported risk stratification and outcome prediction, deep learning enabled imaging and segmentation applications, natural language processing facilitated clinical information extraction, and robotic systems supported navigation and procedural assistance. AI demonstrates substantial potential across the vascular MIS pathway, but broader clinical adoption requires stronger validation, prospective multicenter studies, standardized reporting, health-economic evaluation, and careful consideration of regulatory, liability, and accessibility challenges.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine] 微创手术（MIS），包括血管内和机器人辅助手术，广泛用于血管病变，但仍受技术复杂性、认知负荷和术后并发症的限制。人工智能（AI）可通过预测分析、决策支持、图像分析和自动化帮助应对这些挑战。于2025年2月21日至2026年1月1日进行了结构化Google Scholar检索，并更新至2026年9月。纳入将AI应用于血管MIS的同行评审研究，并进行额外针对性检索，以探讨临床转化、部署、监管和伦理考量。分析了30项原始研究，包括8项机器学习、9项深度学习、4项自然语言处理和9项机器人或强化学习研究。机器学习支持风险分层和结局预测，深度学习实现影像和分割应用，自然语言处理促进临床信息提取，机器人系统支持导航和手术辅助。AI在整个血管MIS路径中显示出巨大潜力，但更广泛的临床采用需要更强验证、前瞻性多中心研究、标准化报告、卫生经济学评估，以及对监管、责任和可及性挑战的审慎考虑。

title: Glyph: An Interpretability Engine for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery in Clinical Data
zh_title: Glyph：临床数据科学发现的可解释性引擎
summary: arXiv预印本提出Glyph引擎，用于解释临床基础模型的隐嵌入特征，以自动提取超出现有表型定义的新特征并支持疾病机制发现。
key_points: 针对预定义表型限制发现范围的问题
解释临床基础模型隐嵌入以发现新特征
预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 方法有新意但仅预印本、无外部验证或结果细节
abstract: Automated scientific discovery has the potential to advance understanding of disease mechanisms and accelerate identification of early disease markers. Manual data annotation is infeasible at population scale, motivating methods that automatically extract pre-defined phenotypes in multimodal and unstructured clinical data. Such pre-defined feature sets determine and limit which associations these approaches can discover. This limitation extends to agentic AI systems that use these tools to query population-scale data. In contrast, foundation models (FMs) trained on large volumes of clinical data can perform tasks beyond their training objectives. This suggests their latent embeddings may represent novel or unexplored features that could yield insights into disease mechanisms, yet such latent features remain difficult to interpret. To address this challenge, we introduce Glyph, an automated multistage framework that extracts features from multimodal and unstructured clinical data using FMs and sparse autoencoders, interprets them as coded clinical concepts, and evaluates their value for clinical scientific discovery. We applied Glyph to abdominal CT volumes, CT radiology reports and laboratory measurements from 41,628 patients across different institutions. We identified 397 predictive concepts supported by 4,463 Bonferroni-significant associations. Moreover, a majority of discovered associations were automatically reproducible in held-out cohorts across different sites. Glyph concepts provided complementary associations to literature-derived markers, leading to gains in predictive power. We envision that interpretability can extend beyond a mechanistic understanding of neural networks to connecting implicitly learned features with clinical knowledge and establishing their significance for patient outcomes. We release Glyph at https://github.com/StanfordMIMI/Glyph.
zh_abstract: 自动化科学发现有望促进对疾病机制的理解，并加速早期疾病标志物的识别。在人群规模上进行人工数据标注不可行，这推动了从多模态和非结构化临床数据中自动提取预定义表型的方法。此类预定义特征集决定并限制了这些方法能够发现的关联。这一局限性也延伸到使用这些工具查询人群规模数据的智能体式人工智能（agentic AI）系统。相比之下，在大规模临床数据上训练的基础模型（FMs）可以执行超出其训练目标的任务。这表明其潜在嵌入可能代表新的或尚未探索的特征，从而可能为疾病机制提供见解，然而此类潜在特征仍然难以解释。为应对这一挑战，我们引入了Glyph，这是一个自动化多阶段框架，使用FMs和稀疏自编码器从多模态和非结构化临床数据中提取特征，将其解释为编码的临床概念，并评估其对临床科学发现的价值。我们将Glyph应用于来自不同机构41,628例患者的腹部CT体积、CT放射学报告和实验室测量数据。我们识别出397个预测性概念，并由4,463个Bonferroni显著关联支持。此外，大多数发现的关联可在不同站点的留出队列中自动重现。Glyph概念与文献衍生标志物提供了互补关联，从而提升了预测效能。我们设想，可解释性可以超越对神经网络的机制性理解，将隐式学习到的特征与临床知识联系起来，并确立其对患者结局的重要性。我们在https://github.com/StanfordMIMI/Glyph发布了Glyph。

title: COMBIO: Automated Discovery of a Compact Composite Biomarker from Routine Laboratory Panels
zh_title: COMBIO：从常规检验面板自动导出复合生物标志物
summary: 预印本提出自动化流程，将梯度提升模型蒸馏为含整数指数的闭式复合生物标志物，并在六个任务上评估。
key_points: 用Shapley值筛选五项候选检验指标
复合式为检验值整数次幂乘积
含NHANES与肝病分类共六项任务
reason: 方法有新意且有留出测试集，但属预印本、证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Machine-learning models based on routine laboratory panels can predict outcomes but can be difficult to interpret and operationalize. We present COMBIO, an automated pipeline that distils such a model into a compact closed-form biomarker. The composite is a product of laboratory measurements raised to integer powers from minus two to two. The sign of each exponent indicates whether higher values of the corresponding measurement increase or decrease the composite. Shapley additive explanation values from the gradient-boosted reference model rank five candidate measurements and guide eligible exponent signs. An exhaustive search over small integer exponents selects the formula on an inner validation set, before evaluation on the reserved test set. We evaluated COMBIO across six tasks: three National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey outcomes, liver-disease classification in the Indian Liver Patient Dataset, and Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV in-hospital mortality and sepsis case-finding, with external evaluation in the eICU Collaborative Research Database for the two hospital tasks. Across the six test sets, COMBIO's area under the receiver operating characteristic curve differed by at most 0.03 from logistic regression using the five candidate laboratory measurements. The hospital mortality composite had an area under the curve of 0.698 in the external database. A version restricted to widely available measurements in the source hospital database achieved an area under the curve of 0.786 in a cohort covering 92% of admissions. The multiplicative representation provides compactness rather than additional accuracy, and local validation and recalibration are required before clinical use.
zh_abstract: 基于常规实验室检查组合的机器学习模型可以预测结局，但可能难以解释和落地应用。我们提出 COMBIO，一个自动化流程，可将此类模型提炼为紧凑的闭式生物标志物。该复合指标是若干实验室测量值的乘积，各测量值取 -2 到 2 的整数次幂。每个指数的符号表示相应测量值升高会增加还是降低该复合指标。来自梯度提升参考模型的 Shapley 加性解释（Shapley additive explanation）值对五个候选测量值排序，并指导可用的指数符号。通过对小整数指数进行穷举搜索，在内部验证集上选择公式，随后在预留测试集上评估。我们在六项任务中评估 COMBIO：三项美国国家健康与营养调查（National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey）结局、印度肝病患者数据集（Indian Liver Patient Dataset）中的肝病分类，以及 Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV 的院内死亡率和脓毒症病例发现，并在 eICU 协作研究数据库（eICU Collaborative Research Database）中对两项医院任务进行外部评估。在全部六个测试集上，COMBIO 的受试者工作特征曲线下面积与使用五个候选实验室测量值的逻辑回归相比差异至多为 0.03。医院死亡率复合指标在外部数据库中的曲线下面积为 0.698。一个仅限于源医院数据库中广泛可用测量值的版本，在覆盖 92% 入院患者的队列中达到曲线下面积 0.786。乘法表示提供的是紧凑性而非额外准确性，临床使用前需要局部验证和重新校准。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ruijin Hospital; conditions: Pancreatic Mucinous Cystic Neoplasm, Pancreatic Serous Cystic Neoplasm, Pancreatic Pseudocyst; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 400; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Pancreatic mucinous cystic neoplasms (MCNs), serous cystic neoplasms (SCNs), and pancreatic pseudocysts (PPCs) often exhibit overlapping imaging features on endoscopic ultrasound (EUS). However, these conditions require different clinical management strategies. Accurate differentiation is therefore important for appropriate treatment planning. This study aims to develop and validate an artificial intelligence (AI) model that integrates EUS images and clinical features to differentiate MCNs, SCNs, and PPCs. The study is designed as an ambispective observational diagnostic study consisting of retrospective model development, prospective temporal validation, and a reader study involving EUS physicians. Approximately 400 adult patients with confirmed MCN, SCN, or PPC will be included. Retrospective clinical data and EUS images will be used for model development and internal validation. After model development is completed, newly diagnosed patients will be prospectively enrolled to independently evaluate the diagnostic performance of the model. The primary outcome is the patient-level macro-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (macro-AUROC) for three-class classification in the prospective validation cohort. Secondary outcomes include diagnostic accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, calibration, clinical net benefit, and the performance of EUS physicians with and without AI assistance. This study is expected to provide evidence for the potential clinical value of AI-assisted differentiation of pancreatic cystic lesions. No additional invasive procedures or study-specific treatments will be performed.

title: Mathematical foundations of artificial intelligence in healthcare: a systematic review.
zh_title: 医疗AI数学基础的系统综述
summary: 按PRISMA 2020系统检索2016年至2026年文献，纳入147项研究，梳理医疗AI的数学基础与方法趋势。

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare relies on diverse mathematical frameworks, yet their contributions to model development, evaluation, interpretability, and clinical translation remain fragmented. This systematic review synthesized the classical and emerging mathematical foundations underpinning healthcare AI and examined major methodological and application trends. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, studies published between January 2016 and June 30, 2026, were identified through systematic searches of Scopus, Google Scholar, and PubMed/MEDLINE, with searches conducted using Harzing's Publish or Perish v8 where applicable. Bibliometric analysis was performed using VOSviewer, while methodological quality was assessed using an adapted JBI-based framework and AMSTAR-2 for systematic reviews. Of 653 records identified, 147 studies met the eligibility criteria. Non-mutually exclusive mathematical-domain coding identified linear algebra in 100/147 studies (68.0%), calculus and optimization in 91/147 (61.9%), and probability and statistics in 79/147 (53.7%), highlighting their roles in data representation, learning, optimization, inference, uncertainty quantification, and validation. A separate mutually exclusive classification of dominant methodological themes identified explainable and trustworthy AI in 24/147 studies (16.3%), statistics and learning theory in 23/147 (15.6%), probability and Bayesian methods in 23/147 (15.6%), calculus and optimization in 19/147 (12.9%), and linear algebra in 15/147 (10.2%). Radiology and medical imaging were the leading healthcare application (24.3%), while classification and diagnosis were the most frequent clinical task (17.1%). Overall, healthcare AI is supported by an interconnected mathematical ecosystem. Emerging approaches, including graph neural networks, Transformers, and quantum machine learning, require stronger external validation, standardized benchmarking, and rigorous evaluation for reliable clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 医疗保健中的人工智能（AI）依赖多种数学框架，但这些框架对模型开发、评估、可解释性和临床转化的贡献仍然零散。本系统综述综合了支撑医疗保健 AI 的经典和新兴数学基础，并考察了主要方法学和应用趋势。遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南，通过系统检索 Scopus、Google Scholar 和 PubMed/MEDLINE 识别 2016 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月 30 日期间发表的研究，并在适用时使用 Harzing's Publish or Perish v8 进行检索。使用 VOSviewer 进行文献计量分析，同时使用改编的基于 JBI 的框架评估方法学质量，并使用 AMSTAR-2 评估系统综述。在识别出的 653 条记录中，147 项研究符合纳入标准。非互斥的数学领域编码显示，线性代数出现在 100/147 项研究（68.0%）中，微积分与优化出现在 91/147 项（61.9%）中，概率与统计出现在 79/147 项（53.7%）中，突显了它们在数据表示、学习、优化、推断、不确定性量化和验证中的作用。对主要方法学主题进行的另一项互斥分类显示，可解释与可信 AI 出现在 24/147 项研究（16.3%）中，统计与学习理论出现在 23/147 项（15.6%）中，概率与贝叶斯方法出现在 23/147 项（15.6%）中，微积分与优化出现在 19/147 项（12.9%）中，线性代数出现在 15/147 项（10.2%）中。放射学与医学成像是领先的医疗保健应用（24.3%），而分类与诊断是最常见的临床任务（17.1%）。总体而言，医疗保健 AI 由一个相互关联的数学生态系统支撑。新兴方法，包括图神经网络、Transformers 和量子机器学习，需要更强的外部验证、标准化基准测试和严格评估，以实现可靠的临床转化。

abstract: Reconstructing participant-level data from published Kaplan-Meier curves supports meta-analysis and other secondary survival analyses when original trial records are unavailable. Researchers may use original PDF figures or screenshots, which can look alike but retain different information. We assessed how converting vector figures to images affects reconstruction by a language model that can inspect files and execute code. We generated 64 independent two-arm datasets across four scenarios combining 100 or 1,000 participants per arm with proportional or crossing hazards. Each figure was supplied as a native vector PDF and a matched 300-dpi PNG to Opus 5.5 through Claude Code under the same instructions. Outcomes compared reconstructed records with the original observed records: time-averaged absolute curve error through 24 months, error in the between-group restricted mean survival time difference, and error in the Cox log-hazard ratio. Native PDFs had lower curve error in all 64 completed pairs, including replacements for incomplete runs. Mean errors were 0.000029 and 0.1047 percentage points for PDF and PNG, respectively; the paired difference was -0.1047 (95% confidence interval, -0.1194 to -0.0909). PNG errors in the restricted mean survival time difference and log-hazard ratio were small: mean absolute errors were 0.0084 months and 0.0027. Lower resolution and compression increased curve errors; embedding unchanged pixels in a PDF did not restore vector accuracy. Some PNG runs exceeded the instructed revision limit, so results describe the implemented workflow rather than performance under a strictly enforced limit. Preserving vector information improved reconstruction fidelity in this workflow, but the observed differences do not establish clinically consequential changes in treatment estimates. Validation against reported survival summaries and event counts remains necessary. Generalization to published clinical figures and other model workflows requires further evaluation.
zh_abstract: 当原始试验记录不可用时，从已发表的Kaplan-Meier曲线重建参与者水平数据可支持荟萃分析和其他二次生存分析。研究人员可能使用原始PDF图或截图，它们看起来相似但保留的信息不同。我们评估了将矢量图转换为图像如何影响一个能够检查文件并执行代码的语言模型所进行的重建。我们在四种情景下生成了64个独立双组数据集，这些情景结合了每组100名或1,000名参与者与成比例或交叉风险。每张图均以原生矢量PDF和匹配的300-dpi PNG形式，在相同指令下通过Claude Code提供给Opus 5.5。结局将重建记录与原始观察记录进行比较：至24个月的时间平均绝对曲线误差、组间限制性平均生存时间差异的误差，以及Cox对数风险比的误差。原生PDF在所有64个完成的配对中曲线误差均较低，包括对未完成运行的替换。PDF和PNG的平均误差分别为0.000029和0.1047个百分点；配对差异为-0.1047（95%置信区间，-0.1194至-0.0909）。PNG在限制性平均生存时间差异和对数风险比方面的误差较小：平均绝对误差分别为0.0084个月和0.0027。较低分辨率和压缩增加了曲线误差；将未改变的像素嵌入PDF并未恢复矢量准确性。一些PNG运行超过了指示的修订限制，因此结果描述的是实际实施的工作流程，而不是在严格强制执行限制下的性能。在此工作流程中，保留矢量信息提高了重建保真度，但观察到的差异并不能确立治疗估计中具有临床意义的变化。仍需针对已报告的生存汇总和事件计数进行验证。对已发表临床图和其他模型工作流程的推广需要进一步评估。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Edozie Iweka; conditions: Analysis of Retrospectively Collected MRI Referral Data; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 900000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Background Vetting and assigning of protocols to MRI scan requests are usually carried out by radiologists and radiographers. This way is both time-consuming and prone to error. Recent improvements in Artificial Intelligence (Al) like Large Language Models (LLMs) are better at processing human language. It could be used to improve tasks like image reporting and assigning protocols in radiology. Approach Firstly, I will find out about the delays in the way this is currently done. I will use a survey to find out the perceptions of radiologists to both the current process and the proposed Al intervention. I will then use an LLM to undertake referral and protocol tasks. I will compare its performance to the performance of clinical specialists and established guidelines. I will present the explanation reports to radiologists and ask them if they can be understood and whether they can be trusted as clinically reliable. Impact My research could help reduce the workload and time radiologists spend dealing with scan requests. The findings will help design future research to consider application in real clinical settings.

The main questions it aims to answer are: 1. Does the AI-assisted primary care intervention increase influenza risk perception, influenza vaccine literacy, vaccine confidence, intention to receive influenza vaccination, and influenza vaccination uptake among patients with chronic diseases? 2. Is the AI-assisted primary care intervention cost-effective compared with conventional health education? 3. Is the AI-assisted primary care intervention acceptable, feasible, and potentially sustainable for influenza vaccination promotion? Researchers will compare patients with chronic diseases who receive the AI-assisted primary care intervention with those who do not receive it to determine whether the intervention improves patients' literacy, confidence, intention, and uptake of influenza vaccination. Participants will: 1. Be recruited and randomly assigned to the intervention group or control group. Participants in the intervention group will have access to an AI assistant for influenza vaccine-related information and will receive an influenza vaccination recommendation from primary care physicians, while participants in the control group will receive routine health education. 2. Complete a survey questionnaire assessing patients' influenza risk perception, influenza vaccine literacy, vaccine confidence, and intention to receive influenza vaccination. 3. Have their influenza vaccination uptake assessed at the end of the trial.

title: Large language models are unstable as autonomous medical evaluators across clinical tasks.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 大模型作自主医学评判者跨任务不稳定
