abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated evaluators of medical text ("LLM-as-judge"). We tested whether LLM-evaluator performance validated on one medical task against a human reference standard remains stable on a structurally different task. We evaluated 10 LLMs (3 locally served open-source and 7 API models: Claude, GPT, DeepSeek) as autonomous judges on 3 tasks with human reference labels: LiveQA-Med answer quality (n = 300), PubMedQA research appraisal (n = 300), and Emergency Severity Index (ESI) triage on MIMIC-IV-Ext (n = 256). Each case was scored 3 times per model at temperature zero (25 680 judgments). Analyses used cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals, quadratic-weighted Cohen's κ, and false-discovery-rate correction. Evaluator performance was unstable across tasks: no model ranked in the top 3 on all 3 tasks, and every model shifted by 3 or more rank positions between at least one pair of tasks. In the highest-stakes task, ESI level 1 (Resuscitation) cases were under-triaged in 89.1% of evaluations, in all 10 models (range 70.2%-96.9%). Best triage agreement only reached the human inter-rater range (Claude Opus quadratic-weighted κ = 0.60 [0.54, 0.66]). Locally served 7-27B models (no per-query charge) occupied the Pareto frontier on the text tasks but only its low-concordance end on triage. LLM-evaluator performance is unstable between medical tasks that differ in cognitive structure; performance validated on one task should not be assumed to transfer to another. Task-specific validation against human reference labels is required before deployment, and emergency triage demands human oversight at the highest-acuity tier.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被用作医学文本的自动评估器（“LLM-as-judge”）。我们检验了：在某一医学任务上以人类参考标准验证的 LLM 评估器表现，在结构不同的任务上是否仍保持稳定。我们将 10 个 LLM（3 个本地部署的开源模型和 7 个 API 模型：Claude、GPT、DeepSeek）作为自主评判者，在 3 个具有人类参考标签的任务上进行评估：LiveQA-Med 答案质量（n = 300）、PubMedQA 研究评价（n = 300），以及 MIMIC-IV-Ext 上的急诊严重指数（ESI）分诊（n = 256）。每个病例在每个模型上以温度零重复评分 3 次（共 25 680 次判断）。分析使用聚类自助法置信区间、二次加权 Cohen's κ 和错误发现率校正。评估器表现跨任务不稳定：没有任何模型在全部 3 个任务上都排名前 3，且每个模型在至少一对任务之间排名移动 3 个或更多位次。在风险最高的任务中，ESI 1 级（复苏）病例在 89.1% 的评估中被分诊不足，且见于全部 10 个模型（范围 70.2%-96.9%）。最佳分诊一致性仅达到人类评分者间范围（Claude Opus 二次加权 κ = 0.60 [0.54, 0.66]）。本地部署的 7-27B 模型（无按查询计费）在文本任务上占据帕累托前沿，但在分诊上仅处于其低一致性端。LLM 评估器表现会在认知结构不同的医学任务之间不稳定；在一个任务上验证的表现不应假定可迁移到另一个任务。部署前需要针对具体任务使用人类参考标签进行验证，而急诊分诊在最高急症层级需要人类监督。

title: Silent Manipulation of Mental Health Treatment Recommendations From a Large Language Model.
zh_title: 大模型心理健康治疗推荐可被静默操纵
summary: 研究显示，对开源大模型施加激活引导，可在不改权重、不改提示词且不告知用户的情况下改变其抑郁症治疗推荐。
key_points: 12个抑郁咨询情境，30档引导强度
激活引导不改变权重与提示词
推荐可被商业或意识形态目的静默改变
reason: JAMA Netw Open同行评审，安全问题新颖，但仅12个情境的小规模非人研究，属值得一看档
abstract: Importance: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly inform mental health decisions by patients and clinicians. Inference-time activation steering can shift model behavior on a target dimension without altering weights or prompts and without disclosure to users, allowing treatment recommendations to be silently changed for commercial or ideological reasons. Objective: To determine whether directional activation steering can shift an open-weights LLM's depression treatment recommendations. Design Setting and Participants: This non-human subjects study applied directional activation steering to an open-weights LLM (DeepSeek V4 Flash) responding to 12 depression-advice scenarios (4 favoring medication, 4 favoring avoidance, 4 neutral), generated at 30 amplitudes from -1.5 to +1.5 in 0.1 increments plus an unsteered baseline. Exposures: A single steering direction contrasting antidepressant medication with self-directed approaches (diet, exercise, meditation, dietary supplements), constructed from 16 paired training prompts and applied at the attention output of every transformer block; weights and system prompt were held constant. Main Outcomes and Measures: The extent to which medication and four self-care categories were addressed, scored 0 to 3 by a human-validated LLM rater (Claude Opus 4.7), the medication-versus-self-care balance, and clinician referral, estimated per unit of amplitude using mixed-effects models with a scenario random intercept. Results: Across 372 generations, steering produced a graded, dose-dependent shift in the medication-versus-self-care balance, which declined by 0.32 per unit of amplitude (β = -0.32; 95% CI, -0.39 to -0.25; P < .001); medication extent fell and self-care extent rose. The shift was largest for scenarios with no stated treatment preference (β = -0.44; 95% CI, -0.54 to -0.34; P < .001). A clinician referral appeared in 322 of 372 responses (87%) and did not vary with steering amplitude (P = .63). Conclusions and Relevance: In this open-weights LLM providing depression treatment information, inference-time activation steering shifted treatment recommendations without altering weights, prompt structure, or safety outputs, with the largest effect among users expressing no treatment preference. These findings suggest a need for LLM disclosure standards and independent auditing as such models inform clinical decisions.
zh_abstract: 【重要性】大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地影响患者和临床医生做出的心理健康决策。推理时激活引导（inference-time activation steering）能够在既不改变权重也不改变提示、且不向用户披露的情况下，使模型行为在某一目标维度上发生偏移，从而可能出于商业或意识形态原因被悄然改变治疗建议。【目的】确定方向性激活引导是否能改变一个开放权重LLM的抑郁症治疗建议。【设计、场景与参与者】这项非人类受试者研究将方向性激活引导应用于一个开放权重LLM（DeepSeek V4 Flash），使其对12个抑郁症建议情景（4个倾向药物治疗、4个倾向回避、4个中性）作出回应；这些情景在-1.5至+1.5范围内以0.1为增量生成30个幅度，另加一个未引导的基线。【暴露】一个单一的引导方向，用于对比抗抑郁药物治疗与自我主导方法（饮食、运动、冥想、膳食补充剂），由16对配对训练提示构建，并施加于每个transformer模块的注意力输出；权重和系统提示保持不变。【主要结局与指标】药物治疗和四个自我照护类别被涉及的程度（由经人工验证的LLM评分者（Claude Opus 4.7）按0至3分评分）、药物治疗与自我照护的平衡以及临床医生转诊，均使用以情景为随机截距的混合效应模型按每单位幅度估计。【结果】在372次生成中，引导在药物治疗与自我照护的平衡上产生了分级、剂量依赖性的偏移，每单位幅度下降0.32（β = -0.32；95% CI，-0.39至-0.25；P < .001）；药物治疗程度下降，自我照护程度上升。该偏移在未陈述治疗偏好的情景中最大（β = -0.44；95% CI，-0.54至-0.34；P < .001）。372条回应中有322条（87%）出现临床医生转诊，且不随引导幅度变化（P = .63）。【结论与意义】在这个提供抑郁症治疗信息的开放权重LLM中，推理时激活引导在不改变权重、提示结构或安全输出的情况下改变了治疗建议，其效应在未表达治疗偏好的使用者中最大。这些发现提示，随着此类模型影响临床决策，有必要制定LLM披露标准并开展独立审计。

source: PubMed · Current opinion in nephrology and hypertension
zh_title: 透析中的AI：从算法开发走向临床实施与治理
summary: 综述指出透析 AI 已进入实施与治理阶段，涉及首项随机试验、21 项 RCT 的 meta 分析及学会框架。

abstract: [Current opinion in nephrology and hypertension] Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning in dialysis have matured beyond the initial phase of algorithm development. Recent work has shifted toward clinical implementation, evaluation, and governance. During the past year, the first randomized trial of AI-guided dosing in maintenance hemodialysis has been published, a meta-analysis of technology-guided dry-weight adjustment has appeared, and the first professional society framework for the responsible use of AI in kidney care has been released. The Anemia Control Model is now supported by hospitalization outcomes and cost-effectiveness analyses. A randomized trial demonstrated that AI-guided erythropoiesis-stimulating agent dosing achieved outcomes comparable to physician-directed dosing. Technology-guided dry-weight adjustment is supported by a meta-analysis of 21 randomized trials. Machine learning for vascular access is evolving toward preoperative clinical decision support, while peritoneal dialysis is beginning to receive greater attention from the machine learning community. Large language models are entering nephrology along two complementary paths: open generative systems for education and clinical support, and deterministic, protocol-driven frameworks designed for safety-critical bedside applications. At the same time, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has released comprehensive lifecycle guidance for AI-enabled medical devices. The major challenge for AI in dialysis is no longer developing accurate prediction models. Instead, success will depend on effective workflow integration, validation across diverse patient populations, ongoing postdeployment monitoring, and demonstrating meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.
zh_abstract: [Current Opinion in Nephrology and Hypertension] 透析中的人工智能（AI）和机器学习已超越算法开发的初始阶段。近期工作已转向临床实施、评估和治理。在过去一年中，首项关于维持性血液透析中 AI 指导给药的随机试验已发表，一项关于技术引导的干体重调整的荟萃分析已出现，并且首个关于在肾脏照护中负责任使用 AI 的专业学会框架已发布。贫血控制模型（Anemia Control Model）现已得到住院结局和成本效果分析的支持。一项随机试验表明，AI 指导的促红细胞生成素刺激剂给药取得了与医生指导给药相当的结果。技术引导的干体重调整得到一项纳入 21 项随机试验的荟萃分析支持。用于血管通路的机器学习正朝着术前临床决策支持方向发展，而腹膜透析正开始受到机器学习界更多关注。大语言模型正沿两条互补路径进入肾脏病学：用于教育和临床支持的开放式生成系统，以及为安全关键的床旁应用设计的确定性、方案驱动框架。与此同时，美国食品药品监督管理局（U.S. Food and Drug Administration）已发布针对 AI 赋能医疗器械的全面全生命周期指南。透析中 AI 的主要挑战不再是开发准确的预测模型。相反，成功将取决于有效的工作流程整合、在不同患者人群中的验证、持续的部署后监测，以及证明患者结局有意义的改善。

abstract: [Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft = Journal of the German Society of Dermatology : JDDG] Basal cell carcinoma (BCC) is the most common cancer and a major public health burden. Noninvasive techniques such as optical coherence tomography (OCT) may reduce unnecessary biopsies and enable earlier detection. However, effective OCT interpretation requires expertise. Artificial intelligence (AI) may help overcome this barrier. An AI model based on a U-Net convolutional neural network was trained using 4,680 annotated OCT image frames from 39 BCCs, 5,640 frames from 47 premalignant and benign lesions, and 12,360 frames from 103 scans of healthy skin. Detection performance was evaluated on an independent test set comprising 26 scans (3,120 frames) from 16 BCCs, 5 premalignant lesions, and 5 benign lesions. External validation used independent clinical data from 25 histologically confirmed BCCs (18 nodular, 7 superficial). AI-assisted OCT generated visual overlays corresponding to established BCC features and identified tumor areas. In the independent test set, the area under the ROC curve was 95.5 % for nodular and 98.2 % for superficial BCC. In clinical validation, all BCCs were detected, and subtype concordance with histology was achieved in 21 of 25 cases (83 %). AI-assisted OCT shows potential to improve non-invasive BCC diagnostics and warrants further clinical evaluation.
zh_abstract: [Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft = Journal of the German Society of Dermatology : JDDG] 基底细胞癌（BCC）是最常见的癌症，也是重大的公共卫生负担。光学相干断层扫描（OCT）等无创技术可减少不必要的活检并实现更早发现。然而，有效的OCT判读需要专业知识。人工智能（AI）可能有助于克服这一障碍。基于U-Net卷积神经网络的AI模型使用来自39例BCC的4,680个标注OCT图像帧、来自47个癌前病变和良性病变的5,640个帧，以及来自103次健康皮肤扫描的12,360个帧进行训练。检测性能在独立测试集上评估，该测试集包括来自16例BCC、5个癌前病变和5个良性病变的26次扫描（3,120个帧）。外部验证使用来自25例经组织学确诊的BCC（18例结节型，7例浅表型）的独立临床数据。AI辅助OCT生成了与既定BCC特征相对应的视觉叠加图，并识别了肿瘤区域。在独立测试集中，结节型BCC的ROC曲线下面积为95.5%，浅表型BCC为98.2%。在临床验证中，所有BCC均被检出，25例中有21例（83%）实现了与组织学的亚型一致性。AI辅助OCT显示出改善无创BCC诊断的潜力，值得进一步临床评估。

title: MedGraph: Maintaining Patient State with Graph Memory for Long-Term Medical Dialogue
zh_title: MedGraph：用图记忆维护长期医疗对话中的患者状态
summary: 预印本提出面向长期医疗对话的图记忆系统，按时间抽取事实、归属到具体患者并链接成链，以改善检索准确性。
key_points: 归纳五种记忆系统的三类错误：状态过时、他人事实混入、缺安全事实
构建时抽取带日期事实并归属到对应个人，药物诊断测量成链保留历史状态
检索按患者事实链为单位、按问题所问时间点读取，并附原文对话
reason: 预印本新方法，与五个基线记忆系统对比并自建基准，但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: LLM-based medical assistants that follow a patient across visits need a memory that keeps the patient's clinical state correct as it changes. We examine the errors of five memory systems on longitudinal medical dialogue and find three recurring causes: the retrieved evidence gives an outdated state, includes another person's health facts, or lacks a safety fact the answer depends on. We present MedGraph, a graph memory built for these three cases. Construction extracts dated facts from each session, attributes each fact to the person it describes, and links medication, diagnosis, and measurement records into chains that keep earlier states. Retrieval ranks the patient's chains as units, reads each chain at the time the question asks about, and adds the original dialogue text; a patient profile lists every recorded safety fact with every question. On MedMemoryBench, MedGraph has the highest overall accuracy with both a GPT and a Qwen backbone, 10.5 and 10.4 points above the strongest of five baselines, with efficient memory construction and answering in the GPT setting.
zh_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的医疗助手在跨就诊随访患者时，需要一种能在患者临床状态变化时保持其正确的记忆。我们考察了五种记忆系统在纵向医学对话中的错误，发现三类反复出现的原因：检索到的证据给出过时状态、包含他人的健康事实，或缺少答案所依赖的安全性事实。我们提出MedGraph，一种针对这三种情况构建的图记忆。构建过程从每次会话中提取带日期的事实，将每条事实归属于其所描述的人，并将药物、诊断和测量记录链接成保留早期状态的链。检索以患者为单元对其链进行排序，在问题所询问的时间点读取每条链，并加入原始对话文本；患者档案列出每条记录的安全性事实与每个问题。在MedMemoryBench上，MedGraph在GPT和Qwen骨干模型下均具有最高总体准确率，分别比五个基线中最强者高10.5和10.4分，并在GPT设置下具有高效的内存构建和回答。

title: A decision-only model as a low-cost judge of medical AI answers
zh_title: 仅决策模型可作为医疗 AI 答案的低成本评判者
summary: medRxiv 预印本：在五项临床基准上预注册评估，比较仅输出结构化概率的轻量决策模型与大模型评判者的表现。
key_points: 覆盖五个已验证临床基准任务
与专家评分者及多个大模型评判者对照
提出决策模型与廉价 LLM 的混合方案
reason: 预注册、多基准对照的评测方法预印本，尚无外部临床验证
abstract: BackgroundTesting and deploying medical AI systems at scale already results in more outputs than clinicians can review, and the use of large language models (LLMs) as judges is growing rapidly. Decision-only models, cheap and fast models that return structured probabilities rather than text, offer a potentially scalable option for that goal. MethodsIn an OSF pre-registered evaluation, we tested TypeSafe Jev 1.13 as a judge on tasks from five validated clinical benchmarks: rubric grading (HealthBench), planted clinical errors (When Rubrics Fail), risk in AI-written clinical documents (MedVAL), counseling ratings and failures (CounselBench) and physicians preferences between answers (Real-POCQi). Comparators were expert raters agreement with each other, OpenAI Decisions, GPT-6 Luna, a proposed hybrid team combining decision models and a cheap LLM and, as frontier comparators, GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5. The main outcome was plain agreement with the expert label. ResultsThe test comprised 25,091 units and 213,913 model calls. Jevs agreement with expert labels averaged 64.7% over six tasks. On 3,614 matched units it averaged 66.1%, against 65.0% for Opus and 60.7% for Sol, and it was non-inferior to both on four of six tasks. Jev judged the whole pool in 17 minutes for US$1.46; per judgment, it cost 1/34 of Sols price and 1/152 of Opuss. A preset cutoff held its false-alarm rate on fresh planted-error answers, and in simulation, reviewing Jevs least-sure answers first found 1.4 times the errors of a random audit. Still, omissions were hard for both: at the same false-alarm rate, Jev missed 55.6% of planted omissions and Opus 48.1%, and Opus caught 8.8 points more planted errors overall. ConclusionsAcross more than 200,000 model calls, a decision-only model was non-inferior to two frontier judges on most tasks at a small fraction of their cost and time, while reporting how sure it was of every call. With local cutoffs and expert oversight of omissions and clinical documents, judging every output of a deployed medical AI system becomes more affordable.
zh_abstract:
【背景】大规模测试和部署医疗 AI 系统已经产生超出临床医生可审阅数量的输出，而使用大语言模型（LLM）作为评判者的做法正在迅速增长。仅决策模型（decision-only models）——即返回结构化概率而非文本的廉价、快速模型——为这一目标提供了一种潜在可扩展的选择。
【方法】在一项 OSF 预注册评估中，我们将 TypeSafe Jev 1.13 作为评判者，在来自五个经过验证的临床基准的任务上进行测试：评分细则评分（HealthBench）、植入临床错误（When Rubrics Fail）、AI 撰写的临床文件中的风险（MedVAL）、咨询评分与失败（CounselBench）以及医生对答案的偏好（Real-POCQi）。对照包括专家评分者彼此之间的一致性、OpenAI Decisions、GPT-6 Luna、一个将决策模型与廉价 LLM 结合的拟议混合团队，以及作为前沿对照的 GPT-6.1 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5。主要结局是与专家标签的简单一致率。
【结果】测试包含 25,091 个单元和 213,913 次模型调用。Jev 与专家标签的一致率在六项任务上平均为 64.7%。在 3,614 个匹配单元上，其平均一致率为 66.1%，而 Opus 为 65.0%，Sol 为 60.7%，并且它在六项任务中的四项上不劣于两者。Jev 在 17 分钟内以 1.46 美元评判了整个池；按单次判断计，其成本为 Sol 价格的 1/34、Opus 价格的 1/152。一个预设截断值在新鲜的植入错误答案上保持了其假警报率，并且在模拟中，优先审阅 Jev 最不确定的答案所发现的错误是随机审计的 1.4 倍。尽管如此，遗漏对两者都很难：在相同假警报率下，Jev 漏掉了 55.6% 的植入遗漏，Opus 漏掉了 48.1%，而 Opus 总体上多发现了 8.8 个百分点的植入错误。
【结论】在超过 200,000 次模型调用中，仅决策模型在大多数任务上不劣于两个前沿评判模型，而成本和时间仅为其一小部分，同时报告其对每次调用的确定程度。借助本地截断值以及对遗漏和临床文件的专家监督，对已部署医疗 AI 系统的每一条输出进行评判变得更加可负担。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Qilu Hospital of Shandong University; conditions: Gastric Intestinal Metaplasia; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 540; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Gastric intestinal metaplasia (GIM) is a precancerous condition associated with an increased risk of gastric cancer. The endoscopic grading of gastric intestinal metaplasia (EGGIM) score evaluates the extent of GIM across five standard gastric regions. The investigators developed a real-time artificial intelligence-assisted EGGIM (AI-EGGIM) system that automatically assigns an intestinal metaplasia grade to each region and calculates a total EGGIM score. This prospective multi-center validation study will consecutively enroll patients undergoing upper gastrointestinal endoscopy. The AI-EGGIM system will generate real-time grades for the five standard gastric regions. Regardless of endoscopic appearance or AI output, every patient will undergo five mapping biopsies, with one biopsy obtained from each standard region. Histopathological operative link on gastric intestinal metaplasia (OLGIM) staging will serve as the reference standard. The primary objective is to estimate the performance of an AI-EGGIM score ≥ 5 for identifying patients at high risk of gastric cancer.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：山东大学齐鲁医院；疾病：胃黏膜肠化生；类型：观察性；入组人数：540；状态：尚未招募] 胃黏膜肠化生（gastric intestinal metaplasia, GIM）是一种癌前病变，与胃癌风险增加相关。胃黏膜肠化生内镜分级（endoscopic grading of gastric intestinal metaplasia, EGGIM）评分评估 GIM 在五个标准胃区域的范围。研究者开发了一种实时人工智能辅助 EGGIM（AI-EGGIM）系统，可自动为每个区域分配肠化生分级并计算总 EGGIM 评分。这项前瞻性多中心验证研究将连续入组接受上消化道内镜检查的患者。AI-EGGIM 系统将实时生成五个标准胃区域的分级。无论内镜表现或 AI 输出如何，每位患者都将接受五点定位活检，每个标准区域取一块活检。组织病理学 OLGIM（operative link on gastric intestinal metaplasia）分期将作为参考标准。主要目标是评估 AI-EGGIM 评分 ≥ 5 用于识别胃癌高风险患者的性能。

title: Hierarchical Temporal Transformer for Cancer Grade Prediction and Cross-Cancer Transfer Learning from Pathology Reports
zh_title: 分层时序Transformer从病理报告预测肿瘤分级并跨癌种迁移
summary: 预印本提出分层时序Transformer，用改编BiomedBERT编码病理报告并结合就诊间隔，在合成基准与4786份TCGA报告上做分级预测与跨癌种迁移。
key_points: 模型结合报告文本与就诊间隔的时间编码
两个合成基准各用十个随机种子评估
TCGA 14个癌种中保留3种做跨癌种测试
reason: 方法有新意但为预印本，仅内部/留出癌种验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Language models for cancer reports usually read one document at a time and are tested on tumour types seen in training. Continuous-time sequence models address the first gap, but whether they use visit timing, not just order, is seldom tested. Methods: We developed the Hierarchical Temporal Transformer (HTT), which encodes reports with adapted BiomedBERT and reads the sequence with a cancer-type-conditioned temporal transformer. We evaluated it against best-possible AUROC ceilings on two synthetic benchmarks, one with the label stated in the text and one recoverable only from tumour sizes and visit intervals (ten seeds). Diagnostics led to an interval-aware time code (HTT-IA). On 4,786 TCGA pathology reports in 14 types, three types were withheld, and a text-only HTT was compared with a survival model. Results: On the phrase benchmark HTT reached AUROC 0.931 +/- 0.012 against 0.913 +/- 0.007 for a last-report baseline (+0.018, 95% CI -0.009 to +0.050); dates cannot raise the ceiling there. On the growth benchmark the initial time code scored 0.790, equal to a no-time model (0.787), whereas HTT-IA reached 0.843 (+0.053, 0.026 to 0.082) against ceilings of 0.894 without and 0.979 with dates. On unseen tumour types HTT reached 0.925 +/- 0.007, equal to in-distribution performance and to a single-report baseline. Text-only macro C-index was 0.592 (CALM 0.626-0.652). Conclusion: Cross-type transfer is carried by the pre-trained encoder. Visit timing is used only when the data make it identifiable and the time code is on a clinical scale. Ceilings, order-only ablations and re-dating probes are inexpensive checks for such models.
zh_abstract:
【背景】用于癌症报告的语言模型通常一次阅读一份文件，并在训练中见过的肿瘤类型上进行测试。连续时间序列模型解决了第一个缺口，但其是否使用就诊时间而不仅仅是顺序，鲜有检验。
【方法】我们开发了分层时间 Transformer（Hierarchical Temporal Transformer, HTT），其使用适配的 BiomedBERT 编码报告，并使用以癌症类型为条件的时间 transformer 读取序列。我们在两个合成基准上将其与最佳可能 AUROC 上限进行比较，一个基准的标签在文本中明确陈述，另一个只能从肿瘤大小和就诊间隔中恢复（十个随机种子）。诊断分析促成了一种间隔感知时间编码（HTT-IA）。在 14 种类型的 4,786 份 TCGA 病理报告中，三种类型被留出，并将仅文本 HTT 与生存模型进行比较。
【结果】在短语基准上，HTT 达到 AUROC 0.931 +/- 0.012，而最后报告基线为 0.913 +/- 0.007（+0.018，95% CI -0.009 至 +0.050）；在该基准中日期无法提高上限。在生长基准上，初始时间编码得分为 0.790，与无时间模型（0.787）相同，而 HTT-IA 达到 0.843（+0.053，0.026 至 0.082），对应上限为无日期时 0.894、有日期时 0.979。在未见肿瘤类型上，HTT 达到 0.925 +/- 0.007，与分布内性能以及单报告基线相同。仅文本的宏 C 指数为 0.592（CALM 0.626-0.652）。
【结论】跨类型迁移由预训练编码器承载。仅当数据使就诊时间可识别且时间编码处于临床尺度时，才会使用就诊时间。上限、仅顺序消融和重新标注日期探针是此类模型的低成本检查。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Universitas Indonesia; conditions: Extubation Failure, Critical Illness; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1065; status: RECRUITING] The goal of this observational study is to predict who will have problems after the breathing tube is removed. Taking out the tube is called extubation, and having these problems is called extubation failure. Participants are adults in the intensive care unit (ICU) who use a breathing machine (ventilator). The main questions it aims to answer are: * How well can computer tools predict problems in the 7 days after the tube is removed? * Which information, such as age or blood tests, matters most for the prediction? Extubation failure means the participant needs the tube put back in, needs a surgical opening in the neck to help breathing, or dies. Researchers will use machine learning to build the computer tools. Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that finds patterns in data. Researchers will compare five types of machine learning to see which works best. They will build the tools with participants from Dr. Cipto Mangunkusumo National General Hospital in Jakarta. They will test the tools with participants from Universitas Indonesia Hospital in Depok. Participants get their usual care. Doctors do not use the tools to make treatment decisions. Researchers will: * Record health information about participants before the tube is removed * Follow participants for 7 days after the tube is removed
zh_abstract:
[新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：印度尼西亚大学；疾病/状况：拔管失败、危重症；类型：观察性；入组人数：1065；状态：招募中] 这项观察性研究的目标是预测谁在呼吸管拔除后会出现问题。拔除管子称为拔管，出现这些问题称为拔管失败。参与者是重症监护病房（ICU）中使用呼吸机（ventilator）的成人。它旨在回答的主要问题是：
* 计算机工具能在多大程度上预测拔管后 7 天内的问题？
* 哪些信息（例如年龄或血液检查）对预测最重要？
拔管失败意味着参与者需要重新插管、需要颈部手术开口以帮助呼吸，或死亡。研究人员将使用机器学习来构建这些计算机工具。机器学习是一种在数据中寻找模式的人工智能。研究人员将比较五种机器学习，以确定哪种效果最好。他们将使用雅加达 Dr. Cipto Mangunkusumo 国家综合医院的参与者来构建这些工具。他们将使用德波（Depok）印度尼西亚大学医院的参与者来测试这些工具。参与者接受常规护理。医生不会使用这些工具做出治疗决策。研究人员将：
* 在拔管前记录参与者的健康信息
* 在拔管后对参与者随访 7 天

abstract: RationaleObstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is associated with major adverse cardiac events (MACE); continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) has not reduced MACE in randomized trials. We hypothesized that multidomain machine learning would identify OSA subgroups differing in cardiovascular risk and CPAP response. MethodsWe conducted a secondary analysis of SAVE trial data. After preprocessing, Gaussian mixture models were fitted; Bayesian information criterion and C-index selected five prototypes. Cox models estimated MACE risk by prototype. Baseline quality of life (EQoL), Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS), and Framingham Risk Score (FRS) were compared; an existing causal survival forest model estimated prototype-specific CPAP effects on cardiovascular risk. Measurements and Main ResultsAfter preprocessing, five OSA prototypes were identified among 2,676 participants using 88 baseline variables. Prototypes differed in selected demographic, cardiometabolic, medication, and sleep variables, including smoking status, diabetes, prior myocardial infarction/stroke, antiplatelet/lipid-lowering therapy, BMI, oxygenation metrics, apnea-hypopnea index, and ESS (overall p<0.001). They also differed in baseline EQoL, FRS, MACE rate, and predicted CPAP response. Prototype 1 had the highest ESS, FRS, and MACE rate, whereas Prototype 5 had the lowest FRS and MACE rate. Using the causal survival forest model to assess prototype-specific CPAP effects on cardiovascular risk, Prototype 5 was predicted to benefit from CPAP (p<0.05), whereas Prototypes 1, 3, and 4 showed no benefit or possible harm. ConclusionThese findings demonstrate heterogeneity in cardiovascular risk and predicted CPAP response, potentially explaining neutral trial results. After external validation, these prototypes could guide trial enrichment and targeted CPAP use to improve cardiovascular outcomes. Impact StatementThis study advances clinical medicine by identifying multidomain OSA prototypes that differ in baseline cardiovascular risk and predicted cardiovascular response to CPAP, potentially supporting more precise treatment selection and future cardiovascular-outcomes trials. It adds to the disease knowledge base by showing that OSA-related cardiovascular risk is not captured by conventional severity metrics alone, but reflects interactions among sleep, cardiometabolic, demographic, and clinical characteristics. zh_abstract: 【背景】阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）与主要不良心脏事件（MACE）相关；随机试验中持续气道正压通气（CPAP）并未减少MACE。我们假设多域机器学习可识别心血管风险和CPAP反应不同的OSA亚组。【方法】我们对SAVE试验数据进行了二次分析。预处理后拟合高斯混合模型；贝叶斯信息准则和C指数选择了五个原型。Cox模型估计各原型的MACE风险。比较基线生活质量（EQoL）、Epworth嗜睡量表（ESS）和Framingham风险评分（FRS）；使用现有的因果生存森林模型估计原型特异性CPAP对心血管风险的影响。【结果】预处理后，使用88个基线变量在2,676名参与者中识别出五个OSA原型。各原型在所选人口学、心脏代谢、用药和睡眠变量上存在差异，包括吸烟状况、糖尿病、既往心肌梗死/卒中、抗血小板/降脂治疗、BMI、氧合指标、呼吸暂停低通气指数和ESS（总体p<0.001）。它们在基线EQoL、FRS、MACE发生率和预测的CPAP反应上也存在差异。原型1的ESS、FRS和MACE发生率最高，而原型5的FRS和MACE发生率最低。使用因果生存森林模型评估原型特异性CPAP对心血管风险的影响，预测原型5可从CPAP获益（p<0.05），而原型1、3和4显示无获益或可能有害。【结论】这些发现证明了心血管风险和预测CPAP反应的异质性，可能解释中性试验结果。经过外部验证后，这些原型可指导试验富集和靶向CPAP使用以改善心血管结局。【影响声明】本研究通过识别基线心血管风险和预测CPAP心血管反应不同的多域OSA原型，推进了临床医学，可能支持更精确的治疗选择和未来的心血管结局试验。它通过表明OSA相关心血管风险不能仅由传统严重程度指标捕捉，而是反映睡眠、心脏代谢、人口学和临床特征之间的相互作用，增加了疾病知识基础。这些发现为生物学（biological）的机制性和前瞻性研究提供了框架。

title: Machine Learning Based Detection of Chronic Kidney Disease using Full Blood Count from a Ghanaian Hospital Population with an Integrated Web Application

reason: 单中心 155 例小样本预印本，仅内部交叉验证，属增量档
abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is usually silent until advanced, and the tests confirming it are frequently unaffordable in sub-Saharan Africa, whereas the full blood count (FBC) is inexpensive and widely performed. We assessed whether machine learning applied to the FBC can detect CKD, and how far its reported performance depends on where synthetic minority oversampling (SMOTE) is applied. Records of 155 patients at the Ho Technical University Hospital, Ghana, 43 (27.7%) with CKD, yielded ten features: age, cardiovascular disease and eight raw FBC parameters. Eleven algorithms, six resampling strategies and thirteen ensembles were compared under repeated stratified cross-validation. With SMOTE applied before the train-test split, the protocol under which the deployed models were fitted, Random Forest and Extra Trees both reached an accuracy of 83.9%, with sensitivities of 0.893 and 0.857 and areas under the curve (AUC) of 0.925 and 0.939; repeated cross-validation gave an accuracy of 0.809 {+/-} 0.051 and an AUC of 0.897. With resampling confined to the training folds, the same features gave a held-out accuracy of 61.5% and an AUC of 0.604 in 39 unseen patients. Age was the only variable separating the groups after correction for multiple testing (median 64 versus 47 years, adjusted p = 0.0026). The models are deployed as NephroScan GH (https://nephroscangh.com), which explains every prediction. The FBC carries a real but moderate signal for CKD, and the 22.4 point gap between the two protocols quantifies how far a single preprocessing decision can move a reported accuracy.
zh_abstract: 慢性肾脏病（CKD）通常在进展前没有症状，而确认该病的检查在撒哈拉以南非洲往往难以负担，相比之下全血细胞计数（FBC）廉价且广泛开展。我们评估了将机器学习应用于 FBC 能否检测 CKD，以及其报告的性能在多大程度上取决于合成少数类过采样（SMOTE）应用的位置。加纳 Ho Technical University Hospital 的 155 名患者记录中，43 名（27.7%）患有 CKD，提取了十个特征：年龄、心血管疾病和八项原始 FBC 参数。在重复分层交叉验证下比较了 11 种算法、6 种重采样策略和 13 种集成模型。在训练-测试划分之前应用 SMOTE（即部署模型拟合时所采用的方案）时，随机森林和极端随机树均达到 83.9% 的准确率，灵敏度分别为 0.893 和 0.857，曲线下面积（AUC）分别为 0.925 和 0.939；重复交叉验证给出的准确率为 0.809 {+/-} 0.051，AUC 为 0.897。当重采样仅限训练折内时，相同特征在 39 名未见患者中给出的留出准确率为 61.5%，AUC 为 0.604。经过多重检验校正后，年龄是唯一区分两组的变量（中位数 64 岁对 47 岁，校正 p = 0.0026）。这些模型部署为 NephroScan GH（https://nephroscangh.com），可解释每一次预测。FBC 对 CKD 具有真实但中等的信号，而两种方案之间 22.4 个百分点的差距量化了单个预处理决策能使报告准确率移动多远。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Alexandria University; conditions: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 200; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study will develop and test an artificial intelligence (AI) model that estimates the risk of type 2 diabetes among senior (third- and fourth-year) nursing students at the Faculty of Nursing, Alexandria University, Egypt. Type 2 diabetes is common in Egypt, and many cases are not diagnosed. Daily habits such as diet, physical activity, and body weight play a major role in who develops it. Nursing students will become health care providers who teach patients about healthy living, so it is important to find those who may be at risk early. About 200 students will take part. Each student will complete a questionnaire about personal information and the Health-Promoting Lifestyle Profile II, which measures health habits such as nutrition, physical activity, stress management, and health responsibility. The researcher will measure height, weight, waist size, and blood pressure. Each student's diabetes risk will be scored using the Arabic version of the Australian Type 2 Diabetes Risk Assessment Tool (AUSDRISK), which classifies risk as low, moderate, or high. These data will be used to build a machine learning model that predicts each student's diabetes risk level from lifestyle and body measurement factors, and shows which factors influenced the prediction most. Students will then try the model and rate how useful and easy to use it is. No treatment or intervention will be given. The study aims to support early identification of students at risk and to provide a model that nursing education programs and community health nurses could use in preventive health efforts.

title: Randomized Evaluation of an Autoimmune Disease Prediction Model — AURA (AUtoimmune Risk Assessment)
zh_title: AURA：自体免疫病预测模型的随机实用性评估
summary: 将可解释的ANA阳性自体免疫病预测模型嵌入电子病历，在单中心开展为期2年的随机实用性研究，评估其对诊断时点的影响。
key_points: 模型预测ANA阳性者发生系统性自身免疫病
1:1随机，干预组高危者加速风湿科评估

reason: 前瞻随机实用性设计评估诊断时点结局，非仅准确率，但为单中心，属重要档
abstract: BACKGROUND: No evidence-based guidance exists for triaging individuals with positive antinuclear antibody (ANA) tests for rheumatology referral. We developed and deployed an interpretable clinical prediction model to predict which individuals with incident positive ANA tests will develop systemic autoimmune disease and evaluated its effect on time to autoimmune disease diagnosis in a 2-year randomized pragmatic study. METHODS: The model was integrated into the electronic health record (EHR) at a single academic health system. All ANA-positive individuals were randomly assigned 1:1 independently of risk scores. In the intervention group, individuals with high-risk scores were invited for expedited rheumatology evaluation. In the control group, risk scores were calculated but not acted on. All participants received standard of care and could be referred to rheumatology. Chart reviews every 6 months assessed whether patients had undergone rheumatology evaluation and received a diagnosis of autoimmune disease. The primary outcome, time from positive ANA test to diagnosis, was analyzed using a Cox proportional-hazards model. Among individuals evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of the positive ANA, the proportion diagnosed with an autoimmune disease was compared between study groups. RESULTS: Of 2385 randomly assigned individuals, 954 were analyzed in the intervention group and 1006 in the control group after postrandomization exclusions. Individuals in the intervention group had a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis from the date of positive ANA (hazard ratio, 1.9; 95% confidence interval, 1.3 to 2.7; P<0.001). Among individuals diagnosed with an autoimmune disease, the median time to diagnosis was 43 days in the intervention group and 138 days in the control group. Among those evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of a positive ANA test, 23% in the intervention group and 16% in the control group were diagnosed with an autoimmune disease (P=0.07). CONCLUSIONS: In this randomized pragmatic study, the intervention incorporating the clinical prediction model was associated with a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis. (Funded by the National Institutes of Health and others.).
zh_abstract: 【背景】对于抗核抗体（ANA）检测阳性的个体，目前尚无基于证据的指导来分诊其风湿科转诊。我们开发并部署了一个可解释的临床预测模型，用于预测哪些新发ANA阳性检测的个体会发生系统性自身免疫病，并在一项为期2年的随机实用性研究中评估了其对自身免疫病诊断时间的影响。【方法】该模型被整合到单一学术医疗系统的电子健康记录（EHR）中。所有ANA阳性个体均按1:1随机分配，且分配与风险评分无关。在干预组中，高风险评分的个体被邀请接受加速的风湿科评估。在对照组中，计算风险评分但不据此采取行动。所有参与者均接受标准诊疗，并可被转诊至风湿科。每6个月进行一次病历审查，评估患者是否接受过风湿科评估以及是否获得自身免疫病诊断。主要结局为从ANA阳性检测到诊断的时间，采用Cox比例风险模型分析。在ANA阳性后6个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，比较了各研究组之间被诊断为自身免疫病的比例。【结果】在2385名随机分配的个体中，随机化后排除后，干预组有954人、对照组有1006人被纳入分析。干预组个体自ANA阳性之日起至自身免疫病诊断的时间显著更短（风险比1.9；95%置信区间1.3至2.7；P<0.001）。在被诊断为自身免疫病的个体中，干预组的中位诊断时间为43天，对照组为138天。在ANA阳性检测后6个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，干预组23%、对照组16%被诊断为自身免疫病（P=0.07）。【结论】在这项随机实用性研究中，纳入临床预测模型的干预与自身免疫病诊断时间显著缩短相关。（由美国国立卫生研究院等资助。）

title: A gait foundation model for prediction of multisystem health phenotypes from 3D skeletal motion

zh_title: 3D骨骼运动步态基础模型预测多系统健康表型
summary: 基于3328名深度表型成人的单深度相机3D骨骼运动数据，构建步态基础模型预测覆盖18个身体系统的健康表型。
key_points: 3328名深度表型成人，5项运动任务

abstract: Gait is increasingly recognized as a vital sign, yet current approaches treat it as a symptom of specific pathologies rather than a systemic biomarker. Here we developed a gait foundation model for three-dimensional skeletal motion, which was recorded via a single-depth camera during 5 motor tasks, from 3,328 deeply phenotyped adults. Our purpose was to capture the full pattern of a person’s movement and use it to predict health phenotypes such as grip strength and sleep quality across 18 body systems. Gait is conventionally described by engineered features (for example, calculated measurements such as cadence and stride length), which may fail to capture the fine detail of how a person moves. Our model instead translates movement into learned embeddings: sets of numbers that describe how all body joints move together over time. Learned embeddings outperformed engineered features for prediction of age (Pearsonʼs r = 0.69), body mass index (r = 0.91) and visceral adipose tissue area (r = 0.83), and embeddings significantly predicted 1,887 of 3,210 tested phenotypes. Relative to a baseline model using age, body mass index, visceral adipose tissue and height alone, gait embeddings improved prediction in all 18 systems in males and 17 of 18 in females, as well as prediction of clinical diagnoses and medication use. Anatomical ablation analyses revealed that leg dynamics dominated metabolic and frailty predictions, and torso dynamics encoded sleep and lifestyle phenotypes. These findings establish gait as an independent, multisystem biosignal, motivating integration of gait analysis into routine clinical assessment as a scalable, passive vital sign.
zh_abstract: 步态正日益被视为一种生命体征，然而当前的方法将其视为特定病理的症状，而非系统性生物标志物。在此，我们开发了一个用于三维骨骼运动数据的步态基础模型；该数据通过单深度相机在5项运动任务中采集自3,328名深度表型化的成年人。我们的目的是捕捉一个人运动的完整模式，并用其预测跨越18个身体系统的健康表型，如握力和睡眠质量。步态通常由工程化特征（例如，计算得到的步频和步长等测量值）描述，这些特征可能无法捕捉一个人如何运动的细微细节。我们的模型则将运动转换为学习到的嵌入（learned embeddings）：即描述所有身体关节随时间如何协同运动的一组数字。学习到的嵌入在预测年龄（Pearson r = 0.69）、体质指数（r = 0.91）和内脏脂肪组织面积（r = 0.83）方面优于工程化特征，且嵌入显著预测了3,210个受测表型中的1,887个。相对于仅使用年龄、体质指数、内脏脂肪组织和身高的基线模型，步态嵌入改善了男性全部18个系统和女性18个系统中17个系统的预测，以及对临床诊断和药物使用的预测。解剖学消融分析显示，腿部动力学在代谢和衰弱预测中占主导，而躯干动力学编码了睡眠和生活方式表型。这些发现确立了步态作为一种独立的多系统生物信号，推动将步态分析作为一种可扩展的、被动的生命体征整合到常规临床评估中。

title: AI-driven multi-horizon risk stratification for heart failure hospitalization in UA with HFpEF: a Chinese multi-center cohort study
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: 多中心AI模型预测HFpEF合并UA患者心衰住院风险
summary: 中国多中心4367例不稳定型心绞痛合并HFpEF患者，用集成特征选择与12种机器学习模型预测12/24/36个月心衰住院风险并外部验证。
key_points: 多中心回顾性队列纳入4367例患者
外部验证AUC约0.836–0.839
预测12、24、36个月心衰住院风险
reason: 多中心大样本且报告外部验证，但为回顾性研究，属重要档下限
abstract: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) complicated by unstable angina (UA) represents a major challenge in chronic disease management with high risk of recurrent heart failure hospitalization (HFH), and despite the availability of multicenter real-world data, AI-driven tools for multi-horizon risk assessment remain limited. This multicenter retrospective cohort enrolled 4367 patients with UA and HFpEF, and an ensemble feature selection pipeline integrating LASSO, SVM-RFE and Boruta identified robust predictors, followed by training of twelve machine learning algorithms to estimate HFH risk at 12-, 24- and 36-month horizons with external validation. The optimal time-specific models (ET, GBDT and LightGBM) achieved strong discrimination in the training cohort with AUCs of 0.818, 0.834 and 0.863, and maintained performance in external validation with AUCs of 0.839, 0.836 and 0.851, respectively, while SHAP analysis highlighted diabetes mellitus, TyG-BMI and NT-proBNP as the most influential predictors. We developed and externally validated a multi-time-point machine learning framework for HFH risk stratification in UA and HFpEF, which showed acceptable calibration and potential clinical utility on decision-curve analysis. Further prospective and real-world validation across diverse populations and healthcare systems is needed to confirm clinical effectiveness and support translation into routine practice.
zh_abstract: 射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）合并不稳定型心绞痛（UA）是慢性疾病管理中的一大挑战，其复发性心力衰竭住院（HFH）风险高；尽管已有多个中心的真实世界数据可用，用于多时间跨度风险评估的AI驱动工具仍然有限。本多中心回顾性队列纳入了4367例UA合并HFpEF患者，一个整合LASSO、SVM-RFE和Boruta的集成特征选择流程识别出稳健的预测因子，随后训练了十二种机器学习算法以估计12、24和36个月时间跨度的HFH风险，并进行了外部验证。最优的时间特异模型（ET、GBDT和LightGBM）在训练队列中表现出较强的区分能力，AUC分别为0.818、0.834和0.863，并在外部验证中保持性能，AUC分别为0.839、0.836和0.851；SHAP分析突出显示糖尿病、TyG-BMI和NT-proBNP是最有影响力的预测因子。我们开发并外部验证了用于UA合并HFpEF患者HFH风险分层的时间多点机器学习框架，其显示出可接受的校准度，并在决策曲线分析中显示出潜在的临床实用性。尚需在不同人群和医疗系统中开展进一步的前瞻性和真实世界验证，以确认临床有效性并支持其转化为常规实践。

title: Physical Limits to AI Substitution across Physician Specialties — Implications for the Physician Workforce
zh_title: AI替代医师的物理极限：各专科差异分析
summary: 基于2023年Medicare Part B约450亿美元账单，量化各专科中需当面操作、当前AI无法替代的工作占比。
key_points: 分析56个专科、58.9万名医师的账单数据
按每项服务是否需身体接触分类
需动手操作占比随毕业后培训年限上升
reason: 大样本医保数据分析，但非AI模型或临床结局验证，属值得一看档
abstract: AbstractAI can already interpret medical images, draft diagnostic assessments, and converse with patients - fueling predictions that it will replace physicians. Yet software cannot physically examine, biopsy, or operate on a patient, so the share of a specialty's work that requires in-person physical interaction sets a ceiling on how much of it AI alone could replace. Analyzing 2023 Medicare Part B claims - nearly US$45 billion in payments to 589,648 physicians across 56 specialties - we classify each billed service by whether it requires physical contact, setting aside evaluation and management (E&M) visits. The share of non-E&M work that is physical, and thus protected at present from AI substitution, varies widely across specialties and increases in the length of postgraduate training: Procedural fields such as dermatology and orthopedic surgery are largely shielded. Only about one fifth of all payments go to non-E&M services with no physical barrier to AI substitution. Physicians, however, concentrate in E&M-heavy specialties - family and internal medicine - where physical protection, as we measure it, is low. The fields most accessible as career paths and most needed to relieve primary care shortages thus face the greatest uncertainty, because AI could impact their work as either a substitute or a complement - an outcome shaped as much by how AI is designed, deployed, and reimbursed as by the technology itself.
zh_abstract: 摘要：AI 已经能够解读医学图像、起草诊断评估并与患者对话——这助长了其将取代医生的预测。然而，软件无法对患者进行体格检查、活检或手术，因此某一专科工作中需要面对面身体交互的部分，为 AI 单独所能替代的比例设定了上限。通过分析 2023 年 Medicare Part B 索赔——向 56 个专科的 589,648 名医生支付的近 450 亿美元——我们根据每项计费服务是否需要身体接触进行分类，并将评估与管理（E&M）就诊排除在外。非 E&M 工作中属于体力性、因而目前免受 AI 替代的工作占比，在不同专科之间差异很大，并随研究生培训时长增加而上升：皮肤科和骨科手术等操作型领域在很大程度上受到保护。所有支付中仅约五分之一流向没有身体屏障、可被 AI 替代的非 E&M 服务。然而，医生集中于 E&M 占比较高的专科——家庭医学和内科——按我们的衡量，这些专科的物理保护较低。因此，作为职业路径最易进入、也最需要用来缓解初级保健短缺的领域面临最大的不确定性，因为 AI 可能以替代或补充的方式影响其工作——这一结果既取决于 AI 的设计、部署和报销方式，也取决于技术本身。

title: A statistical framework for evaluating the repeatability and reproducibility of large language models.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 量化大模型可重复性与再现性的统计框架
summary: JAMIA 提出通用统计框架与Python包llmReproScore，从语义与内部两维度量化大语言模型输出的可重复性与再现性。
key_points: 建立四个指标，分语义与内部两维度
发布配套Python包llmReproScore
以USMLE题目测试多模型诊断推理输出
reason: 同行评审的评测方法学工作并公开工具包，应用示例有限，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Systematic evaluation of variability in large language model (LLM)-generated outputs is critical for assessing their reliability. We developed a general statistical framework and Python package (llmReproScore) for quantifying the repeatability and reproducibility of LLM outputs. Following US Food and Drug Administration terminology, our framework establishes four metrics for quantifying LLM repeatability and reproducibility along two dimensions: semantic and internal. Semantic metrics quantify variability in the meaning of LLM-generated outputs, whereas internal metrics quantify variability in token-generation certainty. We validated these metrics, and as an illustrative use case, applied them to diagnostic reasoning outputs generated across LLMs and prompting strategies using US Medical Licensing Examination questions and 90 real-world rare disease cases from the Undiagnosed Diseases Network. Validation results showed that semantic scores aligned with human ratings (Spearman ρ = 0.88 for repeatability and 0.66 for reproducibility) and confirmed that internal metrics capture variability in token-generation certainty. In the illustrative use case, LLM repeatability was generally not associated with accuracy, suggesting that LLM output variability and accuracy capture distinct dimensions of model performance. The proposed metrics can be used to characterize LLM output variability and systematically compare models, prompts, and generation settings. These comparisons can inform more rigorous selection of LLM configurations based on repeatability and reproducibility. We developed and validated generalizable metrics for quantifying LLM output variability. The proposed metrics can complement accuracy-based evaluation to inform experimental design and support more rigorous comparison and selection of models, prompts, and generation settings.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 系统评估大语言模型（LLM）生成输出的变异性对于评估其可靠性至关重要。我们开发了一个通用统计框架和Python包（llmReproScore），用于量化LLM输出的重复性和再现性。参照美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的术语，我们的框架沿两个维度建立了四项指标来量化LLM的重复性和再现性：语义和内部。语义指标量化LLM生成输出在含义上的变异性，而内部指标量化token生成确定性方面的变异性。我们验证了这些指标，并作为一个示例性用例，将其应用于使用美国医师执照考试（US Medical Licensing Examination）题目和来自未诊断疾病网络（Undiagnosed Diseases Network）的90个真实世界罕见病病例、跨LLM和提示策略生成的诊断推理输出。验证结果显示，语义评分与人工评分一致（重复性的Spearman ρ = 0.88，再现性的Spearman ρ = 0.66），并确认内部指标捕捉了token生成确定性的变异性。在示例性用例中，LLM重复性总体上与准确性无关，提示LLM输出变异性和准确性捕捉的是模型性能的不同维度。所提出的指标可用于表征LLM输出变异性，并系统比较模型、提示和生成设置。这些比较可为基于重复性和再现性更严格地选择LLM配置提供依据。我们开发并验证了用于量化LLM输出变异性的可推广指标。所提出的指标可以补充基于准确性的评估，为实验设计提供信息，并支持更严格地比较和选择模型、提示及生成设置。

title: An explainable, bias-audited machine learning model to detect hidden hepatitis C from region-wide real-world health records
zh_title: 可解释偏差审计模型从区域健康档案识别隐匿丙肝

abstract: Background: Although direct-acting antivirals have transformed hepatitis C virus (HCV) treatment, 25-30% of active infections in Spain remain undiagnosed. We aimed to develop and validate an interpretable machine-learning model to identify undiagnosed HCV infection using only data already recorded within the health system. Materials and Methods: We conducted a retrospective, population-based cohort study using the Andalusian Population Health Database (BPS). Individuals diagnosed with HCV between 2017 and 2024 (n=25,028) were matched, up to 10:1, to controls by birth year, sex, and health district. An Explainable Boosting Machine was trained on 2017-2022 data, with a threshold set in a 2023 validation set to guarantee [≥]60% sensitivity, then evaluated unmodified in an independent, non-matched, population-representative 2024 sample approximating real-world screening. Predictors comprised chronic-disease diagnoses and laboratory summary statistics recorded [≥]30 days before the index date; age and sex were excluded as matching variables. Predictors reflecting socioeconomic proxies or matching artefacts (pharmaceutical co-payment category, a zone-level deprivation index) were removed after explainability review. Results: In the independent test set, the model achieved an AUC of 0.837 (0.826 in validation), sensitivity 63.5%, specificity 91.8%, positive predictive value 7.0%, and negative predictive value 99.6%. Leading predictors were minimum alanine aminotransferase, HIV infection, dependence on non-tobacco substances, and platelet-count statistics, forming a clinically coherent, laboratory- and comorbidity-driven profile. Conclusion: An explainable model built exclusively from routine electronic health record data can identify undiagnosed HCV infection with discrimination comparable to previously published tools, evaluated under conditions approximating true population prevalence. Bias-auditing was feasible without sacrificing interpretability, supporting a scalable, equity-conscious instrument for the final phase of HCV elimination.
zh_abstract: 【背景】尽管直接抗病毒药物已改变丙型肝炎病毒（hepatitis C virus, HCV）治疗格局，西班牙25-30%的活动性感染仍未确诊。我们旨在开发并验证一种可解释的机器学习模型，仅使用卫生系统内已记录的数据来识别未确诊的HCV感染。【方法】我们使用安达卢西亚人口健康数据库（Andalusian Population Health Database, BPS）开展了一项回顾性、基于人群的队列研究。2017年至2024年间诊断为HCV的个体（n=25,028）按出生年份、性别和卫生区与对照进行最多10:1匹配。在2017-2022年数据上训练可解释提升机（Explainable Boosting Machine），并在2023年验证集中设定阈值以保证灵敏度≥60%，随后在一个独立的、非匹配的、代表人群的2024年样本中不作修改地评估，该样本近似真实世界筛查。预测变量包括索引日期前≥30天记录的慢性病诊断和实验室汇总统计量；年龄和性别作为匹配变量被排除。在可解释性审查后，反映社会经济替代指标或匹配伪影的预测变量（药品共付类别、区域层面剥夺指数）被移除。【结果】在独立测试集中，模型达到AUC 0.837（验证集0.826）、灵敏度63.5%、特异度91.8%、阳性预测值7.0%、阴性预测值99.6%。主要预测变量为丙氨酸氨基转移酶最小值、HIV感染、对非烟草物质的依赖以及血小板计数统计量，形成具有临床一致性、由实验室和合并症驱动的特征谱。【结论】一个完全基于常规电子健康记录数据构建的可解释模型能够识别未确诊的HCV感染，其区分能力与既往已发表工具相当，并在近似真实人群患病率的条件下评估。偏倚审计在不牺牲可解释性的情况下可行，支持一种可扩展、具有公平意识的工具用于HCV消除的最后阶段。

source: PubMed · Journal of medical Internet research

summary: JMIR 研究用Gemma-3-27B-it配合少样本提示，将64份德语老年科门诊报告改写为患者友好版本，并经盲法评估与专家版本比较。

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Effective communication between clinicians and patients plays an important role in the successful delivery of health care. In geriatric medicine, where multimorbidity, polypharmacy, and functional limitations often make treatment plans complex, AI simplifications of clinical reports into patient-friendly language offer a promising way to improve communication. This study investigated whether AI could generate patient-friendly simplifications of outpatient reports that were comparable to those authored by human experts. Gemma-3-27B-it, an instruction fine-tuned open-source large language model (LLM) by Google, was used, and few-shot prompting was applied to enable the generation of patient-friendly simplifications of 64 deidentified geriatric outpatient reports written in German while preserving clinical meaning. LLM-generated simplifications were compared with those produced by 2 medical experts in a blinded evaluation. Quality was assessed using three approaches: (1) embedding-based semantic similarity to the original report, (2) blinded expert review by 2 clinicians, and (3) review by patient representatives, with the latter 2 using a standardized Likert-scale questionnaire. AI-generated simplifications were comparable to geriatrician-authored simplifications regarding semantic similarity (P=.02) and were preferred by patient representatives (P<.001) as well as one expert reviewer (P=.001). Expert reviewers perceived physician-authored simplifications as more complete (P<.001), a finding that correlated with text length (P<.001). This study demonstrates the feasibility of using LLMs via few-shot prompting to simplify medical reports for improved perceived patient comprehension in geriatric care. Future prospective studies should examine whether such AI-driven simplifications positively impact objective health-related outcomes, adherence, and patient engagement.
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 临床医生与患者之间的有效沟通在成功提供医疗保健中发挥重要作用。在老年医学中，多病共存、多重用药和功能受限常使治疗计划复杂化，AI将临床报告简化为患者友好语言为改善沟通提供了一种有前景的方法。本研究调查了AI能否生成与人类专家撰写的简化版本相当的患者友好型门诊报告简化版本。使用由Google开发、经指令微调的开源大语言模型（LLM）Gemma-3-27B-it，并应用少样本提示（few-shot prompting），以生成64份以德语书写的去标识化老年门诊报告的患者友好型简化版本，同时保留临床含义。在盲法评估中，将LLM生成的简化版本与2名医学专家生成的简化版本进行比较。质量通过三种方法评估：（1）基于嵌入的与原始报告的语义相似度；（2）由2名临床医生进行盲法专家评审；（3）由患者代表评审，后两者使用标准化Likert量表问卷。AI生成的简化版本在语义相似度方面与老年科医生撰写的简化版本相当（P=.02），并且更受患者代表（P<.001）以及一名专家评审者（P=.001）偏好。专家评审者认为医生撰写的简化版本更完整（P<.001），这一发现与文本长度相关（P<.001）。本研究证明通过少样本提示使用LLM简化医疗报告以改善老年护理中患者感知理解程度的可行性。未来前瞻性研究应检验此类AI驱动的简化是否对客观健康相关结局、依从性和患者参与度产生积极影响。

abstract: [Cell reports. Medicine] Artificial intelligence in medical imaging is shifting from task-specific algorithms toward adaptable foundation models (FMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, applying these models to MRI remains challenging because clinical interpretation requires integrating multi-parametric, volumetric imaging across multiple sequences with clinical context. This systematic review evaluates 35 studies on unimodal FMs and multimodal VLMs in MRI, summarizing emerging architectures, downstream applications, and challenges to clinical translation. Current research is concentrated in neuroimaging, with diagnostic classification representing the most mature application. Segmentation and outcome prediction also show promise, whereas automated report generation remains limited by poor clinical fidelity despite strong linguistic fluency. Broader adoption is hindered by heterogeneous MRI acquisition, limited large-scale paired image-text datasets, and inadequate safety-focused evaluation metrics. Advancing clinical translation will require standardized multicenter datasets, stronger integration with electronic health records and pathology, robust evaluation frameworks, and improved model explainability.
zh_abstract: [Cell reports. Medicine] 医学影像中的人工智能正从任务特定算法转向可适应基础模型（foundation models, FMs）和视觉-语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）。然而，将这些模型应用于MRI仍具挑战，因为临床解读需要整合跨多个序列的多参数、容积成像与临床背景。本系统综述评估了35项关于MRI中单模态FMs和多模态VLMs的研究，总结了新兴架构、下游应用及临床转化面临的挑战。当前研究集中于神经影像，诊断分类是最成熟的应用。分割和结局预测也显示出前景，而自动报告生成尽管语言流畅性强，仍受限于临床保真度差。更广泛采用受到MRI采集异质性、大规模配对图像-文本数据集有限以及缺乏以安全性为重点的评估指标等因素的阻碍。推进临床转化将需要标准化的多中心数据集、与电子健康记录和病理学更强整合、稳健的评估框架以及改进的模型可解释性。

title: Scalable Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification for Cancer Histopathology: Calibrated Uncertainty Under Distribution Shift
zh_title: 可扩展贝叶斯高斯过程用于癌症病理分类
summary: 预印本提出基于冻结病理基础模型嵌入的可扩展贝叶斯高斯过程分类框架，在约30万训练点上实现HMC后验采样，并考察分布偏移下的不确定性校准。
key_points: 在Phikon冻结嵌入上做低秩高斯过程分类
RPCholesky加速与HMC非中心参数化采样
关注跨院分布偏移下的过度自信问题

reason: 方法有新意、规模可观，但预印本且未见外部验证或代码，属值得一看档
abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for clinical deployment of cancer diagnosis models, yet neural networks and variational Gaussian process methods can produce overconfident predictions, particularly under the distribution shifts that arise when models trained at one hospital are applied at another. We present a scalable Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification (GPC) framework that operates on frozen pathology foundation model embeddings (Phikon) and combines accelerated Randomly Pivoted Cholesky (RPCholesky) for low-rank kernel factorization, Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) with non-centered parameterization for posterior sampling, and a pivots-as-inducing-points scheme for prediction. This makes HMC posterior sampling in the low-rank latent representation tractable at N approximately 300,000 training points, enabling HC-based low-rank GPC on substantially larger datasets than prior MCMC-based demonstrations. We evaluate on two histopathology benchmarks for breast cancer metastasis detection: PCam and CAMELYON17-WILDS, where the latter tests calibration under hospital-level distribution shift. Compared to stochastic variational GP and neural network baselines, our method improves calibration and predictive performance - reducing expected calibration error by up to 88% and false negative rate by up to 90% - with the largest gains appearing under distribution shift, suggesting that HMC-based posterior sampling provides more trustworthy uncertainty estimates for cross-site pathology classification.
zh_abstract: 可靠的不确定性量化对于癌症诊断模型的临床部署至关重要，然而神经网络和变分高斯过程方法可能产生过度自信的预测，尤其是在一家医院训练的模型应用于另一家医院时出现的分布偏移下。我们提出一种可扩展的贝叶斯高斯过程分类（Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification, GPC）框架，该框架在冻结的病理基础模型嵌入（Phikon）上运行，并结合用于低秩核分解的加速随机主元Cholesky（Randomly Pivoted Cholesky, RPCholesky）、采用非中心参数化的哈密顿蒙特卡洛（Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, HMC）进行后验采样，以及以主元作为诱导点的预测方案。这使得在约300,000个训练点规模下，对低秩潜在表示进行HMC后验采样变得可行，从而能够在比以往基于MCMC的演示大得多的数据集上实现基于HC的低秩GPC。我们在两个用于乳腺癌转移检测的组织病理学基准上评估：PCam和CAMELYON17-WILDS，其中后者检验医院级分布偏移下的校准。与随机变分GP和神经网络基线相比，我们的方法改善了校准和预测性能——将预期校准误差最多降低88%，将假阴性率最多降低90%——最大增益出现在分布偏移下，表明基于HMC的后验采样为跨站点病理分类提供了更可信的不确定性估计。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: zhaoxiaohui; conditions: Cancer, Malignant Neoplasms, Radiotherapy; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 62; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Radiotherapy, a cornerstone of comprehensive cancer treatment, relies heavily on clinician expertise for target volume contouring and treatment planning. Consequently, clinical practice is often constrained by procedural bottlenecks, inter-observer variability, and prolonged iterative feedback cycles. Although current artificial intelligence (AI) models have demonstrated progress in automated contouring, key limitations persist, including insufficient integration of multimodal clinical text, a lack of closed-loop dosimetric feedback, and limited generalizability across complex cancer types. This study aims to develop and validate RATA (Radiotherapy Treatment Multi-Agent Assistant), a novel large model system powered by a collaborative multi-agent architecture. Driven by Large Language Model (LLM) decision engines, RATA processes pathological imaging, electronic health records (EHR), and multimodal medical data to construct a end-to-end, fully automated closed-loop pipeline encompassing "target contouring, plan design, dosimetric evaluation, and reflective refinement." Innovatively breaking through traditional unidirectional radiotherapy workflows, the system establishes a dosimetric feedback-driven adaptive iteration mechanism, leveraging dose distribution outcomes to guide multi-agent dynamic fine-tuning of target volumes, thereby mimicking the collaborative clinical logic between senior radiation oncologists and medical physicists. For validation, this study adopts a multi-center, three-stage clinical validation framework-comprising multi-center retrospective validation, human-AI collaborative efficacy assessment, and a prospective randomized controlled trial (RCT)-to comprehensively evaluate the system's performance in improving contouring precision, mitigating experience-dependent disparities across clinician seniority, and reducing total workflow processing time. Implementation of the RATA platform holds potential to eliminate redundant operational steps, enabling a minute-level "scan-to-treat" response. Furthermore, its natural language interaction interface optimizes human-AI collaboration and substantially reduces clinical workload. Overall, this study not only establishes a standardized, intelligent assistance paradigm for precision radiation oncology but also provides essential evidence-based support and technological foundations for the clinical translation of multimodal AI in complex cancer management.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：zhaoxiaohui；疾病：Cancer（癌症）、Malignant Neoplasms（恶性肿瘤）、Radiotherapy（放疗）；类型：INTERVENTIONAL（干预性）；分期：NA（不适用）；入组人数：62；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING（尚未招募）] 放疗是综合癌症治疗的基石，其靶区勾画和治疗计划高度依赖临床医生的专业经验。因此，临床实践常受流程瓶颈、观察者间差异和漫长迭代反馈周期的制约。尽管当前人工智能（AI）模型在自动勾画方面已取得进展，但仍存在关键局限，包括多模态临床文本整合不足、缺乏闭环剂量学反馈，以及在复杂癌症类型间泛化能力有限。本研究旨在开发并验证RATA（Radiotherapy Treatment Multi-Agent Assistant，放疗治疗多智能体助手），这是一种由协作式多智能体架构驱动的新型大模型系统。RATA以大语言模型（LLM）决策引擎为驱动，处理病理影像、电子健康记录（EHR）和多模态医学数据，以构建涵盖“靶区勾画、计划设计、剂量学评估和反思性优化”的端到端、全自动闭环流程。该系统创新性地突破传统单向放疗工作流程，建立剂量学反馈驱动的自适应迭代机制，利用剂量分布结果指导多智能体对靶区进行动态微调，从而模拟资深放射肿瘤科医生与医学物理师之间的协作临床逻辑。在验证方面，本研究采用多中心、三阶段临床验证框架——包括多中心回顾性验证、人机协作疗效评估和前瞻性随机对照试验（RCT）——以全面评估该系统在提高勾画精度、减轻不同资历临床医生之间经验依赖差异以及缩短总工作流程处理时间方面的性能。RATA平台的实施有望消除冗余操作步骤，实现分钟级“扫描到治疗”（scan-to-treat）响应。此外，其自然语言交互界面优化了人机协作，并大幅降低临床工作量。总体而言，本研究不仅为精准放射肿瘤学建立了标准化智能辅助范式，还为多模态AI在复杂癌症管理中的临床转化提供了必要的循证支持和技术基础。

abstract: Using electronic health record (EHR) data to answer clinical research questions is challenging. It requires understanding the research question, finding relevant information across different sources, and combining that information to produce meaningful results. We developed an agentic large language model (LLM) pipeline that decomposes investigator-authored requests into source-specific tasks, generates and executes SQL on EHR, integrates structured and unstructured EHR evidence, and applies study-specific clinical note adjudication. We evaluated this workflow against data analyst-identified cohorts across 50 pediatric orthopedic clinical data query requests. Of these, 43 were included in manual-review-adjusted performance analyses. The median adjusted positive predictive value, sensitivity among patients identified by either approach, and corresponding F1 score were 0.93 (95% CI, 0.88-0.98), 0.92 (95% CI, 0.90-0.95) and 0.90 (95% CI, 0.87-0.94), respectively. These findings support the feasibility of translating natural-language research intent into executable, autonomous multi-stage EHR workflows.
zh_abstract: 使用电子健康记录（EHR）数据回答临床研究问题具有挑战性。这需要理解研究问题、在不同来源中查找相关信息，并整合这些信息以产生有意义的结果。我们开发了一个智能体式大语言模型（LLM）流水线，将研究者编写的请求分解为针对特定数据源的任务，生成并在 EHR 上执行 SQL，整合结构化与非结构化 EHR 证据，并应用研究特定的临床笔记判定。我们在 50 项儿科骨科临床数据查询请求中，将该工作流程与数据分析师识别的队列进行对比评估。其中 43 项被纳入经人工复核调整的性能分析。调整后的阳性预测值中位数、两种方法任一识别患者中的敏感性及相应 F1 分数分别为 0.93（95% CI，0.88-0.98）、0.92（95% CI，0.90-0.95）和 0.90（95% CI，0.87-0.94）。这些发现支持将自然语言研究意图转化为可执行、自主的多阶段 EHR 工作流程的可行性。

title: LeadWeaver: Topology-Aware Masked-Lead Modeling for Robust 12-Lead ECG Diagnosis

abstract: Clinical electrocardiography is organized as a structured set of correlated leads, yet most neural ECG classifiers assume that all twelve leads are present, correctly ordered, and acquired under the same device conditions at training and deployment. We propose LeadWeaver, a topology-aware ECG representation model designed for diagnosis under missing, corrupted, or device-shifted leads. LeadWeaver represents each lead as a temporal token stream, couples leads through a fixed-plus-learned physiological lead graph, and performs masked-lead latent completion rather than waveform synthesis. A reliability router estimates which observed leads should dominate each diagnostic decision, while a consistency objective aligns complete-lead and incomplete-lead predictions. We evaluate the model on PTB-XL and CPSC-style settings using complete-input diagnosis, arbitrary missing-lead subsets, lead corruption, cross-dataset transfer, calibration, and selective prediction. The central hypothesis is that robust ECG diagnosis requires explicitly modeling both inter-lead topology and uncertainty about unavailable evidence, rather than treating missing channels as zero-valued inputs.
zh_abstract: 临床心电图被组织为一组结构化的相关导联，然而大多数神经 ECG 分类器假设所有十二个导联均存在、顺序正确，并且在训练和部署时处于相同设备条件下。我们提出 LeadWeaver，一种拓扑感知的 ECG 表示模型，旨在用于导联缺失、损坏或设备偏移情况下的诊断。LeadWeaver 将每个导联表示为时间 token 流，通过固定加可学习的生理导联图耦合导联，并执行掩码导联的潜在补全而非波形合成。可靠性路由器估计哪些观测导联应在每个诊断决策中占主导，而一致性目标使完整导联和不完整导联的预测对齐。我们在 PTB-XL 和 CPSC 风格设置上评估该模型，使用完整输入诊断、任意缺失导联子集、导联损坏、跨数据集迁移、校准和选择性预测。核心假设是，稳健的 ECG 诊断需要显式建模导联间拓扑结构以及对不可用证据的不确定性，而不是将缺失通道视为零值输入。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University of Maryland, Baltimore; conditions: Central Line-Associated Bloodstream Infection (CLABSI), Bacteremia, Bloodstream Infections; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 30; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Infection prevention and control programs at US hospitals perform surveillance to detect and publicly report hospital-onset central line-associated bloodstream infections (CLABSI) using standards set by CDC's National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN). Because this process requires time-consuming review of the medical record by dedicated infection preventionists, VA has developed a generative artificial intelligence (AI) tool that applies the NHSN CLABSI standard to clinical data from the medical record. In this quality improvement initiative, we will evaluate the tool as it is implemented operationally across a cohort of VA medical centers in 3 randomized waves. title: Enhanced MRI brain tumor detection using deep learning in conjunction with explainable AI SHAP based diverse and multi feature analysis
zh_title: 多特征与SHAP可解释的深度学习脑肿瘤MRI检测
summary: arXiv预印本比较LBP、Gabor、小波、CNN等多种特征与五种分类器组合，用于MRI脑肿瘤识别。
key_points: 融合手工特征与CNN特征做MRI肿瘤分类
使用SHAP提升模型可解释性
LBP配合SVC与CNN报告较高特异度与准确率
reason: 预印本，特征组合式方法，仅报告指标无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Recent innovations in medical imaging have markedly improved brain tumor identification, surpassing conventional diagnostic approaches that suffer from low resolution, radiation exposure, and limited contrast. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is pivotal in precise and accurate tumor characterization owing to its high-resolution, non-invasive nature. This study investigates the synergy among multiple feature representation schemes such as local Binary Patterns (LBP), Gabor filters, Discrete Wavelet Transform, Fast Fourier Transform, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Gray-Level Run Length Matrix alongside five learning algorithms namely: k-nearest Neighbor, Random Forest, Support Vector Classifier (SVC), and probabilistic neural network (PNN), and CNN. Empirical findings indicate that LBP in conjunction with SVC and CNN obtained high specificity and accuracy, rendering it a promising method for MRI-based tumor diagnosis. Further to investigate the contribution of LBP, Statistical analysis chi-square and p-value tests are used to confirm the significant impact of LBP feature space for identification of brain Tumor. In addition, The SHAP analysis was used to identify the most important features in classification. In a small dataset, CNN obtained 97.8% accuracy while SVC yielded 98.06% accuracy. In subsequent analysis, a large benchmark dataset is also utilized to evaluate the performance of learning algorithms in order to investigate the generalization power of the proposed model. CNN achieves the highest accuracy of 98.9%, followed by SVC at 96.7%. These results highlight CNN's effectiveness in automated, high-precision tumor diagnosis. Code: https://github.com/asifrahman557/BrainTumorDetection
zh_abstract: 医学影像的最新创新显著改进了脑肿瘤识别，优于受低分辨率、辐射暴露和对比度受限困扰的传统诊断方法。磁共振成像（MRI）由于其高分辨率和非侵入性，在精确和准确的肿瘤表征中至关重要。本研究探讨了多种特征表示方案之间的协同作用，例如局部二值模式（LBP）、Gabor滤波器、离散小波变换、快速傅里叶变换、卷积神经网络（CNN）和灰度级游程长度矩阵（Gray-Level Run Length Matrix），以及五种学习算法，即：k近邻、随机森林、支持向量分类器（SVC）、概率神经网络（PNN）和CNN。实证结果表明，LBP结合SVC和CNN获得了高特异度和准确率，使其成为基于MRI的肿瘤诊断的一种有前景的方法。为进一步研究LBP的贡献，使用卡方检验和p值检验进行统计分析，以确认LBP特征空间对脑肿瘤识别的显著影响。此外，使用SHAP分析识别分类中最重要的特征。在小数据集中，CNN获得了97.8%的准确率，而SVC产生了98.06%的准确率。在后续分析中，还使用大型基准数据集评估学习算法的性能，以研究所提出模型的泛化能力。CNN达到最高准确率98.9%，其次是SVC的96.7%。这些结果凸显了CNN在自动化、高精度肿瘤诊断中的有效性。代码：https://github.com/asifrahman557/BrainTumorDetection

title: Collaborative generalist-specialist AI for safe worklist deprioritization of non-contrast brain computed tomography
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: 通才-专科AI协作实现脑CT工作列表安全降级
summary: 多中心回顾性外部验证2001例急诊与创伤NCCT，通用CLIP基础模型与商用检测器协作实现安全降级。
key_points: 外部验证2001例，单用商用检测器漏检31例
协作系统按预设阈值召回全部异常检查
检查仍留在报告流程，仅降级排序
reason: 多中心外部验证加工作流安全设计，属重要档下限；为回顾性研究减分
abstract: Safe deprioritization of non-contrast brain computed tomography (NCCT) demands high sensitivity and negative predictive value (NPV) across common and uncommon findings requiring clinical attention. Here, we present a collaborative safety net integrating BrainCT-CLIP, a generalist foundation model via contrastive language-image pre-training (CLIP), with commercial detectors. Every examination remained in the reporting workflow, deprioritized only when no model returned a positive result. In a retrospective multicenter external validation of consecutive emergency and trauma cohorts ( n = 2001), standalone commercial detectors left 31 of 324 remarkable examinations deprioritized, including 16 target-disease false negatives and 15 outside their indications. In contrast, the collaborative system recovered every remarkable examination at a threshold prespecified in the development cohort, achieving 100% sensitivity and NPV while deprioritizing 18% of examinations (368/2001; 95% CI, 17–20). These findings support generalist-specialist AI for safe worklist deprioritization under radiologist oversight, with high sensitivity for intracranial findings requiring clinical attention.
zh_abstract: 对非增强脑计算机断层扫描（NCCT）安全地降低优先级，要求在需要临床关注的常见和不常见发现中具有高灵敏度和阴性预测值（NPV）。在此，我们提出一种协作式安全网，将通过对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）构建的通才基础模型 BrainCT-CLIP 与商用检测器整合。每项检查均保留在报告工作流程中，仅当没有任何模型返回阳性结果时才降低其优先级。在一项对连续急诊和创伤队列（n = 2001）进行的回顾性多中心外部验证中，单独使用商用检测器时，324 项有异常发现的检查中有 31 项被降低优先级，包括 16 项目标疾病假阴性和 15 项超出其适应证。相比之下，协作系统在开发队列中预先设定的阈值下识别出全部有异常发现的检查，达到 100% 灵敏度和 NPV，同时将 18% 的检查降低优先级（368/2001；95% CI，17–20）。这些发现支持在放射科医生监督下使用通才-专科 AI 进行安全的工作列表优先级降低，对需要临床关注的颅内发现具有高灵敏度。

title: Generative Artificial Intelligence and Maternal Health Outcomes in Pregnant and Postpartum Individuals: A Randomized Clinical Trial.

abstract: [JAMA network open] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots are increasingly used to support maternal health, but randomized evidence is limited. To evaluate whether access to a generative AI maternal health chatbot improved 12-month maternal health outcomes. This 2-group randomized clinical trial enrolled 400 participants from October 2023 to December 2024, with 12-month follow-up completed in December 2025. Participants were recruited online across 49 US states and the District of Columbia. Eligible participants were English-speaking, aged 14 years or older, pregnant or parenting an infant younger than 6 months, and self-identified as members of racial and/or ethnic minoritized groups. Participants were randomized 1:1 to receive access to the chatbot or an active control consisting of monthly children's books. Primary outcomes were anxiety and depression symptoms at 12 months measured using the Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 and Patient Health Questionnaire-9. Secondary outcomes included emergency department visits, pregnancy-related complications, postpartum care checkups, effective contraception use, and sleep duration. Among 400 randomized participants, the mean (SD) age was 32.6 (5.1) years; 200 (50%) were parenting an infant at enrollment; and 10 (2%) identified as American Indian or Alaska Native, 80 (20%) Asian, 188 (47%) Black or African American, 57 (14%) multiracial, and 65 (16%) Hispanic or Latino. The AI chatbot was not associated with differences in anxiety scores (adjusted mean difference, 0.10; 95% CI, -0.77 to 0.96) or depression scores (adjusted mean difference, -0.23; 95% CI, -1.05 to 0.59), nor with emergency department visits, postpartum care, contraception use, or sleep duration. Among participants pregnant at enrollment, the chatbot was associated with more self-reported pregnancy-related complications in the secondary 12-month end point analysis, but not in longitudinal analyses. Higher chatbot engagement was associated with longer sleep duration and higher anxiety scores in exploratory within-group analyses. In this randomized clinical trial of pregnant and postpartum individuals from racial and ethnic minoritized groups, access to a generative artificial intelligence maternal health chatbot did not improve maternal anxiety or depression at 12 months compared with an active control. Secondary and exploratory findings should be interpreted cautiously. ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06053515.
zh_abstract: [JAMA Network Open] 生成式人工智能（AI）聊天机器人越来越多用于支持孕产妇健康，但随机证据有限。评价获得生成式AI孕产妇健康聊天机器人是否改善12个月孕产妇健康结局。这项两组随机临床试验于2023年10月至2024年12月招募400名参与者，12个月随访于2025年12月完成。参与者通过在线方式在美国49个州和哥伦比亚特区招募。合格参与者为英语使用者、年龄14岁及以上、怀孕或正在抚养小于6个月婴儿、并自我认同为种族和/或族裔少数群体成员。参与者按1:1随机分配接受该聊天机器人访问权限或由每月儿童书籍组成的主动对照。主要结局为12个月时使用广泛性焦虑障碍量表-7和患者健康问卷-9测量的焦虑和抑郁症状。次要结局包括急诊就诊、妊娠相关并发症、产后保健检查、有效避孕使用和睡眠时长。在400名随机参与者中，平均（SD）年龄为32.6（5.1）岁；200名（50%）在入组时正在抚养婴儿；10名（2%）自我认同为美洲印第安人或阿拉斯加原住民，80名（20%）为亚裔，188名（47%）为黑人或非裔美国人，57名（14%）为多种族，65名（16%）为西班牙裔或拉丁裔。AI聊天机器人与焦虑评分差异无关（校正平均差，0.10；95% CI，-0.77至0.96）或抑郁评分差异无关（校正平均差，-0.23；95% CI，-1.05至0.59），也与急诊就诊、产后保健、避孕使用或睡眠时长无关。在入组时怀孕的参与者中，在次要12个月终点分析中，聊天机器人与更多自我报告的妊娠相关并发症相关，但在纵向分析中不相关。在探索性组内分析中，较高的聊天机器人参与度与更长的睡眠时长和更高的焦虑评分相关。在这项针对种族和族裔少数群体孕妇和产后个体的随机临床试验中，与主动对照相比，获得生成式人工智能孕产妇健康聊天机器人未改善12个月时的孕产妇焦虑或抑郁。次要和探索性发现应谨慎解读。ClinicalTrials.gov标识符：NCT06053515。

title: Vibe Coding versus Clinical Reality
zh_title: 氛围编程与临床现实之间的距离
summary: 观点文章：AI 大幅降低原型开发门槛，但从演示到安全合规的临床产品仍需工程与监管专业能力。
key_points: 心脏病医生借 AI 工具开发患者支持应用获编程赛第三
从可用演示到合规临床产品仍需工程师与安全专家
文中援引 EU MDR、FDA AI 指南与 GDPR 隐私要求
reason: 观点类文章，无论点数据或验证，仅泛论监管门槛，属增量档
abstract: AbstractIn February 2026, a full-time interventional cardiologist placed third in a global coding competition with a postvisit patient support application called postvisit.ai. Many top participants had no formal engineering background but were domain experts who could describe a problem precisely enough for AI tools to translate it into working software. This process has been called "vibe coding." We discuss what it means and whether it has any relevance to clinical reality. Although AI tools have dramatically lowered the barrier to building a prototype, turning a working demo into a safe, regulated product ready for clinical use still very much requires engineers, security specialists, and regulatory expertise. The EU Medical Device Regulation, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration guidance on AI in healthcare, and the privacy requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act all demand professional teams and rigorous processes that no amount of vibe coding can replace. None of this should discourage physicians from building. The natural next step is for them to move from consulting on software design to actively shaping the tools that they use, creating a new generation of physician-builders.
zh_abstract: 摘要 2026年2月，一位全职介入心脏病学家在一场全球编程竞赛中获得第三名，其参赛作品是一款名为 postvisit.ai 的诊后患者支持应用。许多顶尖参与者没有正式工程背景，而是领域专家，能够足够精确地描述问题，使 AI 工具将其转化为可运行的软件。这一过程被称为“vibe coding”。我们讨论其含义以及它是否与临床现实相关。尽管 AI 工具已大幅降低构建原型的门槛，但将可运行的演示转化为安全、受监管、可临床使用的产品，仍然非常需要工程师、安全专家和监管专业知识。欧盟医疗器械法规（EU Medical Device Regulation）、美国食品药品监督管理局（U.S. Food and Drug Administration）关于医疗保健中 AI 的指南，以及《通用数据保护条例》（General Data Protection Regulation）和《健康保险可携性和责任法案》（Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act）的隐私要求，都要求专业团队和严格流程，这些都不是再多 vibe coding 所能替代的。这一切不应阻止医生去构建。自然的下一步是让他们从软件设计咨询转向积极塑造他们所使用的工具，创造新一代“医生-构建者”。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Gallbladder Carcinoma: A Review of Research Studies and Clinical Evidence.
zh_title: 胆囊癌人工智能研究的系统综述
summary: 系统综述纳入31项胆囊癌AI原始研究，发现多数为回顾性、单中心且仅内部验证，外部验证性能有限。
key_points: 31项研究中29项为回顾性
22项单中心、24项仅内部验证
外部队列中模型判别能力有限
reason: 系统综述揭示证据质量缺口，结论明确但非临床结局研究，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of gastrointestinal cancer] Gallbladder carcinoma (GBC) is the most common biliary tract malignancy and is usually diagnosed at an advanced stage. Artificial intelligence (AI), including radiomics, machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), is increasingly applied to its diagnosis, surgical management and prognostication, but how far the reported performance can be trusted is unclear. PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library and Google Scholar were searched to 5 May 2026 using database-specific search strategies. Each primary prediction-model study was characterized separately by design, number of centers and validation type (internal, temporal or external). Of 31 primary AI studies in GBC, 29 were retrospective, 22 were single-center and 24 reported internal validation only. In independent test or external cohorts, DL and ML models discriminated benign from malignant gallbladder lesions with areas under the curve (AUCs) of approximately 0.80-0.89; a multicenter model distinguishing xanthogranulomatous cholecystitis from GBC achieved an external AUC of 0.88, and automated computed tomography (CT) segmentation an external Dice score of 0.76. The best recurrence model achieved an AUC of 0.76 on internal (random-split) validation; none of the reviewed prognostic models reported a quantified external-validation estimate. Intraoperative AI is technically feasible but has no outcome data, and federated learning has been tested only in simulation. AI could plausibly assist several steps of GBC care, but the evidence is dominated by retrospective, single-center, internally validated studies from Asia, and metrics from different studies are not directly comparable. Prospective multicenter external validation, shared annotated datasets and standardized reporting are required before clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Gastrointestinal Cancer] 胆囊癌（GBC）是最常见的胆道恶性肿瘤，通常诊断时已处于晚期。人工智能（AI），包括影像组学（radiomics）、机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL），越来越多应用于其诊断、外科管理和预后判断，但所报告性能的可信程度尚不清楚。检索截至2026年5月5日，使用各数据库特定检索策略检索了PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Web of Science、Cochrane Library和Google Scholar。每项原始预测模型研究分别按设计、中心数量和验证类型（内部、时间或外部）进行特征描述。在31项GBC原始AI研究中，29项为回顾性研究，22项为单中心研究，24项仅报告内部验证。在独立测试或外部队列中，DL和ML模型鉴别良性与恶性胆囊病变的曲线下面积（AUC）约为0.80-0.89；一个区分黄色肉芽肿性胆囊炎与GBC的多中心模型达到外部AUC 0.88，自动计算机断层扫描（CT）分割达到外部Dice评分0.76。最佳复发模型在内部（随机拆分）验证中达到AUC 0.76；所综述的预后模型均未报告量化的外部验证估计值。术中AI在技术上可行，但无结局数据，联邦学习仅在模拟中测试。AI有可能协助GBC诊疗的多个步骤，但证据主要来自亚洲的回顾性、单中心、内部验证研究，且不同研究的指标不能直接比较。在临床采用之前，需要前瞻性多中心外部验证、共享标注数据集和标准化报告。

title: Leakage- and Label-Aware Benchmarking of Class-Imbalance Strategies for Multimodal Chest X-Ray and EHR Classification
zh_title: 多模态胸片与电子病历类别不平衡基准的泄漏审计
summary: 预印本审计MIMIC-CXR 29,083张胸片、10,479例患者的多模态基准，发现记录级划分存在标签泄漏，模型在未见患者上失效。
key_points: 记录级划分可被查表法近似复现，具误导性

reason: 大规模公开数据的方法学审计，揭示泄漏与标签问题，属值得一看档
abstract: Benchmarks of class-imbalance strategies for multimodal chest X-ray (CXR) and electronic health record (EHR) prediction are often evaluated on record-level splits of cohorts in which one patient contributes several radiographs. We audit such a benchmark on 29,083 MIMIC-CXR radiographs of 10,479 patients with eight diagnosis targets. First, the record-split benchmark was misleading: a lookup table that copies the label of a development-set radiograph with the same EHR vector nearly matched the best model, and on unseen patients every model fell to the level of predicting every case positive. Second, tracing the labels back to MIMIC-IV explained why: each patient's labels are keyword matches on the diagnosis codes of a single admission, copied, with one EHR vector per patient, to all of the patient's radiographs, so about a third of the radiographs carry labels that differ from the codes of their own admission. Third, under patient-separated evaluation with admission-aligned and rule-refined labels, the initial conclusions do not hold: in the evaluated configurations no imbalance strategy raised the observed mean macro F2 over no augmentation by more than 0.01, tuned tree ensembles showed no consistent advantage over tuned logistic regression, and the released EHR variables stayed at the level of the all-positive baseline, whereas the diagnostic history available at imaging time and image embeddings exceeded it, including, with rule-refined labels, a CheXpert-trained encoder that never saw these radiographs; RAD-DINO had seen 96.6% of them during self-supervised pretraining. Adding either encoder to the diagnostic history gave no statistically significant F2 gain; exploratory AUROC gains were significant with RAD-DINO but not with DenseNet. We provide reusable diagnostics, a leakage-aware protocol and a checklist.
zh_abstract: 针对多模态胸部X线（CXR）和电子健康记录（EHR）预测的类别不平衡策略基准，常在患者可贡献多张放射影像的队列的记录级划分上进行评估。我们在29,083张MIMIC-CXR放射影像、10,479名患者、八个诊断目标的此类基准上进行审计。首先，记录划分基准具有误导性：一张查找表——复制与同一EHR向量相对应的开发集放射影像的标签——几乎匹配最佳模型；而在未见患者上，每个模型都降至将所有病例预测为阳性的水平。其次，将标签回溯至MIMIC-IV解释了原因：每位患者的标签是对单次入院诊断代码的关键词匹配，并以每位患者一个EHR向量复制到该患者的所有放射影像上，因此约三分之一的放射影像携带的标签与其自身入院的代码不同。第三，在患者分离评估、入院对齐且规则精炼的标签下，初始结论不成立：在所评估的配置中，没有任何不平衡策略使观测到的平均宏F2较无增强提高超过0.01；调优的树集成模型相较调优的逻辑回归未显示一致优势；已发布的EHR变量仍停留在全阳性基线水平，而成像时可获得的诊断史和图像嵌入超过了该基线，包括在规则精炼标签下，一个从未见过这些放射影像的CheXpert训练编码器；RAD-DINO在自监督预训练期间已见过其中96.6%的影像。将任一编码器加入诊断史均未带来有统计学显著性的F2增益；探索性AUROC增益在RAD-DINO中显著，但在DenseNet中不显著。我们提供可复用的诊断工具、一种感知泄漏的协议和一份清单。

title: Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry
zh_title: Kev-Bio：面向超声生物测量的系统一视觉语言模型
summary: 预印本提出 Kev-Bio 视觉语言模型，用临床测量问句引导超声解剖标志点检测，以语言模型决策表征建模定位可能性分布。
key_points: 针对产前、心脏等超声生物测量的卡尺定位问题
用文本指令替代任务专用预测头，提升灵活性
以决策表征显式建模定位模糊性
摘要未提及外部验证或临床结局
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，但仅摘要信息、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: **Purpose:** Ultrasound biometry is widely used across various clinical applications, including prenatal and cardiac examinations, to obtain quantitative measurements by placing calipers at anatomical landmarks. However, these measurements remain subject to interoperator variability as they rely largely on manual caliper placement. Conventional methods often use specialized prediction heads for different ultrasound tasks, whereas vision-language models offer flexibility through text instructions. However, direct coordinate prediction does not explicitly model spatial likelihood distributions, limiting the representation of localization ambiguity. **Methods:** We propose Kev-Bio, a vision-language model that uses clinical measurement questions to guide ultrasound landmark detection. Inspired by System One decision models, Kev-Bio uses decision representations of the language model to generate queries for each caliper endpoint. These queries are matched against shared dense ultrasound features to produce spatial probability maps, from which landmark coordinates and clinical measurements are derived. The model is trained end-to-end using both landmark localization and clinical measurement losses. **Results:** On the nine-view FU/GU Biometry 2026 dataset, Kev-Bio achieves a mean radial error (MRE) of 22.50 pixels and a clinical measurement mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.38, outperforming the compared baselines in overall performance. **Conclusion:** These results demonstrate the effectiveness of Kev-Bio for ultrasound landmark detection and clinical measurement across different anatomical views. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio.
zh_abstract: **目的：** 超声生物测量广泛应用于各种临床应用，包括产前和心脏检查，通过将卡尺置于解剖标志处获得定量测量。然而，这些测量在很大程度上依赖手动放置卡尺，因此仍受操作者间变异性的影响。传统方法通常针对不同超声任务使用专门的预测头，而视觉-语言模型通过文本指令提供灵活性。然而，直接坐标预测并未显式建模空间似然分布，限制了对定位歧义的表示。**方法：** 我们提出Kev-Bio，一种视觉-语言模型，使用临床测量问题引导超声标志点检测。受System One决策模型启发，Kev-Bio利用语言模型的决策表示生成每个卡尺端点的查询。这些查询与共享的密集超声特征匹配，生成空间概率图，并由此推导标志点坐标和临床测量值。该模型使用标志点定位和临床测量损失进行端到端训练。**结果：** 在九视图FU/GU Biometry 2026数据集上，Kev-Bio达到22.50像素的平均径向误差（MRE）和15.38的临床测量平均绝对误差（MAE），总体性能优于所比较的基线方法。**结论：** 这些结果证明了Kev-Bio在不同解剖视图的超声标志点检测和临床测量中的有效性。我们的代码和模型可在https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio获取。
