abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: China National Center for Cardiovascular Diseases; conditions: Hypertension, Hyperglycemia, Dyslipidemia; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 150; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] High blood pressure often occurs together with abnormal blood glucose, abnormal blood lipids, or abdominal obesity. Managing these conditions outside the hospital can be difficult. This study will test whether a digital health program that combines artificial intelligence (AI) with review and support by doctors and nurses improves health outcomes compared with standard out-of-hospital guidance. The study will enroll 150 adults aged 18 to 70 years who have hypertension and at least one additional cardiometabolic risk factor that is not at target. Participants will be randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to either the hybrid AI-assisted management group or the standard-guidance group. The intervention group will use a patient mini-program and connected devices to monitor blood pressure, glucose, and lifestyle information. The AI system will propose personalized medication, diet, exercise, and monitoring plans, which the healthcare team will review and confirm before delivery. The control group will receive routine printed health education and usual clinical follow-up. All participants will be followed for 6 months. The main outcome is the proportion of participants achieving blood pressure control together with control of at least one glycemic or lipid indicator. Other assessments include treatment adherence, cardiovascular events, hospitalizations, medical costs, quality of life, and system usability.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：中国国家心血管病中心（China National Center for Cardiovascular Diseases）；疾病：高血压、高血糖、血脂异常；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；分期：不适用（NA）；入组人数：150；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 高血压常与血糖异常、血脂异常或腹型肥胖同时发生。在医院外管理这些疾病可能较为困难。本研究将检验一种数字健康项目——结合人工智能（AI）与医生和护士的审核和支持——与标准院外指导相比是否改善健康结局。研究将入组150名18至70岁、患有高血压且至少有一项未达标的额外心血管代谢危险因素的成年人。参与者将按1:1比例随机分配至混合AI辅助管理组或标准指导组。干预组将使用患者小程序和连接设备监测血压、血糖和生活方式信息。AI系统将提出个体化用药、饮食、运动和监测方案，由医疗团队审核确认后交付。对照组将接受常规印刷健康教育及常规临床随访。所有参与者将随访6个月。主要结局是达到血压控制并同时至少一项血糖或血脂指标控制的参与者比例。其他评估包括治疗依从性、心血管事件、住院、医疗费用、生活质量和系统可用性。

title: Application of Machine Learning and Deep Learning in diagnosis Covid19
zh_title: 机器学习与深度学习用于COVID-19诊断与结局预测
summary: 预印本用阿尔及利亚80例与法国99例队列，比较五种机器学习模型预测死亡、ICU入住与临床状态变化。
key_points: 两队列共179例住院患者，样本量小
评估LR、KNN、CART、朴素贝叶斯与SVM
预测死亡、ICU入住与病情改善或恶化
摘要未说明外部验证结果

abstract: Predicting the progression of COVID-19 in hospitalised patients was an important challenge during the pandemic, particularly when healthcare resources were limited. This study investigates the use of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models to predict three clinical outcomes: death, admission to the intensive care unit (ICU), and clinical status (improvement or worsening). The study uses two patient datasets: an Algerian cohort of 80 patients from the Internal Medicine Department of the University Hospital Centre of Constantine, collected between July and August 2020, and a French cohort of 99 patients collected between March and May 2020. Five ML classifiers were evaluated: logistic regression (LR), k-nearest neighbours (KNN), classification and regression trees (CART), Naive Bayes (NB), and support vector machines (SVM). Their performance was examined in combination with three feature-selection methods: analysis of variance (ANOVA), mutual information (MI), and recursive feature elimination (RFE). The results were also compared with multilayer perceptron (MLP) models using one to five hidden layers. Model evaluation included 30 repetitions of five-fold cross-validation on the training data, followed by evaluation on a separate hold-out test set. The results showed that selecting 20 features generally provided better cross-validated accuracy than selecting 30 features or using the full feature set. The best-performing classifier-feature-selection combination varied across the six dataset-outcome tasks. LR combined with RFE was selected for three tasks, LR combined with ANOVA for one task, and CART combined with ANOVA for two tasks. The selected ML models achieved test-set accuracies ranging from 0.47 to 0.95 and higher accuracy than the average MLP results in five of the six tasks. These findings suggest that ML methods can be useful for exploring clinical outcomes in hospitalised COVID-19 patients. However, the small sample sizes and limitations of the available data mean that the results should be interpreted with caution. Further evaluation using larger and independent patient datasets is needed before these models can be considered for clinical use.
zh_abstract: 预测住院COVID-19患者的疾病进展是大流行期间的一项重要挑战，尤其是在医疗资源有限时。本研究探讨使用机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）模型预测三项临床结局：死亡、入住重症监护病房（ICU）以及临床状态（改善或恶化）。研究使用两个患者数据集：一个阿尔及利亚队列，来自君士坦丁大学医院中心内科的80名患者，收集于2020年7月至8月；以及一个法国队列，99名患者，收集于2020年3月至5月。评估了五种ML分类器：逻辑回归（LR）、k近邻（KNN）、分类与回归树（CART）、朴素贝叶斯（NB）和支持向量机（SVM）。这些分类器的性能与三种特征选择方法结合进行考察：方差分析（ANOVA）、互信息（MI）和递归特征消除（RFE）。结果还与使用1至5个隐藏层的多层感知机（MLP）模型进行比较。模型评估包括在训练数据上进行30次重复的五折交叉验证，随后在单独的留出测试集上评估。结果显示，选择20个特征通常比选择30个特征或使用完整特征集提供更好的交叉验证准确率。最佳表现的分类器-特征选择组合在六个数据集-结局任务中各不相同。LR联合RFE被选用于三个任务，LR联合ANOVA用于一个任务，CART联合ANOVA用于两个任务。所选ML模型在测试集上的准确率范围为0.47至0.95，并且在六个任务中的五个任务上准确率高于MLP的平均结果。这些发现表明，ML方法可用于探索住院COVID-19患者的临床结局。然而，样本量小和可用数据的局限性意味着结果应谨慎解读。在将这些模型考虑用于临床之前，需要使用更大且独立的患者数据集进行进一步评估。

title: Cross-paradigm audit of large language model judges for clinical text evaluation
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: 临床文本评估中大语言模型评审者的跨范式审计
summary: 以专家评审为参照，审计 6 个开放权重模型在 4 个德语临床数据集上的评审可靠性与偏差。
key_points: 覆盖报告、护理记录、出院小结与患者信四类语料
无任一提示配置在各范式下与专家稳定对齐

reason: 多数据集并以专家评审为外部参照，揭示 LLM 评审系统性偏差，属重要档
abstract: Large language models are increasingly being used to evaluate clinical texts, a concept known as LLM-as-a-judge. However, most of the existing evidence focuses on English data and uses pooled agreement metrics that obscure clinically relevant failure modes. This study audited six open-weight models against expert judges on four German clinical datasets covering report and nursing documentation summarization, discharge summary generation, and patient letter generation. The models were evaluated across three paradigms and four prompt configurations. Alignment with experts varied by criterion and corpus, and no configuration proved reliable across paradigms. All judges exhibited position and identity bias. Substituting LLM-as-a-judge for the expert panel shifted 57.2% of pointwise categories, swapped 41.7% of pairwise winners, missed 10.2% of clinical errors, and inverted clinical priorities by overrating the criteria succinct and accurate. Therefore, LLM-as-a-judge is not a safe substitute for experts in German clinical text evaluations, and deployment thresholds should follow decision-impact analysis for LLM-as-a-judge in clinical contexts.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被用于评估临床文本，这一概念被称为 LLM-as-a-judge。然而，现有证据大多集中于英文数据，并使用会掩盖临床相关失效模式的汇总一致性指标。本研究以专家评审为对照，审计了六个开放权重模型在四个德语临床数据集上的表现，这些数据集涵盖报告和护理文书摘要、出院摘要生成以及患者信件生成。模型在三种范式和四种提示配置下接受评估。与专家的一致性因标准和语料库而异，且没有任何配置在所有范式中均被证明可靠。所有评审模型都表现出位置偏差和身份偏差。以 LLM-as-a-judge 替代专家小组，使 57.2% 的逐点评分类别发生改变，调换了 41.7% 的成对比较优胜者，漏掉 10.2% 的临床错误，并因高估“简洁”和“准确”这两个标准而颠倒了临床优先级。因此，在德语临床文本评估中，LLM-as-a-judge 不是专家的安全替代品；部署阈值应遵循针对临床情境中 LLM-as-a-judge 的决策影响分析。

abstract: [JAMA network open] Although external validation of machine learning (ML)-based delirium risk models is a key stage in the model development pipeline, few published reports exist. Moreover, ML-based delirium risk models commonly degrade in performance during external validation. To examine the performance of a fusion multimodal with natural language processing (NLP) delirium risk stratification model in live clinical practice with cross-hospital external validation. This quality improvement study evaluated live clinical deployment of the model among patients 60 years or older who were admitted to non-intensive care units at Mount Sinai Hospital (MSH), with external validation performed at Mount Sinai Morningside Hospital (MSM), from December 1, 2024, to December 31, 2025. Primary outcomes were performance of the risk stratification model, assessed by area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), and monthly delirium detection rates. A 2 × 2 confusion matrix was created, and the 4 cells were used to calculate model performance metrics and compare associated diagnostic yield between premodel deployment and active model deployment periods. The overall sample included 33 095 admissions to non-intensive care units at MSM and MSH (mean [SD] age, 74.86 (9.22) years; 15 601 women [47.1%], 17 271 men [52.2%]). A total of 9020 MSM inpatient admissions were assigned a delirium risk score by the risk stratification model during live clinical operations and were compared to 21 186 MSH inpatient admissions that were assigned a risk score by the same model. Age at admission significantly differed between patients at MSM and MSH (MSM: median [IQR] age, 75.79 [68.25-83.88] years vs MSH: 72.62 [66.64-79.65] years; P < .001). Patients from MSM and MSH also significantly differed by sex, race and ethnicity, surgical vs medical primary diagnosis, length of stay, and dementia prevalence rate. Among 11 909 MSM patients, patients in the pre-ML cohort (median [IQR] age, 78.00 [71.00-85.00] years) were significantly older than those in the post-ML cohort (median [IQR] age, 75.79 [68.25-83.88] years) (P < .001). The AUROC of the model was 0.91 (95% CI, 0.90-0.92) for MSM and 0.94 (95% CI, 0.93-0.94) for MSH. The positive predictive value of the model was 25.9% for MSM and 19.4% for MSH. For MSM, the mean monthly delirium detection rate significantly increased from 9.23% (95% CI, 8.07%-10.38%) to 19.59% (95% CI, 17.32%-21.85%) after model deployment (P < .001). source: PubMed · Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons. Global research & reviews

abstract: [Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons. Global research & reviews] Artificial intelligence (AI) is permeating many aspects of daily life. Medicine, and specifically orthopaedic surgery, is being influenced by the rapid growth and success of AI in serving as an adjunct to medical expertise. AI includes many nested subfields and applications such as computer vision, language models, and predictive analytics. Using standard machine learning methods, clinical decision support tools are being developed for clinicians to provide evidence-based, individualized care. Some models predict clinical and functional outcomes after a procedure, whereas others may incorporate administrative metrics to predict factors, such as length of stay, return to the emergency department, and complications. The application of AI to medical imaging focuses on the extraction of a large amount of quantitative data in the form of predefined features from clinical images that humans cannot perceive, a field known as radiomics. There has been recent interest, particularly in oncology, to apply radiomics to aid in diagnosis and prognostication of outcomes. Given the robust growth of radiomics literature, and the anticipated application in orthopaedic surgery, the purpose of this review article is to educate the orthopaedic surgery community on the practical importance and the basics of radiomics.

Global research & reviews] 人工智能（AI）正在渗透日常生活的许多方面。医学，尤其是骨科手术，正受到AI快速发展和成功作为医学专业能力辅助手段的影响。AI包括许多嵌套的子领域和应用，如计算机视觉、语言模型和预测分析。使用标准机器学习方法，正在为临床医生开发临床决策支持工具，以提供循证、个体化诊疗。一些模型预测某项操作后的临床和功能结局，而另一些模型可能纳入管理指标来预测诸如住院时间、重返急诊科和并发症等因素。AI在医学影像中的应用侧重于从临床图像中提取大量以预定义特征形式存在的、人类无法感知的定量数据，这一领域称为放射组学。近期尤其肿瘤学领域有兴趣应用放射组学来辅助诊断和预后判断。鉴于放射组学文献的强劲增长，以及其在骨科手术中的预期应用，本综述文章的目的是让骨科手术界了解放射组学的实际重要性和基础知识。

title: Cross-cancer knowledge transfer for lymph node metastasis prediction: Applicability of an axillary lymph node-based deep learning model

abstract: Evaluation of lymph node (LN) metastasis is critical for cancer staging and treatment planning. Since radiologic hallmarks of metastatic LNs are shared across primary cancers, a computed tomography (CT)-based deep learning (DL) classifier developed from one anatomy may transfer to others. This study built a DenseNet-121 ensemble model using clinical-implication-applied preprocessing and evaluated its cross-anatomical generalizability to LNs from diverse primary cancers. A DenseNet-121 ensemble model combining fixed-size cropping (FSC) and adjustable square cropping (ASC) was trained from ImageNet initialization on an axillary lymph node (ALN) dataset (n = 1,128 from 523 breast cancer patients). The model utilized clinical-implication-applied perinodal cropping with bicubic filtering and standardized resizing. To test cross-anatomical generalizability, an external dataset of 256 CT images across four anatomical regions was evaluated: cervical, mediastinal, upper-abdominal, and lower-abdominal LNs. Perinodal free margins were systematically varied from 10% to 40% to optimize the balance between context preservation and surround interference. Bicubic filtering and standardized resizing yielded the highest internal performance on the original ALN dataset (FSC-ASC ensemble area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUROC] 0.958, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.920-0.987 at 40% margin). The model demonstrated site-dependent, above-chance generalizability across all external regions. Cervical LNs achieved the highest performance at a 40% margin (AUROC 0.939, 95% CI 0.875-0.989). Mediastinal LNs peaked at a 10% margin (AUROC 0.796, 95% CI 0.672-0.903), with wider margins degrading performance due to adjacent structural interference. Upper-abdominal and lower-abdominal LNs reached optimal performance at a 30% margin (AUROC 0.814 for upper; AUROC 0.917 for lower). A single ALN-trained DL model can accurately predict LN metastasis across cervical, mediastinal, and abdominal stations through site-specific perinodal margin tuning. These findings support the feasibility of cross-cancer knowledge transfer and the clinical utility of generalizable backbones for pan-cancer nodal assessment.
zh_abstract: 淋巴结（LN）转移的评估对癌症分期和治疗计划至关重要。由于转移性LN的影像学特征在原发癌症之间共享，从某一解剖部位开发的基于计算机断层扫描（CT）的深度学习（DL）分类器可能迁移至其他部位。本研究使用应用临床含义的预处理构建了一个DenseNet-121集成模型，并评估其对不同原发癌症LN的跨解剖部位泛化性。一个结合固定尺寸裁剪（FSC）和可调方形裁剪（ASC）的DenseNet-121集成模型，从ImageNet初始化开始，在腋窝淋巴结（ALN）数据集（n = 1,128，来自523例乳腺癌患者）上训练。该模型采用应用临床含义的淋巴结周围裁剪，并结合双三次滤波和标准化调整尺寸。为检验跨解剖部位泛化性，评估了一个包含四个解剖区域共256张CT图像的外部数据集：颈部、纵隔、上腹部和下腹部LN。淋巴结周围自由边界从10%到40%系统变化，以优化背景保留与周围干扰之间的平衡。双三次滤波和标准化调整尺寸在原始ALN数据集上产生最高的内部性能（FSC-ASC集成在40%边界时的受试者工作特征曲线下面积[AUROC]为0.958，95%置信区间[CI] 0.920-0.987）。该模型在所有外部区域均表现出部位依赖性的、高于随机水平的泛化性。颈部LN在40%边界时达到最高性能（AUROC 0.939，95% CI 0.875-0.989）。纵隔LN在10%边界时达到峰值（AUROC 0.796，95% CI 0.672-0.903），更宽的边界因邻近结构干扰而降低性能。上腹部和下腹部LN在30%边界时达到最佳性能（上腹部AUROC 0.814；下腹部AUROC 0.917）。单一经ALN训练的DL模型通过部位特异性淋巴结周围边界调优，可准确预测颈部、纵隔和腹部各站LN转移。这些发现支持跨癌症知识迁移的可行性，以及可泛化骨干模型用于泛癌淋巴结评估的临床效用。

title: Evaluating uncertainty for detecting performance loss and guiding deferral after model transfer between hospital systems
zh_title: 模型跨院迁移后不确定性用于检测性能下降
summary: 预印本在MIMIC-IV训练三种神经网络做院内死亡预测，于eICU-CRD测试不确定性指标能否预警性能损失。
key_points: 熵与互信息均未能可靠反映性能下降
推迟熵最高20%可将剩余错误率降至6.3-8.0%
reason: 跨医院系统外部验证、结论有方法学价值，但为预印本且无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Clinical prediction models often perform worse after transfer between hospital systems, but deterioration becomes apparent only once outcomes are known. We investigated whether uncertainty measures available at prediction time warn of performance loss and can help identify individual predictions requiring review. Three neural network architectures were trained on MIMIC-IV for in-hospital mortality prediction and evaluated on eICU-CRD. Measures included predictive entropy, mutual information from Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles, and representation density. After transfer, AUROC fell from 0.86-0.87 to 0.76-0.77 and calibration worsened, while entropy and mutual information were lower. None of the measures reliably indicated the reduced performance. Deferring the 20% with the highest entropy reduced the remaining error rate from 17.5-20.1% to 6.3-8.0%; the deferred patients included 91-99% of false alarms but only 2-7% of missed deaths, which carried low uncertainty. Uncertainty therefore supported selective review but failed to reveal performance loss.
zh_abstract: 临床预测模型在医院系统之间迁移后往往表现更差，但性能下降只有在结局已知后才会显现。我们研究了预测时可得的不确定性度量是否能警示性能损失，并帮助识别需要复核的个体预测。我们在 MIMIC-IV 上训练了三种神经网络架构用于院内死亡预测，并在 eICU-CRD 上评估。度量包括预测熵、来自 Monte Carlo dropout 和 deep ensembles 的互信息，以及表示密度。迁移后，AUROC 从 0.86-0.87 降至 0.76-0.77，校准变差，而熵和互信息更低。没有任何度量能可靠指示性能下降。将熵最高的20%转交复核后，剩余错误率从17.5-20.1%降至6.3-8.0%；被转交复核的患者包括91-99%的假警报，但仅包括2-7%的漏报死亡，而这些漏报死亡具有低不确定性。因此，不确定性支持选择性复核，但未能揭示性能损失。

title: Rethinking Next-Visit Diagnosis Prediction Beyond Aggregate Metrics: Retrieval--Memory Multi-Agent Adjudication
zh_title: 超越聚合指标重新审视下次就诊诊断预测
summary: 预印本提出按分布、时间与病史深度分维度的评估框架，比较规则、LLM提示、检索、记忆与多智能体方法。
key_points: 提出多维度评估框架，替代单一聚合指标
重复上次就诊记录在整体上优于多数LLM方法
检索与记忆方法在不同时间转移场景下各有优势
reason: 预印本评估框架有新意且有基线对比，但无外部临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Next-visit diagnosis prediction forecasts the diagnoses documented at a patient's next encounter, turning retrospective electronic health records into prospective clinical prediction. However, conventional aggregate evaluation obscures its multifaceted nature: distributionally, models must handle variable-size diagnosis sets and long-tailed labels; temporally, they must distinguish persistent, newly recorded, and recurrent diagnoses; and both vary with observed history depth. We introduce an evaluation framework along these dimensions and apply it to rule-based heuristics, LLM-based prompting, retrieval, memory, and multi-agent approaches. This reveals that repeating the last visit outperforms most LLM-based approaches overall despite predicting no new or recurrent diagnoses, and that retrieval and memory exhibit distinct profiles whose relative strengths vary across temporal transitions and backbones. Motivated by this, we propose LONGINUS, a retrieval-memory multi-agent adjudication framework combining evidence retrieved from patient records with structured memory of the patient trajectory. Using cross-view agreement as a reliability heuristic, it preserves shared predictions and adjudicates disagreements without revealing their source. Across MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV with four LLM backbones, LONGINUS achieves the best transition-specific performance among LLM-based methods in nearly all settings while remaining competitive with them on aggregate metrics.
zh_abstract: 下一次就诊诊断预测预报患者下一次就诊时记录的诊断，将回顾性电子健康记录转化为前瞻性临床预测。然而，传统的聚合评估掩盖了其多面性：在分布上，模型必须处理可变大小的诊断集和长尾标签；在时间上，模型必须区分持续性、新记录和复发性诊断；且二者随观察到的病史深度而变化。我们引入一个沿这些维度的评估框架，并将其应用于基于规则的启发式方法、基于LLM的提示、检索、记忆和多智能体方法。这揭示出，重复上一次就诊在总体上优于大多数基于LLM的方法，尽管其不预测任何新发或复发性诊断；并且检索和记忆表现出不同特征，其相对优势随时间的转换和骨干模型而变化。受此启发，我们提出LONGINUS，一种检索-记忆多智能体裁决框架，结合从患者记录中检索的证据与患者轨迹的结构化记忆。使用跨视图一致性作为可靠性启发式，它保留共享预测并对分歧进行裁决而不揭示其来源。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上，使用四个LLM骨干模型，LONGINUS在几乎所有设置中取得基于LLM方法中最佳的转换特异性性能，同时在聚合指标上保持与它们有竞争力。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] The clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) published by the European Society for Vascular Surgery (ESVS) span approximately 1100 pages whose simultaneous cross-referencing is impractical at the point of care. Unguarded large language models (LLMs) carry hallucination risk, motivating a guideline-locked design. We describe the architecture and development of a context-aware clinical agent encompassing the full ESVS corpus of 14 CPGs. The system extends a validated single-guideline GraphRAG prototype with an LLM-driven Guideline Router, an embedded Context Gate that withholds retrieval when decision-critical parameters are absent, dual-channel retrieval, and GPT-5 synthesis under a mandatory citation template. An automated benchmark assessed the final system on 55 vignettes, scored by 2 blinded LLM judges over 3 runs (330 judgments), with clinician adjudication of every flagged claim. The system stayed within its locked corpus, declined all out-of-scope queries, and achieved 98.4% guideline-routing recall. The Context Gate showed 91.9% specificity and 78.6% sensitivity for underspecified queries, and all 259 cited recommendations were verifiable within the locked corpus. Automated judges flagged an unsupported claim in 18.2% of items under a sensitive screening definition; on adjudication by 2 vascular surgeons, 7.3% of items contained a clinically consequential error, none graded capable of causing harm. Clinical acceptability of complete answers was not scored and is reserved for prospective expert evaluation. These results support the feasibility of a multi-guideline context-aware clinical agent for vascular surgery; citation traceability and locked-corpus provenance facilitate future auditability.
zh_abstract: 《美国医学信息学协会杂志：JAMIA》欧洲血管外科学会（European Society for Vascular Surgery, ESVS）发布的临床实践指南（clinical practice guidelines, CPGs）约达1100页，在诊疗现场同时交叉检索并不切实际。未加防护的大型语言模型（large language models, LLMs）存在幻觉风险，这促使采用指南锁定设计。我们描述了一个涵盖ESVS全部14部CPG的上下文感知临床智能体的架构与开发。该系统扩展了一个经过验证的单指南GraphRAG原型，加入了由LLM驱动的指南路由器（Guideline Router）、一个嵌入式上下文门控（Context Gate，在缺少决策关键参数时暂缓检索）、双通道检索，以及在强制引用模板下由GPT-5进行综合。自动化基准在55个情景案例（vignettes）上评估最终系统，由2名盲法LLM评审者在3次运行中评分（共330次判定），并对每一条被标记的声明进行临床医生裁定。系统始终处于其锁定语料库范围内，拒绝了所有超出范围的查询，并达到98.4%的指南路由召回率。上下文门控对信息不充分查询的特异性为91.9%，敏感性为78.6%，且所有259条被引用的推荐意见均可在锁定语料库内验证。在敏感筛查定义下，自动评审者标记18.2%的条目存在无支持声明；经2名血管外科医生裁定，7.3%的条目含有具有临床后果的错误，无一被评定为可能造成伤害。完整答案的临床可接受性未予评分，留待前瞻性专家评估。这些结果支持用于血管外科的多指南上下文感知临床智能体的可行性；引用可追溯性和锁定语料库来源有助于未来的可审计性。

summary: npj Digital Medicine 发表患者级多模态眼科基础模型 RETBind，用配对 OCT 与超广角眼底图统一编码器预训练。
key_points: 统一编码器学习 OCT 与超广角眼底的跨模态对应

abstract: Medical artificial intelligence (AI) holds considerable promise across a wide range of ophthalmic tasks, offering a practical path to patient-level diagnostic support. Foundation models further extend this potential by learning generalizable representations from large-scale unlabeled data, alleviating the burden of extensive manual annotation. However, existing ophthalmic foundation models largely rely on single-modality or modality-specific encoders, failing to capture patient-level cross-modal correspondence in real-world multimodal clinical workflows. To address these gaps, we propose RETBind, a patient-level multimodal foundation model with a unified encoder that explicitly learns cross-modal correspondence from paired clinical imaging using patient-level paired optical coherence tomography (OCT) and ultra-widefield (UWF) fundus imaging. This patient-level paired pretraining strategy enables the model to learn unified cross-modal representations of complementary information, improv-ing performance and robustness beyond single-modality approaches. Across nine benchmark datasets spanning ocular disease classification and segmentation tasks, RETBind achieved consistent improvements, particularly enhancing AUPR in clinically relevant imbalanced settings. Exploratory analyses further examined the potential of RETBind for systemic disease prediction from retinal imaging, collectively highlighting its ability to learn unified cross-modal representations within a single shared encoder, enabling direct interaction between modalities and supporting transfer across diverse retinal imaging tasks.
zh_abstract: 医学人工智能（AI）在广泛眼科任务中具有相当大的前景，为患者级诊断支持提供了一条实用路径。基础模型通过从大规模无标注数据中学习可泛化表征，进一步扩展了这种潜力，减轻了大量人工标注的负担。然而，现有眼科基础模型在很大程度上依赖单模态或模态特异性编码器，未能捕捉真实世界多模态临床工作流程中的患者级跨模态对应关系。为弥补这些空白，我们提出RETBind，一种具有统一编码器的患者级多模态基础模型，其利用患者级配对的光学相干断层扫描（OCT）和超广角（UWF）眼底成像，从配对临床影像中显式学习跨模态对应关系。这种患者级配对预训练策略使模型能够学习互补信息的统一跨模态表征，超越单模态方法提升性能和稳健性。在涵盖眼病分类和分割任务的九个基准数据集上，RETBind取得了持续改善，尤其在临床相关的失衡设置中提升了AUPR。探索性分析进一步考察了RETBind基于视网膜影像预测系统性疾病的能力，共同凸显了其在单一共享编码器内学习统一跨模态表征的能力，使模态之间能够直接交互，并支持在多样视网膜成像任务间迁移。

title: MIMIC-Note-Extract: A Large-Scale Structured Dataset Extracted from MIMIC-IV-Note Discharge Summaries

summary: 预印本发布从 MIMIC-IV-Note 的 300,720 份出院小结中抽取 16 个章节结构化为表格的大型公开数据集。

reason: 规模大且可公开获取的电子病历结构化数据集，属重要档；但为预印本未经同行评审
abstract: MIMIC is one of the most widely used public hospital datasets for machine learning on electronic health records, yet clinically important information, such as past medical history, allergies, and diagnostic findings, remains confined to free-text discharge summaries. Studies requiring this information must therefore build their own extraction pipelines, duplicating substantial effort across projects. We release MIMIC-Note-Extract (MNE), a large-scale dataset that uses a hybrid extraction pipeline combining deterministic parsing with schema-guided large language model generation to transform 16 sections from 300,720 discharge summaries into structured tables. MNE adds information that has no structured MIMIC counterpart and enriches related tables with broader coverage and greater clinical detail, including 10 times more patient-history entries and medication histories for more than twice as many admissions. Validation by medical doctors confirms extraction accuracy above 92% across sections. Using MNE, we construct a clinical decision-making benchmark for LLM agents, demonstrating how reusable structured representations of clinical narratives reduce data curation effort.
zh_abstract: MIMIC是用于电子健康记录机器学习的最广泛使用的公共医院数据集之一，然而临床上重要的信息，如既往病史、过敏史和诊断发现，仍局限于自由文本出院小结中。因此，需要这些信息的研究必须构建自己的提取流程，导致跨项目重复大量工作。我们发布MIMIC-Note-Extract（MNE），这是一个大规模数据集，使用结合确定性解析与模式引导的大型语言模型生成的混合提取流程，将300,720份出院小结中的16个部分转换为结构化表格。MNE增加了MIMIC中没有结构化对应项的信息，并以更广覆盖和更多临床细节丰富相关表格，包括多10倍的患者病史条目，以及覆盖超过两倍住院次数的用药史。由医生进行的验证确认各部分的提取准确率高于92%。使用MNE，我们为LLM智能体构建了一个临床决策基准，展示了临床叙述的可复用结构化表示如何减少数据整理工作。

abstract: Pure data-driven artificial intelligence (AI) is insufficient for clinical adoption. This editorial summarizes 31 papers showing that precision medicine requires integrating structural domain knowledge before model training. We identify three necessary transitions: anchoring algorithms in biological laws for mechanistic interpretability; designing collaborative, human-centered clinical interfaces; and scaling equitable, population-level interventions. These shifts advance medical AI from technical novelty toward trustworthy, clinically grounded, and ethically deployed foundational science.
zh_abstract: 纯数据驱动的人工智能（AI）不足以用于临床采纳。这篇社论总结了 31 篇论文，表明精准医学需要在模型训练之前整合结构性领域知识。我们确定三项必要转变：将算法锚定于生物学规律以实现机制可解释性；设计协作式、以人为中心的临床界面；以及扩大公平的、人群层面的干预。这些转变推动医学 AI 从技术新奇走向可信、具有临床基础且符合伦理部署的基础科学。

title: Development and cross-cohort evaluation of a multimodal deep-learning model for ER, PR and HER2 status classification in breast cancer

summary: 预印本在TCGA开发结合全切片图像与转录组的多模态模型预测乳腺癌ER/PR/HER2状态，并在CPTAC外部队列评估判别与校准。
key_points: TCGA开发约1000例，CPTAC外部验证120例
分析去除HER2转录本后的增量价值
考察外部队列校准与再校准
reason: 有独立外部队列验证与校准分析，但外部样本仅120例且为预印本
abstract: Background. Estrogen receptor (ER), progesterone receptor (PR) and HER2 status guide systemic treatment in breast cancer. Multimodal models are rarely benchmarked against key biomarker molecular baselines or evaluated for cross-cohort calibration. We assessed incremental value, dependence on label-proximal HER2 transcripts, and transport of discrimination and calibration. Methods. A model combining whole-slide images, transcriptomes, age and stage was developed in TCGA-BRCA (1051 patients; ER/PR/HER2 analysis sets: 1001/998/1006) and evaluated in CPTAC-BRCA (120 patients; 118/113/95). CPTAC had been observed during earlier development and included 13 HER2-positive cases. Analyses included paired model comparisons, transcript removal, alternative loss functions and recalibration. Internal discrimination used pooled out-of-fold predictions; external discrimination used fold-mean estimates, with ensemble calibration reported separately. Internal calibration and macro-AUC uncertainty were interpreted as exploratory. Results. Internal AUCs were 0.943 for ER, 0.901 for PR, and 0.860 for HER2; external AUCs were 0.952, 0.937, and 0.918, respectively. External macro-AUC was 0.936 for the multimodal model and 0.957 for logistic regression using ESR1, PGR, and ERBB2 (difference -0.021). Removal of the extended 29-transcript 17q12-q21 region changed HER2 AUC by -0.035 [-0.058 to -0.013] (95% CI) internally and by -0.042 [-0.089 to -0.007] externally relative to the baseline multimodal model. For external 15-model ensemble predictions, recalibrated HER2 expected calibration error (ECE) was 0.236, exceeding the ECE reference ceiling of 0.125, while calibration-in-the-large was -1.657 [-2.373 to -1.023] (profile-likelihood 95% CI), indicating systematic overprediction. ER and PR also showed overprediction. In paired fold-mean comparisons, HER2 ECE and Brier score favoured the three-transcript model (ESR1, PGR, and ERBB2). Conclusions. A multimodal deep-learning model achieved high discrimination across cohorts but did not demonstrate clear incremental value over a parsimonious three-transcript baseline, while cross-cohort calibration remained a substantial challenge. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating incremental value, calibration, and clinical utility alongside discrimination when assessing AI-based prediction models for medical use.
zh_abstract: 【背景】雌激素受体（ER）、孕激素受体（PR）和 HER2 状态指导乳腺癌的系统治疗。多模态模型很少与关键生物标志物的分子基线进行基准比较，也很少评估跨队列校准。我们评估了增量价值、对标签邻近 HER2 转录本的依赖，以及判别力和校准的可迁移性。【方法】在 TCGA-BRCA（1051例患者；ER/PR/HER2 分析集：1001/998/1006）中开发了一个结合全切片图像、转录组、年龄和分期的模型，并在 CPTAC-BRCA（120例患者；118/113/95）中评估。CPTAC 曾在早期开发过程中被观察到，并包括13例 HER2 阳性病例。分析包括配对模型比较、转录本移除、替代损失函数和重新校准。内部判别力使用汇总的折外预测；外部判别力使用折均值估计，集成校准另行报告。内部校准和 macro-AUC 不确定性被解释为探索性。【结果】内部 AUC 为 ER 0.943、PR 0.901、HER2 0.860；外部 AUC 分别为0.952、0.937和0.918。外部 macro-AUC 在多模态模型中为0.936，在使用 ESR1、PGR 和 ERBB2 的逻辑回归中为0.957（差值 -0.021）。相对于基线多模态模型，移除扩展的29个转录本 17q12-q21 区域使 HER2 AUC 在内部变化 -0.035 [-0.058 至 -0.013]（95% CI），在外部变化 -0.042 [-0.089 至 -0.007]。对于外部15个模型的集成预测，重新校准后的 HER2 期望校准误差（ECE）为0.236，超过 ECE 参考上限0.125，而大范围校准（calibration-in-the-large）为 -1.657 [-2.373 至 -1.023]（轮廓似然95% CI），表明存在系统性高估。ER 和 PR 也显示高估。在配对的折均值比较中，HER2 ECE 和 Brier 评分支持三转录本模型（ESR1、PGR 和 ERBB2）。【结论】一个多模态深度学习模型在各队列中实现了高判别力，但相较于简约的三转录本基线未显示出明确的增量价值，而跨队列校准仍是一个重大挑战。这些发现强调了在评估用于医学用途的 AI 预测模型时，除判别力外，评估增量价值、校准和临床效用很重要。

abstract: [Philosophy, ethics, and humanities in medicine : PEHM] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in healthcare and may improve efficiency in clinical support, health management, and doctor-patient communication. Yet its tendency to hallucinate, that is, to generate medical information that appears plausible but is false, can create systemic ethical risks in high-risk medical settings. This paper addresses two questions: what distinctive ethical risks are created by medical AI hallucinations, and what governance mechanisms can respond to them? Using the four principles of biomedical ethics as an analytical tool, the paper identifies four risk pathways: weakened informed consent, erosion of doctor-patient trust, harm to life and health, and unfair responsibility allocation. It then introduces responsible research and innovation (RRI) to build a four-dimensional framework of anticipation, inclusion, reflexivity, and responsiveness. The main contribution of the paper is to integrate biomedical ethical principles with RRI governance tools in the specific context of medical AI hallucinations, developing a closed-loop governance matrix across technology development, clinical application, and regulatory oversight. This provides an operational pathway for moving medical AI from technical feasibility towards ethical trustworthiness.
zh_abstract: [Philosophy, ethics, and humanities in medicine : PEHM] 生成式人工智能（AI）正越来越多地用于医疗保健，并可能提高临床支持、健康管理和医患沟通的效率。然而，其产生幻觉的倾向，即生成看似合理但虚假的医疗信息，可能在高风险医疗环境中造成系统性伦理风险。本文探讨两个问题：医疗 AI 幻觉会带来哪些独特的伦理风险，以及哪些治理机制可以应对这些风险？本文以生物医学伦理四原则为分析工具，识别出四条风险路径：知情同意被削弱、医患信任被侵蚀、生命与健康受到伤害，以及责任分配不公。随后，本文引入负责任研究与创新（responsible research and innovation, RRI），构建由预见、包容、反思和响应构成的四维框架。本文的主要贡献在于，在医疗 AI 幻觉的具体情境中将生物医学伦理原则与 RRI 治理工具相结合，开发出一个跨越技术开发、临床应用和监管监督的闭环治理矩阵。这为医疗 AI 从技术可行性迈向伦理可信性提供了一条可操作路径。

title: PhenoMe: An interactive AI framework for interpretable, microscopy-driven phenotyping
zh_title: PhenoMe：可解释的显微图像表型分析开源框架
summary: bioRxiv 预印本发布开源、模型无关框架 PhenoMe，将基础模型提取的显微图像嵌入与定量图像属性、实验元数据结合，支持可视化、降维聚类与相似性检索等交互分析。
key_points: 开源且模型无关，兼容多种预训练基础模型嵌入
整合嵌入可视化、降维、聚类与相似性检索工作流
同时纳入定量图像属性与实验元数据

reason: 新开源框架工具有基线意义，但无外部验证与对照，属值得一看档
abstract: Extracting meaningful biological patterns from microscopy image datasets requires tools that quantitatively connect visual similarities and experimental context. Deep learning models, and in particular novel foundation models, have the capacity to translate images into high-dimensional embeddings that can better represent complex visual patterns. Using these complex representations analytically and linking them to experimental information, it is possible to build advanced exploratory and phenotyping capabilities. Here, we present PhenoMe, an open-source, model-agnostic framework to handle pretrained foundation model-derived image representations alongside quantitative image properties and experimental metadata. PhenoMe integrates multiple scriptable and interactive workflows for embedding space visualisation, dimensionality reduction and clustering, similarity-based comparison and retrieval of representative images for each phenotype, among others. It also supports correlation analyses that link the embedding structure to interpretable image properties. We demonstrate PhenoMe's capabilities on seven public microscopy datasets, ranging from cell painting assays, nanoscale synaptic images, drug-response analyses and dynamic cell-phenotyping. These case studies show how readily available image representations can support data contextualisation, curation and analysis. Through guided notebooks, reproducible configurations, extensible model wrappers and a napari plugin, PhenoMe makes representation-based microscopy exploration accessible to researchers without dedicated technical expertise. PhenoMe lays the groundwork for applying foundation models and representation learning to microscopy data analysis.
zh_abstract: 从显微图像数据集中提取有意义的生物学模式，需要能够将视觉相似性与实验背景定量关联起来的工具。深度学习模型，尤其是新型基础模型（foundation models），能够将图像转换为高维嵌入（embeddings），从而更好地表征复杂的视觉模式。通过分析性地使用这些复杂表征并将其与实验信息关联，可以构建先进的探索性和表型分析能力。在此，我们提出 PhenoMe，一个开源、模型无关的框架，用于处理预训练基础模型衍生的图像表征，以及定量图像属性和实验元数据。PhenoMe 整合了多个可脚本化和交互式工作流，用于嵌入空间可视化、降维与聚类、基于相似性的比较以及为每种表型检索代表性图像等。它还支持将嵌入结构与可解释图像属性关联的相关性分析。我们在七个公开显微图像数据集上展示了 PhenoMe 的能力，涵盖细胞 painting  assays、纳米尺度突触图像、药物反应分析和动态细胞表型分析。这些案例研究表明， readily available 图像表征如何支持数据情境化、整理和分析。通过引导式笔记本、可复现配置、可扩展模型包装器和 napari 插件，PhenoMe 使不具备专门技术专长的研究人员也能开展基于表征的显微图像探索。PhenoMe 为将基础模型和表征学习应用于显微图像数据分析奠定了基础。

title: Benchmark of THReD: Evaluating an LLM Agent and Its Preprocessing Tools for Turning Electronic Health Records into AI-Ready Datasets
zh_title: THReD基准：评估EHR预处理LLM智能体
summary: 预印本发布THReD基准，用141项任务、超2550次运行评估LLM智能体将电子病历转为AI-ready数据集的可靠性。
key_points: 7类141项任务，含提示注入与失败恢复
Claude Haiku 5.5首答完成率92.7%
所有步骤需用户确认后才执行
reason: 针对临床数据预处理智能体的新基准，设计有新意但为预印本、单一模型评测
abstract: LLM agents are increasingly built into data-analysis software, yet little evidence shows how reliably they preprocess clinical data or whether the tools they invoke give correct, reproducible output. We report a benchmark of THReD, a web-based system that turns electronic health record (EHR) extracts into AI-ready datasets through a chat agent whose proposed steps run only after user confirmation. The agent benchmark has 141 tasks (100 templates) in seven categories, including goal-level requests, failure recovery, requests calling for no action, schema variation and prompt injection through the data, on synthetic tables calibrated to a regional health information exchange; success is judged by checks on the produced data. Over 2,550 episodes with Claude Haiku 5.5 in four context configurations, the deployed agent completed 92.7% (95% CI 88.1-96.4) of tasks on its first answer, abstained on every advice request, recovered from every injected fault, and never proposed an action requested by planted text. Without the data profile, completion fell to 58.0%; goal-level requests were hardest (80.6%). Six experiments on real records of two chronic-disease cohorts and on synthetic data at scale validate the tools: 91-92% of inferred patient classes and 99.7-99.8% of inferred vital-sign labels were correct in masked reconstruction; a dictionary builder combining curated dictionaries with LLM suggestions mapped 99.0% of 2,208 raw variants correctly; all 2,176 replays of 128 saved pipelines gave byte-identical files under pinned dependencies; subgroup differences in inference accuracy vanished within facility and lookup key; and the same-day consolidation rule changed 90-day emergency revisit rates by up to 3.2 points without shifting cohort composition by more than one point. Processing time grew roughly linearly to 5.5 million records while the prompt stayed at about 13 thousand tokens.
zh_abstract: LLM 智能体正越来越多地被内置到数据分析软件中，但很少有证据表明它们预处理临床数据的可靠性如何，或它们调用的工具是否给出正确、可复现的输出。我们报告了 THReD 的基准测试；THReD 是一个基于网络的系统，通过一个聊天智能体将电子健康记录（EHR）提取数据转换为可供 AI 使用的数据集，该智能体提出的步骤仅在用户确认后运行。该智能体基准测试包含七类共141项任务（100个模板），涵盖目标级请求、故障恢复、要求不采取行动的请求、模式变异以及通过数据进行的提示注入，测试基于校准至区域健康信息交换的合成表；成功与否由对生成数据的检查判定。在使用 Claude Haiku 5.5、四种上下文配置的超过2,550个回合中，已部署智能体在首次回答时完成了92.7%（95% CI 88.1-96.4）的任务，对每个建议请求均弃权，从每个注入故障中恢复，并且从未提出植入文本所请求的行动。在没有数据概况的情况下，完成率降至58.0%；目标级请求最难（80.6%）。在来自两个慢性病队列的真实记录以及规模化合成数据上进行的六项实验验证了这些工具：在掩码重建中，91-92%的推断患者类别和99.7-99.8%的推断生命体征标签是正确的；一个将精选词典与 LLM 建议相结合的词典构建器正确映射了2,208个原始变异中的99.0%；在固定依赖下，128个已保存流程的全部2,176次重放均产生字节完全相同的文件；推断准确性的亚组差异在机构与查找键内消失；同日合并规则使90天急诊复诊率变化最多达3.2个百分点，而未使队列构成变化超过1个百分点。处理时间随记录数增至550万条大致呈线性增长，而提示词保持在约1.3万个 token。

summary: medRxiv 预印本在 COPE in PACE 研究的去标识照护者—临床医生对话转写中比较四种机器学习与 LLM 方法的负担检测效果。

abstract: Dementia caregivers' elevated burden is associated with earlier patient institutionalization and greater caregiver morbidity, yet no standardized, objective method exists for detecting burden during routine clinical encounters. We compared four machine learning and AI approaches for detecting caregiver burden in de-identified caregiver-clinician transcripts from the COPE in PACE study using Zarit burden scores. A naive baseline predicting burden in every transcript achieved precision/F1 = 0.40/0.57. LLM prompting achieved precision/F1 = 0.43/0.60. Weak supervision achieved precision/F1 = 0.48/0.58. The fully supervised model, trained on sentence-level labels with only 1.1% burden-positive sentences, achieved precision/F1=0.19/0.25; this result is not directly comparable because of different labels and units of analysis. LLM prompting modestly outperformed weak supervision and naive baseline without fine-tuning, while class imbalance limited fully supervised sentence-level classification. Larger annotated corpora and refined labeling strategies are needed for clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: 痴呆照护者的负担升高与患者更早被机构化安置以及照护者发病率更高相关，然而在常规临床接触中尚无标准化、客观的方法来检测负担。我们使用Zarit负担评分，在COPE in PACE研究中去标识化的照护者-临床医生转录文本中，比较了四种机器学习和AI方法检测照护者负担。一个对每份转录文本都预测存在负担的朴素基线达到精确率/F1 = 0.40/0.57。LLM提示达到精确率/F1 = 0.43/0.60。弱监督达到精确率/F1 = 0.48/0.58。全监督模型在句子级标签上训练，其中仅1.1%的句子为负担阳性，达到精确率/F1=0.19/0.25；由于标签和分析单位不同，该结果不能直接比较。LLM提示无需微调即小幅优于弱监督和朴素基线，而类别不平衡限制了全监督句子级分类。临床部署需要更大的标注语料库和更精细的标注策略。

title: Identification of local nonlinear shear-wave dynamics using Volterra kernels: application to prostate cancer detection.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging

summary: 提出用Volterra核识别局部非线性剪切波动力学，经仿真与体模验证，并用于前列腺癌在体检测。

abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Cancer remains a major health concern worldwide. Shear-wave elastography (SWE) holds promise for cancer detection by quantifying linear elastic changes in tissue through shear-wave (SW) velocity estimation. However, shear viscosity and nonlinearity are often over-looked, despite their potential as additional biomarkers. This study evaluates the visco-hyperelastic properties of soft tissue, including linear shear modulus, shear viscosity, and shear nonlinearity. We propose using Volterra kernels to characterize local nonlinear SW dynamics, with kernel identification based on SW particle velocity measurements at adjacent locations. The method was validated using in-silico simulations and in-vitro gelatin phantoms. To evaluate its clinical relevance, we applied the method for prostate cancer (PCa) detection. To our knowledge, this is the first in-vivo assessment of voxel-based visco-hyperelastic properties of the prostate. In 90 patients, our results indicated that the linear kernel correlated with the linear shear modulus, while the quadratic kernel reflected both viscosity and nonlinearity. A convolutional neural network trained on these parameters with registered histopathology as ground truth achieved area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) values of 0.60 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.57, 0.62) and 0.66 (95% CI: 0.64, 0.68) for PCa detection, respectively-both significantly outperforming the linear shear modulus (AUC of 0.54; 95% CI, 0.52 to 0.56). Our findings suggest that Volterra kernels reflect information related to the visco-hyperelastic properties of prostate tissue, highlighting the potential of viscosity and nonlinearity as additional biomarkers for PCa detection.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 癌症仍然是全球主要的健康问题。剪切波弹性成像（SWE）通过剪切波（SW）速度估计量化组织的线性弹性变化，有望用于癌症检测。然而，剪切黏性和非线性常被忽视，尽管它们有潜力作为附加生物标志物。本研究评估软组织的黏-超弹性特性，包括线性剪切模量、剪切黏性和剪切非线性。我们提出使用 Volterra 核表征局部非线性 SW 动力学，核识别基于相邻位置的 SW 粒子速度测量。该方法通过计算机模拟和体外明胶体模验证。为评估其临床相关性，我们将该方法用于前列腺癌（PCa）检测。据我们所知，这是首次对前列腺基于体素的黏-超弹性特性进行体内评估。在 90 例患者中，我们的结果表明线性核与线性剪切模量相关，而二次核反映黏性和非线性。以配准组织病理学为金标准，在这些参数上训练的卷积神经网络用于 PCa 检测的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）分别为 0.60（95% 置信区间 [CI]：0.57，0.62）和 0.66（95% CI：0.64，0.68），均显著优于线性剪切模量（AUC 为 0.54；95% CI，0.52 至 0.56）。我们的发现提示，Volterra 核反映与前列腺组织黏-超弹性特性相关的信息，突显黏性和非线性作为 PCa 检测附加生物标志物的潜力。

abstract: [The Journal of investigative dermatology] Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly being developed for dermatology, but the conditions under which patients trust these tools remain poorly characterized. This Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses-guided systematic narrative review synthesizes peer-reviewed empirical studies, published from January 1, 2015 through July 7, 2026, that directly assessed patient or public attitudes toward AI in dermatologic diagnosis, skin-cancer screening, image sharing, teledermatology image-quality support, and related patient-facing workflows. Eligible evidence included qualitative interviews and focus groups, surveys, preference/conjoint or vignette experiments, and early clinical deployments. Twenty studies met the inclusion criteria using the review framework. Across study designs, patients expressed conditional support for dermatology AI but consistently favored dermatologist-supervised AI over autonomous AI, especially for high-stakes diagnostic decisions. Trust was strengthened by visible clinician accountability, clear explanations of AI outputs and uncertainty, privacy safeguards, transparent data use, and evidence that performance is reliable across skin tone and diagnosis. Trust declined when AI was framed as replacing clinicians, when image governance was unclear, or when unequal performance was perceived. These findings support a model of augmented intelligence: dermatology AI should serve the clinical relationship; be subject to human oversight; and be evaluated and reported stratified by skin tone, diagnosis, and care context.
zh_abstract: [The Journal of investigative dermatology] 人工智能（AI）系统越来越多地用于皮肤病学，但患者信任这些工具的条件仍不清楚。这项由系统评价和荟萃分析首选报告项目（PRISMA）指导的系统性叙述综述，综合了 2015 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 7 月 7 日发表的同行评审实证研究，这些研究直接评估患者或公众对 AI 用于皮肤病学诊断、皮肤癌筛查、图像共享、远程皮肤病学图像质量支持及相关面向患者工作流程的态度。符合条件证据包括定性访谈和焦点小组、调查、偏好/联合或情景实验，以及早期临床部署。使用该综述框架，20 项研究符合纳入标准。跨研究设计，患者对皮肤病学 AI 表达有条件支持，但始终更青睐由皮肤科医生监督的 AI，而非自主 AI，尤其在高风险诊断决策中。临床医生可见的问责、对 AI 输出和不确定性的清晰解释、隐私保障、透明的数据使用，以及性能在不同肤色和诊断中可靠的证据，增强了信任。当 AI 被表述为取代临床医生、图像治理不明确，或感知到性能不平等时，信任下降。这些发现支持增强智能模型：皮肤病学 AI 应服务于临床关系；应接受人类监督；并应按肤色、诊断和照护背景进行分层评估和报告。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Beijing Tsinghua Chang Gung Hospital; conditions: Biliary Tract Cancer (BTC); type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 10000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Biliary tract cancer is a group of malignant tumors involving the intrahepatic bile ducts, extrahepatic bile ducts, and gallbladder. This prospective study aims to clinically validate an artificial intelligence (AI) system for screening and detecting biliary tract cancer on NCCT images. The AI system will independently analyze eligible NCCT examinations and generate a patient-level risk score for biliary tract cancer. abstract: Interstitial lung disease (ILD) is a potentially fatal toxicity of immune checkpoint inhibitors and antibody-drug conjugates. Drug-safety studies in healthcare databases identify ILD with claims-based algorithms that trade positive predictive value (PPV) against sensitivity. We assessed whether large language models (LLMs) improve on these algorithms, with and without electronic health record (EHR) notes, and whether these gains translate into measurable epidemiological benefits. In 309 oncology patients with ILD diagnosis codes at Mass General Brigham, adjudicated by two pulmonologists, we compared 12 open-access LLMs with 20 published claims-based algorithms. LLMs received claims, EHR notes, or both, without task-specific training. Measures were PPV and yield (proportion classified positive). We projected the attenuation of a drug-induced ILD odds ratio under non-differential outcome misclassification. LLMs extended the PPV-yield frontier of the published algorithms with all three inputs. Across the 36 model--input evaluations, LLM PPV exceeded that of the best algorithm without specialist-coding requirements (Algorithm 4) by 14.3 percentage points on average. With claims alone, Qwen3-8B achieved 89.8% PPV (95% CI 78.2-95.6) at 15.9% yield, versus 86.7% at 4.9% for the highest-PPV algorithm. With notes alone, Qwen3-32B achieved 78.9% PPV at 49.2% yield, versus 64.6% at 51.1% for Algorithm~4. With combined claims and notes, Qwen3-14B achieved 100.0% PPV at 24.3% yield. Under a simulated drug-safety scenario with a true odds ratio of 3.0, the projected observed odds ratio was 2.67 with combined inputs versus 1.07 with Algorithm 4, corresponding to a 46-fold difference in the estimated sample size required for 80% power (591 versus 27,200 patients). Zero-shot LLMs offer a higher-PPV alternative to rule-based claims phenotyping for ILD, on all three input types. Because the claims-only configuration uses the same claims data as existing algorithms, it could be deployed in administrative databases without linked notes, and may recover drug-safety signal otherwise lost to outcome misclassification.
zh_abstract: 间质性肺病（ILD）是免疫检查点抑制剂和抗体-药物偶联物的一种潜在致死性毒性。医疗保健数据库中的药物安全性研究使用基于理赔数据的算法识别 ILD，这些算法在阳性预测值（PPV）与敏感性之间权衡。我们评估了大语言模型（LLM）在有无电子健康记录（EHR）笔记的情况下是否优于这些算法，以及这些增益是否能转化为可测量的流行病学获益。在 Mass General Brigham 的 309 例带有 ILD 诊断代码的肿瘤患者中（由两名呼吸科医生裁定），我们将 12 个开放获取 LLM 与 20 个已发表的基于理赔数据的算法进行比较。LLM 接收理赔数据、EHR 笔记或两者，且未进行任务特定训练。测量指标为 PPV 和产出率（被分类为阳性的比例）。我们预测了在非差异性结局错分下药物诱导 ILD 比值比的衰减。在全部三种输入下，LLM 扩展了已发表算法的 PPV-产出率前沿。在 36 项模型-输入评估中，LLM 的 PPV 平均比无需专科编码要求的最佳算法（算法 4）高 14.3 个百分点。仅使用理赔数据时，Qwen3-8B 在 15.9% 产出率下达到 89.8% PPV（95% CI 78.2-95.6），而最高 PPV 算法在 4.9% 产出率下为 86.7%。仅使用笔记时，Qwen3-32B 在 49.2% 产出率下达到 78.9% PPV，而算法 4 在 51.1% 产出率下为 64.6%。联合使用理赔数据和笔记时，Qwen3-14B 在 24.3% 产出率下达到 100.0% PPV。在真实比值比为 3.0 的模拟药物安全情景中，联合输入的预测观察比值比为 2.67，而算法 4 为 1.07，对应于达到 80% 把握度所需估计样本量的 46 倍差异（591 例对 27,200 例患者）。零样本 LLM 在所有三种输入类型上为 ILD 提供了比基于规则的理赔表型分析更高 PPV 的替代方案。由于仅理赔数据配置使用与现有算法相同的理赔数据，它可部署于无关联笔记的行政数据库，并可能恢复否则会因结局错分而丢失的药物安全信号。

title: Conversational Interaction for LLM-Based Clinical Text-to-SQL: A User Study with Healthcare Professionals
zh_title: 面向临床Text-to-SQL的对话式交互：医护人员用户研究
summary: 预印本：14名医生在MIMIC-IV上对比单轮与多轮对话式Text-to-SQL界面，可用性评分显著提升。
key_points: 14名常接触EHR数据的医生参与，被试内设计
另分析21名医护人员交互日志
reason: 真实临床用户可用性研究有信息量，但样本小、无临床结局
abstract: Conversational text-to-SQL interfaces could give healthcare professionals natural-language access to electronic health record (EHR) data, but evidence for their real-world usability remains limited: prior evaluations have relied largely on curated benchmarks with fully specified questions or on simulated users. We report a user study in which 14 physicians who regularly work with EHR data used both a single-turn and a conversational multi-turn text-to-SQL interface over the MIMIC-IV database in a within-subjects design; dialogue analyses additionally drew on interaction logs from 21 healthcare professionals across the main study and two pilot studies. The conversational interface was consistently favored: mean System Usability Scale scores rose from 68.2, near the industry average, to 85.9 (p<0.001), with significant advantages across technology-acceptance constructs including performance expectancy, effort expectancy, self-efficacy, and behavioral intention. In post-study forced-choice comparisons, 93% of participants reported greater overall satisfaction with the conversational interface, 86% preferred it for real-world adoption, and 71% trusted its results more; no participant preferred or trusted the single-turn interface more. Turn-level analysis of 425 logged user turns showed that freely composed queries triggered clarification requests in 24.8% of cases versus 1.8% for predefined, fully specified questions, and 64.3% of clarification episodes stemmed from EHR- or clinical-domain knowledge. Conversational interaction is a practical prerequisite, rather than a convenience, for natural-language EHR access. The frequent need for clarification in realistic clinical queries further underscores the importance of conversational interfaces, while benchmark-style evaluation can substantially underrepresent the ambiguity of real clinical use.
zh_abstract: 对话式文本到SQL（text-to-SQL）接口可以让医疗专业人员以自然语言访问电子健康记录（EHR）数据，但有关其在真实世界中可用性的证据仍然有限：既往评估主要依赖问题完全明确的精选基准测试，或依赖模拟用户。我们报告了一项用户研究：14名经常处理EHR数据的医生在受试者内设计（within-subjects design）中，同时使用了基于MIMIC-IV数据库的单轮和对话式多轮text-to-SQL接口；对话分析还纳入了来自主要研究和两项试点研究的21名医疗专业人员的交互日志。对话式接口始终更受青睐：系统可用性量表（System Usability Scale）平均得分从接近行业平均水平的68.2升至85.9（p<0.001），并在绩效期望、努力期望、自我效能和行为意向等技术接受度构念上均具有显著优势。在研究后的强制选择比较中，93%的参与者报告对对话式接口的整体满意度更高，86%的参与者更倾向于在真实世界应用中采用该接口，71%的参与者更信任其结果；没有任何参与者更偏好或更信任单轮接口。对425条记录的用户轮次进行的轮次级分析显示，自由编写的查询在24.8%的情况下触发了澄清请求，而预先定义的、问题完全明确的查询仅为1.8%，且64.3%的澄清事件源于EHR或临床领域知识。对话式交互是实现自然语言EHR访问的实际前提，而非一种便利。真实临床查询中频繁需要澄清进一步凸显了对话式接口的重要性，而基准测试式评估可能大幅低估真实临床使用中的歧义性。

abstract: There is an urgent global need for affordable, large-scale health screening to enhance preventive care in the ageing population. Using low-cost, non-invasive retinal photographs and leveraging large foundation models, we developed a deep learning-based biomarker, Retinal Mortality Equivalent (RetiME), that directly mapped retinal features to individual mortality risk. Trained on a European cohort and externally validated across three independent external cohorts spanning Southeast Asia, Eurasia and North America, RetiME showed robust associations with all-cause and cause-specific mortality and predicted the incidence of a wide range of systemic and ocular diseases. Crucially, beyond static risk estimation, RetiME re-timed mortality risk by reconstructing personalized lifespan trajectories that were associated with observed mortality outcomes (for example, age of death). Clustering of these trajectories revealed distinct mortality patterns, spanning cancer-predominant, cardiometabolic and neurodegenerative risks, reflecting diverse ageing pathways captured by RetiME. Interpretability analyses showed that RetiME captures diverse biological and retinal features underlying mortality risk. Genome-wide analyses further identified genetic loci associated with RetiME. Collectively, these findings support further evaluation of retinal imaging and trajectory modelling as one component of a comprehensive assessment of mortality risk.
zh_abstract: 全球迫切需要可负担的大规模健康筛查，以加强老龄人群的预防性照护。利用低成本、非侵入性的视网膜照片，并借助大型基础模型，我们开发了一种基于深度学习的生物标志物——视网膜死亡等效物（Retinal Mortality Equivalent, RetiME），其将视网膜特征直接映射至个体死亡风险。RetiME 在欧洲队列中训练，并在覆盖东南亚、欧亚和北美的三个独立外部队列中进行外部验证，显示出与全因死亡和特定原因死亡的稳健关联，并可预测多种系统性疾病和眼部疾病的发生率。关键在于，除静态风险估计之外，RetiME 还通过重建与观察到的死亡结局（例如死亡年龄）相关的个性化寿命轨迹，对死亡风险进行了重新定时。对这些轨迹进行聚类揭示了不同的死亡模式，涵盖以癌症为主、心脏代谢和神经退行性风险，反映了 RetiME 所捕捉到的多样化衰老通路。可解释性分析显示，RetiME 捕捉到了死亡风险背后的多样化生物学和视网膜特征。全基因组分析进一步识别出与 RetiME 相关的遗传位点。总体而言，这些发现支持进一步评估将视网膜成像和轨迹建模作为死亡风险综合评估的一个组成部分。

key_points: LLM 智能体帮助患者梳理病情、生成问题清单
802 名成人、866 段对话，随机分为两版本与对照
由盲法临床医生评估，智能体优于对照
reason: 前瞻性随机设计+盲法临床医生评估、样本 802，但为预印本未同行评审
abstract: Patients often arrive at brief, time-constrained clinical visits unsure of what to expect or ask, and millions of adults now turn to general-purpose AI chatbots to prepare beforehand. Yet whether conversational AI improves visit readiness remains unclear. We designed a large language model (LLM)-based visit preparation agent to guide patients before an appointment by gathering clinical context, setting visit expectations, providing relevant health information, building a prioritized list of questions for their clinician, and generating a summary. In a prospective consented randomized study in the Google Health app, 802 U.S. adults held 866 health-related conversations with the visit preparation agent (standard or concise variant) or a minimally prompted control chatbot built on the same LLM. The visit preparation agent significantly outperformed the control across blinded clinician evaluations and patient self-reports. In clinician reviews of completed sessions (n = 272), the agent achieved a 16.6% higher rate of comprehensive preparation (67.2% vs. 50.6%; P < 0.05) and an 8.5% higher rate of alignment with patients' health context (98.9% vs. 90.4%; P < 0.01), while maintaining high medical safety and appropriateness across all study arms. Patient post-surveys (n = 460) showed 16.8% higher visit preparedness (73.8% vs. 57.0%; P < 0.01), 14.3% higher confidence in knowing what to ask (81.4% vs. 67.1%; P < 0.01), and 12.0% higher overall satisfaction (74.0% vs. 62.0%; P < 0.05). Clinician and participant metrics were not significantly correlated, indicating that expert review and patient self-assessment capture complementary dimensions of patient-facing AI. These findings suggest that LLM chatbots can safely help patients prepare for clinical visits, with greater benefit when following a structured workflow, and motivate future studies on in-visit communication and clinical outcomes.
zh_abstract: 患者常常在短暂、时间受限的临床就诊中到来，却不确定会有什么预期或该问什么；如今数百万成年人转向通用人工智能聊天机器人以提前准备。然而，对话式 AI 是否能改善就诊准备度仍不清楚。我们设计了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的就诊准备智能体，通过在预约前收集临床背景、设定就诊预期、提供相关健康信息、构建按优先级排列的向临床医生提问的问题清单，并生成摘要，来指导患者。在 Google Health 应用中进行的一项前瞻性、知情同意的随机研究中，802 名美国成年人使用就诊准备智能体（标准版或简版）或基于同一 LLM 构建的最低限度提示对照聊天机器人进行了 866 次健康相关对话。在盲法临床医生评估和患者自我报告中，就诊准备智能体均显著优于对照。在临床医生对已完成会话的审查中（n = 272），该智能体的全面准备率高出 16.6%（67.2% 对 50.6%；P < 0.05），与患者健康背景的一致性率高出 8.5%（98.9% 对 90.4%；P < 0.01），同时在所有研究组中维持了较高的医疗安全性和适当性。患者后测调查（n = 460）显示，就诊准备度高出 16.8%（73.8% 对 57.0%；P < 0.01），对知道该问什么的信心高出 14.3%（81.4% 对 67.1%；P < 0.01），总体满意度高出 12.0%（74.0% 对 62.0%；P < 0.05）。临床医生指标与参与者指标无显著相关性，表明专家审查和患者自我评估捕捉了面向患者的人工智能的互补维度。这些发现表明，LLM 聊天机器人可以安全地帮助患者为临床就诊做准备，遵循结构化工作流程时获益更大，并推动未来关于就诊中沟通和临床结局的研究。

title: Clinical AI in 2025–2026 — Six Themes from the SAIL Year in Review
zh_title: NEJM AI：2025–2026 临床 AI 六大主题年度回顾

abstract: AbstractIn the past year, the medical field's relationship to clinical AI has progressed from rapid and often speculative adoption toward evaluation of its impact on patient outcomes, clinical workflows, and society. Drawing from the Symposium on AI for Learning Health Systems (SAIL) Year in Review (May 2026), this Perspective examines six key areas that dominated the domain of clinical AI in the past year: clinical AI evaluation, workflow integration, direct-to-consumer applications, regulation and societal impacts, AI in medical education, and foundational advancements in technology. AI's successes across these areas have been uneven, reflecting its jagged frontier. We highlight milestones that illustrate what AI has already achieved in health care, its potential, and major challenges that remain ahead. (Funded by the Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development of the National Institutes of Health [grant number T32HD040128].).
zh_abstract: 摘要：在过去一年中，医学领域与临床AI的关系已从快速且往往带有推测性的采用，转向评估其对患者结局、临床工作流程和社会的影响。本文借鉴学习型健康系统人工智能研讨会（Symposium on AI for Learning Health Systems，SAIL）年度回顾（2026年5月），考察过去一年主导临床AI领域的六个关键方面：临床AI评估、工作流程整合、直接面向消费者的应用、监管与社会影响、医学教育中的AI，以及技术的基础性进展。AI在这些领域取得的成功并不均衡，反映出其“参差不齐的前沿”。我们重点介绍一些里程碑，以说明AI在医疗保健中已经取得的成就、其潜力以及未来仍面临的主要挑战。（由美国国立卫生研究院下属的尤妮斯·肯尼迪·施莱弗国家儿童健康与人类发展研究所资助[资助编号 T32HD040128]。）

title: PharmaAgent: a real-world evaluation of high- and low-autonomy agentic systems for inpatient vancomycin dosing
zh_title: PharmaAgent：住院万古霉素给药智能体的真实世界评估
summary: 在斯坦福医院静默部署LLM万古霉素给药智能体两个月，比较高自主与低自主配置的给药准确性与安全性。
key_points: 316例患者403次给药事件，与药师医嘱对比
高自主组误差21.8%，低自主组37.8%
196条超容差建议中65.8%被药师认定存在安全隐患
reason: 真实医院前瞻性静默部署、样本可观并含安全性人工复核，但为预印本且未报临床结局
abstract: Vancomycin has a narrow therapeutic window requiring individualized dosing and repeated monitoring, a process health systems delegate from physicians to pharmacists for consistency. We silently deployed PharmaAgent, LLM-based vancomycin dosing agentic systems, at Stanford Hospital for two months and compared high- and low-autonomy configurations, each with and without institutional guidelines. Across 403 dosing events in 316 patients, mean absolute percentage error against the treating pharmacist's order was 21.8% with high autonomy versus 37.8% with low autonomy, and recommendations were within 25% of the order in 73.4% versus 50.9% of events (P < 0.001); a second pharmacist was within 25% in 90.2%. Pharmacist review of 196 out-of-tolerance recommendations found a safety concern in 65.8%, more often with low autonomy (odds ratio 2.37). A higher-autonomy agent that self-debugged its intermediate steps proved more robust than stricter engineering, but neither configuration is ready to dose patients without pharmacist oversight.
zh_abstract: 万古霉素治疗窗窄，需要个体化给药和反复监测，这一流程由卫生系统从医师委托给药师以保证一致性。我们在斯坦福医院静默部署了基于LLM的万古霉素给药智能体系统PharmaAgent，为期两个月，并比较了高自主性与低自主性配置，每种配置分别在有和没有机构指南的情况下运行。在316名患者的403次给药事件中，与治疗药师医嘱相比的平均绝对百分比误差在高自主性下为21.8%，低自主性下为37.8%；推荐意见与医嘱相差在25%以内的事件分别占73.4%和50.9%（P < 0.001）；第二位药师的相差在25%以内比例为90.2%。药师对196条超出容差范围的推荐意见进行审查，发现65.8%存在安全性顾虑，低自主性下更常见（比值比2.37）。一个会自我调试其中间步骤的更高自主性智能体被证明比更严格的工程化设计更稳健，但两种配置均未准备好在没有药师监督的情况下为患者给药。

abstract: [Neurosurgical focus] The 2021 WHO CNS tumor classification marked a fundamental shift in neuro-oncology: molecular markers rather than histological appearance now define glioma diagnosis and guide treatment. Yet, in clinical practice the molecular information that matters most to a surgeon-IDH status, 1p/19q codeletion, and methylation class-typically arrives days to weeks after the operation it was meant to inform. Artificial intelligence (AI) is beginning to close that gap. Over the past several years, a growing body of work has demonstrated that AI models can extract diagnostically relevant molecular and histological information from data sources available in the operating room, in real time, at the point of surgical decision-making. In this review, the authors provide a comprehensive overview of state-of-the-art intraoperative AI models available to neurosurgeons during brain tumor resections. They examine AI-augmented approaches to established intraoperative techniques, such as cryosection and fluorescence-guided surgery, before turning to novel technologies including nanopore sequencing and stimulated Raman histology (SRH). The authors conclude by discussing barriers to widespread clinical adoption and what lies ahead for this field. For cryosection, models such as LGNet and the Cryosection Histopathology Assessment and Review Machine (CHARM) have demonstrated strong performance on intraoperative discrimination of primary CNS lymphoma and molecular subtyping of glioma, respectively, with CHARM achieving areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.88-0.93 across glioma subtypes. In fluorescence-guided surgery, hyperspectral imaging combined with machine learning has enabled classification of tumor type, grade, and IDH mutation based on the 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA) signal with up to 93% accuracy, extracting molecular information from a modality already present in the operating room. For nanopore-based methylation classification, ensemble models such as Rapid Nanopore Brain Intraoperative Classification (ROBIN) have achieved 90% concordance with the final diagnosis prospectively in under 2 hours. In SRH, foundation models for infiltration detection now outperform FLAIR, contrast enhancement, and 5-ALA fluorescence in identifying tumor margins, while molecular classification models have achieved over 90% glioma subtype accuracy in multi-institutional cohorts. zh_abstract: [Neurosurgical focus] 2021年世界卫生组织（WHO）中枢神经系统（CNS）肿瘤分类标志着神经肿瘤学的根本性转变：现在由分子标志物而非组织学表现来定义胶质瘤诊断并指导治疗。然而，在临床实践中，对外科医生最重要的分子信息——IDH状态、1p/19q共缺失和甲基化类别——通常在其本应指导的手术之后数天至数周才到达。人工智能（AI）正开始缩小这一差距。在过去几年中，越来越多的研究表明，AI模型可以从手术室中可用的数据源中，实时、在手术决策点提取具有诊断相关性的分子和组织学信息。在这篇综述中，作者全面概述了脑肿瘤切除术中神经外科医生可用的最先进术中AI模型。他们审视了对已建立的术中技术（如冷冻切片和荧光引导手术）的AI增强方法，随后转向包括纳米孔测序和受激拉曼组织学（SRH）在内的新技术。作者最后讨论了广泛临床应用的障碍以及该领域的前景。对于冷冻切片，LGNet和冷冻切片组织病理学评估与审查机器（Cryosection Histopathology Assessment and Review Machine，CHARM）等模型已分别在术中鉴别原发性CNS淋巴瘤和胶质瘤分子分型方面表现出强大性能，其中CHARM在胶质瘤各亚型中达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积0.88-0.93。在荧光引导手术中，高光谱成像联合机器学习已能够基于5-氨基乙酰丙酸（5-ALA）信号对肿瘤类型、分级和IDH突变进行分类，准确率高达93%，从而从手术室中已有的一种模态中提取分子信息。对于基于纳米孔的甲基化分类，快速纳米孔脑术中分类（Rapid Nanopore Brain Intraoperative Classification，ROBIN）等集成模型已在2小时内前瞻性地与最终诊断达到90%的一致性。在SRH中，用于浸润检测的基础模型在识别肿瘤边界方面现已优于FLAIR、对比增强和5-ALA荧光，而分子分类模型在多机构队列中已实现超过90%的胶质瘤亚型准确率。在单细胞水平，SRH图像的形态计量学分析已揭示核特征 di

title: Algorithmic design choices as determinants of health equity: a causal simulation study of healthcare resource allocation
zh_title: 算法设计选择如何影响医疗资源分配公平性
summary: 基于 All of Us 约 20 万成年人电子病历与调查数据的模拟研究，评估三种算法设计选择对资源分配公平性的影响。
key_points: 分析队列含 201,216 名成年人
比较逻辑回归、随机森林与 XGBoost

reason: 大样本模拟研究聚焦公平性设计，但为预印本且无外部验证
abstract: Background. Care management programs increasingly rely on prediction algorithms to decide which patients receive limited healthcare resources. Because these algorithms are typically trained to predict future healthcare utilization or cost, they may systematically underidentify patients whose care-seeking behavior is suppressed by structural barriers. Objective. To evaluate how three modifiable design choices (selection threshold, feature set, and training objective) affect allocation equity in care management targeting. Methods. We constructed an analytical cohort of 201,216 adults from linked electronic health record and participant survey data in the NIH All of Us Research Program (2017-2019). Three prediction models (logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost) were trained and evaluated under simulation conditions that varied one design choice at a time while holding the others fixed. Equity was assessed using false negative rate (FNR), equal opportunity difference (EOD), and allocation rate conditional on need (an access-independent benchmark based on self-reported general health status). We also applied Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition to identify which predictors contributed most to the Black-White allocation gap. Results. Prior utilization understated self-reported health burden among disadvantaged groups: 33% of Black and 32% of Hispanic participants reported fair or poor health, yet only 22% and 19% were classified as high utilizers. White participants showed the opposite pattern: 25% were classified as high utilizers, while only 19% reported fair or poor general health status. Under baseline design choices, all three models produced similar disparities, with uninsured participants showing the largest gap (EOD: -0.148). Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition identified prior outpatient visits as the dominant contributor to the Black-White gap in predicted allocation, with higher average emergency department utilization among Black participants partially offsetting the effect. Varying the selection threshold had little effect; disparities persisted across all thresholds. Feature set variation produced mixed and group-specific effects; removal of prior outpatient visits achieved near-zero Black-White EOD (0.001, AUC: 0.77), consistent with the Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition finding. Training objective variation produced the most substantial and consistent equity effects, with the health status objective achieving near-zero Black-White EOD (0.008, AUC: 0.69) an
zh_abstract: 【背景】照护管理项目越来越多地依赖预测算法来决定哪些患者获得有限的医疗资源。由于这些算法通常被训练用于预测未来的医疗利用或费用，它们可能系统性地识别不足那些因结构性障碍而照护寻求行为受到抑制的患者。【目的】评估三种可修改的设计选择（选择阈值、特征集和训练目标）如何影响照护管理目标定位中的分配公平性。【方法】我们利用美国国立卫生研究院All of Us研究计划（NIH All of Us Research Program，2017—2019）中关联的电子健康记录与参与者调查数据，构建了包含201,216名成年人的分析队列。在每次改变一个设计选择而保持其他选择固定的模拟条件下，训练并评估了三种预测模型（逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost）。公平性采用假阴性率（false negative rate, FNR）、机会均等差（equal opportunity difference, EOD）和以需求为条件的分配率（一种基于自报总体健康状况、与可及性无关的基准）进行评估。我们还应用Oaxaca-Blinder分解来识别哪些预测因素对黑人—白人分配差距贡献最大。【结果】既往利用情况低估了弱势群体自报的健康负担：33%的黑人参与者和32%的西班牙裔参与者报告健康状况一般或差，但仅有22%和19%被归类为高利用者。白人参与者表现出相反模式：25%被归类为高利用者，而仅有19%报告总体健康状况一般或差。在基线设计选择下，三种模型产生相似差异，无保险参与者差距最大（EOD：-0.148）。Oaxaca-Blinder分解识别出既往门诊就诊是预测分配中黑人—白人差距的主要贡献因素，黑人参与者平均急诊科利用更高部分抵消了该效应。改变选择阈值影响很小；差异在所有阈值下均持续存在。特征集变化产生混合且因群体而异的影响；移除既往门诊就诊实现了接近零的黑人—白人EOD（0.001，AUC：0.77），与Oaxaca-Blinder分解发现一致。训练目标变化产生了最显著且一致的公平性效应，其中健康状态目标实现接近零的黑人—白人EOD（0.008，AUC：0.69）an

abstract: [Journal of environmental pathology, toxicology and oncology : official organ of the International Society for Environmental Toxicology and Cancer] Non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) represents the majority of lung cancer cases and remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Early detection, accurate staging, and individualized therapy are crucial for improving patient survival. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have transformed NSCLC care through the automated analysis of imaging, pathology, and molecular datasets. Deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) models, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have demonstrated high accuracy in tumor detection, histologic classification, biomarker prediction (PD-L1, EGFR, KRAS) and prognosis assessment. Integration of the AI with whole slide imaging (WSI), computed tomography (CT), PET/CT and liquid biopsies enables non-invasive tumor characterization, early recurrence detection and prediction of treatment response. Multimodal AI approaches that combine imaging, genomic, and clinical data offer superior patient stratification and personalized treatment planning compared with traditional methods. Beyond diagnosis, AI facilitates therapeutic development through radiomics based nodule classification, multi-omics data interpretation, and drug discovery. Radiomics, in particular, extracts quantitative imaging biomarkers that capture tumor heterogeneity beyond human perception. The AI further supports clinical decision-making in surgery, radiotherapy, and systemic therapy, enhancing workflow efficiency. Despite challenges in data quality, interpretability, and clinical adoption, AI holds significant promise for advancing precision oncology and improving outcomes in NSCLC management.
zh_abstract: [Journal of environmental pathology, toxicology and oncology : official organ of the International Society for Environmental Toxicology and Cancer] 非小细胞肺癌（non-small-cell lung cancer, NSCLC）占肺癌病例的大多数，并且仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因。早期发现、准确分期和个体化治疗对于提高患者生存率至关重要。人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）的最新进展通过自动分析影像、病理和分子数据集，改变了NSCLC的诊疗。深度学习（deep learning, DL）和机器学习（machine learning, ML）模型，尤其是卷积神经网络（convolutional neural networks, CNNs），在肿瘤检测、组织学分类、生物标志物预测（PD-L1、EGFR、KRAS）和预后评估方面表现出高准确度。AI与全切片成像（whole slide imaging, WSI）、计算机断层扫描（computed tomography, CT）、PET/CT和液体活检的整合，能够实现无创肿瘤表征、早期复发检测和治疗反应预测。结合影像、基因组和临床数据的多模态AI方法，与传统方法相比，可提供更优的患者分层和个体化治疗规划。除诊断外，AI通过基于影像组学的结节分类、多组学数据解释和药物发现促进治疗开发。尤其是影像组学，可提取超越人类感知的定量影像生物标志物，以捕捉肿瘤异质性。AI进一步支持外科、放疗和全身治疗的临床决策，提高工作流程效率。尽管在数据质量、可解释性和临床采用方面存在挑战，AI在推进精准肿瘤学和改善NSCLC管理结局方面具有重大前景。

title: Decision-only medical AI: early evidence and pairing with language models
zh_title: 仅输出决策的医疗AI：早期证据及与大模型配对
summary: 预印本测试两种决策式模型与一个大语言模型在2134个病例上的稳定性，配对后标签与压力诱因引起的决策改变降低约42%–81%。
key_points: 2134例病例、248万次模型调用，测量决策改变
加入标签/压力线索使决策改变较中性措辞多13–14/100

reason: 预印本新方法+大规模调用与留出评估，但无临床结局与外部临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Recently introduced decision-only AI returns probabilities over specified options rather than text. We tested the clinical consistency and potential bias susceptibility of the two available decision models, Jev and OpenAI Decisions, against a large language model (LLM), GPT-6 Luna, then paired each decision model with the LLM. Across 2,134 case presentations and 2,483,222 model calls, we measured decision changes after adding labels or pressure cues without changing clinical findings. In the original controlled challenges, these additions changed 13.4 more decisions per 100 than neutral wording for the decision models and 14.0 for the LLM. Pairing reduced this to 2.6, about 81% lower in development and 42% to 48% lower in held-out reports. Triage accuracy stayed near 81% to 82%. The paired Decisions workflow cost at most US$0.77 per 1,000 entries. We see this as a practical proof of concept for reducing framing sensitivity and flagging influential text for review.
zh_abstract: 近期引入的仅做决策的 AI 返回的是指定选项上的概率，而非文本。我们测试了两种可用决策模型 Jev 和 OpenAI Decisions 相对于大语言模型（LLM）GPT-6 Luna 的临床一致性和潜在偏差易感性，然后将每个决策模型与 LLM 配对。在 2,134 份病例呈现和 2,483,222 次模型调用中，我们测量了在不改变临床发现的情况下添加标签或压力提示后的决策变化。在最初的对照挑战中，对于决策模型，这些添加每 100 次决策中改变的决策数比中性措辞多 13.4 次，而 LLM 多 14.0 次。配对后这一数值降至 2.6，在开发集中降低约 81%，在留出报告中降低 42% 至 48%。分诊准确率保持在 81% 至 82% 附近。配对的 Decisions 工作流程每 1,000 条记录的成本至多为 0.77 美元（US$0.77）。我们认为这是降低框架敏感性和标记有影响力文本以供审查的实用概念验证。

title: MATS: A Multi-Agent Framework for Controllable and Reflective Tumor Synthesis

summary: 预印本提出多智能体框架，按肿瘤形态属性分布做生成规划，并以两阶段扩散生成跨器官肿瘤掩膜与纹理。

闭环反思机制校验生成质量
reason: 预印本新方法有清晰设计，但仅见摘要、无外部验证与开源说明
abstract: Synthesizing realistic tumors on medical images helps address data scarcity for clinical AI. Existing diffusion-based methods, however, lack fine-grained attribute-level controllability, closed-loop quality verification, and awareness of which morphological patterns are underrepresented in the target distribution. We present MATS, a multi-agent framework for text-controllable, cross-organ tumor synthesis. Given a target disease, MATS first profiles its morphological distribution over a fine-grained attribute space covering tumor geometry and appearance, and constructs a generation plan that amplifies underrepresented subtypes while keeping common ones dominant. It then localizes the target organ, proposes anatomically valid placement, and executes two-stage diffusion to produce the tumor mask and render texture, each conditioned on the corresponding attributes. A closed-loop reflective mechanism verifies attribute alignment at three checkpoints throughout synthesis and provides targeted feedback to guide re-generation when misalignment is detected. Trained exclusively on a single-source pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor dataset, MATS consistently improves downstream segmentation both in-domain and across LiTS, KiTS, and MSD-Pancreas benchmarks, whereas most prior generative augmentation methods fall below real-only training.
zh_abstract: 在医学图像上合成逼真肿瘤有助于解决临床AI的数据稀缺问题。然而，现有基于扩散的方法缺乏细粒度属性级可控性、闭环质量验证，以及对目标分布中哪些形态模式代表性不足的感知。我们提出MATS，一种用于文本可控、跨器官肿瘤合成的多智能体框架。给定目标疾病，MATS首先在涵盖肿瘤几何和外观的细粒度属性空间上刻画其形态分布，并构建生成计划，以扩增代表性不足的亚型，同时保持常见亚型占主导。然后定位目标器官，提出解剖学上有效的放置方案，并执行两阶段扩散以生成肿瘤掩膜并渲染纹理，每一步均以相应属性为条件。闭环反思机制在合成全过程的三个检查点验证属性对齐，并在检测到错位时提供针对性反馈以指导重新生成。MATS仅在单源胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤（pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor）数据集上训练，却在域内以及跨LiTS、KiTS和MSD-Pancreas基准上持续改善下游分割，而大多数既往生成式增强方法低于仅用真实数据训练。

abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used across clinical, administrative, and public health settings, but technical performance alone does not establish clinical utility, safety, equity, or sustainability. To critically analyze contemporary healthcare AI applications, characterize source types and non-ordinal evidence profiles in the supporting literature, synthesize key opportunities and risks, and identify governance requirements for clinically useful, safe, equitable, and responsible implementation. We conducted a critical narrative synthesis using PubMed, the Virtual Health Library, Web of Science, and Scopus as source-discovery tools on July 16, 2026. A curated corpus of 28 bibliographically verifiable publications was assembled judgmentally to provide complementary coverage of clinical applications, evidence characteristics, implementation, risk, and life-cycle governance. Sources were classified by primary design and non-mutually exclusive evidentiary domains, and the evidence described within them was characterized using non-ordinal profile categories. Findings were synthesized qualitatively because of substantial heterogeneity across technologies, settings, and source designs. The curated corpus addressed diagnosis and imaging, prediction and monitoring, clinical documentation, conversational systems, public health, hospital operations, and specialty applications. Within this assembled corpus, technical-performance/validation and process-utility/workflow domains were represented more often than clinical or patient-safety outcomes, economic outcomes, or post-deployment surveillance; these document-level counts are descriptive and have no inferential weight beyond the selected sources. Reported or proposed benefits included diagnostic support, personalization, documentation, surveillance, and workflow efficiency. Recurrent risks included poor generalizability, bias, miscalibration, hallucinations, opacity, privacy concerns, interoperability problems, inappropriate automation, unclear accountability, and hidden costs. Within this non-exhaustive corpus, the evidence more consistently supported assistive, context-specific uses than generalized autonomous replacement. abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University College, London; conditions: Sensorineural Hearing Loss, Tinnitus; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 84; status: ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION] Background and study aims Hearing problems are becoming more common. In the UK around 18 million adults have hearing loss or hear ringing or buzzing in their ears, which is called tinnitus. Many people wait a long time to be seen, partly because there are not enough audiologists - the specialists who test hearing and treat hearing problems. The standard hearing test is called pure-tone audiometry. An audiologist plays quiet sounds at different pitches through headphones and the person presses a button each time they hear one. The test is accurate, but it takes 20 to 30 minutes to complete, and needs a trained audiologist for all of that time. For people with tinnitus and comorbidity it can be especially tiring and slow. The research team has built a version of this test that uses artificial intelligence, called AI-PTA. Instead of following a fixed pattern, it chooses each sound based on the responses already given, which should mean fewer sound presentations are needed to find the same result. The audiologist stays with the person throughout and remains in charge of the test. This study asks three questions. 1. Does AI-PTA give the same hearing results as the standard test? 2. Is it quicker? 3. And do patients and staff find it acceptable? Who can participate? Adults aged 18 or over who have been diagnosed with sensorineural hearing loss, either with or without tinnitus, and who are due to attend the Royal National ENT \& Eastman Dental Hospital in London. Participants need enough English to read and complete questionnaires and to be able to give informed consent. People who have or report hyperacusis (an unusual sensitivity to everyday sounds), an active ear infection, or recent ear surgery cannot take part. What does the study involve? People who are interested are sent information about two weeks before a hospital appointment they already have. Those who decide to take part come in about 30 minutes early, meet a research audiologist, discuss the study, and if happy to take part, sign a consent form. They fill in a short questionnaire about their hearing health. They then have two hearing tests at that visit: the standard test, which is part of their normal care, and the AI-PTA test. Half of the participants have the standard test first and half have AI-PTA first, so that the order does not affect the results. title: TIM: Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model for Longitudinal Radiology Report Generation

abstract: Clinical artificial intelligence (AI) often trades predictive performance against interpretability. This study develops an interpretability-driven feature engineering framework for multi-outcome risk stratification at hospitalization for chronic hepatitis B. A total of 36,024 hospitalization records from 22,001 patients were included. The framework integrating SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)-based main and interaction effects was used to construct compact machine learning models for classifying disease non-progression, liver cirrhosis (LC), and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). SHAP main effects selected the top 15 features per outcome; TreeSHAP interactions selected four pairwise terms. Performance was evaluated using patient-level data splitting, temporal validation, and independent external validation, with calibration and decision-curve analyses. The full-feature models achieved superior discrimination (AUCs: 0.927, 0.897, and 0.899) for classifying hospitalization-recorded disease non-progression, LC, and HCC, respectively. The corresponding compact models maintained strong discrimination (AUCs: 0.911, 0.882, and 0.890) with 80.8% fewer features. Interaction models yielded subtle AUC shifts (AUCs: 0.912, 0.881, and 0.891) while characterizing potential clinical joint-effect patterns. Temporal validation yielded AUCs of 0.863, 0.827, and 0.847, while external validation yielded AUCs of 0.829, 0.865, and 0.827, respectively. The framework produced compact and transparent models for contemporaneous risk stratification in clinical practice, seamlessly uniting predictive accuracy with multi-level interpretability.

_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
