abstract: Medical large language models achieving high benchmark accuracy exhibit unexplained variability in clinical tasks, producing errors that clinicians cannot safeguard against. We evaluated clinical reasoning stability in GPT-5, MedGemma-27B-Text-IT, and OpenBioLLM-Llama3-70B using 3035 systematic perturbations from physician-validated oncology SOAP, brief vignette, and MIMIC cases. We trained sparse autoencoders on 1 billion tokens from 50,000 MIMIC-IV clinical notes to decompose their internal representation. We find models exhibit dramatic reasoning instability, shifting staging accuracy by over 50% based solely on prompt format, or generating definitive staging in clinically insufficient scenarios. Sparse autoencoder analysis revealed hierarchical encoding in MedGemma, where high-magnitude features encode lexical identity and low-magnitude features encode contextual meaning. OpenBioLLM distributes information uniformly. We demonstrate that these internal encoding structures differentially affect retrieval and reasoning interventions, suggesting interventions effective for one architecture may harm another. These results motivate architecture-specific safety validation as a component of pre-deployment evaluation for medical LLMs.
zh_abstract: 医学大语言模型虽在基准测试中达到高准确率，却在临床任务中表现出无法解释的变异性，产生临床医生无法防范的错误。我们使用来自经医生验证的肿瘤学SOAP、简要病例摘要和MIMIC病例的3035个系统性扰动，评估了GPT-5、MedGemma-27B-Text-IT和OpenBioLLM-Llama3-70B的临床推理稳定性。我们在来自50,000份MIMIC-IV临床记录的10亿个token上训练稀疏自编码器，以分解其内部表征。我们发现模型表现出显著的推理不稳定性：仅因提示格式不同，分期准确率就会变化超过50%；或在临床信息不足的情况下生成确定性分期。稀疏自编码器分析揭示了MedGemma中的分层编码，其中高幅值特征编码词汇身份，低幅值特征编码上下文语义。OpenBioLLM则均匀分布信息。我们证明，这些内部编码结构对检索和推理干预产生不同影响，提示对一种架构有效的干预可能损害另一种架构。这些结果支持将针对特定架构的安全性验证作为医学大语言模型部署前评估的组成部分。

abstract: Generating clinical synthetic text represents an effective solution for common clinical NLP issues like sparsity and privacy. This paper aims to conduct a systematic review on generating synthetic medical free-text by formulating quantitative analysis to three research questions concerning (i) the purpose of generation, (ii) the techniques, and (iii) the evaluation methods. We searched PubMed, ScienceDirect, Web of Science, Scopus, IEEE, Google Scholar, and arXiv databases for publications associated with generating synthetic medical unstructured free-text. We have identified 94 relevant articles out of 1,398 collected ones. A great deal of attention has been given to the generation of synthetic medical text from 2018 onwards, where the main purpose of such a generation is towards text augmentation, assistive writing, corpus building, privacy-preserving, annotation, and usefulness. Transformer architectures were the main predominant technique used to generate the text, especially the GPTs. On the other hand, there were four main aspects of evaluation, including similarity, privacy, structure, and utility, where utility was the most frequent method used to assess the generated synthetic medical text. Although the generated synthetic medical text demonstrated a moderate possibility to act as real medical documents in different downstream NLP tasks, it has proven to be a great asset as augmented, complementary to the real documents, towards improving the accuracy and overcoming sparsity/undersampling issues. Yet, privacy is still a major issue behind generating synthetic medical text, where more human assessments are needed to check for the existence of any sensitive information. Despite that, advances in generating synthetic medical text will considerably accelerate the adoption of workflows and pipeline development, discarding the time-consuming legalities of data transfer.
zh_abstract: 生成临床合成文本是解决稀疏性和隐私等常见临床NLP问题的有效方案。本文旨在通过围绕三个研究问题开展定量分析，对合成医学自由文本的生成进行系统综述，这三个问题涉及（i）生成目的、（ii）技术和（iii）评估方法。我们检索了PubMed、ScienceDirect、Web of Science、Scopus、IEEE、Google Scholar和arXiv数据库中与生成合成医学非结构化自由文本相关的出版物。我们从1,398篇收集到的文章中识别出94篇相关文章。自2018年起，合成医学文本的生成受到大量关注，此类生成的主要目的包括文本增强、辅助写作、语料库构建、隐私保护、注释和实用性。Transformer架构是用于生成文本的主要主流技术，尤其是各类GPT。另一方面，评估主要有四个方面，包括相似性、隐私、结构和效用，其中效用是评估所生成合成医学文本最常用的方法。尽管所生成的合成医学文本在不同下游NLP任务中表现出作为真实医学文档的中等可能性，但已证明其作为真实文档的增强和补充具有重要价值，可提高准确性并克服稀疏性/欠采样问题。然而，隐私仍是生成合成医学文本背后的主要问题，需要更多人工作业评估以检查是否存在任何敏感信息。尽管如此，合成医学文本生成方面的进展将显著加速工作流程的采用和流水线开发，摆脱数据转移中耗时的法律合规问题。

abstract: Persistent fever after initiating intravenous antibiotics is common in hospitalized patients with cancer and often leads to additional imaging and antimicrobial escalation. Early identification of patients unlikely to remain febrile could provide additional information during clinical reassessment. We developed and externally validated machine learning models to predict persistent fever 48-72 h after antibiotic initiation using electronic health records from two academic hospitals. Adult cancer patients with fever within 24-48 h of treatment were included. Models incorporated demographics, comorbidities, laboratory results, vital signs, and temperature patterns. The best-performing model achieved an AUROC of 0.82 (95% CI 0.79-0.84) internally and 0.78 (95% CI 0.77-0.79) externally. Temperature-related variables were the dominant predictors. Decision curve analysis demonstrated positive net benefit across much of the evaluated threshold range. Retrospective assessment suggested that approximately one quarter of antibiotic escalations and chest CT scans occurred in patients correctly predicted not to remain febrile, highlighting the potential contextual value of fever predictions. These findings indicate that short-term fever persistence can be predicted with clinically meaningful accuracy using routine data. However, clinical use should be limited to an adjunctive role rather than standalone rule-out decision-making, and prospective studies are required to evaluate safety, clinician uptake, and real-world impact.
zh_abstract: 在开始静脉注射抗生素后持续发热在住院癌症患者中很常见，并且常导致额外影像学检查和抗菌治疗升级。早期识别不太可能持续发热的患者可在临床再评估期间提供额外信息。我们开发并外部验证了机器学习模型，利用两家学术医院的电子健康记录预测抗生素开始后48-72小时的持续发热。纳入在治疗24-48小时内发热的成年癌症患者。模型纳入人口学特征、合并症、实验室结果、生命体征和体温模式。表现最佳的模型在内部达到AUROC 0.82（95% CI 0.79-0.84），在外部达到0.78（95% CI 0.77-0.79）。体温相关变量是最主要的预测因素。决策曲线分析显示，在评估阈值范围的大部分区间内具有正向净获益。回顾性评估提示，大约四分之一的抗生素升级和胸部CT扫描发生在被正确预测为不会持续发热的患者中，突显了发热预测的潜在情境价值。这些发现表明，使用常规数据可以以具有临床意义的准确度预测短期发热持续。然而，临床使用应仅限于辅助作用，而非独立的排除决策，并且需要前瞻性研究评估安全性、临床医生接受度和真实世界影响。

abstract: Of all melanoma patients who develop distant metastasis over time, 41% were initially diagnosed with stage I/II. More accurate prognostic models are needed to select patients for potential (neo)adjuvant therapy. We hypothesise that histopathological features in whole slide images (WSIs) from primary early-stage melanomas provide additional information beyond American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) stage. We utilised data from the population-based Dutch Early-Stage Melanoma (D-ESMEL) study. This included a discovery set (n=328) of case-control sets matched on follow-up time and known prognostic features (i.e. Breslow thickness, ulceration, age, and sex) and a validation cohort based on >5,500 patients following a nested case-control (NCC) design with stage-matched controls (n=266). We developed an end-to-end deep learning workflow to automatically extract relevant patches from WSIs and predict patient-level metastatic risk based on histopathological features independent of AJCC stage. The discovery set served as a training set for the workflow using 10-fold cross-validation. The prognostic performance of this model and its independence from clinical risk factors was evaluated in the validation cohort using odds ratios (OR) and the weighted C-index. We achieved a balanced accuracy of 0.88 (mean: 0.81; 95% CI: 0.77-0.85) in the best validation fold of the discovery set. In the validation cohort, metastatic risk predictions from the deep learning model were an independent prognostic factor (adjusted OR: 1.97; p<0.01). Combining the deep learning predictions (C-index: 0.86) with AJCC stage (C-index: 0.80) yielded the highest C-index of 0.87, significantly improving the C-index compared to AJCC stage alone (p<0.001). Our histopathology-based deep learning model was rigorously evaluated in a population-based cohort and demonstrated added prognostic value beyond AJCC stage. Further investigations of the underlying biological features could improve clinical decision making and patient outcomes.
zh_abstract: 在所有随时间发生远处转移的黑色素瘤患者中，41% 初诊时为 I/II 期。需要更准确的预后模型来选择可能接受（新）辅助治疗的患者。我们假设，原发性早期黑色素瘤全切片图像（WSIs）中的组织病理学特征可提供超出美国癌症联合委员会（AJCC）分期的额外信息。我们使用了基于人群的荷兰早期黑色素瘤（D-ESMEL）研究的数据。该研究包括一个发现集（n=328），由按随访时间和已知预后特征（即 Breslow 厚度、溃疡、年龄和性别）匹配的病例-对照集组成；以及一个基于 >5,500 例患者的验证队列，采用巢式病例对照（NCC）设计并设置分期匹配的对照（n=266）。我们开发了一个端到端深度学习工作流程，从 WSIs 中自动提取相关图像块，并基于独立于 AJCC 分期的组织病理学特征预测患者水平的转移风险。发现集作为该工作流程的训练集，采用 10 折交叉验证。在验证队列中，使用比值比（OR）和加权 C 指数评估该模型的预后性能及其独立于临床风险因素的程度。在发现集的最佳验证折中，我们达到了 0.88 的平衡准确率（均值：0.81；95% CI：0.77-0.85）。在验证队列中，深度学习模型的转移风险预测是一个独立预后因素（校正 OR：1.97；p<0.01）。将深度学习预测（C 指数：0.86）与 AJCC 分期（C 指数：0.80）结合，得到最高的 C 指数 0.87，与单独 AJCC 分期相比显著提高了 C 指数（p<0.001）。我们基于组织病理学的深度学习模型在基于人群的队列中经过严格评估，并显示出超出 AJCC 分期的附加预后价值。对潜在生物学特征的进一步研究可改善临床决策和患者结局。

title: DINOv2 for PET: A Pre-Training Domain Benchmark Across Classification, Segmentation, and Prognosis

abstract: DINO (self-DIstillation with NO labels) has become a stan- dard for self-supervised pre-training, producing features that generalise across datasets and downstream tasks. In medical imaging it has been adopted mainly for radiology (X-ray, CT and MRI), where even natural- image DINO features transfer well. In the literature, these features have been reported to transfer worse to functional imaging such as PET. Yet PET-specific DINO models have barely been introduced, and even less validated across multiple tasks and datasets. We present PET-DINOv2-2D, the first DINOv2 model pre-trained on 2D PET, and benchmark it against open-source encoders: the origi- nal DINOv2 (pre-trained on the LVD-142M natural-image dataset) and OmniRad (pre-trained on CT, MRI and ultrasound). Using the same lightweight heads for every backbone, and despite far less pre-training data, PET-DINOv2-2D matches or outperforms both on three down- stream PET tasks: normal/abnormal classification, lesion segmentation and recurrence-free survival prognosis. Its advantage is largest when few labels are available, suggesting that PET pre-training gives more transferable, label-efficient features. Code is made available at https://github.com/nuclivision/pet-dinov2-2d/.
zh_abstract: DINO（self-DIstillation with NO labels，无标签自蒸馏）已成为自监督预训练的标准，所产生的特征能够泛化到不同数据集和下游任务。在医学影像中，它主要用于放射学（X 射线、CT 和 MRI），即使自然图像 DINO 特征也能很好地迁移。文献报道，这些特征向 PET 等功能成像的迁移效果较差。然而，PET 专用的 DINO 模型几乎尚未被提出，更少在多个任务和数据集上得到验证。我们提出 PET-DINOv2-2D，这是首个在 2D PET 上预训练的 DINOv2 模型，并将其与开源编码器进行基准比较：原始 DINOv2（在 LVD-142M 自然图像数据集上预训练）和 OmniRad（在 CT、MRI 和超声上预训练）。对每个骨干网络使用相同的轻量级头，尽管预训练数据少得多，PET-DINOv2-2D 在三个下游 PET 任务上达到或超过二者：正常/异常分类、病灶分割和无复发生存预后。其优势在可用标签较少时最大，提示 PET 预训练能提供更具迁移性、标签效率更高的特征。代码已在 https://github.com/nuclivision/pet-dinov2-2d/ 提供。

abstract: Early-stage melanoma accounts for 40-60% of melanoma-related deaths. Most prognostic modelling studies focus on unimodal approaches or a single multimodal integration strategy, overlooking alternative methods and biological processes underlying metastatic progression. We aimed to evaluate multi-modal data integration for predicting metastasis using the Dutch Early-Stage Melanoma (D-ESMEL) study, the worlds largest multi-modal cohort of American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) stage I/II melanoma. We analysed clinicopathological, genomic, transcriptomic, and pathomics data from the D-ESMEL study. The discovery set included 221 case-control sets matched on follow-up time, age, sex, Breslow thickness, and ulceration. The validation cohort included 154 AJCC stage matched case-control sets based on a population of >5,500 stage I/II melanoma patients. We evaluated four integration strategies (early, intermediate, mixed, and late) using a repeated (n=5) nested 3-fold cross-validation in the discovery set. The best-performing models were evaluated in the validation cohort using the odds ratios (ORs) and a weighted C-index reflecting performance in the sampled population. In the discovery set, intermediate integration of genomics and transcriptomics achieved the highest balanced accuracy ({micro}: 0{middle dot}62; 95% CI: 0{middle dot}57-0{middle dot}66). Early and late integration of transcriptomics and pathomics, and the unimodal transcriptomics model showed similar performance ({micro}: 0{middle dot}61; 95% CI: 0{middle dot}58-0{middle dot}65). In the validation cohort both early integration, late integration, and the unimodal transcriptomics model achieved the highest balanced accuracy of 0{middle dot}60{middle dot} When adjusted for clinicopathological risk factors early integration remained an independent prognostic factor for metastasis (OR 1{middle dot}75; p<0{middle dot}01), outperforming transcriptomics alone (OR 1{middle dot}26; p<0{middle dot}01). Early integration reached a weighted C-index of 0{middle dot}83 outperforming AJCC stage (0{middle dot}81 C-index). When combined the population-weighted C-index was significantly improved to 0{middle dot}85 (p<0{middle dot}01). Early integration of transcriptomics and pathomics outperformed all unimodal models and improved prediction of distant metastasis independently of AJCC stage. Understanding the biological mechanisms underlying these predictions may further support clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: 早期黑色素瘤占黑色素瘤相关死亡的 40–60%。大多数预后建模研究集中于单模态方法或单一多模态整合策略，忽视了其他方法以及转移进展背后的生物学过程。我们旨在利用荷兰早期黑色素瘤（Dutch Early-Stage Melanoma，D-ESMEL）研究——全球最大的美国癌症联合委员会（AJCC）I/II 期黑色素瘤多模态队列——评估多模态数据整合用于预测转移。我们分析了 D-ESMEL 研究的临床病理学、基因组学、转录组学和病理组学数据。发现集包括 221 个病例-对照集，按随访时间、年龄、性别、Breslow 厚度和溃疡进行匹配。验证队列包括 154 个按 AJCC 分期匹配的病例-对照集，基于超过 5,500 例 I/II 期黑色素瘤患者的人群。我们在发现集中使用重复（n=5）嵌套 3 折交叉验证评估了四种整合策略（早期、中间、混合和晚期）。表现最佳的模型在验证队列中使用比值比（ORs）和反映抽样人群中表现的加权 C 指数进行评估。在发现集中，基因组学和转录组学的中间整合获得了最高的平衡准确率（{micro}：0.62；95% CI：0.57–0.66）。转录组学和病理组学的早期与晚期整合，以及单模态转录组学模型表现出相似的表现（{micro}：0.61；95% CI：0.58–0.65）。在验证队列中，早期整合、晚期整合和单模态转录组学模型均达到最高的平衡准确率 0.60。当调整临床病理学危险因素后，早期整合仍是转移的独立预后因素（OR 1.75；p<0.01），优于单独转录组学（OR 1.26；p<0.01）。早期整合达到加权 C 指数 0.83，优于 AJCC 分期（C 指数 0.81）。当联合时，人群加权 C 指数显著提高至 0.85（p<0.01）。转录组学和病理组学的早期整合优于所有单模态模型，并独立于 AJCC 分期改善远处转移预测。理解这些预测背后的生物学机制可能进一步支持临床决策。

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] AI-enabled patient profiling has been proposed to organize heterogeneous patient data and support personalized nursing care and health support. Given the growing use of AI, machine learning, large language models (LLMs), digital phenotyping, and digital twins in health care, it is important to clarify how patient profiling has been conceptualized, applied, and evaluated in nursing-relevant contexts. This scoping review aimed to examine and report the available evidence on AI-enabled patient profiling for personalized nursing care and health support. This scoping review was conducted using the Joanna Briggs Institute methodological framework and the PRISMA-ScR (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews). Chinese and English databases were searched from inception to May 18, 2026, including China National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang Data, VIP Database, Chinese Biomedical Literature Database, PubMed, CINAHL, Web of Science, and Embase. Eligible studies used AI or computational intelligence methods to construct, classify, apply, validate, or evaluate patient profiles or related patient representations relevant to personalized nursing care or health support. Two reviewers independently screened records, assessed full texts, and charted data using a predefined form. Data were synthesized descriptively and narratively using an input-process-output framework. A total of 61 studies were included. AI-enabled patient profiling was represented through patient profiles, patient or user personas, digital phenotypes, patient segments, clinical subtypes, digital twins, and LLM-enabled personalization. Included studies used diverse data sources, including electronic health records, nursing records, patient-reported outcomes, questionnaires, mobile app data, wearable and sensor data, engagement logs, and textual or conversational data. Common AI approaches included machine learning, clustering, deep learning, natural language processing, recommender systems, knowledge graphs, digital twin modeling, and LLMs. Applications focused on personalized education, self-management support, rehabilitation, chronic disease management, remote monitoring, decision support, follow-up care, and shared decision-making. abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Istanbul Medipol University Hospital; conditions: Nursing Education, Nursing Process, Learning Outcome, Generative Artificial Intelligence; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 173; status: COMPLETED] This randomized controlled trial evaluated the effect of generative artificial intelligence (AI)-supported education in teaching the nursing process on nursing students' learning outcomes. The study was conducted with undergraduate nursing students enrolled in the Nursing Process course for the first time at a foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye. After a 7-week instructor-centered theoretical course, students were randomly assigned to an intervention or control group using computer-based simple randomization. Over three consecutive weeks, the intervention group worked on three patient case scenarios using a generative AI platform (Gemini), guided by pre-defined themes and prompts covering data collection, nursing diagnosis, planning, and implementation. The accuracy, consistency, and alignment of AI-generated responses with the nursing process steps were then discussed in class. During the same period, the control group completed three different case studies using the instructor's standard care plan template. Nursing process knowledge, self-efficacy in clinical performance, and clinical decision-making confidence and anxiety were measured before and after the intervention, and attitudes toward artificial intelligence and the course were measured after the intervention. A total of 173 eligible students were randomized (intervention n = 85; control n = 88), and the study was completed with 140 students (intervention n = 68; control n = 72). Students who were repeating the course or were horizontal or vertical transfer students were excluded. The primary outcome was nursing process knowledge, measured with a researcher-developed Nursing Process Knowledge Test. Secondary outcomes were measured with the Self-Efficacy in Clinical Performance Scale, the Nursing Anxiety and Self-Confidence with Clinical Decision Making Scale, and the Attitude Toward Artificial Intelligence and Its Course Scale. Data were collected through electronic forms and analyzed using IBM SPSS 22.0.

abstract: [Frontiers in cardiovascular medicine] Electrocardiography is a widely available and low-cost cardiovascular test, and artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiography (AI-ECG) can identify latent electrical phenotypes beyond conventional interpretation. However, high retrospective discrimination does not necessarily translate into clinically reliable or actionable benefit. This critical narrative review evaluates the translational maturity of AI-ECG across arrhythmias, acute myocardial infarction, heart failure, valvular heart disease, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and cardiac amyloidosis. PubMed, IEEE Xplore, and Web of Science were searched from January 1, 2022, through July 10, 2026, with earlier landmark studies added by backward citation tracking. Seventy-seven publications informed the review. Evidence was appraised using five clinically oriented criteria: intended use, reference-standard reliability, external validation and transportability, clinical actionability, and effects on workflow or patient outcomes. AI-ECG has progressed furthest in ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction triage and reduced-left-ventricular-ejection-fraction screening, where prospective or randomized studies have demonstrated workflow or diagnostic-yield benefits, whereas acute myocardial infarction rule-out has reached prospective multicenter diagnostic validation. Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy screening has also advanced through international validation and prospective implementation. By contrast, occlusion myocardial infarction detection, prediction of occult or future atrial fibrillation, valvular heart disease, heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, long-term heart-failure prediction, and cardiac amyloidosis remain primarily validation-stage or risk-enrichment applications. Across domains, broader adoption is constrained by label quality, calibration, transportability, operating-threshold selection, and limited patient-outcome evidence. AI-ECG is therefore best positioned as clinician-supervised decision support linked to explicit downstream testing and care pathways.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in cardiovascular medicine] 心电图是一种广泛可用且低成本的心血管检查，人工智能赋能的心电图（AI-ECG）能够识别超出传统解读的潜在电学表型。然而，高回顾性区分能力并不一定转化为临床可靠或可操作的获益。这篇批判性叙述综述评估了AI-ECG在心律失常、急性心肌梗死、心力衰竭、瓣膜性心脏病、肥厚型心肌病和心脏淀粉样变性中的转化成熟度。检索了PubMed、IEEE Xplore和Web of Science，时间范围为2022年1月1日至2026年7月10日，并通过回溯引文追踪补充了更早的里程碑研究。77篇出版物为综述提供了依据。采用五项面向临床的标准评估证据：预期用途、参考标准可靠性、外部验证与可迁移性、临床可操作性，以及对工作流程或患者结局的影响。AI-ECG在ST段抬高型心肌梗死分诊和左心室射血分数降低（reduced-LVEF）筛查中进展最为成熟，前瞻性或随机研究已证明其工作流程或诊断产出获益，而急性心肌梗死排除已达到前瞻性多中心诊断验证。肥厚型心肌病筛查也已通过国际验证和前瞻性实施取得进展。相比之下，闭塞性心肌梗死检测、隐匿性或未来心房颤动预测、瓣膜性心脏病、射血分数保留的心力衰竭、长期心力衰竭预测和心脏淀粉样变性仍主要处于验证阶段或风险富集应用。跨领域而言，更广泛的应用受到标签质量、校准、可迁移性、操作阈值选择以及有限的患者结局证据制约。因此，AI-ECG最适合定位为与明确的下游检测和护理路径相连接的、由临床医生监督的决策支持。

title: Vision-Language-Based Large-Scale Model for Emergency Screening
zh_title: 视觉语言大模型用于急诊胸腹病变筛查的随机试验
summary: 吉林大学第一医院注册单中心前瞻性1:1随机优效性诊断试验，640例急诊患者比较视觉语言大模型powER辅助阅片与常规阅片。
key_points: 单中心前瞻随机，计划入组640例
对照为无AI辅助的常规影像阅片
全部受试者完成60天临床随访金标准

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: The First Hospital of Jilin University; conditions: Acute Thoraco-Abdominal Emergency Lesions; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 640; status: RECRUITING] This is a single-center, prospective, stratified 1:1 parallel-group randomized superiority diagnostic trial at The First Hospital of Jilin University. Eligible emergency patients aged ≥18 who received routine thoraco-abdominal non-contrast CT were randomly assigned to two groups. The experimental group adopted a self-developed vision-language large model (powER) for auxiliary CT interpretation, while the control group received standard radiological reading without AI assistance. All participants completed standardized 60-day clinical follow-up to obtain clinical gold-standard outcomes. The primary objective is to compare the diagnostic performance of the AI model versus conventional radiology interpretation for multiple acute thoraco-abdominal emergency lesions.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：吉林大学第一医院；病症：急性胸腹急诊病变；类型：干预性；分期：NA；入组人数：640；状态：招募中] 这是一项在吉林大学第一医院开展的单中心、前瞻性、分层1:1平行组随机优效性诊断试验。符合条件的、年龄≥18岁且接受常规胸腹部平扫CT的急诊患者被随机分配至两组。实验组采用自主开发的视觉-语言大模型（powER）辅助CT判读，而对照组接受无AI辅助的标准放射学阅片。所有参与者均完成标准化60天临床随访，以获得临床金标准结局。主要目的是比较AI模型与传统放射学判读对多种急性胸腹急诊病变的诊断性能。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Thyroid Nodule Diagnosis: From Multimodal Integration to Clinical Utility.
zh_title: 甲状腺结节诊断AI：从多模态整合到临床效用
summary: 叙述性综述评估超声、细胞学、组织学与分子模型的AI研究，主张以决策改变而非单一准确率衡量价值。
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence (AI) for thyroid nodules should be evaluated against the decisions it changes, not diagnostic accuracy alone. This critical narrative review examines ultrasound, cytology, histology, and molecular models and distinguishes modality-specific prediction from implemented multimodal learning. The original PubMed/MEDLINE search through 10 August 2026 was supplemented on 25 September 2026 by targeted OpenAlex searches and checks of primary publications, reporting standards, and regulatory sources. Selected studies are compared by sample size, reference standard, acquisition setting, testing design, and performance with confidence intervals where available. We explain feature concatenation, intermediate representation learning, cross-attention, and decision-level fusion, and examine whether integration improves on the strongest component. Reported gains are inconsistent, and complete-case multimodal datasets may exclude the low-risk nodules most relevant to avoiding biopsy. High discrimination for histological malignancy or occult nodal disease does not demonstrate reduced overdiagnosis, fewer operations, or improved survival. A thyroid-specific translation roadmap therefore addresses active surveillance, partial verification and spectrum bias, Hashimoto thyroiditis and multinodular disease, cytology preparation shifts, category-specific thresholds, operator dependence, reporting frameworks, and regulatory change control. The priority is a calibrated, externally tested tool using information available at a defined clinical decision, followed by prospective evaluation of patient and workflow outcomes. A unified imaging-pathology-omics system and reliable AI prediction of surveillance progression remain research objectives rather than established clinical capabilities.
key_points: 按样本量、参考标准、测试设计与置信区间比较研究
区分单模态预测与真正落地的多模态学习
提出应以临床决策改变而非仅准确率评价AI
reason: 叙述性综述，非系统综述/meta分析，按规则最高6分，给5分
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] 对甲状腺结节的人工智能（AI）应依据其改变的决策来评估，而不仅仅是诊断准确率。这篇批判性叙述性综述考察超声、细胞学、组织学和分子模型，并区分特定模态预测与已实施的多模态学习。原始 PubMed/MEDLINE 检索截至 2026 年 8 月 10 日，并于 2026 年 9 月 25 日通过有针对性的 OpenAlex 检索以及对原始出版物、报告标准和监管来源的核查进行补充。所选研究按样本量、参考标准、采集环境、测试设计以及（若有）带置信区间的性能进行比较。我们解释特征拼接、中间表示学习、交叉注意力和决策级融合，并考察整合是否优于最强组件。报道的增益并不一致，完整病例多模态数据集可能排除与避免活检最相关的低风险结节。对组织学恶性或隐匿性淋巴结病变的高区分度并不能证明可减少过度诊断、减少手术或改善生存。因此，针对甲状腺的转化路线图涉及主动监测、部分验证和谱偏倚、桥本甲状腺炎和多结节性疾病、细胞学制片变化、类别特异性阈值、操作者依赖性、报告框架和监管变更控制。优先事项是使用在明确临床决策时可获得的信息，开发经过校准和外部测试的工具，随后对患者和工作流程结局进行前瞻性评估。统一的影像-病理-组学系统以及对监测进展的可靠 AI 预测仍是研究目标，而非已确立的临床能力。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Gastroenterology: Towards Explainable, Generalisable and Clinically Actionable Decision Support.
zh_title: 消化病学中的可解释、可泛化、可落地的AI决策支持
summary: 结构化叙述性综述，从可解释性、可泛化性与临床可操作性三维度审视消化内镜、IBD、肝病及胰胆疾病AI决策支持的转化现状。
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence is increasingly used in gastroenterology for endoscopic detection and characterisation, disease-activity assessment, risk prediction, treatment-response estimation and workflow support. However, high retrospective accuracy does not necessarily translate into reliable or beneficial clinical decision support. This structured narrative review examines the clinical development of artificial intelligence across gastrointestinal endoscopy, inflammatory bowel disease, hepatology and pancreaticobiliary diseases through three translational dimensions: explainability, generalisability and clinical actionability. Communication, human oversight and lifecycle governance are considered cross-cutting determinants of implementation. The evidence is most mature in gastrointestinal endoscopy, particularly for computer-aided polyp detection, although benefits vary across operators, indications and practice settings. Applications in inflammatory bowel disease, hepatology and pancreaticobiliary care remain predominantly retrospective, with limited prospective evidence that model outputs alter management or improve patient outcomes. Explainability is commonly represented by heatmaps or feature-attribution methods, but rarely evaluated in terms of clinician understanding, calibrated trust or patient communication. External validation is becoming more frequent, yet geographic and technological transportability, calibration and performance under dataset shift remain insufficiently assessed. Prospective implementation and health-economic studies are uncommon, and available economic evidence is largely model-based. Clinical artificial intelligence should therefore be evaluated as a sociotechnical intervention comprising the model, interface, users, workflow, communication process and associated care pathway. Translation requires clinically defined use cases, representative multicentre validation, human-centred evaluation, prospective assessment of benefits and harms, and continuous post-deployment surveillance. Clinical AI in gastroenterology should complement clinical expertise through transparent, contestable and continuously monitored decision support that preserves clinician accountability and supports informed, patient-centred decisions.
key_points: 证据最成熟的是消化内镜，尤以计算机辅助息肉检出为代表
回顾性高准确率未必转化为可靠、有益的临床决策支持
沟通、人工监督与全生命周期治理是实施的关键横跨因素
reason: 结构化叙述性综述，无新数据，属综述档上限6分，取5分
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] 人工智能在胃肠病学中越来越多地用于内镜检测与特征描述、疾病活动度评估、风险预测、治疗反应估计和工作流程支持。然而，高回顾性准确率并不一定转化为可靠或有益的临床决策支持。本结构化叙述性综述从三个转化维度——可解释性、泛化性和临床可操作性——审视人工智能在胃肠内镜、炎症性肠病、肝病和胰胆疾病中的临床发展。沟通、人工监督和生命周期治理被视为实施的横跨性决定因素。证据在胃肠内镜中最为成熟，尤其是计算机辅助息肉检测，尽管获益因操作者、适应证和实践环境而异。炎症性肠病、肝病和胰胆疾病照护中的应用仍以回顾性研究为主，仅有有限的前瞻性证据表明模型输出会改变管理或改善患者结局。可解释性通常通过热图或特征归因方法表示，但很少从临床医生理解、校准信任或患者沟通的角度进行评估。外部验证正变得更加频繁，但地理和技术可迁移性、校准以及数据集偏移下的性能仍评估不足。前瞻性实施和卫生经济学研究并不常见，现有经济学证据大多基于模型。因此，临床人工智能应作为一种社会技术干预进行评估，包括模型、界面、用户、工作流程、沟通过程和相关照护路径。转化需要临床定义的使用场景、具有代表性的多中心验证、以人为中心的评估、对获益和危害的前瞻性评估，以及部署后持续监测。胃肠病学中的临床人工智能应通过透明、可质疑且持续监测的决策支持来补充临床专业知识，同时保留临床医生问责制并支持知情、以患者为中心的决策。

title: Integrating Heterogeneous Echocardiography AI Outputs in Language Space: Learnable Late Fusion with a Supervised LLM
zh_title: 用监督式LLM在语言空间融合超声心动图AI输出
summary: 预印本提出基于监督式大语言模型的后期融合模块，在语言空间聚合视图特异的超声心动图AI结论与测量值。
key_points: 直接融合各视图预测描述与测量值而非二值决策
859次检查、646例患者的三折交叉验证
性能与最佳参考策略相当，优于无监督通用LLM
reason: 预印本新方法有基线对比，但仅内部交叉验证、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: View- and target-specific echocardiography AI models capture useful but complementary information and may not achieve sufficient predictive performance in isolation. A learned ensemble is a natural way to combine these outputs, but heterogeneous models typically require each output to be converted into a binary decision, probability, confidence score, or fixed-length feature vector. We developed a supervised large language model (LLM)-based late-fusion module that directly aggregates view-specific predicted finding statements and predicted measurements in language space and learns a case-level fusion function. In patient-level three-fold cross-validation of 859 examinations from 646 patients, the proposed method integrated heterogeneous outputs within a single framework, performed comparably to the best-performing reference strategy evaluated, and outperformed a general-purpose LLM without task-specific training. These results suggest that a supervised LLM can combine multiple upstream models without model-specific output conversion or feature engineering that requires medical knowledge.
zh_abstract: 视图特异性和目标特异性的超声心动图AI模型可捕捉有用但互补的信息，并且单独使用时可能无法达到足够的预测性能。学习型集成是组合这些输出的一种自然方式，但异构模型通常要求将每个输出转换为二元决策、概率、置信度分数或固定长度特征向量。我们开发了一个基于监督式大语言模型（large language model, LLM）的后期融合模块，该模块在语言空间中直接聚合视图特异性的预测发现陈述和预测测量值，并学习病例级融合函数。在来自646例患者的859次检查的患者水平三折交叉验证中，所提出的方法在单一框架内整合了异构输出，其表现与所评估的表现最佳的参考策略相当，并优于未经任务特定训练的通用LLM。这些结果提示，监督式LLM可以组合多个上游模型，而无需进行模型特定的输出转换或需要医学知识的特征工程。

title: A 211K Parameter Foundation Model: Genetic Prompting in Neural Cellular Automata
zh_title: 21.1万参数基础模型：神经细胞自动机中的遗传提示
summary: arXiv 预印本提出 Foundational-NCA，一种约21.1万参数、基于神经细胞自动机与遗传提示的轻量医学分割基础模型。
key_points: 面向低资源环境的轻量医学分割模型
结合梯度学习与潜在任务空间遗传优化
称无需重训即可跨任务适应，未经同行评审
reason: 有新意的轻量方法预印本，但来源未体现外部验证与充分基线对比
abstract: The scale of modern foundation models enables broad task generalization. In medical imaging, where segmentation demands vary widely across clinical contexts, such flexibility is invaluable. But current models, such as SAM trade adaptability for scale, locking their utility behind high-end infrastructure and leaving behind the low-resource environments most in need of diagnostic support. To bridge this gap, we introduce Foundational-NCA, a lightweight foundation model capable of adapting to a wide range of medical segmentation tasks without retraining. Built on Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), Foundational-NCA incorporates gradient-based learning with genetic optimization over a latent task space, using a compact task vector to guide predictions. This enables dynamic adaptation via a genetic prompt mechanism, allowing the model to generalize across tasks while keeping the parameter count magnitudes lower at just 211 thousand, compared to SAM-based models with 38.9 to 636 million parameters. We evaluate Foundational-NCA on 15 trained and 6 entirely unseen segmentation tasks from the TotalSegmentator dataset, achieving an average Dice score of 84.5% on known tasks and 60.4% on unseen ones. These results demonstrate that task generalization is possible in ultra-compact models, laying the groundwork for resource-efficient, deployable foundation models in clinical environments where infrastructure is limited. By reducing model size by over 180 times, Foundational-NCA takes a step toward a more equitable future for medical AI, one where powerful tools are within reach of every healthcare setting.
zh_abstract: 现代基础模型的规模使其能够实现广泛的任务泛化。在医学影像中，分割需求在不同临床情境下差异很大，这种灵活性极为宝贵。但当前模型（如SAM）以可适应性换取规模，使其效用受限于高端基础设施，并遗忘了最需要诊断支持的低资源环境。为弥合这一差距，我们提出Foundational-NCA，一种轻量级基础模型，能够在无需重新训练的情况下适应广泛的医学分割任务。Foundational-NCA建立在神经细胞自动机（Neural Cellular Automata, NCA）之上，将基于梯度的学习与潜在任务空间上的遗传优化相结合，使用紧凑的任务向量指导预测。这通过遗传提示机制实现动态适应，使模型能够在任务间泛化，同时参数量低数个数量级，仅为211 thousand，而基于SAM的模型参数量为38.9至636 million。我们在TotalSegmentator数据集中的15个已训练任务和6个完全未见过的分割任务上评估Foundational-NCA，在已知任务上达到平均Dice分数84.5%，在未见任务上达到60.4%。这些结果表明，超紧凑模型中的任务泛化是可能的，为在基础设施有限的临床环境中部署资源高效的基础模型奠定了基础。通过将模型规模缩小超过180倍，Foundational-NCA朝着医学AI更公平的未来迈出了一步，使强大工具能够惠及每一个医疗环境。

title: Fu-TCM: a multimodal large language model that learns traditional Chinese medicine diagnostic reasoning
zh_title: Fu-TCM：学习中医辨证推理的多模态大模型
summary: 预印本提出基于约712万条中医数据训练的多模态大模型Fu-TCM，并用辨证导向的策略优化提升证候推理。
key_points: 训练数据约712万条，覆盖典籍、教材、医学图像与临床病例
提出BGPO强化学习方法，奖励格式、推理字段与证候预测
Fu-TCM-27B在6项中医基准中领先，但均为自建评测
reason: 领域专用多模态大模型加新强化学习目标，但仅自建基准、未经外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are advancing in multimodal understanding and reasoning, accelerating medical model development. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) uses evidence from the four examinations to determine disease location and nature, differentiate syndromes and guide treatment. This diagnostic process constitutes a complete chain of reasoning. We present Fu-TCM, a multimodal TCM LLM trained on data retained after cleaning and filtering an initial collection of approximately 7.12 million examples derived from classical texts, textbooks, medical images, clinical cases and publicly available datasets. The model was further optimized using Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization (BGPO), which explicitly targets syndrome differentiation through rewards for response format, intermediate TCM reasoning fields and final syndrome predictions. Fu-TCM-27B led all six benchmarks spanning TCM reasoning, text and vision, achieving a macro-average accuracy of 81.01% and surpassing the strongest reference model with complete results across all six benchmarks by 7.13 percentage points. Its largest margin was 11.90 points on Fu-bianzheng. Case-level analyses further showed a positive association between intermediate-field accuracy and final syndrome-selection accuracy in most evaluated models. These findings suggest that TCM syndrome differentiation may be computationally learnable and that structured reasoning supervision can improve performance across TCM tasks.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在多模态理解与推理方面不断进步，加速了医学模型的发展。中医（TCM）利用四诊证据确定病位与病性、辨证并指导治疗。这一诊断过程构成完整的推理链。我们提出 Fu-TCM，这是一种多模态中医大语言模型，其训练数据来自对初始收集的约 712 万条样本进行清洗和过滤后保留的数据，这些样本源自经典文献、教科书、医学图像、临床病例和公开可用数据集。该模型进一步使用辨证锚定策略优化（Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization，BGPO）进行优化，该方法通过对响应格式、中间中医推理字段和最终证候预测给予奖励，明确以辨证为目标。Fu-TCM-27B 在涵盖中医推理、文本和视觉的全部六项基准中领先，达到 81.01% 的宏平均准确率，并比在全部六项基准上均有完整结果的最强参考模型高 7.13 个百分点。其最大领先幅度为 Fu-bianzheng 上的 11.90 分。病例层面分析进一步显示，在大多数受评估模型中，中间字段准确率与最终证候选择准确率之间存在正相关。这些发现提示，中医辨证可能是可计算学习的，并且结构化推理监督可以提升跨中医任务的性能。

title: Automated Language Analysis in Neurodegenerative Diseases: Application of Artificial Intelligence Models
zh_title: 神经退行性疾病自动语言分析AI多中心试验
summary: 新注册多中心干预性试验，拟用AI模型分析远程评估采集的言语语言数据，寻找早期与鉴别诊断的语言标志物。
key_points: 覆盖AD、PPA、bvFTD、DLB与帕金森病
计划入组200例，目前招募中，尚无结果
以远程神经心理评估的语音语言数据为输入

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Istituti Clinici Scientifici Maugeri SpA; conditions: Alzheimer's Disease (AD), Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD), Parkinsons Disease (PD), Lewy Body Dementia; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 200; status: RECRUITING] This multicenter study aims to characterize the language profiles of patients with various neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease (AD), Primary Progressive Aphasia (PPA), behavioral variant Frontotemporal Dementia (bvFTD), Dementia with Lewy Bodies (DLB), and Parkinson's disease (PD), using artificial intelligence (AI) models. title: Using iterative agentic retrieval-augmented generation to refine the risk of infection from social contexts during the COVID-19 pandemic: Development and Evaluation Study
zh_title: 迭代式智能体RAG细化新冠感染风险估计
summary: medRxiv 预印本开发迭代检索增强生成对话框架，基于社交互动描述与LSTM模型预测新冠感染风险。
key_points: 用19434条社交互动文本训练LSTM风险模型
将模型接入Llama3构建对话式智能体
目标是通过追问获取个性化风险因素
reason: 预印本智能体应用，场景偏公共卫生风险估计，缺乏前瞻或外部验证信息
abstract: Background: Contact tracing is crucial to limit pathogen transmission and to gather epidemiological data. However, despite machine learning optimizations, it remains time-consuming. Large language models have been used for infection risk prediction, but no existing application converses with a user to adapt its risk estimates. Objective: We aimed to develop an iterative retrieval-augmented generation conversational framework to predict coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) infection risk from textual social data. The conversational agent aims to gather personalized risk factors based on descriptions of social interactions. Methods: We trained a long short-term memory (LSTM) model to predict the risk of COVID-19 infection from 19,434 textual descriptions of social interactions, collected during the pandemic in the Leuven student community, in Belgium. We integrated this model into a Llama3.3-based conversational framework that iteratively gathers additional social information that may represent a risk of infection. We evaluated the framework using large language model (LLM)-as-a-judge metrics and by comparing its risk assessment in different social contexts. Results: Based solely on social interaction data, a fine-tuned RobBERT model predicted infection risk with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC AUC) of 0.73. It performed similarly to an LSTM model and a logistic regression on term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) features, which both achieved a ROC AUC of 0.72. These three models slightly outperformed a Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA)-fine-tuned Mistral NeMo model (ROC AUC = 0.69). Llama3.3 performed well in our framework: the predicted infection risk converged often, and it asked fewer redundant questions than the smaller models (Mistral 7B, Gemma3 12B). In addition, the framework showed the ability to stratify, by risk of infection, synthetic users who had different types of social interactions. Conclusions: Combining simple language models with large language models can refine individual infection risk from contact tracing data in a high-circulation context. Our conversational framework may help optimize contact tracing by highlighting social contexts with a high risk of infection.
zh_abstract: 【背景】接触者追踪对于限制病原体传播和收集流行病学数据至关重要。然而，尽管有机器学习优化，它仍然耗时。大语言模型已被用于感染风险预测，但现有应用中没有一种能与用户对话以调整其风险估计。【目的】我们旨在开发一种迭代式检索增强生成对话框架，用于从文本社交数据预测2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）感染风险。该对话代理旨在根据对社交互动的描述收集个性化风险因素。【方法】我们训练了一个长短期记忆（LSTM）模型，利用比利时鲁汶学生社区在大流行期间收集的19,434条文本社交互动描述来预测COVID-19感染风险。我们将该模型整合到基于Llama3.3的对话框架中，该框架迭代收集可能代表感染风险的额外社交信息。我们使用大语言模型作为评判者（LLM-as-a-judge）指标，并通过比较其在不同社交情境中的风险评估来评估该框架。【结果】仅基于社交互动数据，经过微调的RobBERT模型预测感染风险的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC AUC）为0.73。其表现与LSTM模型以及基于词频-逆文档频率（TF-IDF）特征的逻辑回归相似，后两者均达到ROC AUC 0.72。这三个模型略优于经量化低秩适配（QLoRA）微调的Mistral NeMo模型（ROC AUC = 0.69）。Llama3.3在我们的框架中表现良好：预测的感染风险经常收敛，且比更小的模型（Mistral 7B、Gemma3 12B）提出更少的冗余问题。此外，该框架显示出能够按感染风险对具有不同类型社交互动的合成用户进行分层。【结论】将简单语言模型与大语言模型结合，可以在高传播情境下根据接触者追踪数据细化个体感染风险。我们的对话框架可能通过突出具有高感染风险的社交情境来帮助优化接触者追踪。

title: External validation and clinical implementation of clinical prediction models: a systematic review.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 临床预测模型外部验证与临床落地：系统综述
summary: 横断面元流行病学研究追踪1072个机器学习临床预测模型（2017–2019年发表），发现仅9.9%完成外部验证、5.2%进入临床实施。
key_points: 1072个ML预测模型中88.1%无转化随访
公开代码与TRIPOD依从性提高转化几率
外部验证与临床实施呈阶段性而非连续路径
reason: 系统综述纳入1072项研究、结论明确，属系统综述可及7分档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To assess whether external validation and clinical implementation of clinical prediction models reflect sequential or distinct stages of a translational pathway. This cross-sectional meta-epidemiologic study analyzed 1072 machine learning-based clinical prediction models published across clinical domains (2017-2019). We assessed downstream external validation and clinical implementation via citation screening through August 2025. Evaluated exposures included public code availability, TRIPOD adherence, multicenter design, and sample size. Secondary outcomes included investigator overlap. Among 1072 studies, 88.1% lacked translational follow-up. Only 9.9% underwent external validation, and 5.2% reached clinical implementation. Code availability (odds ratio [OR] 3.04; 95% CI, 1.91-4.84) and higher TRIPOD adherence (OR 2.68 per 10% increase; 95% CI, 2.04-3.52) were significantly associated with external validation, but not consistently with clinical implementation. Notably, 39% of implemented models lacked prior external validation. Independent groups predominantly conducted external validation (72.6%), whereas implementation frequently involved original development teams. Findings indicate a divergence in algorithmic translation. Characteristics emphasizing evaluability (code availability, reporting transparency) facilitate external validation but do not ensure clinical implementation. The frequent bypass of independent validation before implementation highlights a reliance on institutional and operational factors rather than generalizable methodology. External validation and clinical implementation appear to represent distinct translational processes rather than sequential stages influenced by a uniform set of factors. Current practices facilitate validation but inadequately address operational requirements for real-world deployment.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 评估临床预测模型的外部验证和临床实施是否反映转化路径中的连续阶段还是不同阶段。这项横断面元流行病学研究分析了 2017-2019 年在各临床领域发表的 1072 个基于机器学习的临床预测模型。我们通过截至 2025 年 8 月的引文筛选评估了下游外部验证和临床实施。评估的暴露因素包括公共代码可用性、TRIPOD 依从性、多中心设计和样本量。次要结局包括研究者重叠。在 1072 项研究中，88.1% 缺乏转化随访。仅 9.9% 进行了外部验证，5.2% 达到临床实施。代码可用性（比值比 [OR] 3.04；95% CI，1.91-4.84）和更高的 TRIPOD 依从性（每增加 10%，OR 2.68；95% CI，2.04-3.52）与外部验证显著相关，但与临床实施并不一致相关。值得注意的是，39% 已实施的模型缺乏先前外部验证。独立团队主要进行外部验证（72.6%），而实施常涉及原始开发团队。研究结果表明算法转化存在分歧。强调可评估性的特征（代码可用性、报告透明度）促进外部验证，但不确保临床实施。实施前经常绕过独立验证，凸显对机构和操作因素的依赖，而非可推广的方法学。外部验证和临床实施似乎代表不同的转化过程，而不是受一组统一因素影响的连续阶段。当前实践促进了验证，但不足以满足真实世界部署的操作要求。

title: Interpretable graph learning of spatial TME patterns in digital pathology for gastric cancer prognosis
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: 数字病理空间肿瘤微环境图学习预测胃癌预后
summary: 提出可解释的GTMA框架，把全切片图像建模为空间图，在1871例队列与TCGA-STAD中验证其预后价值。
key_points: GTMA将全切片图像建模为空间图，刻画组织交互
在1871例大队列及TCGA-STAD（213例）中验证
风险评分可补充TNM分期，识别同期同亚型高危患者
reason: 大样本并含外部数据集验证，但为回顾性预后研究，无临床结局，属重要档
abstract: Current gastric cancer (GC) risk stratification, based on TNM staging and molecular subtypes, often fails to capture intratumoral heterogeneity driving variable outcomes. Although the tumor microenvironment (TME) spatial architecture within histopathological images holds critical prognostic value, quantifying these interactions remains challenging. We present the Graph-based Tumor Microenvironment Aggregation (GTMA) framework, an interpretable deep learning approach modeling whole-slide images as spatial graphs to decipher tissue interactions. Validated in a large cohort ( n = 1871) and TCGA-STAD dataset ( n = 213), the GTMA-derived Risk Score (RS) provided prognostic information complementary to TNM staging and clinical models. Notably, the RS stratified patients into distinct risk groups within identical TNM stages and molecular subtypes, identifying high-risk patients traditionally overlooked. Integrative analysis revealed high-RS tumors feature a fibroblast-dominant, immune-excluded phenotype and distinct stromal spatial patterns. By linking digital pathology to biological TME patterns, GTMA offers a robust, interpretable AI tool for individualized prognostic risk stratification and precision oncology in GC.
zh_abstract: 当前基于TNM分期和分子亚型的胃癌（GC）风险分层，常常无法捕捉导致结局差异的瘤内异质性。尽管组织病理学图像中的肿瘤微环境（TME）空间结构具有关键预后价值，但量化这些相互作用仍然具有挑战性。我们提出基于图的肿瘤微环境聚合（GTMA）框架，这是一种可解释的深度学习方法，将全切片图像建模为空间图以解析组织相互作用。在一个大型队列（n = 1871）和TCGA-STAD数据集（n = 213）中验证后，GTMA衍生的风险评分（RS）提供了与TNM分期和临床模型互补的预后信息。值得注意的是，RS在相同TNM分期和分子亚型内将患者分为不同风险组，识别出传统上被忽视的高风险患者。整合分析显示，高RS肿瘤具有成纤维细胞主导、免疫排斥的表型以及独特的间质空间模式。通过将数字病理学与生物学TME模式联系起来，GTMA为GC的个体化预后风险分层和精准肿瘤学提供了一种稳健、可解释的AI工具。

title: AnySleep: a channel-agnostic deep learning system for high-resolution sleep staging in multi-center cohorts
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: AnySleep：跨中心通道无关的高分辨率睡眠分期系统
summary: AnySleep可从任意EEG或EOG信号按可调时间分辨率进行睡眠分期，在28个数据集、逾2万夜记录上训练验证。
key_points: 对任意EEG/EOG通道配置，时间分辨率可调
训练验证覆盖28个数据集、逾20万小时信号
多中心泛化表现达当前最优水平
reason: 多中心大规模数据（28数据集、2万夜）验证，泛化性强，但未报告临床结局，属重要档
abstract: Sleep is essential for health, yet studying its dynamics requires manual sleep staging, a labor-intensive step in research and clinical care. Across centers, polysomnography (PSG) recordings are traditionally scored in 30-s epochs for pragmatic, not physiological, reasons and vary in electrode count, montage, and subject characteristics. These constraints challenge harmonized multi-center studies and the discovery of robust biomarkers on shorter timescales. We present AnySleep, a deep neural network that scores sleep from any electroencephalography (EEG) or electrooculography (EOG) data at adjustable temporal resolutions. We trained and validated the model on over 20,000 overnight recordings (>200,000 h of EEG and EOG) from 28 datasets across multiple clinics to promote robust generalization across sites. The model attains state-of-the-art performance and surpasses or equals established baselines at 30-s epochs. Performance improves with more channels, yet remains strong when EOG is absent, or only EOG or single EEG derivations (frontal, central, or occipital) are available. On sub-30-s timescales, the model captures short wake intrusions consistent with arousals and improves the prediction of pathophysiological conditions (obstructive sleep apnea, narcolepsy type 1, insomnia) over 30-s scoring. We make the model publicly available to facilitate large-scale studies with heterogeneous electrode setups and accelerate biomarker discovery in sleep.
zh_abstract: 睡眠对健康至关重要，但研究其动态变化需要人工睡眠分期，这是研究和临床护理中一项劳动密集型步骤。在不同中心，多导睡眠图（PSG）记录传统上以30秒epoch进行判读，这是出于实用性而非生理学原因，并且电极数量、导联组合和受试者特征各不相同。这些限制对协调一致的多中心研究以及在更短时间尺度上发现稳健生物标志物构成挑战。我们提出AnySleep，一种深度神经网络，可在可调的时间分辨率下从任何脑电图（EEG）或眼电图（EOG）数据中判读睡眠。我们在来自多个诊所的28个数据集、超过20,000次整夜记录（>200,000小时EEG和EOG）上训练并验证该模型，以促进跨站点的稳健泛化。该模型达到最先进性能，并在30秒epoch上超过或等于已有基线。性能随通道增多而提高，但在EOG缺失，或仅有EOG或单导EEG导出（额区、中央区或枕区）时仍保持较强。在低于30秒的时间尺度上，模型捕捉到与觉醒一致的短暂清醒侵入，并较30秒判读改善了对病理生理状况（阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停、1型发作性睡病、失眠）的预测。我们公开该模型，以促进具有异质电极设置的大规模研究，并加速睡眠中的生物标志物发现。

title: Accuracy and impact of an AI safety system for missed specialist referrals in primary care
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: 初级保健漏诊专科转诊AI安全系统的准确性与影响
summary: 在新加坡七家基层诊所准实验评估MR-AI识别咨询记录中漏开的专科转诊，并与医生复核比较。
key_points: 每周扫描约2.5万份记录，漏诊检出提升约七倍
428例标记中225例经医生核实
与七名医生盲法比较，PPV 61.8% 对 51.8%
reason: 七家诊所准实验部署、真实工作流检出提升并与医生头对头比较，属重要档
abstract: Missed specialist referrals in primary care pose substantial health and medico-legal risks, yet remain poorly understood. We developed an AI-supported safety system (MR-AI) to identify missed referrals from consultation notes, evaluated in a quasi-experimental study across seven primary care clinics in Singapore. MR-AI scanned ~25,000 notes weekly for referral intent without a corresponding order, achieving an estimated sevenfold increase in weekly missed referral detection (4.7 percentage point level increase; 95% CI 0.024–0.069; p < 0.001). Of 428 cases flagged, 225 were clinician-verified, alongside 31 patient-reported cases, yielding 256 total detections. MR-AI demonstrated 99.9% specificity and 48.8% sensitivity. In a blinded one-week comparison against seven physician reviewers, MR-AI achieved a PPV of 61.8% versus a human confirmation rate of 51.8% across 83 flagged cases, while requiring approximately 41 fewer projected staff-hours. AI-enabled surveillance substantially assisted in missed referral detection, though sustainable improvement will require complementary preventive workflow changes and future cost-effectiveness assessment.
zh_abstract: 基层医疗中遗漏专科转诊会带来重大的健康和医疗法律风险，但对此仍知之甚少。我们开发了一种人工智能支持的安全系统（MR-AI），用于从就诊记录中识别遗漏的转诊，并在新加坡七家基层医疗诊所开展的一项准实验研究中进行了评估。MR-AI每周扫描约25,000份记录，查找有转诊意图但无相应医嘱的情况，估计使每周遗漏转诊检出增加七倍（水平提高4.7个百分点；95% CI 0.024–0.069；p < 0.001）。在428例被标记的病例中，225例经临床医生核实，另有31例为患者报告病例，合计256例检出。MR-AI的特异性为99.9%，敏感性为48.8%。在与7名医师审阅者进行的为期一周的盲法比较中，在83例被标记病例中，MR-AI的阳性预测值（PPV）为61.8%，而人工确认率为51.8%，同时预计所需工作人员工时约减少41小时。人工智能支持的监测在很大程度上协助了遗漏转诊的检出，但可持续改善将需要配套的预防性工作流程变革以及未来的成本效益评估。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] We audited deployment readiness of an end-of-surgery postoperative infection model across clinically relevant subgroups and assessed mitigation of subgroup miscalibration. We analyzed out-of-fold predictions from 10 719 procedures (2014-2022) with 504 present-on-admission (POA)-coded postoperative infection events across recorded sex, age, and a clinical physiological-reserve proxy. We assessed discrimination, calibration, threshold-specific errors, and decision-curve net benefit, treating t = 0.10 as a reference anchor. We compared no recalibration with common and group-specific cross-fitted isotonic recalibration, evaluated a refit without the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE), and performed a temporal-holdout analysis. Overall area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.876, with similar sex-marginal discrimination in women and men (0.878 vs 0.875). Calibration-in-the-large was -1.02 overall, -0.86 in frail, and -1.34 in prefrail patients; the 6-event nonfrail stratum was not estimable. At t = 0.10, net benefit was positive in frail and negative in prefrail patients in the source cohort, but negative prefrail utility did not persist in the ascertainable-period (2018-2022) and temporal analyses. Common recalibration moved overall calibration-in-the-large from -1.020 to -0.007. Removing SMOTE shifted overall calibration but did not reduce the reserve gradient. Temporal-holdout AUROC was 0.851 with persistent overprediction. Present-on-admission coding was effectively absent before 2018; prevalence-dependent results were therefore additionally reported for the ascertainable 2018-2022 period, and ascertainment differed by physiological reserve. Discrimination-only or sex-marginal evaluation would have missed deployment-relevant subgroup heterogeneity, while endpoint ascertainment affected prevalence-dependent interpretation. Joint subgroup evaluation can identify deployment-relevant limitations missed by aggregate metrics. Prospective validation with comparable outcome ascertainment remains necessary before clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学协会杂志：JAMIA] 我们审计了一个手术结束时术后感染模型在临床相关亚组中的部署就绪度，并评估了对亚组校准不良的缓解情况。我们分析了10 719例手术（2014-2022年）的折外预测，其中包含504例入院时存在（present-on-admission，POA）编码的术后感染事件，并按记录的性别、年龄和一个临床生理储备替代指标进行分析。我们评估了区分度、校准、阈值特异性错误和决策曲线净获益，将 t = 0.10 作为参考锚点。我们将不重新校准与共同的和组特异性的交叉拟合等渗重校准进行比较，评估了不使用合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）的重新拟合，并进行了时间留出分析。总体受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.876，女性和男性的性别边际区分度相似（0.878 vs 0.875）。整体校准（calibration-in-the-large）总体为 -1.02，衰弱患者为 -0.86，前衰弱患者为 -1.34；6个事件的非衰弱层不可估计。在 t = 0.10 时，源队列中衰弱患者的净获益为正，前衰弱患者为负，但前衰弱患者的负效用未在可确定期（2018-2022年）和时间分析中持续存在。共同重校准将总体整体校准从 -1.020 变为 -0.007。移除SMOTE改变了总体校准，但未降低储备梯度。时间留出 AUROC 为 0.851，并持续存在过度预测。入院时存在编码在2018年前实际上缺失；因此，还报告了可确定期2018-2022年的患病率依赖结果，且确定情况因生理储备而异。仅区分度或性别边际评估会漏掉与部署相关的亚组异质性，而终点确定影响患病率依赖的解释。联合亚组评估可以识别被总体指标漏掉的部署相关局限性。在临床部署前，仍需要具有可比结局确定的前瞻性验证。

title: Training language models in simulation for psychiatric intake
zh_title: 模拟环境强化学习训练精神科接诊语言模型
summary: 预印本显示，多轮强化学习训练的模型在结构化精神科接诊中优于同源基座模型。
key_points: 随机双盲交叉，120次访谈
15名精神科医师独立盲评记录

reason: 随机双盲交叉+精神科医师盲评属重要档，但为预印本且场景模拟，不给更高
abstract: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ($p < 0.0001$), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ($d_z = 0.77$, $p < 0.0001$), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, $p < 0.001$), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, $p < 0.001$). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model's clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, $p < 0.0001$). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, $p < 0.0001$). Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters, though residual gaps require safeguards and clinician oversight.
zh_abstract: 在精神科实践中，临床接诊访谈仍是主要的诊断工具，要求临床医生在建立融洽关系的同时，理清复杂且相互重叠的表现。在此，我们展示，模拟环境中的多轮强化学习（reinforcement learning, RL）可提高语言模型在结构化文本精神科接诊中的表现，涵盖病史采集、鉴别诊断和初始管理计划。在一项随机、双盲交叉研究中（$N = 60$ 对匹配场景，120次接诊），将经RL训练的智能体与接受相同提示的基础模型进行比较，32名委员会认证的精神科医生角色扮演标准化患者，而由另一个由15名独立、委员会认证的精神科医生组成的小组对去标识化转录文本进行评分。训练后智能体在76.7%的匹配场景对中优于基础模型（$p < 0.0001$），并在改编的临床检查评分量表（$d_z = 0.77$，$p < 0.0001$）、以患者为中心的沟通（82.0% 对 65.2%，$p < 0.001$）和鉴别诊断适当性（68.3% 对 33.3%，$p < 0.001$）方面均有改善。在127个经精神科医生验证的模拟接诊场景中，训练后智能体的临床评分量表得分几乎为基础模型的两倍（0.706 对 0.379；复合奖励 0.564 对 0.294，$p < 0.0001$）。为系统探究对话安全性，我们建立了两个德尔菲共识分类体系，分别关于临床安全风险和关系能力，并从中衍生出256个具有挑战性的对抗性表现；我们发现，在模拟环境中进行训练使急性安全风险的分诊不足减少了一半以上（12.9% 对 30.5%，$p < 0.0001$）。因此，模拟环境为训练和压力测试精神科对话智能体提供了受控测试平台，其收益可迁移至由精神科医生实施的接诊中，但残余差距仍需要保障措施和临床医生监督。

title: An uncertainty-aware deep learning-based registration model for adaptive lung cancer radiotherapy.
source: PubMed · Physics in medicine and biology
zh_title: 不确定性感知深度学习配准模型用于肺癌自适应放疗
summary: 提出变分贝叶斯配准模型TransMorph-prob，预测位移场均值与方差，用于肺癌MR引导放疗的剂量累积不确定性评估。
key_points: 变分贝叶斯模型预测体素级位移场均值与方差

abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] To develop a deep learning (DL) based probabilistic 3D deformable image registration framework for uncertainty-aware dose accumulation in magnetic resonance imaging-guided radiotherapy (MRgRT) of lung cancer. Approach: We propose TransMorph-prob (TM-prob), a variational Bayesian model that predicts the voxel-wise mean and variance of dense displacement fields (DDFs). Two TM-prob models were trained on an internal CT dataset (725 patients) and a low-field MR-linac dataset (102 patients), and benchmarked against Monte Carlo dropout TransMorph (TM-MCD) and DIRUncertainty with B-spline initialization (ASDIR) on the DIRLAB 4DCT dataset (10 patients, 3000 landmarks), and an annotated MR-linac dataset (16 patients, 107 image pairs, 227 landmarks) with target and seven organ-at-risk (OAR) contours. Both datasets contained an additional 1239/13,289 algorithm-generated landmarks. Performance was evaluated using target registration error (TRE), Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), landmark- and voxel-wise expected calibration errors (LECE/ECE), and dose distributions derived from 2000 DDF samples per patient. Main results: On the DIRLAB dataset, TM-prob achieved a median TRE of \qty{1.8}{\mm}/\qty{2.8}{\mm} on manual/algorithm-generated landmarks, versus \qty{1.3}{\mm}/\qty{2.4}{\mm} for ASDIR and \qty{2.1}{\mm}/\qty{3.0}{\mm} for TM-MCD. On the MRI dataset, TM-prob achieved the median TRE of \qty{3.9}{\mm}/\qty{2.6}{\mm} and a mean DSC of 0.87, matching ASDIR (\qty{3.3}{\mm}/\qty{2.7}{\mm}, and DSC of 0.87) while outperforming TM-MCD (\qty{4.4}{\mm}/\qty{2.9}{\mm}, and 0.84). In uncertainty calibration, TM-prob achieved a LECE of \qty{1.74}{\mm}/\qty{0.30}{\mm} on MRI manual/algorithm-generated landmarks versus \qty{2.41}{\mm}/\qty{0.56}{\mm} for ASDIR and \qty{6.65}{\mm}/\qty{3.92}{\mm} for TM-MCD, and an average contour ECE of 5.8% versus 7.0% and 21.2%. Two patients with indistinct GTV boundaries exhibited substantially wider target D95 distributions, demonstrating that calibrated DDF uncertainty translates into clinically relevant dose-coverage uncertainty. Significance: TM-prob is an end-to-end DL model, achieving fast, well-calibrated, uncertainty-aware registration for lung cancer patients, enabling reliable DDF uncertainty propagation into dose accumulation for clinical decision-making in online adaptive radiotherapy.
zh_abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] 【目的】开发一个基于深度学习（DL）的概率性 3D 可变形图像配准框架，用于肺癌磁共振成像引导放疗（MRgRT）中考虑不确定性的剂量累积。【方法】我们提出 TransMorph-prob（TM-prob），一种变分贝叶斯模型，可预测稠密位移场（DDF）的体素级均值和方差。两个 TM-prob 模型分别在内部 CT 数据集（725 名患者）和低场 MR-linac 数据集（102 名患者）上训练，并在 DIRLAB 4DCT 数据集（10 名患者，3000 个标志点）和带靶区及七个危及器官（OAR）轮廓标注的 MR-linac 数据集（16 名患者，107 对图像，227 个标志点）上与蒙特卡洛 dropout TransMorph（TM-MCD）和带 B 样条初始化的 DIRUncertainty（ASDIR）进行基准比较。两个数据集额外包含 1239/13,289 个算法生成标志点。性能使用靶区配准误差（TRE）、Dice 相似系数（DSC）、标志点和体素级期望校准误差（LECE/ECE），以及每名患者 2000 个 DDF 样本得出的剂量分布进行评估。【主要结果】在 DIRLAB 数据集上，TM-prob 在手动/算法生成标志点上的中位 TRE 为 1.8 mm/2.8 mm，而 ASDIR 为 1.3 mm/2.4 mm，TM-MCD 为 2.1 mm/3.0 mm。在 MRI 数据集上，TM-prob 的中位 TRE 为 3.9 mm/2.6 mm，平均 DSC 为 0.87，与 ASDIR（3.3 mm/2.7 mm，DSC 为 0.87）相当，同时优于 TM-MCD（4.4 mm/2.9 mm，DSC 为 0.84）。在不确定性校准中，TM-prob 在 MRI 手动/算法生成标志点上的 LECE 为 1.74 mm/0.30 mm，而 ASDIR 为 2.41 mm/0.56 mm，TM-MCD 为 6.65 mm/3.92 mm；平均轮廓 ECE 为 5.8%，而 ASDIR 和 TM-MCD 分别为 7.0% 和 21.2%。两名 GTV 边界不清的患者表现出明显更宽的目标 D95 分布，表明校准后的 DDF 不确定性可转化为临床相关的剂量覆盖不确定性。【意义】TM-prob 是一种端到端 DL 模型，为肺癌患者实现快速、校准良好且考虑不确定性的配准，使 DDF 不确定性能够可靠传播到剂量累积中，用于在线自适应放疗的临床决策。

abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are proposed for clinical prediction but are untested in pediatrics, where cohorts are small and outcomes are uncommon. Using records from 2,489 youth with type 2 diabetes (T2D) and 4,018 with type 1 diabetes (T1D), spanning structured data, note-derived social determinants and, in T1D, continuous glucose monitoring data, we predicted seven T2D outcomes, four also in T1D, at 24 months from 18 months of follow-up. CEDAR (Clinical Evidence-Driven Agent for Risk-prediction), an evidence-citing, self-auditing LLM pipeline, outperformed trained machine learning in both cohorts (pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.815 versus 0.656 to 0.700 in T2D and 0.756 versus 0.603 to 0.631 in T1D), most on the sparsely screened outcomes. Only 4 of 70,246 values it cited did not match the chart. Reading only the evidence and reasoning cited by CEDAR, two pediatric endocrinologists reached the same prediction as CEDAR in about nine of ten cases, agreeing with each other on 90.5%.

abstract: [ERJ open research] Diagnosis of asthma and/or COPD is challenging due to overlapping clinical and physiological characteristics; however, due to varying treatment recommendations, determining the correct diagnosis is vital to clinical care. Hyperpolarised xenon-129 ventilation (129Xe)-magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provides high spatial resolution three-dimensional images of gas distribution within the lungs. Recently, artificial intelligence (AI)-based models have successfully classified pulmonary pathologies via medical images, but due to their black-box nature, clinical application is challenging. Here, we aim to develop an explainable AI framework to classify patients with asthma and/or COPD using 129Xe-MRI alone. 129Xe-MRI from 207 patients with asthma and/or COPD were classified using a vision transformer (ViT) and a convolutional neural network (CNN). Regional visualisations of areas of importance (AOIs) associated with each diagnosis were generated. Regional patterns were investigated to develop a shape-based metric which quantified asthma-like and COPD-like features. The ViT accurately classified asthma and/or COPD patients in 83% (n=25/30) of cases (area under the curve (AUC) 0.86, F1 score 0.82), outperforming the CNN (AUC 0.71, F1 score 0.62). Patients with asthma had more diffuse, elongated AOIs associated with disease grouping while patients with COPD had more focal, spherical AOIs. The proposed sphericity score weakly correlated with conventional lung function metrics in clinically understandable ways. When applied to patients with overlapping features of asthma and COPD (asthma+COPD), the classification framework informed the prevalence and regional distribution of asthma-like and COPD-like features. Explainable AI classification of 129Xe-MRI could facilitate diagnosis of patients with asthma and/or COPD, including determining the prevalence of asthma-like or COPD-like features in patients with asthma+COPD, potentially informing management and treatment.
zh_abstract: [ERJ开放研究] 哮喘和/或COPD的诊断具有挑战性，因为临床和生理特征存在重叠；然而，由于治疗建议不同，确定正确诊断对临床诊疗至关重要。超极化氙-129通气（129Xe）磁共振成像（MRI）可提供肺部内气体分布的高空间分辨率三维图像。最近，基于人工智能（AI）的模型已通过医学图像成功对肺部病变进行分类，但由于其黑箱性质，临床应用具有挑战性。在此，我们旨在开发一个可解释的AI框架，仅使用129Xe-MRI对哮喘和/或COPD患者进行分类。使用视觉Transformer（ViT）和卷积神经网络（CNN）对207例哮喘和/或COPD患者的129Xe-MRI进行分类。生成了与每种诊断相关的重要区域（areas of importance，AOIs）的区域可视化。研究了区域模式，以开发一种基于形状的指标，该指标量化了哮喘样和COPD样特征。ViT在83%（n=25/30）的病例中准确分类了哮喘和/或COPD患者（曲线下面积（AUC）0.86，F1分数0.82），优于CNN（AUC 0.71，F1分数0.62）。哮喘患者具有与疾病分组相关的更弥漫、细长的AOI，而COPD患者具有更局灶、球形的AOI。所提出的球形度评分以临床可理解的方式与传统肺功能指标弱相关。当应用于具有哮喘和COPD重叠特征的患者（asthma+COPD）时，该分类框架提供了哮喘样和COPD样特征的患病率和区域分布信息。129Xe-MRI的可解释AI分类可促进哮喘和/或COPD患者的诊断，包括确定asthma+COPD患者中哮喘样或COPD样特征的患病率，可能为管理和治疗提供信息。

title: Artificial intelligence-powered solutions for environmental sustainability in medical imaging: a scoping review.
source: PubMed · Diagnostic and interventional radiology (Ankara, Turkey)

summary: 范围综述检索八个数据库，纳入23项研究，梳理AI用于降低医学影像环境影响的可能途径。
key_points: 检索8个数据库，纳入23项研究
采用JBI清单评估偏倚风险

reason: 范围综述，主题偏可持续性、与临床AI效能关联弱，综述上限内偏低调
abstract: [Diagnostic and interventional radiology (Ankara, Turkey)] Growing evidence shows that medical imaging has a substantial environmental impact. With the increasing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in clinical settings, it is important to explore how this technology may support environmental sustainability. Literature searches were performed across eight databases (PubMed, Wiley Online Library, Embase, Web of Science platform, the Cochrane Library, Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature Ultimate, Google Scholar, and MedRxiv) for the period January 2020-June 2026. Full-text sources in the English language were eligible for inclusion. The Joanna Briggs Institute checklists were employed for risk of bias assessment. All data were analyzed using a textual narrative synthesis. In total, 23 studies were deemed eligible for inclusion. The literature proposed that AI tools in medical imaging could be used to minimize energy consumption by optimizing patient scheduling, decreasing scanner idle times and workstation use, reducing computed tomography over-scanning, contrast agent usage, and radiation dose, harnessing low-field magnetic resonance imaging, and curtailing low-value imaging. However, AI technologies may also impact the environment in harmful ways. Although AI-powered solutions hold promise for improving sustainability in medical imaging, the true environmental impact remains largely unexplored. The findings of this work further strengthen the dual role of AI adoption in medical imaging related to environmental sustainability.
zh_abstract: [诊断与介入放射学（Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology，安卡拉，土耳其）] 越来越多的证据表明，医学影像具有显著的环境影响。随着人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）在临床环境中的采用日益增加，探索该技术如何支持环境可持续性十分重要。文献检索覆盖八个数据库（PubMed、Wiley Online Library、Embase、Web of Science 平台、Cochrane Library、Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature Ultimate、Google Scholar 和 MedRxiv），检索时段为2020年1月至2026年6月。英文全文来源符合纳入条件。采用 Joanna Briggs Institute 清单进行偏倚风险评估。所有数据均采用文本叙述综合进行分析。共有23项研究被认为符合纳入条件。文献提出，医学影像中的AI工具可通过优化患者排程、减少扫描仪空闲时间和工作站使用、减少计算机断层扫描过度扫描、对比剂使用和辐射剂量、利用低场磁共振成像以及削减低价值影像检查来最小化能耗。然而，AI技术也可能以有害方式影响环境。尽管AI驱动的解决方案有望改善医学影像的可持续性，其真实环境影响仍在很大程度上未被探索。本研究结果进一步强化了医学影像中AI采用与环境可持续性相关的双重作用。

title: AI-Assisted Instruction Versus Peer Learning for Sustained Lumbar Puncture Competency
zh_title: AI 辅助教学与同伴学习对腰椎穿刺技能保持的比较
summary: ClinicalTrials.gov 新注册、已完成但无结果的随机试验，比较传统床旁、同伴互助与 AI 智能模拟人三种腰椎穿刺教学方法。
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Second Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University, School of Medicine; conditions: Lumbar Puncture; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 100; status: COMPLETED] This study compared three teaching methods for training resident physicians in lumbar puncture, a critical medical procedure used to collect spinal fluid for diagnosing conditions like meningitis. One hundred thirty-five residents were randomly assigned to either traditional bedside teaching, peer-assisted learning (where trainees practiced in pairs and gave each other feedback), or artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted training using a smart simulator that provided real-time voice feedback on technique. All residents were tested immediately after training and again three months later to see how well they retained their skills. Right after training, all three groups performed equally well. However, after three months, both the peer-learning and AI groups scored significantly higher on practical skills than the traditional group, showing that these newer methods help slow skill decay. The AI group showed the greatest advantages in procedural standardization, pre-procedure assessment, post-procedure care, and operating speed. Meanwhile, residents in the peer-learning group reported the highest satisfaction with classroom interaction and teaching methods. In short, while all three approaches work well for short-term training, AI-assisted and peer-assisted learning are more effective than traditional teaching at helping residents maintain their lumbar puncture skills over time, with AI excelling in technical precision and efficiency, and peer learning offering a more engaging and collaborative learning experience.

title: Multiscale Spatial Characterization of Glioma MRI with MUSE and Radiomics
zh_title: MUSE 与影像组学对胶质瘤 MRI 的多尺度空间刻画
summary: medRxiv 预印本在 UCSF-PDGM 公开数据 416 例胶质瘤 MRI 上评估 MUSE 变差函数场与方向性影像组学特征的一致性。

416 例有 MUSE 输出，其中 375 例有配对 GLCM 测量

abstract: Purpose. Characterizing glioma heterogeneity requires measurements that retain the physical scale and orientation of intratumoral intensity dependence. We evaluate the original 3D variographic field produced by the MUSE tool (Modeling Uncertainty as a Support for the Environment) alongside directional radiomics and independent image-based molecular classification. Methods. We analyzed postcontrast T1-weighted magnetic resonance images and enhancing-tumor segmentations from the public UCSF-PDGM collection. Verified MUSE outputs were available for 416 independent baseline patients, of whom 375 had paired directional gray-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) measurements. Each MUSE field retained 328 original experimental directional variograms with physical lag distances, semivariances, orientations, and voxel-pair support. Agreement was assessed at aligned offsets and through between-tumor comparisons. Patient-level permutation tests evaluated associations with isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) status on 2,508 native direction-lag coordinates. A standalone 3D residual convolutional neural network (CNN) provided a separate IDH classification benchmark. Results. At 9,371 geometrically aligned offsets, native MUSE semivariance and half GLCM contrast correlated strongly (Pearson r = 0.954). Across 31,599 eligible between-tumor comparisons, representation-level dissimilarities showed Spearman {rho}_S = 0.862, with sensitivity to GLCM feature family and long-offset sampling support. In 364 grade-4 tumors, including 24 IDH-mutant cases, the original MUSE field was associated with IDH after conventional adjustment (global permutation p = 0.00050), but the association was attenuated after primary directional GLCM adjustment (p = 0.256). The independent CNN achieved an out-of-fold IDH ROC-AUC of 0.792 and PR-AUC of 0.414 across 416 patients. Native MUSE examples revealed scale- and direction-dependent spatial behavior, including distances beyond those sampled by the GLCM protocol. Conclusion. Variograms by MUSE provide a physically indexed description of tumor spatial heterogeneity that can accompany radiomic analysis and CNN classification. The observed statistical overlap is substantial, and incremental clinical discrimination beyond directional GLCM features remains unestablished.
zh_abstract: 【目的】描述胶质瘤异质性需要保留瘤内强度依赖的物理尺度和方向的测量。我们评估由 MUSE 工具（Modeling Uncertainty as a Support for the Environment）生成的原始 3D 变异函数场（variographic field），并与方向性影像组学和独立的基于图像的分子分类进行比较。【方法】我们分析了来自公开 UCSF-PDGM 集合的增强后 T1 加权磁共振图像和增强肿瘤分割。416 名独立基线患者有经验证的 MUSE 输出，其中 375 名有配对的方向性灰度共生矩阵（GLCM）测量。每个 MUSE 场保留 328 个原始实验方向变异函数，包含物理滞后距离、半方差、方向和体素对支持。在对齐偏移处以及通过肿瘤间比较评估一致性。患者水平置换检验在 2,508 个原生方向-滞后坐标上评估与异柠檬酸脱氢酶（IDH）状态的关联。一个独立的 3D 残差卷积神经网络（CNN）提供单独的 IDH 分类基准。【结果】在 9,371 个几何对齐偏移处，原生 MUSE 半方差与半数 GLCM 对比度强相关（Pearson r = 0.954）。在 31,599 次符合条件的肿瘤间比较中，表示水平差异显示 Spearman ρ_S = 0.862，并对 GLCM 特征家族和长偏移采样支持敏感。在 364 例 4 级肿瘤中，包括 24 例 IDH 突变病例，原始 MUSE 场在常规调整后与 IDH 相关（全局置换 p = 0.00050），但在主要方向性 GLCM 调整后关联减弱（p = 0.256）。独立 CNN 在 416 名患者中取得 IDH 的折外（out-of-fold）ROC-AUC 为 0.792，PR-AUC 为 0.414。原生 MUSE 示例揭示尺度和方向依赖的空间行为，包括超出 GLCM 协议采样范围的距离。【结论】MUSE 的变异函数提供了肿瘤空间异质性的物理索引描述，可伴随影像组学分析和 CNN 分类。观察到的统计重叠很大，而超出方向性 GLCM 特征的增量临床判别仍未确立。

title: A clinical multimodal vision language foundation model with fine-grain explainability

summary: EVLF-FM覆盖10种影像模态、18个数据集共130余万样本，外部验证1.3万余例，支持诊断、视觉问答与像素级定位。

abstract: Despite their considerable promise, many current medical foundation models remain modality specific and lack transparent reasoning, limiting clinical adoption. To address this gap, we introduce Explainable Vision Language Foundation Model for Medicine (EVLF-FM), a multimodal vision language foundation model that combines broad diagnostic capabilities with fine-grained explainability. The development and testing of EVLF-FM encompassed more than 1.3 million total samples from 18 global datasets across 10 imaging modalities related to six clinical specialties: dermatology, hepatology, ophthalmology, pathology, pulmonology and radiology. External validation employed 13,443 independent test samples from 17 additional datasets across 10 imaging modalities. EVLF-FM supports disease diagnosis, visual question answering and pixel-level visual grounding with reasoning capabilities. In internal validation for disease diagnostics, EVLF-FM achieved the highest average accuracy, 0.895, outperforming leading generalist and specialist models. In medical visual grounding, EVLF-FM also achieved reasonable performance across nine modalities with average accuracy at 0.5 intersection over union (Acc@0.5) of 0.842. External testing further confirmed consistent zero-shot and few-shot performance, with competitive F1 scores despite a smaller model size. A hybrid training strategy combining supervised and visual reinforcement fine-tuning enables EVLF-FM to generate clinically interpretable explanations aligned with visual evidence. Human evaluation of these reasoning outputs using the S.C.O.R.E. framework yielded a high overall mean score of 4.25/5, supporting their clinical interpretability. Current limitations include the need for additional validation across diverse healthcare settings. Prospective clinical studies are required to evaluate the safety, effectiveness and clinical utility of EVLF-FM before routine clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: 尽管具有相当大的前景，许多当前的医学基础模型仍局限于特定模态，并缺乏透明推理，限制了临床采用。为弥补这一空白，我们引入可解释医学视觉语言基础模型（Explainable Vision Language Foundation Model for Medicine, EVLF-FM），这是一种多模态视觉语言基础模型，将广泛的诊断能力与细粒度可解释性相结合。EVLF-FM 的开发和测试涵盖来自18个全球数据集的超过130万份总样本，涉及10种成像模态，与六个临床专科相关：皮肤科、肝病科、眼科、病理科、肺科和放射科。外部验证使用了来自另外17个数据集的13,443份独立测试样本，涵盖10种成像模态。EVLF-FM 支持疾病诊断、视觉问答和具有推理能力的像素级视觉定位。在疾病诊断的内部验证中，EVLF-FM 取得最高平均准确率0.895，优于领先的通用型和专科模型。在医学视觉定位中，EVLF-FM 在九种模态上也取得了合理性能，交并比0.5下的平均准确率（Acc@0.5）为0.842。外部测试进一步证实了稳定的零样本和少样本性能，尽管模型规模较小，仍具有有竞争力的 F1 分数。结合监督学习和视觉强化微调的混合训练策略使 EVLF-FM 能够生成与视觉证据一致的临床可解释的说明。使用 S.C.O.R.E. 框架对这些推理输出进行人工评估，总体平均分高达4.25/5，支持其临床可解释性。当前局限包括需要在多样化医疗环境中进行额外验证。在常规临床部署之前，需要进行前瞻性临床研究以评估 EVLF-FM 的安全性、有效性和临床效用。

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Radiology reports serve as the definitive clinical record of imaging diagnoses, with their accuracy being directly critical to patient safety. However, amid escalating workloads, manual review remains inadequate for capturing subtle errors in reports on a large scale. Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable promise in medical text processing, previous studies have predominantly been confined to radiology report text from a single imaging modality or datasets with synthetic errors. This study aimed to evaluate the feasibility, accuracy, and generalizability of general-purpose LLMs for quality assurance of radiology report text from multiple imaging modalities (x-ray, computed tomography [CT], and magnetic resonance imaging [MRI]), multi-anatomical regions, and multicenter clinical settings, with head-to-head comparisons conducted against radiologists of varying seniority. Radiology report texts from 3 aforementioned imaging modalities and 5 anatomical regions (head, chest, abdomen, spine, and knee) were retrospectively collected from center 1 (March 2025-May 2025) and reviewed using a clinician-annotated 5-category error taxonomy (type 1: interpretive; type 2: factual). Five LLMs (Qwen3, GPT-5.4 Pro, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Llama 4, and DeepSeek-V3.1) were benchmarked on 10,000 randomly selected reports, and the best-performing model was evaluated on the full cohort. A blinded head-to-head comparison with 3 radiologists (3-10 years of experience) used a modality-stratified, error-enriched challenge set. The radiologists subsequently rated the model-generated explanations using a 5-point Likert scale. Cross-center performance was evaluated in an independent external cohort. The same 2 senior radiologists labeled reports from both centers using the same protocol, resolving disagreements by consensus. In total, 4.6% (4431/95,582) of the reports in center 1 contained at least one confirmed text internal error. zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 放射学报告是影像诊断的最终临床记录，其准确性直接对患者安全至关重要。然而，在工作量不断升级的情况下，人工审核仍不足以大规模捕捉报告中的细微错误。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在医学文本处理中已展现出相当大的前景，但既往研究主要局限于单一成像模态的放射学报告文本或包含合成错误的数据集。本研究旨在评估通用LLMs对来自多种成像模态（X射线、计算机断层扫描[CT]和磁共振成像[MRI]）、多解剖区域和多中心临床环境的放射学报告文本进行质量保证的可行性、准确性和泛化性，并与不同资历的放射科医师进行头对头比较。从中心1（2025年3月至2025年5月）回顾性收集来自上述3种成像模态和5个解剖区域（头部、胸部、腹部、脊柱和膝部）的放射学报告文本，并使用由临床医生标注的5类错误分类法（类型1：解释性；类型2：事实性）进行审核。五种LLMs（Qwen3、GPT-5.4 Pro、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Llama 4和DeepSeek-V3.1）在10,000份随机抽取的报告上进行基准测试，表现最佳的模型在完整队列上接受评估。使用按成像模态分层、错误富集的挑战集，与3名放射科医师（3-10年经验）进行盲法头对头比较。放射科医师随后使用5点Likert量表对模型生成的解释进行评分。在独立外部队列中评估跨中心性能。同两名资深放射科医师使用相同方案对来自两个中心的报告进行标注，并通过共识解决分歧。中心1共有4.6%（4431/95,582）的报告包含至少一个经确认的文本内部错误。所选模型Qwen3达到报告级灵敏度、特异度、阳性预测值和F1分数分别为0.99、0.99、0.90和0.94，在来自3种成像模态和多个解剖区域的报告中均表现良好，并且对事实性错误的检测优于解释性错误。在错误富集的挑战集中，其错误实例精确类别召回率超过放射科医师（0.96 vs 0.45-0.67；P<.001），且平均任务完成时间更短（每份报告5.80 vs 55.80-67.80秒）。

title: TRACER, a time-to-event EHR foundation model for disease detection across health systems

summary: 预印本提出基于EHR的基础模型TRACER，在两家外部医疗系统验证16种疾病1/2/5年风险预测。
key_points: 预训练覆盖4家系统450万患者
外部验证200万患者、16种疾病
按筛查可接受的低假阳性率评估
