abstract: Foundation models trained on longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) can predict clinical diagnoses years in the future, making them a potential tool for disease screening. We developed TRACER (Temporal Risk Assessment with Clinical EHR Representations), a decoder-based foundation model pretrained on data from over 4.5 million patients from four health systems, and evaluated it on 16 incident diseases at 1-, 2-, and 5-year horizons in more than 2 million patients from two health systems excluded from model development. In contrast to typical evaluations that focus on global metrics (e.g., AUROC), we measured performance at the low false-positive rates that are realistic for screening. We found that TRACER retained its discrimination in external health systems, and at 95% specificity, the patients it flagged were up to eight times more likely to be diagnosed within a year than unselected patients. Evaluating at this operating point also revealed what global metrics alone did not: detection and false-alert burden varied across diseases and health systems, even when discrimination appeared stable. Our results illustrate the potential of foundation models for screening and underscore the need for evaluation in health systems excluded from development to assess disease detection and false-alert burden at levels appropriate for intended clinical use.}
zh_abstract: 基于纵向电子健康记录（EHRs）训练的基础模型能够预测未来数年的临床诊断，使其成为疾病筛查的潜在工具。我们开发了 TRACER（Temporal Risk Assessment with Clinical EHR Representations），这是一个基于解码器的基础模型，在来自四个卫生系统的超过 450 万名患者的数据上预训练，并在来自两个未参与模型开发的卫生系统的超过 200 万名患者中，对 16 种新发疾病在 1 年、2 年和 5 年时间范围内的预测进行了评估。与关注全局指标（如 AUROC）的典型评估不同，我们在符合筛查实际的低假阳性率下测量性能。我们发现 TRACER 在外部卫生系统中保持了区分能力；在 95% 特异度下，其标记的患者在一年内被诊断的可能性最高可达未筛选患者的八倍。在这一操作点进行评估还揭示了仅靠全局指标无法显示的内容：即使区分能力看起来稳定，检出负担和误报警负担也因疾病和卫生系统而异。我们的结果说明了基础模型用于筛查的潜力，并强调需要在未参与开发的卫生系统中进行评估，以在适合预期临床使用的水平上评估疾病检出和误报警负担。

title: GeoMind: Dancing with Geometric Brain Rhythm on Symmetric Positive Definite Manifolds.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: GeoMind：对称正定流形上的几何脑节律建模
summary: 提出基于对称正定流形与状态空间模型的深度学习方法，刻画脑功能连接的自组织动态演化。
key_points: 将脑状态演化视为自组织动力系统
在SPD黎曼流形上刻画功能连接共激活几何
发表于IEEE TMI的方法类研究
reason: 功能神经影像方法创新，但条目未见外部验证或临床结局信息
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] State space model (SSM) is a powerful tool in neuroscience field to characterize the dynamic nature of brain functions by elucidating the mechanism of how brain system transits between brain states and how underlying states give rise to the observed neural activities. Although tremendous efforts have been made to lend the power of deep learning and mathematical insight of SSM in various functional neuroimaging studies, current state-of-the-art methods lack a holistic view of brain state evolution as a self-organized dynamical system where each part of the brain is functionally inter-connected. Since the topological co-activation of functional fluctuations exhibits an intrinsic geometric pattern (symmetric and positive definite, SPD) on the Riemannian manifold, the call for understanding how a selective set of functional connectivities in the brain supports diverse behavior and cognition emerge a new machine learning scenario of manifold-based SSM for largescale functional neuroimages. To that end, we propose a geometric neural network of SSM, coined GeoMind, designed to uncover evolving brain states by tracking the trajectory of functional dynamics on a high-dimensional Riemannian manifold of SPD matrices. GeoMind demonstrates promising results in identifying specific brain states on task-based functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) data, as well as in diseases early diagnosis for Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and Autism, by using resting-state fMRI. These results highlight the applicability of GeoMind in neuroscience research. To further evaluate generalizability of GeoMind, we applied GeoMind to electroencephalography (EEG) emotion datasets, outperforming competing methods and demonstrating scalability across neuroimaging modalities.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 状态空间模型（SSM）是神经科学领域中的一个强大工具，可通过阐明大脑系统如何在不同脑状态之间转换以及潜在状态如何产生观察到的神经活动的机制，来刻画脑功能的动态特性。尽管已在各种功能神经影像研究中投入大量努力，以借助深度学习的威力与SSM的数学洞见，当前最先进的方法仍缺乏一种整体视角，即把脑状态演化视为一个自组织的动力系统，其中大脑各部分在功能上相互连接。由于功能波动的拓扑共激活在黎曼流形上表现出一种内在几何模式（对称正定，SPD），理解大脑中一组选择性功能连接如何支持多样行为与认知的需求，催生了一个新的机器学习场景：面向大规模功能神经影像的基于流形的SSM。为此，我们提出一种SSM的几何神经网络，命名为GeoMind，旨在通过追踪SPD矩阵高维黎曼流形上功能动力学的轨迹来揭示演化中的脑状态。GeoMind在任务态功能磁共振成像（fMRI）数据中识别特定脑状态，以及利用静息态fMRI对阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和自闭症进行疾病早期诊断方面，均展现出有前景的结果。这些结果凸显了GeoMind在神经科学研究中的适用性。为进一步评估GeoMind的泛化性，我们将GeoMind应用于脑电图（EEG）情绪数据集，其表现优于竞争方法，并展示了跨神经影像模态的可扩展性。

abstract: Background. Predictive artificial intelligence (AI) models hold great promise for medical care. While many types of models have proliferated across healthcare and the life sciences, systematic, rapid generation of multi-condition predictions of diagnoses, future medical events and future clinical outcomes from a single foundation-model architecture remains rare. PhenOM(R) is a generative AI foundation model trained and validated on longitudinal medical-event data from more than 400 million patient records in the OM1 Real World Data Cloud (RWDC) and designed to complete predictive tasks for a broad array of medical diagnoses, events and clinical outcomes (collectively outcomes) at varying time intervals, currently up to five (5) years. This paper describes the implementation of PhenOM to complete a vast number of predictive tasks across clinical domains and outcomes. Methods. PhenOM was evaluated across four outcome categories (Future Risk, Screening, Care Opportunity, and Treatment Effect) in multiple domains spanning chronic disease, acute medical events, healthcare utilization, and rare and frequently undiagnosed conditions. Performance was assessed using area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). Outcomes were defined within an eligible-population framework using standardized medical code sets (ICD-10, SNOMED, CPT, NDC, LOINC) unless outcomes could not be specified with an existing code. All benchmarks reported were derived from data excluded from training. Results. As of this publication, the single PhenOM model has been used to complete and validate thousands of predictive tasks covering more than 1,770 outcomes spanning most organ systems and clinical specialties, with new predictive tasks being validated each day. Overall, 80 percent of predictive tasks achieved AUROC of at least 0.70 and 30 percent achieved AUROC of at least 0.80. We present a sample of 177 of these tasks as examples that show the breadth of tasks the model can complete. Performance varied systematically by outcome and clinical domain. Conclusions. PhenOM demonstrates the ability to complete thousands of predictive tasks across clinical domains and outcomes at the individual patient level, without additional training. Outcomes include screening for undiagnosed conditions, predicting future conditions, medical events, effects of treatments, and assessing care opportunities. These can be ascertained at the individual patient and population levels. These findings
zh_abstract: 【背景】预测性人工智能（AI）模型对医疗照护具有很大前景。尽管许多类型的模型已在医疗健康和生命科学领域不断涌现，但基于单一基础模型架构、系统且快速地生成对诊断、未来医疗事件和未来临床结局的多病种预测仍然少见。PhenOM(R) 是一种生成式 AI 基础模型，基于 OM1 Real World Data Cloud（RWDC）中超过4亿份患者记录的纵向医疗事件数据进行训练和验证，设计用于在不同时间间隔内完成广泛医学诊断、事件和临床结局（统称结局）的预测任务，目前最长可达五（5）年。本文描述了 PhenOM 的实施，以完成跨越临床领域和结局的大量预测任务。【方法】PhenOM 在四个结局类别（未来风险（Future Risk）、筛查（Screening）、照护机会（Care Opportunity）和治疗效果（Treatment Effect））中进行了评估，涉及慢性病、急性医疗事件、医疗资源利用以及罕见和常未被诊断的疾病等多个领域。性能使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）评估。除非结局无法用现有编码指定，否则结局均在合格人群框架内使用标准化医学编码集（ICD-10、SNOMED、CPT、NDC、LOINC）定义。所报告的所有基准均来自训练时排除的数据。【结果】截至本文发表时，单一 PhenOM 模型已用于完成和验证数千项预测任务，覆盖超过1,770种结局，涵盖大多数器官系统和临床专科，且每天都有新的预测任务得到验证。总体而言，80%的预测任务达到至少0.70的 AUROC，30%达到至少0.80的 AUROC。我们展示其中177项任务作为示例，以表明该模型可完成任务的范围广度。性能因结局和临床领域而系统性变化。【结论】PhenOM 证明能够在个体患者层面完成跨越临床领域和结局的数千项预测任务，而无需额外训练。结局包括筛查未诊断疾病、预测未来疾病、医疗事件、治疗效果以及评估照护机会。这些可在个体患者和人群层面确定。这些发现

title: CellTrack-Bench: Microscopic Cell Tracking Benchmark for Vision-Language Models
zh_title: CellTrack-Bench：视觉语言模型细胞追踪基准
summary: 预印本推出CellTrack-Bench，基于15个细胞追踪数据集、1537道题评测视觉语言模型并与专用追踪器对比。
key_points: 覆盖四种成像模态、9041次细胞连接判断
与专用细胞追踪算法进行对照
另设需更强推理的困难子集
reason: 多数据集公开基准具一定规模，但为未经同行评审预印本
abstract: Large language models have shown outstanding performance on text-first tasks such as coding, math, and writing. Recent efforts are shifting models' training to include scientific problems that often live in highly specialized domains beyond text, such as protein structure and biological images. However, in these scenarios, their general-purpose accuracy compared with specialized algorithms remains in question. One such domain is cell tracking, which requires spatiotemporal awareness of cell dynamics. To evaluate this, we created a new benchmark, CellTrack-Bench, which assesses Vision-Language Models' (VLMs) cell-tracking-related performance against specialized trackers. The full benchmark draws from 15 standard cell-tracking datasets across four imaging modalities and comprises 1,537 problems corresponding to 9,041 cell-linking decisions. We selected a hard subset requiring greater reasoning effort by identifying failures shared across distinct algorithmic trackers. With this proposed dataset, we: (i) evaluated different environment harnesses for VLMs; (ii) benchmarked 9 frontier closed-source models and 13 open-weight models; and (iii) provided a detailed analysis of their failure modes. Code, the stored model outputs, and a pipeline that regenerates the benchmark from the source datasets are available at https://github.com/royerlab/celltrack-bench.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型在编程、数学和写作等文本优先任务上已展现出卓越性能。近期的努力正在将模型的训练转向纳入科学问题，而这些问题往往存在于文本之外的高度专业化领域，例如蛋白质结构和生物图像。然而，在这些场景中，与专用算法相比，它们的通用准确性仍然存疑。细胞追踪就是这样一个领域，它需要对细胞动力学具备时空感知能力。为了评估这一点，我们创建了一个新基准 CellTrack-Bench，用于评估视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models，VLMs）在细胞追踪相关任务上的表现，并与专用追踪器进行比较。完整基准取自四种成像模态下的 15 个标准细胞追踪数据集，包含 1,537 个问题，对应 9,041 个细胞连接决策。我们通过识别不同算法追踪器共有的失败案例，选择了一个需要更强推理努力的困难子集。利用这一提出的数据集，我们：(i) 评估了用于 VLMs 的不同环境测试框架（environment harnesses）；(ii) 对 9 个前沿闭源模型和 13 个开放权重模型进行了基准测试；(iii) 对它们的失败模式进行了详细分析。代码、存储的模型输出以及从源数据集重新生成该基准的流水线可在 https://github.com/royerlab/celltrack-bench 获取。

title: Large Language Models for Accurate Medical Chart Abstraction: Enabling Scalable and Secure Artificial Intelligence Deployment in Stroke

summary: 预印本：在3家医院2416份神经介入急性卒中报告中，评测22个开源指令微调大模型提取8项临床变量的准确率、延迟与专家一致性。

abstract: Medical chart abstraction transforms unstructured clinical narratives into structured variables for research and quality monitoring. We evaluated a prompting-based large language model (LLM) framework for extracting eight clinical variables from 2,416 neurointerventional acute stroke intervention reports across three hospitals. Twenty-two instruction-tuned open-source LLMs were evaluated across architectures, model sizes, and biomedical adaptations using Quick Response and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. Non-expert staff annotations served as the cross-model reference standard. Evaluation was restricted to report-variable pairs with a valid LLaMA3.3-70B CoT prediction and a corresponding reference label. Performance measures included extraction accuracy, inference latency, and agreement with expert adjudication. Twenty discordant cases per variable underwent review by two senior physicians and four medical students. LLaMA3.3-70B achieved the highest overall accuracy (94.8%). CoT improved performance on inference-dependent variables such as site of occlusion, while Quick Response was optimal for directly stated procedural fields. Expert adjudication showed that AI predictions were more closely aligned with expert interpretations than non-expert annotations for most variables, with intracranial angioplasty remaining a challenge. Locally deployed LLMs can support scalable clinical information extraction and retrospective stroke registry curation, with expert oversight for ambiguous cases.
zh_abstract: 病历摘录将非结构化临床叙述转化为结构化变量，用于研究和质量监测。我们评估了一种基于提示的大型语言模型（LLM）框架，用于从三家医院的2,416份神经介入急性卒中干预报告中提取八项临床变量。使用快速响应（Quick Response）和思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）提示，对22个经过指令微调的开源LLM在架构、模型规模和生物医学适配方面进行了评估。非专家工作人员的标注作为跨模型参考标准。评估仅限于具有有效 LLaMA3.3-70B CoT 预测和相应参考标签的报告-变量对。性能指标包括提取准确率、推理延迟以及与专家裁决的一致性。每个变量20个不一致病例由两名资深医师和四名医学生复核。LLaMA3.3-70B 取得最高总体准确率（94.8%）。CoT 改善了依赖推理的变量（如闭塞部位）的性能，而快速响应对于直接陈述的操作字段最优。专家裁决显示，对于大多数变量，AI 预测比非专家标注更接近专家解读，颅内血管成形术仍是一个挑战。本地部署的LLM可支持可扩展的临床信息提取和回顾性卒中登记库管理，并对模糊病例进行专家监督。

abstract: Background Effective type 2 diabetes (T2D) education improves patient outcomes, but clinician time constraints limit what can be covered during encounters. Large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable way to answer patient questions, yet their accuracy and reliability in T2D education across health literacy levels remain poorly characterized. Methods We developed DiaBench, a standardized benchmarking framework built from 96 question-and-answer pairs collected by clinicians from representative real-world patient encounters. GPT-5 transformed each pair into multiple-choice questions (MCQs) under three configurations (1-3) simulating different question formats and levels of user background. A five-member panel of certified diabetes care and education specialists (CDCESs), medical doctors (MDs), and endocrinologists validated the transformations, rating question rephrasing, answer rephrasing, and answer correctness. We then evaluated seven LLMs (GPT-51, Gemini-2.5-Flash2, Cohere Command3, Llama-44, DeepSeek-R15, Perplexity Sonar6, Mistral-Large-2.07) for accuracy and self-consistency across three runs. Results (i) Expert validation showed a consensus over MCQ transformation. For configuration 1, 98.1% (SD 0.01) of rephrased answers were appropriate, 98.1% (SD 0.01) of MCQ answers were correct, and 95.0% (SD 0.05) of rephrased questions were appropriate; corresponding values for configuration 2 were 96.3% (SD 0.05), 97.5% (SD 0.02), and 89.8% (SD 0.14). (ii) across benchmarking for configurations 1 and 2, most models achieved high accuracy ([≥]95%), but Mistral-Large-2.0, Llama 4, and Perplexity Sonar showed substantially lower self-consistency (60.4%-91.7%) than other models ([≥]95%). All models degraded in both accuracy and self-consistency on configuration 3. Conclusions DiaBench quantitatively differentiates LLM capability in T2D patient education, with Gemini, GPT-5, and DeepSeek-R1 performing strongly and other models suboptimally. DiaBench provides a transferable platform for evaluating existing and newly developed LLMs, addressing the need for standardized benchmarking before clinical deployment of LLM-based systems in patient education.
zh_abstract: 【背景】有效的 2 型糖尿病（T2D）教育可改善患者结局，但临床医生时间受限，限制了就诊期间可覆盖的内容。大语言模型（LLMs）提供了一种可扩展的方式来回答患者问题，但其在 T2D 教育中跨健康素养水平的准确性和可靠性仍缺乏充分描述。【方法】我们开发了 DiaBench，这是一个标准化基准测试框架，基于临床医生从有代表性的真实世界患者就诊中收集的 96 个问答对构建。GPT-5 在三种配置（1-3）下将每个问答对转换为多项选择题（MCQs），以模拟不同的问题格式和用户背景水平。一个由认证糖尿病护理与教育专家（CDCESs）、医学博士（MDs）和内分泌科医生组成的五人专家组验证了这些转换，并对问题改写、答案改写和答案正确性进行评分。随后，我们在三次运行中评估了七个 LLMs（GPT-51、Gemini-2.5-Flash2、Cohere Command3、Llama-44、DeepSeek-R15、Perplexity Sonar6、Mistral-Large-2.07）的准确性和自一致性。【结果】（i）专家验证显示对选择题转换达成共识。对于配置 1，98.1%（SD 0.01）的改写后答案恰当，98.1%（SD 0.01）的选择题答案正确，95.0%（SD 0.05）的改写后问题恰当；配置 2 的相应值分别为 96.3%（SD 0.05）、97.5%（SD 0.02）和 89.8%（SD 0.14）。（ii）在配置 1 和 2 的基准测试中，大多数模型达到高准确率（[≥]95%），但 Mistral-Large-2.0、Llama 4 和 Perplexity Sonar 的自一致性（60.4%-91.7%）显著低于其他模型（[≥]95%）。所有模型在配置 3 上准确性和自一致性均下降。【结论】DiaBench 定量区分了 LLM 在 T2D 患者教育中的能力，其中 Gemini、GPT-5 和 DeepSeek-R1 表现强劲，其他模型表现欠佳。DiaBench 提供了一个可迁移平台，用于评估现有和新开发的 LLMs，满足在患者教育中临床部署基于 LLM 的系统之前进行标准化基准测试的需求。

abstract: To: Suzanne Bakken, PhD, RN, FAAN, FACMI, FIAHSI Editor-in-Chief Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association (JAMIA) Oxford University Press Dear Dr. Bakken, We thank the authors for their thoughtful correspondence and for raising important issues regarding transparency, reproducibility, and generalizability in evaluations of vendor-based artificial intelligence tools. We agree that these are important goals. However, in this instance, we do not believe that identifying the specific vendors evaluated in our randomized crossover trial would, by itself, substantially advance those goals. A central challenge in evaluating vendor-based AI products is that they evolve far more rapidly than most other clinical technologies or interventions. In the broader data science literature, authors can often specify model versions with some precision. In contrast, vendor-based products may change through frequent feature releases, workflow modifications, or institution-specific customization without a clear, standardized mechanism for communicating those changes to readers. Even during the course of our trial, both products continued to evolve. As a result, naming the vendors could create a false impression that any single vendor is persistently superior to another, which does not reflect how these systems are deployed in practice.
zh_abstract:
致：Suzanne Bakken博士，注册护士，FAAN，FACMI，FIAHSI，《美国医学信息学协会杂志》（JAMIA）主编，牛津大学出版社
尊敬的Bakken博士：
我们感谢作者们深思熟虑的来信，以及他们就在评估基于供应商的人工智能工具时涉及的透明度、可重复性和泛化性问题提出的重要议题。我们同意这些是重要目标。然而，在此情形下，我们认为，指明我们随机交叉试验中所评估的具体供应商本身并不会实质性地推进这些目标。评估基于供应商的AI产品的一个核心挑战在于，它们比大多数其他临床技术或干预措施演变得快得多。在更广泛的数据科学文献中，作者通常可以较为精确地说明模型版本。相比之下，基于供应商的产品可能通过频繁的功能发布、工作流程修改或机构特定的定制而发生变化，却没有一个清晰、标准化的机制向读者传达这些变化。甚至在我们试验进行期间，两种产品也都在继续演变。因此，点名供应商可能会造成一种错误印象，即任何单一供应商始终优于另一供应商，而这并不反映这些系统在实践中的部署方式。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology; conditions: Pulmonary Subsolid Nodules, Ground-Glass Nodules; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 200; status: COMPLETED] The goal of this prospective, non-interventional study is to evaluate the predictive performance and potential clinical utility of an artificial intelligence (AI)-based virtual follow-up framework for incidentally detected pulmonary subsolid nodules (SSNs), including pure ground-glass and part-solid nodules. The main questions it aims to answer are: 1. Can the AI model accurately predict future CT appearances, quantitative growth characteristics, and morphological progression of pulmonary SSNs at specified follow-up intervals? 2. Does AI-assisted virtual follow-up improve radiologists' assessment of nodule progression and simulated surveillance management decisions compared with assessment without AI assistance? Researchers will compare radiologists' assessments with and without access to AI-generated future CT images and quantitative predictions. An additional reader evaluation will examine whether generated future images provide incremental value beyond quantitative predictions alone. Participants will undergo clinically indicated CT examinations and receive routine care according to standard clinical practice. The research team will: * Collect previously acquired CT images and clinical information. * Generate and lock AI predictions before the corresponding follow-up CT examinations occur. * Obtain and lock radiologists' assessments and simulated management recommendations before actual follow-up outcomes become available. * Compare predicted nodule progression with observed follow-up CT findings. AI predictions and research-related reader assessments will not be disclosed to treating clinicians or used to alter patients' actual surveillance or treatment decisions.

Participants will: * Undergo prostate MRI as part of their usual clinical care. Areas flagged only by Pi may also be biopsied. * If not biopsied, be followed for 12 months after MRI with PSA tests at 6 and 12 months and clinical assessment, to confirm the absence of clinically significant cancer. About 226 participants will be enrolled at two Italian centres (Fondazione Policlinico Universitario A. Gemelli IRCCS, Rome, and IRCCS Ospedale San Raffaele, Milan).

abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used across the diagnostic pathway, from screening and disease detection to differential diagnosis, prognostic stratification, and treatment-response assessment. This narrative review examines predictive, generative, multi-modal, and agentic AI through a diagnostic-science lens and evaluates the evidence required for translation into clinical practice. Predictive models can identify complex patterns in images, physiological signals, laboratory data, and electronic health records, but high retrospective accuracy does not establish diagnostic utility. Clinical validity and utility depend on the intended use, target population, disease spectrum and prevalence, reference standard, operating threshold, calibration, and the consequences of false-positive and false-negative results. Generative AI may support problem representation, differential diagnosis, information synthesis, and documentation, yet fluent outputs can omit critical alternatives, amplify false premises, or convey unjustified certainty. Multimodal systems may better reflect clinical reasoning by integrating imaging, text, signals, pathology, and molecular data, but they must demonstrate incremental value over the best single-modality test and remain robust to missing data. Agentic systems can coordinate evidence retrieval, test selection, and sequential workflows, thereby increasing the need for bounded permissions, auditability, error recovery, and human escalation. Across all paradigms, a credible pathway to diagnostic implementation requires independent external and prospective validation, representative consecutive patients, subgroup analysis, workflow and human-AI evaluation, clinical impact studies, and post-deployment surveillance. The field should therefore be judged not by model capability alone, but by whether AI measurably improves diagnostic yield, timeliness, safety, equity, and patient-relevant outcomes in real care settings.
zh_abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] 人工智能（AI）正日益应用于整个诊断路径，从筛查和疾病检测到鉴别诊断、预后分层和治疗反应评估。本叙述性综述从诊断科学视角审视预测性、生成式、多模态和代理式 AI，并评估其转化为临床实践所需的证据。预测模型能够识别图像、生理信号、实验室数据和电子健康记录中的复杂模式，但高回顾性准确率并不能确立诊断效用。临床有效性和效用取决于预期用途、目标人群、疾病谱和患病率、参考标准、操作阈值、校准以及假阳性和假阴性结果的后果。生成式 AI 可能支持问题表征、鉴别诊断、信息综合和文档记录，但流畅的输出可能遗漏关键备选诊断、放大错误前提或传达不合理的确定性。多模态系统可能通过整合影像、文本、信号、病理和分子数据更好地反映临床推理，但它们必须证明相对于最佳单模态检查具有增量价值，并对缺失数据保持稳健。代理式系统可以协调证据检索、检查选择和序贯工作流程，从而增加对有界权限、可审计性、错误恢复和人工升级的需求。在所有范式中，可信的诊断实施路径需要独立的外部验证和前瞻性验证、具有代表性的连续患者、亚组分析、工作流程和人机协作评估、临床影响研究以及部署后监测。因此，不应仅以模型能力来评判该领域，而应看 AI 是否在真实照护环境中可测量地改善诊断产出、及时性、安全性、公平性和患者相关结局。

title: Performance of artificial intelligence for fracture detection: an umbrella review and second-order-meta-analysis
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: AI骨折检测性能：伞形综述与二次荟萃分析
summary: 纳入50篇系统综述或荟萃分析、387项原始研究的伞形综述，二次荟萃分析合并AI骨折检测敏感度为0.897。

21项荟萃分析纳入二次合并，重叠度仅4.31%

abstract: Abstract Fractures affect approximately 178 million people annually, and artificial intelligence (AI) tools for fracture detection are increasingly approved by regulators. We conducted an umbrella review and second-order meta-analysis (PROSPERO CRD42024516414), searching six databases to 4/06/2025 for systematic reviews or meta-analyses of AI fracture detection using any imaging modality. Screening, extraction, and quality assessment were performed in duplicate. We assessed review quality using AMSTAR-2, primary-study overlap using corrected covered area, and certainty using GRADE. Fifty reviews were included (25 systematic reviews and 25 meta-analyses; 387 primary studies). Twenty-one meta-analyses (269 primary studies) contributed to second-order meta-analysis, with slight overall overlap (4.31%). Pooled AI sensitivity was 0.897 (95% CI 0.882–0.911; 95% prediction interval 0.753–0.962) and specificity 0.904 (95% CI 0.891–0.916; prediction interval 0.824 to 0.950). Comparative evidence showed no consistent differences for AI, clinicians, and AI-assisted clinicians: however, this data was sparse and inconclusive. No review reported adverse events or other safety outcomes. Certainty was very low/low for almost all outcomes; all meta-analyses were rated critically low/low on AMSTAR-2. Although published estimates suggest high diagnostic accuracy, real-world and comparative performance remain uncertain. Prospective external validation, multi-reader-multi-case studies, and randomised trials are needed before broad clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: 摘要 骨折每年影响约1.78亿人，用于骨折检测的人工智能（AI）工具正越来越多地获得监管机构批准。我们开展了一项伞状综述和二阶meta分析（PROSPERO CRD42024516414），检索了六个数据库至4/06/2025，纳入使用任何影像模态进行AI骨折检测的系统综述或meta分析。筛查、提取和质量评价均双人重复进行。我们使用AMSTAR-2评估综述质量，使用校正覆盖面积（corrected covered area）评估原始研究重叠，并使用GRADE评估证据确定性。共纳入50篇综述（25篇系统综述和25篇meta分析；387项原始研究）。21篇meta分析（269项原始研究）纳入二阶meta分析，总体重叠较小（4.31%）。合并的AI敏感度为0.897（95% CI 0.882–0.911；95%预测区间0.753–0.962），特异度为0.904（95% CI 0.891–0.916；预测区间0.824–0.950）。比较证据显示AI、临床医生和AI辅助的临床医生之间没有一致差异：然而，这些数据稀少且无定论。没有综述报告不良事件或其他安全性结局。几乎所有结局的确定性为极低/低；所有meta分析在AMSTAR-2上被评为极低/低。尽管已发表的估计提示诊断准确性高，但真实世界和比较性能仍不确定。在广泛临床采用之前，需要前瞻性外部验证、多读者多病例研究和随机试验。

title: Automation Bias and Deskilling in Radiology AI: A Confidence-stratified Triage Model for Workflow Integration.
zh_title: 放射AI的自动化偏差与技能退化
summary: 该文讨论放射科AI常态化使用带来的自动化偏差与技能退化风险，并提出置信度分层分诊模型。
key_points: AI错误输出会降低判读准确性，与经验无关
辅助收益因读片者与任务而异，撤除后表现下降
提出置信度分层分诊模型以融入工作流
reason: 同行评审观点/框架文章，提出整合模型但无实证数据，属值得一看档。
abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] Radiology is adopting artificial intelligence (AI) faster than it is studying what AI does to radiologists' perceptual expertise and interpretive skill. The question has partly shifted from whether these tools perform well on benchmark tasks to what happens to clinical judgment when use of these tools becomes routine. Two risks accompany this transition: automation bias, the tendency to follow AI suggestions without adequate scrutiny, and deskilling, the erosion of perceptual and interpretive ability through disuse, typically revealed when AI support is withdrawn. Incorrect AI output degrades accuracy regardless of experience, the benefit of assistance varies unpredictably across readers and tasks, and performance falls after AI withdrawal; neither risk has been studied longitudinally in radiology. A confidence-stratified triage model is proposed in which calibrated AI confidence, not findings alone, routes cases to low-, intermediate-, or high-confidence streams: output withheld until independent reading, shown with uncertainty signals and a checklist, or shown with random blinded audit. Demonstrated local confidence calibration is a precondition for deployment, and stream thresholds and audit rates should be weighted by task and potential clinical harm, not error probability alone. Rather than applying one workflow to every case, the model redistributes radiologist attention to where AI error is most likely and most consequential, operationalizing four principles: keeping the radiologist in the decision loop, making AI uncertainty visible, inserting targeted cognitive friction, and governing the human-AI interaction as a system. A research agenda to determine whether these countermeasures reduce automation bias and skill erosion in practice is also proposed.
zh_abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] 放射学采用人工智能（AI）的速度，快于研究AI对放射科医师感知专长和判读技能所产生影响的速度。问题已部分从这些工具是否在基准任务上表现良好，转向当这些工具的使用成为常规时临床判断会发生什么。这一转变伴随两种风险：自动化偏差（automation bias），即在没有充分审查的情况下遵循AI建议的倾向；以及去技能化（deskilling），即因不使用而导致感知和判读能力侵蚀，通常在AI支持被撤除时显现。错误的AI输出会降低准确性，无论经验如何；辅助的获益在不同阅片者和任务之间不可预测地变化；并且在AI撤除后表现下降；这两种风险均未在放射学中进行纵向研究。提出一种置信度分层分诊模型，其中经过校准的AI置信度而非仅依据发现，将病例分流至低、中、高置信度流程：输出暂不提供直至完成独立判读；在显示不确定性信号和清单的情况下显示输出；或在随机盲法审核下显示输出。已证明的本地置信度校准是部署的前提，流程阈值和审核率应根据任务和潜在临床危害加权，而非仅依据错误概率。该模型不是对每个病例应用一种工作流程，而是将放射科医师的注意力重新分配到AI错误最可能且最具后果的地方，并将四项原则操作化：让放射科医师保持在决策环路中、使AI不确定性可见、插入有针对性的认知摩擦，以及将人-AI交互作为一个系统进行治理。还提出了一个研究议程，以确定这些对策在实践中是否减少自动化偏差和技能侵蚀。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To compare patient trust in educational health contentand the physician providing it, when authorship is attributed to a physician or generative artificial intelligence (AI). In a preregistered randomized, parallel survey study, participants read a health education article. Individuals were randomized to 1 of 4 conditions, attributing authorship of an identical article to (1) a physician author, (2) generative AI, (3) a physician assisted by AI (hybrid authorship), or (4) no author. Pregnant or postpartum English-speaking US adults (n = 400) were recruited in August-October 2025 via an online survey panel. Eighty percent passed timing and attention checks. Participants rated article engagement, content trust, and trust in the (hypothetical) recommending physician with Likert-scales. Bonferroni corrections were applied to post hoc pairwise comparisons (α = 0.05). Among participants who correctly recalled authorship (n = 195), AI-only authorship was associated with lower trust in content (mean, 9.43 vs 11.11; P = .001) and the recommending physician (mean, 8.93 vs 10.84; P = .03) compared with physician-only authorship, while hybrid authorship did not differ significantly from physician-only authorship for either outcome (content: P = .08; physician: P > .99). Sensitivity analyses including all participants (n = 321) were generally consistent with the primary findings. Engagement did not differ significantly across conditions in the primary analytic sample. As generative AI becomes increasingly integrated into clinical care, how AI involvement and physician oversight are communicated to patients could have important implications for patient trust. AI authorship was associated with reduced trust in patient-facing education despite identical, clinician-written content.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 在作者署名归属于医生或生成式人工智能（AI）时，比较患者对教育性健康内容及提供该内容的医生的信任。在一项预注册的随机、平行调查研究中，参与者阅读一篇健康教育文章。个体被随机分配到4种条件之一，将同一篇文章的作者署名归于（1）医生作者、（2）生成式AI、（3）由AI协助的医生（混合署名）或（4）无作者。妊娠期或产后英语美国成年人（n = 400）于2025年8月至10月通过在线调查面板招募。80%通过了时间与注意力检查。参与者使用Likert量表对文章参与度、内容信任以及对（假设的）推荐医生的信任进行评分。事后两两比较采用Bonferroni校正（α = 0.05）。在正确回忆作者身份的参与者（n = 195）中，与仅医生署名相比，仅AI署名与对内容的信任较低相关（均值，9.43 vs 11.11；P = .001）以及对推荐医生的信任较低相关（均值，8.93 vs 10.84；P = .03），而混合署名在两项结局上均与仅医生署名无显著差异（内容：P = .08；医生：P > .99）。纳入所有参与者（n = 321）的敏感性分析总体上与主要发现一致。在主要分析样本中，参与度在各条件间无显著差异。随着生成式AI日益融入临床护理，如何向患者传达AI参与和医生监督可能对患者信任产生重要影响。尽管内容相同且由临床医生撰写，AI署名与对面向患者教育的信任降低相关。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Second Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University, School of Medicine; conditions: Acute Ischemic Stroke; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: PHASE3; enrollment: 826; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This multicenter, prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of intravenous recombinant human prourokinase (rhPro-UK) in patients with acute ischemic stroke treated more than 4.5 hours and up to 24 hours after stroke onset, selected using a noncontrast computed tomography-based artificial intelligence (CT-AI) tissue-window algorithm. A total of 826 participants will be randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive intravenous rhPro-UK or matching placebo, in addition to guideline-recommended standard stroke care. The primary outcome is the proportion of participants achieving a modified Rankin Scale (mRS) score of 0-1 at 90 ± 7 days. Secondary outcomes include functional outcomes, changes in neurological deficits, early neurological improvement at 24 hours and 7 days, and tissue reperfusion at 24-48 hours. Safety outcomes include symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage, parenchymal hematoma, all-cause mortality, and serious systemic bleeding.

source: PubMed · Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine
zh_title: 跨模态跨数据集跨阶段的神经退行性疾病深度学习检测系统综述
summary: PRISMA 系统综述纳入 2019 年至 2026 年 4 月的 111 项研究，评估多模态深度学习用于神经退行性疾病早期预测、诊断与进展监测。
key_points: 按早期预测、诊断、进展三阶段分层评估
指出模型性能高度依赖数据可得性与多样性
reason: 系统综述纳入研究数量较多但仅见摘要，结论细节有限，属值得一看档
abstract: [Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine] BackgroundNeurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's pose significant diagnostic challenges because they are incurable. Their symptoms often overlap with those of normal ageing and involve progressive neuronal loss. This makes early prediction, proper diagnosis, and ongoing monitoring crucial at every stage of the disease. Deep learning has become a useful tool for handling different types of data. However, the performance of these models relies heavily on the availability and variety of data, making it important to characterize datasets.ObjectiveThis PRISMA-based systematic review looks at 111 studies from 2019 to April 2026, organized into three clinical stages of neurodegenerative diseases: early prediction, diagnosis, and progression.MethodsEach study is assessed across four dimensions: data type (neuroimaging or non-neuroimaging), datasets (open-access, self-created, or hybrid), deep learning model architecture, and the use of explainable AI.ResultsMRI is the only imaging modality that spans all three stages. Speech is the most common non-neuroimaging method for diagnosis, while gait is used only for diagnosis and progression. The ADNI and PPMI datasets are the most commonly used. Self-created datasets introduce new modalities such as ECG and iPSCs, which are not found in open-access datasets. CNNs are the leading models for neuroimaging tasks, while LSTMs and RNNs capture temporal patterns in longitudinal datasets. Survival models are exclusively used for ALS and LATE. Fewer than 6% of the studies used confirmed XAI. Only 2 of the 111 studies validated their results on an independent external cohort.ConclusionThis review is the only one that covers all three disease stages across multiple neurodegenerative diseases.
zh_abstract: [Technology and Health Care（欧洲工程与医学学会官方期刊）]【背景】阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等神经退行性疾病因无法治愈而带来重大诊断挑战。其症状常与正常衰老的症状重叠，并涉及进行性神经元丢失。这使得在疾病的每个阶段进行早期预测、正确诊断和持续监测至关重要。深度学习已成为处理不同类型数据的有用工具。然而，这些模型的性能在很大程度上依赖于数据的可获得性和多样性，因此对数据集进行表征很重要。【目的】本项基于PRISMA的系统综述考察了2019年至2026年4月的111项研究，并按神经退行性疾病的三个临床阶段进行组织：早期预测、诊断和进展。【方法】每项研究均从四个维度进行评估：数据类型（神经影像或非神经影像）、数据集（开放获取、自建或混合）、深度学习模型架构，以及可解释人工智能（XAI）的使用情况。【结果】MRI是唯一涵盖全部三个阶段的影像模态。语音是诊断中最常用的非神经影像方法，而步态仅用于诊断和进展。ADNI和PPMI数据集是最常用的数据集。自建数据集引入了开放获取数据集中没有的新模态，如ECG和iPSCs。CNN是神经影像任务的主要模型，而LSTM和RNN用于捕捉纵向数据集中的时间模式。生存模型仅用于ALS和LATE。少于6%的研究使用了经确认的XAI。111项研究中仅有2项在独立外部队列上验证了其结果。【结论】本综述是唯一一项涵盖多种神经退行性疾病全部三个疾病阶段的综述。

title: M4Bench: Evaluating Procedural Specification for Clinical EHR Derivation Agents
zh_title: M4Bench：评估临床EHR衍生智能体的规范说明能力
summary: 预印本提出M4Bench，含MIMIC-IV与eICU上28项临床衍生任务，测试编码智能体能否复现EHR变量衍生。
key_points: 28项任务覆盖15个任务族
技能使奖励提升0.136，26/28任务改善
规范完整性贡献大部分增益
reason: 新公开评测基准、任务设计系统，但为预印本且未见代码开放说明
abstract: Clinical research over electronic health records depends on derived variables whose definitions sit outside the schema, in item codes, time windows, missingness rules, and output-grain choices that change cohorts and downstream conclusions. We introduce M4Bench, 28 clinical derivation tasks across 15 task families on MIMIC-IV and eICU, to test whether AI coding agents can reproduce such derivations and how clinician-reviewed agent skills change their results. Its controls decompose the value of skills into specification completeness, delivery format, and schema familiarity. In a Docker-isolated Codex campaign (GPT 5.4 Mini and GPT 5.5), skills raise reward by 0.136 over the no-skill baseline, with 26 of 28 tasks improving. Specification completeness accounts for most of this gain: on an eight-task control subset, an operational spec alone raises reward by 0.162, and skills add only 0.024 on top, indistinguishable from zero. On a ten-task subset, decoy skills score like no skill and raw reference SQL nearly matches targeted skills, arguing against generic context or the skill format as the explanation. Schema obfuscation and restructuring preserve 86% and 70% of the skill gain (GPT 5.4 Mini, 26 MIMIC-IV tasks), a descriptive robustness check rather than a bound on memorization. A descriptive Claude Code replication on all 28 tasks (Opus 4.7 and Sonnet 4.6, 560 runs) is directionally consistent (+0.120, 21 of 28 tasks improving). These gains are partial agreement with the reference, not completed tasks: only 25 of 280 with-skill and 13 of 280 no-skill Codex runs pass every strict check, and skills barely change which rows agents return (key F1 +0.003). Skills are released as a versioned, clinician-reviewable markdown delivery format, with a family-level reference-validity audit. M4Bench releases tasks, skills, evaluation code, and sanitized per-run evidence as an open-source benchmark.
zh_abstract: 基于电子健康记录的临床研究依赖于派生变量，而这些变量的定义位于模式（schema）之外，体现在项目代码、时间窗、缺失规则以及会改变队列和下游结论的输出粒度选择中。我们提出 M4Bench，在 MIMIC-IV 和 eICU 上涵盖 15 个任务族的 28 个临床派生任务，用于检验 AI 编码智能体能否复现此类派生，以及经临床医生审核的智能体技能如何改变其结果。其对照将技能的价值分解为规范完整性、交付格式和模式熟悉度。在一项 Docker 隔离的 Codex 实验中（GPT 5.4 Mini 和 GPT 5.5），技能相较无技能基线将奖励（reward）提高 0.136，28 个任务中有 26 个得到改善。规范完整性解释了这一增益的大部分：在包含八个任务的对照子集上，仅可操作规范即使奖励提高 0.162，而技能在此基础上仅增加 0.024，与零无法区分。在包含十个任务的子集上，诱饵技能的得分与无技能相当，而原始参考 SQL 几乎与针对性技能相当，这反对将通用上下文或技能格式作为解释。模式混淆与重构分别保留了 86% 和 70% 的技能增益（GPT 5.4 Mini，26 个 MIMIC-IV 任务），这是一项描述性稳健性检查，而非对记忆的界限。在全部 28 个任务上的描述性 Claude Code 复现（Opus 4.7 和 Sonnet 4.6，560 次运行）方向一致（+0.120，28 个任务中有 21 个得到改善）。这些增益是与参考的部分一致，而非完成任务：在 Codex 运行中，仅有 280 次有技能运行中的 25 次和 280 次无技能运行中的 13 次通过每项严格检查，且技能几乎不改变智能体返回的行（关键 F1 +0.003）。技能以版本化、可供临床医生审核的 Markdown 交付格式发布，并附有任务族级参考有效性审计。M4Bench 作为开源基准发布任务、技能、评估代码和经净化的逐次运行证据。

title: AI-Assisted Differentiation of Autoimmune Pancreatitis and Pancreatic Cancer Using EUS: A Multicenter Ambispective Study
zh_title: EUS图像AI鉴别自身免疫性胰腺炎与胰腺癌
summary: 瑞金医院登记一项多中心观察研究，用EUS图像开发AI以鉴别局灶性自身免疫性胰腺炎与胰腺癌。
key_points: 多中心观察性研究，计划入组690例
基于2026年1月前数据开发AI模型

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ruijin Hospital; conditions: Autoimmune Pancreatitis, Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC); type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 690; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Focal autoimmune pancreatitis (f-AIP) and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) exhibit substantial overlap in clinical manifestations and imaging features, posing a major diagnostic challenge in pancreatic diseases. Given the marked differences in treatment strategies and prognosis, accurate differentiation is essential to avoid unnecessary surgery and ensure timely initiation of anticancer treatment. This study aims to collect endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) images from patients with confirmed f-AIP or PDAC across multiple centers, using a previously established multicenter database. Data collected before January 2026 will be used to develop an artificial intelligence (AI) model based on EUS radiomics for differential diagnosis. Subsequently, prospectively collected data from participating centers from 2026 onward will be used for model testing and validation. The diagnostic performance of the model will be evaluated and compared with that of endoscopists with different levels of experience. Furthermore, this study will investigate the clinical value of interpretable radiomic features, with particular emphasis on challenging diagnostic scenarios, including IgG4-negative AIP, AIP with elevated carbohydrate antigen 19-9 (CA19-9) levels, and PDAC with imaging features resembling those of AIP. The ultimate goal is to provide a reliable tool for accurate, noninvasive preoperative differential diagnosis while promoting the standardization of multicenter AIP databases and the sharing and utilization of imaging data resources.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：瑞金医院；疾病：自身免疫性胰腺炎、胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）；类型：观察性；入组人数：690；状态：尚未招募] 局灶性自身免疫性胰腺炎（f-AIP）与胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）在临床表现和影像学特征方面存在显著重叠，对胰腺疾病构成重大诊断挑战。鉴于治疗策略和预后存在显著差异，准确鉴别对于避免不必要的手术并确保及时启动抗癌治疗至关重要。本研究旨在利用既往建立的多中心数据库，收集多个中心确诊f-AIP或PDAC患者的内镜超声（EUS）图像。2026年1月之前收集的数据将用于开发基于EUS影像组学的人工智能（AI）模型以进行鉴别诊断。随后，参与中心自2026年起前瞻性收集的数据将用于模型测试和验证。将评估该模型的诊断性能，并与不同经验水平的内镜医师进行比较。此外，本研究将探讨可解释影像组学特征的临床价值，特别关注具有挑战性的诊断场景，包括IgG4阴性AIP、碳水化合物抗原19-9（CA19-9）升高的AIP以及影像学特征类似AIP的PDAC。最终目标是提供一种可靠工具，用于准确、无创的术前鉴别诊断，同时促进多中心AIP数据库的标准化以及影像数据资源的共享和利用。

title: Clinical Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Management of Chronic Hepatitis B.
source: PubMed · Journal of gastroenterology and hepatology
zh_title: 人工智能在慢性乙型肝炎管理中的临床应用
summary: 该综述讨论AI在慢性乙型肝炎筛查、诊断、风险分层与肝癌监测等管理环节的应用空间。
key_points: 慢性乙肝管理在筛查与诊断上仍有缺口
既往多用传统统计方法构建风险预测
AI有望改善筛查与抗病毒决策等环节
reason: 疾病管理类综述，无原始数据或外部验证，属增量档。
abstract: [Journal of gastroenterology and hepatology] Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) burdens the healthcare system, affecting millions of individuals worldwide with a potential progression to complications such as cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The World Health Organization launched the chronic viral hepatitis elimination plan which aimed to eliminate chronic hepatitis B virus by 2030, yet the goal has seemed to be far from reach with the remaining few years owing to different hurdles ranging from screening strategy and diagnosis to risk stratification for antiviral treatment and HCC surveillance. To refine the management of CHB, previous studies focused on identifying the at-risk populations and predictors for adverse outcomes using conventional statistical methods. With the emerging role of artificial intelligence (AI), there is further room to improve different aspects of screening and management. For instance, generative AI, such as large language models (LLMs), has been proven to have the ability to answer different clinical questions, assisting patients' and physicians' decision on various clinical scenarios. Different machine learning and deep learning models have also been developed to assess for liver fibrosis, as well as to aid segmentation of liver structures and detection of focal liver lesions through various imaging modalities. While different AI models have shown superior performance compared to those developed through traditional statistical models, the lack of standardized datasets in training cohorts and the unresolved concerns of hallucination of false information in LLMs pose challenges on applying AI in the current management of CHB, in which further studies are required to adopt AI into daily clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Journal of gastroenterology and hepatology] 慢性乙型肝炎（CHB）给医疗系统带来负担，影响全球数百万个体，并可能进展为肝硬化、肝细胞癌（HCC）等并发症。世界卫生组织启动了慢性病毒性肝炎消除计划，旨在到2030年消除慢性乙型肝炎病毒，但由于从筛查策略和诊断到抗病毒治疗的风险分层和HCC监测等不同障碍，在剩余几年内该目标似乎仍遥不可及。为改进CHB的管理，既往研究侧重于使用传统统计方法识别高危人群和不良结局的预测因素。随着人工智能（AI）作用的显现，在筛查和管理的不同方面仍有进一步改进空间。例如，生成式AI，如大语言模型（LLMs），已被证明有能力回答不同临床问题，协助患者和医师在各种临床场景中做出决策。还开发了不同的机器学习和深度学习模型，用于评估肝纤维化，以及通过多种影像模态辅助肝脏结构分割和局灶性肝脏病变检测。虽然不同AI模型相比通过传统统计模型开发的模型显示出更优性能，但训练队列缺乏标准化数据集以及LLMs中虚假信息幻觉这一未解决问题，对在当前CHB管理中应用AI构成挑战，需要进一步研究以将AI纳入日常临床实践。

title: Richer database context improves LLM-generated EHR phenotyping algorithms
zh_title: 更丰富的数据库上下文提升LLM生成EHR表型算法表现
summary: 预印本评估8个公开LLM系统生成2型糖尿病表型SQL，发现提供详细码表可显著提升SQL可执行率。
key_points: 8个LLM系统生成T2DM表型SQL
有限上下文时多数输出无法直接执行
详码表使可执行率升至81.3%–100%
reason: 方法有新意、有参考表型对比，但为预印本且仅单中心EHR，属值得一看档
abstract: Objective: To evaluate large language model (LLM) generation of type 2 diabetes (T2DM) phenotyping SQL and the effect of database implementation context. Materials and Methods: Eight publicly accessible LLM-based systems generated SQL under progressively richer prompts using synthetic and University of North Carolina (UNC) Health electronic health record (EHR) data, both based on the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) model. Outputs were compared with the Electronic Medical Records and Genomics (eMERGE) T2DM reference phenotype using SQL executability, F1, positive predictive value (PPV), and recall. Results: Fewer than 55% of limited-context synthetic outputs and no limited-context UNC EHR outputs executed without modification. Detailed codebooks (L3) increased executability to 81.3% in synthetic OMOP and 100% in UNC EHR; adding sample rows (L4) increased synthetic executability to 100%. Limited-context recall was as low as 0.01, whereas high-context outputs achieved recall [≥]0.99 at synthetic L4 and >0.90 at UNC L3, although UNC PPV remained substantially lower than recall. At the highest available context levels, Beta F1 ranged from 0.72-0.99 in synthetic OMOP and 0.57-0.68 in UNC EHR; all UNC models exceeded the diagnosis-code baseline (F1=0.54). The top synthetic performer fell from F1=0.99 to 0.64 on UNC EHR. Discussion: Richer database context was associated with more consistent SQL executability and recall, while model rankings varied across datasets. Conclusion: LLMs can generate clinically meaningful T2DM phenotyping SQL when provided with sufficient database context, but limited PPV in real-world data underscores the need for local validation.
zh_abstract: 【目的】评估大语言模型（LLM）生成 2 型糖尿病（T2DM）表型 SQL 的能力，以及数据库实施情境的影响。【材料与方法】八种可公开访问的基于 LLM 的系统在逐步更丰富的提示下，使用基于观察性医疗结果合作组织（OMOP）模型的合成数据和北卡罗来纳大学（UNC）Health 电子健康记录（EHR）数据生成 SQL。将输出与电子病历与基因组学（eMERGE）T2DM 参考表型进行比较，指标包括 SQL 可执行性、F1、阳性预测值（PPV）和召回率。【结果】有限上下文的合成数据输出中不足 55% 可在未经修改的情况下执行，而有限上下文的 UNC EHR 输出中没有一项可未经修改执行。详细的代码本（L3）将可执行性提高到合成 OMOP 中的 81.3% 和 UNC EHR 中的 100%；添加样本行（L4）将合成数据可执行性提高到 100%。有限上下文的召回率低至 0.01，而高上下文输出在合成 L4 中达到召回率 ≥0.99，在 UNC L3 中 >0.90，尽管 UNC 的 PPV 仍显著低于召回率。在可获得的最高上下文水平下，Beta F1 在合成 OMOP 中范围为 0.72-0.99，在 UNC EHR 中为 0.57-0.68；所有 UNC 模型均超过诊断代码基线（F1=0.54）。表现最好的合成数据模型在 UNC EHR 上从 F1=0.99 降至 0.64。【讨论】更丰富的数据库上下文与更一致的 SQL 可执行性和召回率相关，而模型排名在不同数据集之间有所变化。【结论】当提供足够的数据库上下文时，LLM 可以生成具有临床意义的 T2DM 表型 SQL，但真实世界数据中有限的 PPV 凸显了本地验证的必要性。

title: Ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning for explainable differential diagnosis
zh_title: 本体引导多智能体可解释鉴别诊断推理
summary: arXiv预印本提出本体引导多智能体框架，模拟医师迭代推理以提升鉴别诊断可解释性。
key_points: 针对LLM依赖模式识别、依据不足的问题
本体引导多智能体复现医师迭代推理过程
目标是使诊断结论可追溯、可供临床评估
reason: 有新意的多智能体可解释方法预印本，未提供外部验证信息，属值得一看档
abstract: Effective differential diagnosis depends on well structured and unambiguous patient case descriptions, since incomplete or ambiguous clinical information readily leads to diagnostic errors and inconsistent reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown promising capabilities in medical question answering and clinical reasoning; however, even when achieving competitive performance on medical benchmarks, they often rely on pattern recognition learned from training data rather than grounded clinical evidence, and can generate plausible yet unsupported diagnostic conclusions. Their reasoning remains largely opaque, making it difficult for clinicians to assess the evidence and rationale behind a given recommendation. To address this gap, we propose an ontology-guided, multiagent differential diagnosis framework that replicates the iterative reasoning process of physicians. The framework grounds diagnostic inference in a structured, expert-curated medical knowledge base, enabling interpretation of symptoms, clinical findings, or disease relationships, while decomposing diagnosis into explicit, auditable reasoning steps. This ontology-based grounding constrains inference to evidence-backed associations, reducing hallucination and improving diagnostic transparency, traceability, and consistency. The system then identifies the most discriminative missing symptoms and generates targeted follow-up questions to reduce uncertainty through a process that mirrors to clinical inquiry. Together, these components improve the reliability, explainability, and diagnostic accuracy of AI-assisted differential diagnosis. The source code is publicly available.
zh_abstract: 有效的鉴别诊断依赖于结构良好且无歧义的患者病例描述，因为不完整或模糊的临床信息很容易导致诊断错误和不一致的推理。大型语言模型（LLMs）最近在医学问答和临床推理方面显示出有前景的能力；然而，即使在医学基准测试中达到有竞争力的表现，它们也常常依赖从训练数据中学到的模式识别，而非有依据的临床证据，并可能生成看似合理但缺乏支持的诊断结论。其推理在很大程度上仍不透明，使临床医生难以评估某一推荐背后的证据和理由。为解决这一差距，我们提出了一种本体引导的多智能体鉴别诊断框架，复现医生的迭代推理过程。该框架将诊断推断建立在结构化、由专家整理的医学知识库之上，从而能够解释症状、临床发现或疾病关系，同时将诊断分解为明确、可审计的推理步骤。这种基于本体的 grounding 将推断限制在有证据支持的关联上，减少幻觉并提高诊断透明度、可追溯性和一致性。随后，系统识别最具鉴别力的缺失症状，并生成有针对性的追问问题，通过一个镜像临床询问的过程来降低不确定性。这些组件共同提高了AI辅助鉴别诊断的可靠性、可解释性和诊断准确性。源代码公开可用。

title: Decision models can offload structured clinical tasks from large language models
zh_title: 决策模型可承接大模型的结构化临床任务
summary: 预印本探索专用决策模型Jev在死亡率风险、Choosing Wisely问题与结肠癌分期任务上替代大语言模型的效果，并与五个旗舰大模型对比。
abstract: Decision models like Jev read text and return probabilities, categories, or ordinal levels, with confidence scores for the latter two, at a fraction of large language models (LLMs) cost. We explored how Jev could be integrated into clinical workflows for all these output types: mortality risk estimation, categorical Choosing-Wisely decisions for patient questions, and ordinal colon cancer staging. With standard LLM-style inputs, Jev trailed five flagship LLMs: mortality AUROC was 0.822 versus 0.837-0.846; Choosing-Wisely accuracy, 87.7% versus 98.4-100%; and staging accuracy, 45.4% versus 94.2-100%. Developer-recommended input alterations improved staging accuracy to 75.8% with medical context, 82.1% with task decomposition, and 85.8% with both. None of Jevs staging errors had full confidence. Using Jev for fully confident staging decisions and LLMs for the rest was non-inferior to each LLM alone and cut flagship LLM costs by 33-44%. Prompted as designed, decision models may efficiently share structured clinical tasks with LLMs.

标准输入下分期准确率45.4%，LLM为94.2–100%
按开发者建议改写输入后分期准确率最高达85.8%

zh_abstract: 像Jev这样的决策模型读取文本并返回概率、类别或有序等级，对后两者还给出置信度分数，其成本仅为大型语言模型（LLMs）的一小部分。我们探索了如何将Jev整合到针对所有这些输出类型的临床工作流程中：死亡风险估计、针对患者问题的分类式Choosing Wisely决策，以及有序结肠癌分期。采用标准LLM风格输入时，Jev落后于五个旗舰LLM：死亡风险AUROC为0.822，而后者为0.837-0.846；Choosing Wisely准确率为87.7%，而后者为98.4-100%；分期准确率为45.4%，而后者为94.2-100%。开发者推荐的输入调整将分期准确率提高至75.8%（加入医学背景）、82.1%（任务分解）和85.8%（两者兼有）。Jev的分期错误均未具有完全置信度。将Jev用于完全置信的分期决策、LLM用于其余决策，不劣于任一LLM单独使用，并将旗舰LLM成本降低33-44%。按设计进行提示后，决策模型可与LLMs高效分担结构化临床任务。

abstract: Fundus fluorescein angiography (FFA) is the gold standard for diagnosing retinal vascular diseases. However, interpretable artificial intelligence (AI) systems for FFA image analysis that align with clinicians’ reasoning processes and real-world diagnostic workflows remain scarce. In this study, we introduce an interpretable graph reasoning framework, FFA-RGNet, that explicitly models the temporal patterns of fine-grained lesions across imaging phases and anatomical locations for disease diagnosis from sequential FFA images. FFA-RGNet was trained and validated on a large, fine-grained, multi-center dataset consisting of 25,312 FFA images from 2651 patients. FFA-RGNet outperformed nine baseline models on the internal test set, achieving an F1-score of 95.38% (95% CI: 92.24%–97.88%), and demonstrated consistent performance across multi-center and prospective validation datasets. Its diagnostic performance not only surpassed that of ophthalmologists, residents and ophthalmology students, but also improved their diagnostic F1-score by 7.48% to 14.11% when used as an assistive tool. Comprehensive inference analysis further revealed its superior ability to correctly recognize fine-grained semantic entities, and to learn stable, disease-specific graph reasoning patterns aligned with clinical knowledge. These results suggest that FFA-RGNet enables accurate diagnosis with interpretable reasoning progresses, highlighting its strong potential as a reliable AI system for FFA interpretation and clinical decision support.
zh_abstract: 眼底荧光素血管造影（fundus fluorescein angiography，FFA）是诊断视网膜血管疾病的金标准。然而，用于FFA图像分析、与临床医生推理过程和真实世界诊断工作流程相一致的可解释人工智能（AI）系统仍然稀缺。在本研究中，我们介绍了一个可解释的图推理框架FFA-RGNet，该框架明确建模细粒度病变在成像阶段和解剖位置上的时间模式，以从序列FFA图像中进行疾病诊断。FFA-RGNet在一个大型、细粒度、多中心数据集上进行了训练和验证，该数据集包含来自2651例患者的25,312张FFA图像。FFA-RGNet在内部测试集上优于九个基线模型，达到95.38%的F1分数（95% CI：92.24%–97.88%），并在多中心和前瞻性验证数据集上表现一致。其诊断性能不仅超过了眼科医生、住院医师和眼科学生，而且作为辅助工具使用时，将其诊断F1分数提高了7.48%至14.11%。全面的推理分析进一步揭示了其正确识别细粒度语义实体以及学习与临床知识一致的、稳定的疾病特异性图推理模式的优越能力。这些结果表明，FFA-RGNet能够以可解释的推理过程实现准确诊断，突显其作为用于FFA解读和临床决策支持的可靠AI系统的强大潜力。

abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into clinical medical imaging has advanced diagnostics but also poses challenges in maintaining long-term reliability as input data change. To address this, we present MMC+, a modular framework for scalable drift monitoring that builds on our CheXstray framework for real-time drift detection using multi-modal data concordance (MMC). MMC+ provides a flexible architecture that enables cost-effective continuous performance monitoring in real-world healthcare settings. The framework’s capabilities include aggregating information from multiple data streams using statistical tests or distance metrics, leveraging foundation model embeddings to remove the need for site-specific encoder training, and quantifying uncertainty to better communicate drift significance. Validated with data from Massachusetts General Hospital during the COVID-19 pandemic, MMC+ effectively detects significant data shifts that correlate with performance changes and indicates when AI systems may deviate from acceptable performance bounds. The code for MMC+ is publicly available (Link: https://github.com/FJDorfner/MedImaging-ModelDriftMonitoring/tree/MMC_plus ), promoting broader adoption of AI solutions in clinical settings. Our framework significantly advances drift detection while promoting transparency and collaboration in clinical AI research.
zh_abstract: 将人工智能（AI）整合到临床医学影像中促进了诊断，但也带来了在输入数据变化时保持长期可靠性的挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出MMC+，这是一个可扩展漂移监测的模块化框架，建立在我们CheXstray框架之上，该框架利用多模态数据一致性（multi-modal data concordance，MMC）进行实时漂移检测。MMC+提供了一种灵活的架构，可在真实世界医疗环境中实现具有成本效益的持续性能监测。该框架的能力包括：使用统计检验或距离度量聚合来自多个数据流的信息，利用基础模型嵌入以消除对站点特定编码器训练的需求，以及量化不确定性以更好地传达漂移显著性。MMC+在COVID-19大流行期间使用马萨诸塞州总医院（Massachusetts General Hospital）的数据进行了验证，能够有效检测与性能变化相关的显著数据偏移，并指示AI系统何时可能偏离可接受的性能界限。MMC+的代码已公开（链接：https://github.com/FJDorfner/MedImaging-ModelDriftMonitoring/tree/MMC_plus ），促进AI解决方案在临床环境中的更广泛采用。我们的框架显著推进了漂移检测，同时促进了临床AI研究的透明性和合作。

title: MedJev: Evaluating Zero-Shot System-One Decision Making in Medicine
zh_title: MedJev：医学零样本System One决策评测
summary: 预印本在十个医学基准上评测开源System One模型MedJev，报告其在知识问答与院内死亡预测上的表现。

院内死亡AUROC 0.926，高于XGBoost 0.902

reason: 多基准对比公开模型与监督模型，但为预印本、无临床结局
abstract: System One decision models such as Jev answer structured questions in a single forward pass without generating text, offering fast and computationally efficient clinical decision support. We evaluate MedJev, an open System One model that runs locally on a laptop, across ten medical benchmarks spanning medical knowledge, diagnosis, and patient level prediction using MIMIC IV and MIMIC IV ED. We compare MedJev against zero shot LLM baselines, published GPT results, and supervised models. MedJev achieves accuracies of 72.5 percent on MedQA, 75.4 percent on USMLE, and 80.1 percent on NEJM, approaching published GPT 4 performance while maintaining well calibrated confidence estimates (ECE 0.028 to 0.063). On patient level tasks, MedJev achieves an AUROC of 0.926 for In Hospital Mortality, exceeding XGBoost (0.902), but underperforms supervised models on operational outcomes such as ED Triage Admission (0.745 vs. 0.809). Patient level predictions also exhibit substantial miscalibration (In Hospital Mortality ECE 0.286). We introduce a lightweight, two parameter recalibration method that adapts predictions to local patient populations using 50 to 200 labeled examples, reducing ECE to 0.007. Our findings establish open System One models as a promising zero shot baseline for medical AI, combining competitive predictive performance with low computational cost and efficient local calibration. We release our code and evaluation harness to support future research.
zh_abstract: System One决策模型（如Jev）在单次前向传递中回答结构化问题而不生成文本，提供快速且计算高效的临床决策支持。我们评估MedJev——一种可在笔记本电脑本地运行的开放式System One模型——在跨越医学知识、诊断和患者层面预测的十项医学基准上，使用MIMIC IV和MIMIC IV ED。我们将MedJev与零样本LLM基线、已发表的GPT结果以及监督模型进行比较。MedJev在MedQA上达到72.5%的准确率，在USMLE上达到75.4%，在NEJM上达到80.1%，接近已发表的GPT 4性能，同时保持校准良好的置信度估计（ECE 0.028至0.063）。在患者层面任务中，MedJev在院内死亡率（In Hospital Mortality）上达到0.926的AUROC，超过XGBoost（0.902），但在急诊分诊入院（ED Triage Admission）等运营结局上表现不及监督模型（0.745 vs. 0.809）。患者层面预测还表现出显著的校准不良（院内死亡率ECE 0.286）。我们引入一种轻量级、双参数的重校准方法，使用50至200个有标签样本使预测适应当地患者人群，将ECE降至0.007。我们的发现确立开放式System One模型作为医学AI有前景的零样本基线，将具有竞争力的预测性能与低计算成本和高效本地校准相结合。我们发布代码和评估工具（evaluation harness）以支持未来研究。

abstract: [The Journal of international medical research] Hepatitis remains a major global health challenge and an important contributor to liver fibrosis, cirrhosis, hepatocellular carcinoma, and liver-related mortality worldwide. Early diagnosis, effective treatment selection, and accurate prognostic stratification remain critical unmet needs in clinical hepatology. Artificial intelligence, particularly machine learning and deep learning, has emerged as a promising approach to addressing these challenges through the integration and analysis of large-scale, heterogeneous biomedical datasets. This narrative review synthesizes advances in artificial intelligence applications in hepatitis research and clinical practice published over the past decade, organized across three clinical domains: diagnosis, treatment optimization, and prognosis prediction. In the diagnostic domain, artificial intelligence-based approaches have been applied to medical imaging, digital pathology, and multi-omics data to enhance the detection, classification, and staging of liver disease. In the therapeutic domain, machine learning models have been increasingly deployed to support drug discovery, optimize therapeutic regimens, and predict individual treatment responses. In the prognostic domain, artificial intelligence-driven models have shown promising performance in predicting disease progression, survival outcomes, and clinical complications. Nevertheless, key limitations persist, including data heterogeneity, limited external generalizability, and barriers to clinical translation. Future progress will depend on prospective multicenter evaluation, use of interoperable multimodal data, development of transparent models that account for uncertainty, and evidence that artificial intelligence improves clinical decisions and patient outcomes rather than performance metrics alone.
zh_abstract: ［《国际医学研究杂志》（The Journal of International Medical Research）］肝炎仍是全球重大健康挑战，也是全球肝纤维化、肝硬化、肝细胞癌和肝脏相关死亡的重要促成因素。早期诊断、有效治疗选择以及准确的预后分层仍是临床肝病学中关键且未被满足的需求。人工智能，尤其是机器学习和深度学习，通过整合和分析大规模、异质性生物医学数据集，已成为应对这些挑战的有前景的方法。本叙述性综述综合了过去十年发表的肝炎研究和临床实践中人工智能应用进展，按三个临床领域组织：诊断、治疗优化和预后预测。在诊断领域，基于人工智能的方法已应用于医学影像、数字病理学和多组学数据，以增强肝病的检测、分类和分期。在治疗领域，机器学习模型越来越多地被部署用于支持药物发现、优化治疗方案和预测个体治疗反应。在预后领域，人工智能驱动的模型在预测疾病进展、生存结局和临床并发症方面显示出有希望的性能。然而，关键局限性仍然存在，包括数据异质性、有限的外部可推广性以及临床转化障碍。未来的进展将取决于前瞻性多中心评估、使用可互操作的多模态数据、开发能够考虑不确定性的透明模型，以及证明人工智能改善临床决策和患者结局而不仅仅是性能指标的证据。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Scarborough Health Network; conditions: Patient Discharge, Health Literacy; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 52; status: RECRUITING] This randomized pilot study will compare standard hospital discharge communication with discharge summaries simplified using ContextCare, an artificial intelligence-assisted application. The study will enroll 50 adults discharged from Scarborough Health Network. Participants will be assigned to one of two groups in a 1:1 ratio, with allocation stratified by baseline health literacy. abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Nantes University Hospital; conditions: Bacteremia; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 8765; status: COMPLETED] Bacteremia, a common infection associated with high morbidity and mortality, requires prompt and appropriate antibiotic treatment. The Nantes University Hospital Center has operated a Biomedical Data Warehouse (BDW) since 2018. The growing availability of data through BDWs thus enables the development of decision-support tools based on machine learning. The primary objective of the OPTIBact project is to predict the optimal empirical antibiotic for hospitalized patients with bacteremia using a machine learning-based predictive model using data from the Nantes University Hospital's BDW. As secondary objectives, the study aims: * To compare the performance of the predictive model for the optimal empirical antibiotic against standard patient care * To estimate the expected benefit of the predictive model compared to real-world practice in terms of clinical outcomes * To predict the optimal dosage of empirical antibiotic therapy * To compare the performance of the predictive model for optimal empirical antibiotic therapy dosing with standard patient care * To describe inpatient patients in Nantes University Hospital who received optimal antibiotic therapy and those who did not * To Identify predictors of antibiotic resistance in bacteria isolated from blood cultures, stratified by pathogen type.

abstract: [Dentistry journal] Background: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly growing in the field of dental medicine and in oral and maxillofacial surgery (OMS). The aim of the present review is to assess current applications of AI in OMS, to evaluate their advantages and limitations, and to identify areas requiring further research. Materials and Methods: A comprehensive search was conducted using PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar, with targeted keywords including "artificial intelligence," "deep learning," "machine learning," "oral surgery," "maxillofacial surgery," and "diagnosis "Artificial Intelligence" OR "Machine Learning" OR "Deep Learning" AND "Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery" OR "Oral Surgery" OR "Maxillofacial Surgery" AND "Diagnosis". Of 308 identified studies, 37 met the inclusion criteria focusing on AI-assisted detection interpretation and surgical planning in OMS. Results: AI is effective in identifying anatomical landmarks, evaluating lesions and cysts, diagnosing bone disease like medication-related osteonecrosis of jaws (MRONJ), planning dental implants, and aiding in the classification of fractures and temporomandibular joint (TMJ) disorders. AI can match or outperform human experts in various diagnostic tasks, particularly in panoramic and cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) image analysis. AI shows promise in early detection of impacted and supernumerary teeth, maxillofacial pathologies, neoplastic conditions, and soft tissue calcifications. Limitations: However, substantial methodological heterogeneity, inconsistent reporting of AI performance metrics, and limited external validation across the included studies constrain direct comparison of results and assessment of the generalizability of reported AI performance. Conclusions: AI may assist clinicians in diagnostic and treatment-related decision-making, but current evidence does not support its use as a replacement for comprehensive clinical assessment and professional judgment.
zh_abstract: [牙科期刊]【背景】人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）在牙医学以及口腔颌面外科（oral and maxillofacial surgery, OMS）领域的使用正在迅速增长。本综述旨在评估AI在OMS中的当前应用，评价其优势与局限性，并识别需要进一步研究的领域。【材料与方法】使用PubMed、Scopus和Google Scholar进行了全面检索，目标关键词包括“artificial intelligence”“deep learning”“machine learning”“oral surgery”“maxillofacial surgery”和“diagnosis ‘Artificial Intelligence’ OR ‘Machine Learning’ OR ‘Deep Learning’ AND ‘Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery’ OR ‘Oral Surgery’ OR ‘Maxillofacial Surgery’ AND ‘Diagnosis’”。在308项已识别研究中，37项符合纳入标准，聚焦于OMS中AI辅助的检测解读和手术规划。【结果】AI在识别解剖标志、评估病变和囊肿、诊断药物相关性颌骨坏死（medication-related osteonecrosis of jaws, MRONJ）等骨病、规划牙种植体以及辅助骨折和颞下颌关节（temporomandibular joint, TMJ）疾病分类方面有效。AI在各种诊断任务中可达到或超过人类专家，尤其是在全景和锥形束计算机断层扫描（cone-beam computed tomography, CBCT）图像分析中。AI在阻生牙和多生牙、颌面部病变、肿瘤性疾病以及软组织钙化的早期检测中显示出前景。【局限性】然而，纳入研究之间存在显著的方法学异质性、AI性能指标报告不一致以及外部验证有限，限制了结果的直接比较和对所报告AI性能泛化能力的评估。【结论】AI可能辅助临床医生进行诊断和治疗相关决策，但当前证据不支持将其作为全面临床评估和专业判断的替代。

title: Instability as Signal: Diagnosing Latent Heterogeneity in Multimodal Survival Models
zh_title: 多模态生存模型的不稳定性作为诊断信号
summary: 预印本以TCGA-BRCA多模态融合模型为探针，分析生存预测不稳定的来源并识别稳定潜在亚组。
abstract: Multimodal deep learning models for cancer survival prediction frequently exhibit unstable and irreproducible performance, limiting their clinical applicability. Rather than proposing a new predictive architecture, this work presents a diagnostic investigation into the sources of this instability. Using a transformer-based deep fusion model combining RNA sequencing and histopathology data from the TCGA-BRCA cohort as a diagnostic probe, we demonstrate that global survival prediction is highly unstable across data splits. We then analyze the learned multimodal embeddings in an unsupervised manner, revealing stable latent patient subgroups with significantly divergent survival outcomes. These subgroups are not explained by canonical receptor status or immune infiltration, but instead align with tumor-intrinsic proliferative activity. Conditioning survival modeling on the largest discovered subgroup recovers strong and stable prognostic performance, substantially outperforming unimodal baselines. These findings indicate that survival predictability is conditional on latent heterogeneity and suggest that heterogeneity-aware modeling strategies are essential for robust multimodal prognostication. This work establishes a methodological framework for interpreting instability in multimodal survival learning.

zh_abstract: 用于癌症生存预测的多模态深度学习模型经常表现出不稳定且不可重复的性能，限制了其临床适用性。本工作并非提出新的预测架构，而是对这种不稳定性的来源进行诊断性研究。我们使用一个基于Transformer的深度融合模型，该模型结合TCGA-BRCA队列的RNA测序和组织病理学数据，作为诊断探针，证明全局生存预测在不同数据划分间高度不稳定。然后，我们以无监督方式分析学习到的多模态嵌入，揭示了具有显著不同生存结局的稳定潜在患者亚组。这些亚组不能由经典受体状态或免疫浸润解释，而是与肿瘤内在的增殖活性一致。以发现的最大亚组为条件进行生存建模，可恢复强且稳定的预后性能，显著优于单模态基线。这些发现表明，生存可预测性以潜在异质性为条件，并提示异质性感知建模策略对于稳健的多模态预后至关重要。本工作为解释多模态生存学习中的不稳定性建立了一个方法学框架。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University of Oxford; conditions: Artificial Intelligence Perception and Attitude; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 30; status: ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION] Background: AI (artificial intelligence) tools are increasingly used to help clinicians interpret medical images such as X-rays, scans, skin photographs and eye images. In most cases the AI does not work alone: a clinician makes the final decision, using the AI as support. Before these tools are used in the NHS, they must be tested to show they are safe and helpful. They are usually tested in a "reader study", where several clinicians each interpret the same set of images, sometimes with the AI's help and sometimes without, so performance can be compared. These studies tend to focus on whether the diagnosis was correct. However, accuracy alone may not measure everything that matters. For example, what happens when the AI gets it wrong, whether clinicians rely on it too much or too little, or how the tool affects efficiency. At present there is no agreed standard for what these studies should measure, so important things are often missed and studies are hard to compare. Aim: The aim of this study is to find out, by talking to people with different perspectives, which outcomes are important when evaluating AI tools that help clinicians read medical images. Objectives: 1. Explore which outcomes people think matter when judging whether an AI tools is safe and good enough to use 2. Understand the reasons behind their views 3. Explore how priorities differ between groups, such as patients and developers. The output will be a list of important candidate outcomes, which will feed into a future project to agree a recommended set of outcomes for these studies (a "core outcome set"). Research value: Without agreement on what to measure, studies of AI tools may overlook outcomes that matter, and their results are difficult to compare and combine. Hearing directly from the people affected, rather than relying only on what previous studies happened to measure, helps ensure the recommended set reflects people's priorities. This will lead to better-designed studies and AI tools that are safer and more useful in practice. Outline of the research: The investigators will interview 24-30 people who have a stake in how these tools are tested and used, including clinicians, researchers, developers, people involved in regulation, and patients and members of the public. Interviews will last 45-60 minutes and will take place using Microsoft Teams. The investigators will ask people what they think is important to measure and why, and then explore which of those things could realist

title: Provider Experiences with AI Clinical Decision Support in eSanjeevani

summary: 预印本基于2025年7月项目反馈问卷调查，分析印度远程医疗eSanjeevani中不同角色对AI鉴别诊断建议的体验。
abstract: BackgroundClinical decision support systems (CDSS) are increasingly embedded in national telemedicine services, however how different stakeholders who use them experience these tools, particularly in low-and middle-income countries, is less explored. In the assisted model of Indias eSanjeevani service, spoke health workers enter structured symptoms and hub clinicians review a symptom summary and an artificial intelligence (AI)-generated differential diagnosis. ObjectiveTo describe role-specific experiences of eSanjeevanis CDSS functions and to estimate how acceptance coexists with specific reported difficulties within each role. MethodsWe analyzed a program feedback web survey completed between 11 July and 29 July, 2025 by hub clinicians and spoke providers. abstract: Deep learning shows promise for breast cancer diagnosis, but limited interpretability hinders clinical adoption. We benchmark ten ImageNet-pretrained models (ResNet50, VGG19, InceptionV3, DenseNet121, Xception, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, ViT, and Swin Transformer) for benign-versus-malignant classification on the BreakHis histopathology dataset using a patient-level split, and explain their predictions with Grad-CAM, LIME, Integrated Gradients, and LRP. DenseNet121 performed best, with 99.4% test accuracy and an AUC-ROC of 0.999, and significantly outperformed all other models (p < 0.001). Transformer-based models trailed the CNNs. The explanations consistently highlighted nuclei-rich and glandular regions of diagnostic relevance. Combining transfer learning with explainable AI can thus yield accurate, interpretable tools for breast cancer diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 深度学习在乳腺癌诊断中显示出前景，但有限的可解释性阻碍了临床采用。我们在BreakHis组织病理学数据集上，使用患者水平划分，对十种ImageNet预训练模型（ResNet50、VGG19、InceptionV3、DenseNet121、Xception、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet、ConvNeXt、ViT和Swin Transformer）进行良性与恶性分类的基准测试，并用Grad-CAM、LIME、Integrated Gradients和LRP解释其预测。DenseNet121表现最佳，测试准确率为99.4%，AUC-ROC为0.999，并显著优于所有其他模型（p < 0.001）。基于Transformer的模型落后于CNN。这些解释一致地突出了具有诊断相关性的富含细胞核区域和腺体区域。因此，将迁移学习与可解释AI相结合，可以产生准确、可解释的乳腺癌诊断工具。

abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems for fracture detection perform strongly in controlled settings, but prospective real-world evidence is limited. In a three-month deployment in one emergency department, thirteen radiographers in a radiographer-led screening programme independently interpreted 2496 consecutive musculoskeletal examinations (one radiographer per examination), reviewed output from a commercial deep-learning system, then recorded a final decision, giving 2496 paired reads against a radiologist reference standard. Standalone AI sensitivity was 75.6%, falling to 46.2% for subtle fractures, below the radiographers’ baseline sensitivity of 91.6%. Radiographers’ baseline accuracy was high (97.6%; specificity 99.0%) and improved modestly with AI assistance (98.0%; exact McNemar p = 0.0064). With AI assistance, radiographers corrected 11 errors and introduced 1, a net gain of 10 cases. Subgroup gains were directionally consistent but not significant after correction. Radiographers changed their decision in only 11 of 729 discordant cases, and most negative interactions were correct AI recommendations not adopted. No or incomplete AI output was returned for 8.8% of acquired examinations. AI assistance delivered a small, selective benefit arising from complementary rather than superior algorithmic performance. Operational reliability proved as consequential as diagnostic accuracy, and behavioural inferences rest on few events. Downstream clinical outcomes were not measured.
zh_abstract: 用于骨折检测的人工智能（AI）系统在受控环境中表现强劲，但前瞻性真实世界证据有限。在一个急诊科为期三个月的部署中，13名放射技师在由放射技师主导的筛查项目中独立解读了2496次连续的肌肉骨骼检查（每次检查由一名放射技师解读），审查了商业深度学习系统的输出，然后记录最终决定，从而产生了2496次与放射科医生参考标准配对的判读。独立AI的敏感度为75.6%，对于细微骨折降至46.2%，低于放射技师的基线敏感度91.6%。放射技师的基线准确率高（97.6%；特异度99.0%），并在AI辅助下略有提高（98.0%；精确McNemar p = 0.0064）。在AI辅助下，放射技师纠正了11个错误并引入了1个错误，净增加10例。亚组获益方向一致，但校正后不显著。放射技师仅在729例不一致病例中的11例改变了决定，大多数负向交互是未采纳正确的AI建议。8.8%的已采集检查返回了无AI输出或不完整AI输出。AI辅助带来了小幅、选择性的获益，其来源于互补而非优越的算法性能。操作可靠性与诊断准确性同样重要，而行为推断仅基于少数事件。未测量下游临床结局。

summary: IEEE TMI论文提出MPM-Reg，用掩码位置建模预训练纯Transformer可变形配准模型，实现跨模态、跨解剖部位的迁移。
key_points: 指出配准任务缺乏合适预训练方案，ViT基础模型应用受限

abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] The core objective of deformable image registration (DIR), estimating a displacement vector field that aligns two images, is fundamentally the same across imaging modalities and anatomical regions. Although this shared objective should imply the use of foundation models, most deep learning approaches for DIR operate within narrow domain-specific settings. Vision Transformers (ViTs) are the predominant choice for foundation models in many image processing tasks due to their excellent generalization capabilities and robustness to domain shifts. However, their use remains largely underexplored for DIR, which we attribute to a lack of suitable pre-training schemes. To address this need, we introduce MPM-Reg, a transferable, modality-agnostic training paradigm based on masked position modeling (MPM), enabling the use of fully transformer-based models as foundation models for image registration. Unlike conventional masked data modeling, which predicts the content of masked image patches, MPM masks the positional information and predicts the spatial relationship between image patches. Initially, we employ MPM on single images, which naturally aligns self-supervised pre-training of ViTs with the downstream registration task. Subsequently, we extend MPM to predict the positions of target patches within source images, re-formulating DIR through the lens of MPM. Experiments across eleven diverse datasets demonstrate MPM-Reg's competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Crucially, MPM-Reg benefits from heterogeneous multi-domain data, which degrades the performance of existing methods, paving the way for scalable foundation models for DIR.
zh_abstract: [IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging] 可变形图像配准（DIR）的核心目标是估计一个使两幅图像对齐的位移向量场，这一目标在成像模态和解剖区域之间从根本上相同。尽管这一共同目标应意味着使用基础模型，但大多数用于 DIR 的深度学习方法仍在狭窄的特定领域设置中运行。视觉 Transformer（ViT）因其出色的泛化能力以及对领域偏移的鲁棒性，在许多图像处理任务中是基础模型的主要选择。然而，它们在 DIR 中的使用仍很大程度上未被充分探索，我们将其归因于缺乏合适的预训练方案。为满足这一需求，我们提出 MPM-Reg，一种基于掩码位置建模（MPM）的可迁移、模态无关的训练范式，使完全基于 Transformer 的模型能够作为图像配准的基础模型。与预测掩码图像块内容的传统掩码数据建模不同，MPM 掩蔽位置信息并预测图像块之间的空间关系。首先，我们在单幅图像上使用 MPM，这自然地将 ViT 的自监督预训练与下游配准任务对齐。随后，我们将 MPM 扩展为预测源图像中目标图像块的位置，通过 MPM 的视角重新表述 DIR。在十一个多样化数据集上的实验表明，MPM-Reg 与最先进基线相比具有有竞争力的性能。关键是，MPM-Reg 受益于异构多领域数据，而这些数据会降低现有方法的性能，从而为可扩展的 DIR 基础模型铺平道路。
